article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يفلت من السيطرة.. ثلاث عقبات تحطم جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus slips out of control... three obstacles derail containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths. The outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with Ituri accounting for 76% of cases and hosting about 1 million of the 5 million IDPs in the east. It is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC, more than double the 2018–2020 epidemic. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the current strain, and detection is hampered by limited diagnostics and late case finding. Transmission occurs in conflict affected areas where population movement and displacement camps complicate tracing and isolation; attacks on health workers further hinder response. Protection monitors logged 369 incidents from March–June 2026, including 178 assaults and 38 gender-based violence cases. In Blink Savo camp, latrines work for only a third of shelters, and only one borehole serves about 80,000 residents. Cross-border movement with Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda raises import/export risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが制御不能に…封じ込めを阻む3つの障害
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,067例・死亡3,901例に達し、7州に拡大、ワクチン・特効薬がない史上最大規模の流行であり、国境を越えた拡散リスクも高いためIHR複数基準・WPRO複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダとの越境移動による拡散リスクが指摘されているが、これらの国での感染確認情報はなく対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。現行株に対するワクチン・特効薬がない点、紛争地域での対応困難（医療従事者への攻撃、避難民キャンプの衛生状態悪化）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat, Ini Gejala dan Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the Rise: Here Are the Symptoms and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Indonesia. As of 26 September 2026 (week 37), influenza positivity among ILI surveillance reached 58.59%, up from 53.71% the prior week. Of 198 specimens tested, 105 were Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and 7 were Influenza A(H3N2). The A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in the country. By week 37, 188 cases have been reported across 20 provinces, highest in Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan. Subclade K predominates in children aged 0–4, 5–9, and 10–17 years. Allianz Life Indonesia reports influenza-related hospitalisations up 47% in Jan–Aug 2026 vs 2025, with claims over Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases through early September 2026. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, myalgia, fatigue; children may have nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, masking when ill, good ventilation, vaccination, and seeking medical care for warning symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA増加中：症状と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09、H3N2 subclade K）の陽性率・入院数が増加しているが、現時点では通常の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は不足している。新亜系統の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H3N2 subclade Kという新しい亜系統が小児に多く検出されている点は注視が必要。死亡者数や重症度の詳細、政府の対応状況についての情報が不足しているため、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Agusan del Sur health officials declare dengue outbreak
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak declared in Agusan del Sur, Philippines on Sept 29, 2026 after rising dengue activity, hospitalizations, severe cases, and deaths. As of 01 Oct 2026, 674 dengue cases have been recorded in just over seven months, with a surge since August. The declaration triggers intensified response activities in collaboration with DOH-CHD Caraga, local government units, health facilities, and partner organizations, including enhanced dengue surveillance, case investigation, vector control, community mobilization, and risk communication. Authorities are implementing the 4S Strategy as part of the collective response to prevent further transmission in the province. The article highlights ongoing outbreak status and underscores coordinated public health efforts to curb dengue in Agusan del Sur.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:アグサン・デル・スル州保健当局がデング熱アウトブレイクを宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン一州での季節性デング熱流行であり重症例・死亡を伴うが、例年発生する既知の疾患で国際的拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節性に毎年流行する既知の疾患。674例・重症例・死亡が報告され地方自治体がアウトブレイク宣言し4Sストラテジーで対応中だが、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない規模。

article.articleHeadline: Five-Year Study Reveals How Respiratory Pathogens Resurged After COVID-19
article.articleSummary: China-based five-year retrospective study of 9,674 patients with acute respiratory infection treated 2021–2025, from Hebei General Hospital and Hebei Medical University, shows suppression of pathogen circulation during strict NPIs, then a surge after relaxation, following China's December 2022 lifting of non-pharmaceutical interventions. Using a uniform multiplex fluorescence PCR panel detecting 11 respiratory viruses plus Mycoplasma pneumoniae and Chlamydia, lower respiratory tract infections (LRTI) accounted for 5,289 cases (54.67%), upper RTIs 4,385 (45.33%). Pathogens were detected in 2,939/5,289 LRTI (55.57%) vs 677/4,385 URTI (15.44%). In LRTI, Mycoplasma pneumoniae led at 954/5,289 (18.04%), rhinovirus 618 (11.68%), influenza A 456 (8.62%). In URTI, rhinovirus predominated with 224/4,385 (5.11%). After NPIs ended, positivity rose from 27.63% in 2021 to 24.38% in 2022, then 34.62% in 2023, 54.68% in 2024, and 42.11% in 2025. Odds of detection rose in 2023–2025 vs 2021. The authors discuss immunity debt and frame findings as descriptive surveillance; no direct mechanism proven.

triage.headline_ja: 5年間の研究が明らかにした、COVID-19後の呼吸器病原体の再流行
triage.triage_reason: 過去5年間（2021-2025年）の後方視的な学術研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（レトロスペクティブ研究）の紹介であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。NPI解除後の『immunity debt（免疫負債）』現象を記述的に分析した内容で、既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（マイコプラズマ、インフルエンザA、ライノウイルス等）の変動を扱っている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa gia tăng, virus liên tục biến đổi: Người mắc bệnh nền cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu on the rise, viruses continually mutating: People with underlying conditions should take note.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, seasonal influenza is rising in the Western Pacific as viruses continually mutate. WHO surveillance shows week-33 2026 influenza activity increasing from about 12% to 13% over two weeks. Japan reports influenza activity since late August 2026, earlier than usual; Hong Kong records a similar trend, with severe cases mainly in the elderly and children. In Vietnam, people with underlying conditions (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic lung or kidney disease, and immunodeficiency) are at high risk for influenza and its complications, and influenza can trigger or worsen chronic illnesses. A study of 364 myocardial infarction cases linked to influenza found roughly a sixfold increased risk within seven days of infection. With ongoing viral evolution, WHO updates the 2026–2027 vaccine composition to include A/H3N2 (subclade K) and B/Victoria. Preventive measures include updated vaccination for high-risk groups, hand hygiene, masking when needed, respiratory hygiene, and healthy living.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが増加、ウイルスは絶えず変異：基礎疾患のある人は注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 西太平洋地域での季節性インフルエンザ流行に関する定例的な情報記事であり、ウイルス変異や早期流行開始など経過観察すべき要素はあるが、緊急のピックアップを要する異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの基礎疾患患者への注意喚起が主題だが、日本・香港の流行動向にも言及。日本は対象国リスト外のため除外。香港はルールによりChinaとして計上。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行情報であり、WHOによるワクチン株更新（A/H3N2亜系統K、B/Victoria）が言及されている点は注視価値あり。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Awas! Ini 7 Tanda Awal Kena Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! Here are 7 early signs of contracting Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity is rising in Indonesia, including in DKI Jakarta. The Health Ministry monitors the outbreak through surveillance at 39 puskesmas (community health centers), 35 hospitals, and 14 health quarantine centers. By week 38, influenza activity was categorized as moderate with a 56% positivity rate, with the dominant circulating strain identified as H1N1 (Influenza A). Early signs to watch for include fever, cough, and fatigue. While flu symptoms can resolve on their own, persistent symptoms beyond a week without improvement warrant medical consult, especially for individuals at high risk (age 65 and older or immunocompromised), as influenza can lead to serious complications. Potential complications include ear infections, diarrhea, nausea and vomiting, abdominal pain, chest pain, asthma, pneumonia, bronchitis, and heart problems. Early recognition and care are essential; take appropriate steps when symptoms begin.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！インフルエンザA感染の初期7つの兆候
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の活動増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、重大性や異常性を示す情報は乏しいが、サーベイランスデータから継続的な流行状況が示されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)に関する公衆衛生啓発記事。保健省によるサーベイランス（プスケスマス、病院、検疫所）で週38時点の陽性率56%・中程度の活動レベルと報告されているが、これは例年の季節性変動の範囲内である可能性が高く、新規性・異常性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Hai bệnh nhân nguy kịch vì Whitmore, cảnh báo nguy cơ sau mưa lũ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two patients critically ill from Whitmore's disease (melioidosis), warning of post-flood risks
article.articleSummary: Two patients at Nghe An Friendship General Hospital in Vietnam were diagnosed with Whitmore's disease (melioidosis) from Burkholderia pseudomallei. A 53-year-old woman developed acute kidney injury, liver injury, and coagulopathy; blood cultures confirmed B. pseudomallei after 3 days. She required mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, and continuous renal replacement therapy, was extubated after 12 days, and stabilized after three weeks of treatment. A male patient (born 1982) presented after four days of fever with rigors, cough, and dyspnea, developing septic shock, severe respiratory failure, AKI, and metabolic disturbances; blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei after 2 days. He was ventilated for 5 days and vasopressors were discontinued. Clinicians warn melioidosis can rapidly progress to pneumonia, bacteremia, and septic shock, especially during rainy seasons and floods; preventive measures include boots, gloves for mud/water, covering wounds, and prompt medical care for fever or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ホイットモア病（類鼻疽）で重体患者2名、洪水後のリスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 類鼻疽はベトナムで季節的・地域的に発生する既知の風土病であり、今回は重症例2件の局所的報告にとどまる。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、洪水後の増加傾向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽（Burkholderia pseudomallei感染症）は東南アジアの風土病で、洪水や豪雨後に土壌・水中の菌への曝露が増え発症が増加することが知られている。本記事は単一病院での重症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや地域的な感染拡大を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa gia tăng, người mắc bệnh nên cần chuẩn bị gì?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza is on the rise; what should patients prepare for?
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza is rising in Vietnam, per national infectious disease surveillance, with a modest uptick in recent weeks but no abnormal surge in severe cases or deaths. Influenza is an acute respiratory infection transmitted primarily by droplets and contaminated surfaces, with activity typically rising during seasonal transitions and fluctuating weather. Most infections are mild, but severe disease can occur in older adults, children under five, pregnant women (especially in the last trimester or within two weeks postpartum), and people with chronic diseases or immunodeficiency. In the North, pediatric hospitalizations have increased as winter approaches. Preventive measures include wearing masks in healthcare settings, on public transport, and in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces; cough etiquette; frequent handwashing; surface cleaning and ventilation. High-risk individuals should seek medical advice rather than self-medicate with antivirals or antibiotics. Vaccination for children is encouraged; the Health Ministry will continue surveillance and guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが増加中、患者は何を準備すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性インフルエンザが例年通りの季節変動として増加しているのみで、重症例や死亡の異常な増加は報告されておらず、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の季節的増加を伝える一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 赞比亚暴发新一轮霍乱疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia reports a new round of cholera outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of September 29, 2026, Zambia is experiencing a new cholera outbreak. Five of the ten provinces have reported 304 laboratory-confirmed cases and 11 deaths. The capital Lusaka is the hardest hit with 130 cases and 4 deaths. Nationwide, 35 patients are currently under treatment and about 230 have been discharged. Health authorities say they are closely monitoring affected districts. The previous cholera outbreak ended in July 2026. World Health Organization data cited in the report indicate the most severe cholera epidemic in Zambia occurred from October 2023 to July 2024, with more than 23,000 cases and over 700 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアで新たなコレラ流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアで複数州にわたりコレラの確認症例・死亡者が発生しており、過去の大規模流行歴もあることから公衆衛生上の深刻性と拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 過去の大規模流行（2023-2024年、23,000例以上・700人以上死亡）があり、再発の可能性と地域拡大リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola epidemic passes 8,000 cases and nears 4,000 deaths as attacks on health workers mount
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,116 confirmed cases and 3,924 confirmed deaths as of September 27, the 135th day of the outbreak, spanning 63 of 167 health zones across seven provinces. The epicenter is shifting from Ituri toward North Kivu’s Butembo–Katwa corridor, with Ituri still holding about 76.3% of cumulative infections. In Butembo, the 29-bed Kitatumba treatment center is full, and a 10-year-old died in triage. Overall case-fatality sits at 59.5% in North Kivu, and two in five diagnosed patients do not survive a treatment center; a third are treated outside facilities. On Sept 26, 78 new confirmed cases were reported from 422 samples; national test positivity rose to 18.5% (Ituri 26.9%), with Mandima contributing a third of daily cases. A total of 31,034 contacts are under follow-up, but 23,187 were traced (74.7%), leaving many unmonitored. Attacks on health workers intensified: a local leader beaten in Butembo, a screening-post worker shot, a burial worker injured, and health posts burned, as authorities deploy Wazalendo fighters to enforce compliance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数8,000人、死者数は4,000人に迫る中、医療従事者への攻撃が激化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約60%の大規模エボラ流行が7州63保健区に拡大し、接触者追跡の不備や医療従事者への攻撃により封じ込めが困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 接触者の約25%が未追跡であり、医療従事者への暴力が治療・サーベイランス活動を妨げている。震源地がイトゥリからノースキブのブテンボ・カトワ回廊へ移行している点にも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Which Seasonal Infections Should You Watch This Festive Season?
article.articleSummary: After the monsoon, India faces rising infections as stagnant water, crowded conditions and festive travel amplify spread. Infections to watch: influenza and other respiratory infections; dengue; malaria; enteric fever; gastroenteritis; and leptospirosis. On August 25, 2026, MoHFW, with ICMR, DHR and NCDC, said H1N1 viruses circulating in India show expected seasonal changes with no unusual genetic shift or new threat. Post-monsoon risks arise from stagnant/contaminated water, floodwater exposure, and mosquito breeding, affecting waterborne, mosquito-borne and respiratory infections; leptospirosis is notable after flooding; malaria and dengue rise with standing water; influenza activity persists year-round with monsoon and winter peaks and regional variation. Symptoms include influenza fever, cough, sore throat, body aches; dengue high fever, severe headache; malaria fever with chills; enteric fever persistent fever; gastroenteritis diarrhea/vomiting; leptospirosis fever with muscle pain and jaundice. Lab confirmation is essential; avoid antibiotics/antivirals without medical advice; practice respiratory hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: この祭りの季節に注意すべき季節性感染症とは？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性感染症に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。MoHFWもH1N1に異常な遺伝的変化はないと確認している。
triage.notes: モンスーン後の季節性感染症（デング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症、インフルエンザ等）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事。具体的な異常発生データや症例数の急増は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Meningkat, Komisi IX Ungkap Kelompok yang Perlu Diwaspadai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases on the rise, Commission IX identifies groups to watch out for.
article.articleSummary: Parliament Commission IX notes rising influenza activity in Indonesia and urges preparedness without panic. Health Ministry data through week 38 of 2026 show influenza positivity at 56%, with activity in the alert range and no indication of a crisis. Children aged 0–4 years account for about 39% of detected cases, prompting emphasis on educating parents about symptoms, when to seek care, and hygiene and cough etiquette. Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in several regions. Since 2025, 188 cases of subclade K have been recorded across 20 provinces, with the highest numbers in Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan. Up to week 38, 2025 data show 166 cases and 22 cases in 2026. Officials stress simple, data-based public communication and sustained surveillance, healthcare readiness, and consistent messaging to prevent misinterpretation of technical terms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ症例が増加、議会委員会IXが注意すべき層を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2サブクレードK含む)の増加が報告されているが、保健省は「危機的状況ではない」と明言しており、IHR基準の該当は確認できない。新規サブクレードの継続検出状況は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加を報告しており、保健省・議会ともに「危機ではない」との立場。H3N2サブクレードKの継続的検出（2025年以降188例、20州）は監視継続が必要だが、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生インパクトや国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo nóng về cúm mùa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health issues an urgent warning about seasonal flu.
article.articleSummary: October 1, Vietnam's Ministry of Health issued a warning about seasonal influenza. Surveillance shows a slight uptick in influenza cases in weeks, with no unusual rise in severe illness or deaths. Seasonal flu is a respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses, transmitted mainly via droplets and surfaces. It can occur year-round but often increases during seasonal weather changes. Most infections are mild and may present with fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose, but high-risk groups include people aged 65+, children under 5, pregnant women in last three months, postpartum women within two weeks, or those with chronic conditions or immunodeficiency. Preventive measures: wear masks in facilities and crowded or poorly ventilated spaces; cover coughs and sneezes; wash hands regularly; clean touched surfaces; ensure ventilation; avoid close contact with the sick; seek care if symptoms worsen. Do not self-medicate with antivirals or antibiotics without medical advice. MOH will continue surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、季節性インフルエンザについて緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲の増加であり、重症例や死亡の異常な増加は報告されておらず、公衆衛生当局の定例的な注意喚起にとどまる。
triage.notes: ベトナム保健省による季節性インフルエンザの定例的な注意喚起であり、重症化・死亡の異常増加は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 營養午餐又出包？民族國小9學生嘔吐　蔣萬安：就是腸病毒...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another school lunch fiasco? Nine students at Minzu Elementary School vomit; Chiang Wan-an: It's enterovirus...
article.articleSummary: Nine students at Minzu Elementary School, Songshan District, Taipei, developed vomiting and gastrointestinal symptoms after a school lunch on Sept 24, 2026. The lunch was supplied by a central kitchen that also serves Jinhua Junior High School, where nine students had diarrhea in early September. The Taipei City Education Bureau confirmed that 716 staff and students at Minzu Elementary School ate the lunch on Sept 24; by Sept 26, a second-grade class had nine students with GI symptoms, including some who ate vegetarian meals. The central kitchen serves four schools; other three schools reported no similar illnesses. Health authorities have sent samples for laboratory testing, with enterovirus suspected and norovirus not ruled out; classrooms have been disinfected and affected students have returned to class. Further results are pending.

triage.headline_ja: 栄養昼食でまた問題？民族国民小学校の9人の生徒が嘔吐　蒋万安市長「エンテロウイルスだ」
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一小学校における少数児童の嘔吐・下痢事例であり、重症例や広域拡大の報告はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念に該当しない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに台湾・中国本土は含まれるが、本事例は台湾限定の学校給食関連の小規模感染であり、中国本土での発生ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。市長のコメントにより地元メディアの関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Người bệnh đái tháo đường, thận mạn đối mặt nguy cơ nhiễm trùng tăng cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diabetes patients with chronic kidney disease face an increased risk of infection.
article.articleSummary: Diabetes mellitus with chronic kidney disease (CKD) markedly increases infection risk in Vietnam, including herpes zoster, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, and pneumonia. Advanced age and comorbidities worsen outcomes. At a national conference, clinicians noted about 10 million people with CKD and roughly 7 million living with diabetes in Vietnam, with over 55% having complications. Diabetes patients are prone to respiratory infections and pneumonia; herpes zoster risk is up about 38%. CKD raises herpes zoster risk by about 29% and elevates RSV and severe disease risk in older adults. Vaccination is emphasized as a preventive shield; ADA recommends immunization in diabetes care, and KDIGO 2024 endorses vaccination as an active intervention for CKD. Health authorities urge integrating risk assessment and vaccination into routine care, reviewing vaccination history and tailoring prevention. Vaccines include hepatitis B, HPV, RSV, influenza, pneumococcus, and herpes zoster.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病患者と慢性腎臓病患者、感染症リスクの増加に直面

article.articleHeadline: Spring-Time Gardeners Reminded Of Dangerous Bacteria Threat From Potting Mix And Compost
article.articleSummary: 135 people hospitalised with Legionnaires’ disease across New Zealand in the past year, linked to potting mix and compost as spring gardening begins. Legionella bacteria cause pneumonia when inhaled from moist environments; symptoms include cough, fever, shortness of breath, muscle aches, headaches, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes confusion. People over 50, smokers, or with chronic illness or weakened immunity are at higher risk and should take extra precautions. Most cases require antibiotics and hospitalisation. Prevention: handle potting mix outdoors or in well-ventilated areas; open bags away from the face; wear gloves and a well-fitting N95 mask; dampen soil to reduce dust; wash hands after gardening. If symptoms develop after handling soil products, contact your health provider or Healthline (0800 611 116). Regionally, cases span Northern (Northland, Auckland), Midland (Waikato, Bay of Plenty, Lakes, Taranaki, Tairawhiti), Central (Hawke’s Bay, Whanganui, MidCentral, Wairarapa, Wellington), and South Island (Nelson-Marlborough, Canterbury, South Canterbury, West Coast, Otago, Southland) for Sept 1, 2025–Aug 31, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Ấu trùng giun phổi chuột nguy hiểm thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous are rat lungworm larvae?
article.articleSummary: A 68-year-old man from Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, developed eosinophilic meningitis caused by Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm) after presenting with fever, fatigue, altered consciousness, and progressive limb weakness. On admission, fever (38–38.5°C), incontinence, and reduced responsiveness were noted; chest exam showed basilar crackles. Blood tests revealed marked eosinophilia, supporting a diagnosis of parasitic meningitis due to rat lungworm. The larva can migrate to the central nervous system, triggering inflammation and neuro symptoms such as headache, nausea, altered mental status, and focal deficits. Treatment comprised high-dose anti-inflammatory therapy, antiparasitic drugs, antibiotics, measures to reduce intracranial pressure and cerebral edema, nutrition support, and management of systemic risk factors. The patient gradually improved and was discharged in stable condition from Hop Luc General Hospital. Preventive advice includes cooking meat and seafood thoroughly, washing vegetables and hands, hygienic food handling, and seeking medical care for persistent or worsening neurological symptoms rather than self-treatment.

The Department of Health promptly sent test samples; the school conducted comprehensive cleaning and disinfection of classrooms, and the students have since returned to school and are recovering. Chiang referenced a prior incident at Chengyuan High School’s junior high division and said plans for future inspections would be arranged. The infection source remains under investigation.

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng bệnh nhân mắc cúm mùa, Bộ Y tế đưa ra 7 khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising number of patients with seasonal influenza: the Ministry of Health issues seven recommendations.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in Vietnam shows rising cases in recent weeks per national infectious disease surveillance, though no nationwide spike and local trends vary. The Ministry of Health’s Department of Preventive Medicine notes influenza is an acute respiratory infection spread mainly by respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces. Most infections are mild and self-limiting, but can progress to severe illness and complications, especially among those aged 65+, children under 5, pregnant women (particularly in the last trimester) or within 2 weeks postpartum, and people with underlying conditions or immunodeficiency. Seven preventive recommendations are issued: wear a mask in healthcare settings, on public transport, in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, and for those with respiratory symptoms; cover mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing; wash hands regularly with soap and water or sanitizer; keep homes and workplaces clean and well ventilated; limit close contact with the ill; maintain a healthy lifestyle; and avoid self-medicating with antivirals or antibiotics without medical advice.

article.articleSummary: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, intensifies dengue-control efforts after September records 1,775 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases. On September 30, drones were deployed to spray larvicide over the Cooum River and Buckingham Canal to curb mosquito breeding sources as transmission persists citywide. Public health authorities have stepped up vector-control operations and surveillance to identify and eliminate breeding habitats, aiming to reduce monthly case numbers as the city enters October 2026. The update sits amid broader civic challenges in Chennai, including water storage concerns and ongoing infrastructure projects, with policy changes on ration cards and Metro Phase 2 progress noted. The report does not specify any imported or exported dengue cases. The response highlights a proactive urban public health campaign targeting dengue alongside other municipal priorities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh Monitors People Exposed to the H5N1 Influenza Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh, Vietnam's Department of Health initiated surveillance after an A/H5N1 avian influenza outbreak in Đồng Tiến Commune, Trung Tiến Village, Ha Tinh Province, since Sept 25. Two households (Tran Thi Bay and Nguyen Thi Nhan) with 720 poultry; 670 birds died and were culled. Laboratory testing confirmed H5N1 in samples. CDC Ha Tinh, with local authorities, conducted risk assessment for human transmission and implemented measures: culling remaining poultry in affected households, sanitizing enclosures, and strengthening local coordination. Exposed individuals are to be monitored daily for 14 days from last contact. Residents with fever, cough, or difficulty breathing should seek medical care promptly. Preventive guidance includes avoiding eating or handling sick or unknown-origin poultry, not slaughtering or trading poultry, wearing masks in live poultry markets, and practicing hand hygiene. In a separate update, authorities culled over 900 poultry to prevent further spread.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu cases on the rise; the Ministry of Health recommends preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health reports a slight uptick in seasonal influenza cases in recent weeks, with no unusual increase in severe illness or deaths. Seasonal flu is an acute respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses, transmitted mainly via droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces. Most infections are mild, but risk groups—those over 65, children under 5, pregnant women (especially in the last trimester) or within two weeks postpartum, and individuals with cardiovascular, chronic lung, kidney, or liver disease, diabetes, immunodeficiency, or other underlying conditions—may develop severe disease. Preventive measures include proper mask-wearing in health facilities, on public transport, crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, and by those with respiratory symptoms around others; cough etiquette, appropriate hand hygiene, surface cleaning, and ensuring good ventilation. Do not self-medicate with antivirals or antibiotics. The Department will continue monitoring, updating information, and guiding prevention efforts.

article.articleHeadline: QC records over 5K dengue cases in nine months
article.articleSummary: Quezon City logged 5,589 dengue cases and 24 dengue-related deaths from 1 January to 24 September 2026, yielding a case fatality rate of 0.43%. Cumulative cases for this period are 35.01% lower than the 8,600 cases recorded during the same period in 2025. Morbidity Week 36 (September 6–12) registered 356 dengue cases—the year's highest weekly total—and 156 cases among 5–17-year-olds (44% of the week’s total). District 2 accounted for the most cases (2,026), followed by Districts 5 (925), 4 (731), 6 (680), 3 (615), and 1 (612). Case investigations were conducted on September 23 in Saint Andrew Sacred Heart Village, Pasong Putik, District 5, and Jemar Compound, Talipapa, District 6. Residents are urged to seek early evaluation for fever or dengue-like symptoms and to watch for warning signs: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, weakness, or breathing difficulty.

article.articleHeadline: Cat Scratch Disease: Penyakit dari Cakaran Kucing yang Bisa Bikin Kelenjar Getah Bening Bengkak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cat Scratch Disease: A disease from cat scratches that can cause swollen lymph nodes.
article.articleSummary: Cat Scratch Disease (CSD) is caused by Bartonella henselae linked to fleas on cats, causing swollen lymph nodes near scratches or bites. In Jakarta, Indonesia, human infection occurs through cat scratches or bites that break the skin, with kittens more likely carriers. Symptoms appear days to weeks after exposure and include redness and swelling at the wound, followed by tender lymphadenopathy; fever, fatigue, and reduced appetite may accompany. Most immunocompetent individuals recover without antibiotics, though azithromycin may help shorten swelling in some cases. Immunocompromised patients require antibiotics and supervision; dissemination to eyes, brain, heart, or other organs is rare. Prevention emphasizes avoiding rough play with cats, hand washing after contact, flea control, and keeping cats indoors. If scratched or bitten, wash the wound with soap and running water and prevent licking by the cat.

article.articleSummary: Seven residents in Depok, West Java, tested positive for laboratory-confirmed influenza A, according to Depok Health Office on 2026-10-01. The seven cases form a local cluster, with health officials noting cases are diagnosed by lab tests rather than self-confirmed. Nationally, influenza A remains most reported in DKI Jakarta, West Java, and Banten. Data through week 38 of 2026 show 1,527 influenza positives and 126 COVID-19 positives from 8,757 specimens, with 2026 influenza activity lower than 2025 (2,790 positives from 11,805 specimens). The dominant subtype is A(H1N1)pdm09, followed by other detections of H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B Victoria lineage. Influenza A can affect all ages; symptoms include high fever, prolonged illness, body aches, and extreme fatigue. Officials state it does not cause death but can have extended symptoms. Prevention focuses on rest, healthy diet, regular exercise, and standard precautions to avoid transmission from symptomatic individuals.

triage.notes: 子供への感染拡大と急速な伝播が報告されているが、症例数・死亡数等の定量データが欠如しており、季節性インフルエンザか新型株かの判断材料が不足している。続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS appelle à renforcer durablement l'accès à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO calls for strengthening sustainable access to.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to place strain on health access, with WHO warning that sustainable medical oxygen is essential for severe cases. Access remains limited due to infrastructure, equipment, and health-service organization challenges. Prompt care greatly improves survival, yet many patients still die at home or within communities before reaching a facility. As of 27 September, over 8,100 confirmed cases and nearly 3,900 deaths have been reported across seven provinces, though recent weeks show a decline in new cases and fatalities. On the ground, the response has strengthened: treatment-center capacity has risen from a few beds at the start to more than 1,600, and hundreds of health professionals have been trained. WHO urges continued investment in medical-oxygen systems and equitable access to care to save lives and bolster health system capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：WHOが医療用酸素への持続的アクセス強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは、累計8,100例以上・死亡約3,900人と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の継続中アウトブレイクに関する最新報告であり、国境を越えた拡大や渡航制限の記載はないため、その項目は不明と評価した。治療キャパシティの増強や医療従事者訓練など対応は進んでいるが、依然として致死率が高く医療用酸素アクセスの改善が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 197 tấn thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả được đưa vào sản xuất thực phẩm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 197 tons of African swine fever-infected pork were put into food production.
article.articleSummary: Over 197 tons of pork infected with African swine fever (ASF) were diverted into food production by Ha Long Canned Goods Joint Stock Company in Hai Phong, Vietnam, as 17 defendants go to trial. From May 2025 to September 8, 2025, the company purchased ASF-contaminated lean pork from traders in Hung Yen, Thai Binh, Bac Giang, Bac Ninh, and Hai Duong for market sale. The total value of the implicated meat is about 17.4 billion VND, with more than 9.7 billion VND of diseased meat earmarked for destruction. Suppliers included Le Ba Doanh (~97 tons) and Trinh Ha Viet (~95 tons). At a September 30 trial in Hai Phong, 15 defendants were charged with violations of food safety laws and 2 with bribery. Sentences ranged up to 19 years for Truong Sy Toan; others received 14–16 years, 15 years, or 5 years; two defendants were given suspended terms, and Le Nhat Huy and Tran Thi Huong received bribe-related penalties.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)感染豚肉197トン以上が食品生産に流用
triage.triage_reason: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は豚のみに感染し人への感染性はないため公衆衛生上の脅威とはならず、本件は食品安全法違反・贈収賄に関する刑事裁判の報道であり感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病でありヒトへの健康リスクはない。本記事は食品安全法違反および贈収賄に関する刑事裁判の報道が主題であり、感染症公衆衛生イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo cúm mùa đang gia tăng, người dân cần chủ động phòng dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Warns That Seasonal Flu Is on the Rise; People Should Take Proactive Measures to Prevent Its Spread.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 Oct 2026, Vietnam’s Ministry of Health reports a rising trend in seasonal influenza cases in recent weeks, with no unusual increase in severe illness or deaths so far. High-risk groups include people 65+, children under 5, pregnant women (especially in the last trimester or within two weeks postpartum), and those with chronic diseases or immune suppression. Transmission is mainly by respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces; symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, and other influenza-like illness. Vaccination is an effective preventive measure. Preventive actions: wear masks in healthcare settings and crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, practice cough etiquette, wash hands regularly, avoid touching the face, and ensure well-ventilated homes and workplaces. Do not self-medicate with antivirals or antibiotics; seek medical advice for high-risk individuals or worsening symptoms. Early detection and protecting vulnerable groups are key to reducing complications.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、季節性インフルエンザの増加を警告、国民に積極的な予防対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの増加傾向が報告されているが、重症化や死亡の異常増加はなく、現時点では通常の季節的変動の範囲内と見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 保健省による季節性インフルエンザ注意喚起であり、重症例や死亡の異常増加は報告されていない。通常の季節的流行対応として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் டெங்கு பாதிப்பு இருமடங்காக உயர்வு.. நேற்று ஒரே நாளில் 72 பேருக்கு பாதிப்பு! மக்கள் அச்சம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Chennai have doubled; 72 people affected in a single day yesterday. Public anxious.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Chennai has doubled, with 72 cases reported in a single day yesterday. In Tamil Nadu this year, dengue has been confirmed in about 18,000 people. Chennai recorded 605 cases in August and 1,290 in September. Authorities warn of a rising outbreak linked to seasonal shifts and variable rainfall, with Chennai, Coimbatore, and Salem seeing higher transmission. Public anxiety has grown as cases climb. Citizens are urged to seek prompt medical care for fever lasting more than four days and to eliminate stagnant water around homes to curb mosquitoes. Common symptoms include high fever, eye and back pain, severe muscle, bone and joint pains, intense headache, red rashes on days 2–5, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding require immediate hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱感染が倍増…昨日一日で72人感染！住民に不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（重症度・継続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、記事内で住民の不安拡大も明記されているため社会的関心も確認できる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性風土病であり、IHR基準としては異常性が低いが、感染者数の急増と住民の不安拡大がWPRO基準・社会的関心の観点から確認されるためPICKUPと判定。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Naik, Kenali Gejala dan Tanda Bahayanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the Rise: Recognize Its Symptoms and Warning Signs.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity rose in Indonesia during September 2026, with a weekly positivity rate of 56% in week 38. Surveillance across 39 community health centers (puskesmas), 35 hospitals, and 14 quarantine centers recorded 1,527 influenza-positive specimens from 8,757 tested in 2026 through week 38. Predominant subtype detected is influenza A(H1N1)pdm09; influenza A(H3N2) subclade K (often called “superflu”) is not dominating. Symptoms commonly include fever or chills, cough, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat, and nasal congestion; vomiting or diarrhea can occur in children. Diagnosis requires laboratory confirmation; clinical symptoms alone are insufficient. Most cases are mild and managed with rest and symptom-based care, while oseltamivir is not advised for mass use or prophylaxis and should be reserved for severe cases or high-risk patients after physician assessment. High-risk groups include those aged 65+, very young children, pregnant women, and individuals with chronic conditions. The rise is viewed as seasonal, with authorities urging vigilance, not panic.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型が増加、症状と警戒サインを知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの活動増加であり、当局も季節性・軽症中心と評価しているが、サーベイランスデータとして継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1pdm09優勢)の陽性率上昇に関する公衆衛生サーベイランス報告。当局は季節性変動と説明し、パニックを避け警戒を呼びかけているのみでIHR基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: O avanço da Herpes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Rise of Herpes
article.articleSummary: Herpes zoster (shingles), caused by reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, is increasingly impacting Brazil. In 2025, the country logged 49,720 ambulatory attendances for herpes zoster and 3,060 hospitalizations. From January to June 2026, 33,141 attendances and 1,559 hospitalizations were recorded. State-level data for 2025 show São Paulo as the most affected (15,459 cases), followed by Rio de Janeiro (9,931) and Minas Gerais (4,039). Vaccination against herpes zoster is not yet provided by Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS), which covers treatment. In early September, the Senate approved PL 4.426/25 to include the vaccine in the SUS vaccination calendar, potentially expanding preventive options."

triage.headline_ja: ヘルペスの増加
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹は水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの再活性化による慢性的・非流行性の疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性はなく、通常の疫学統計報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 帯状疱疹はヒト-ヒト感染で流行するタイプの感染症ではなく、ワクチン導入に関する政策議論が中心の記事。公衆衛生上の統計報告であり、緊急性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Jaga Hewan Peliharaan dari Rabies, Barantin Sulteng Ingatkan Dampak Penularan ke Manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protect Pets from Rabies, Barantin Central Sulawesi Reminds of the Human Transmission Impact.
article.articleSummary: Barantin Sulteng announces a free rabies vaccination drive for pets in Palu, targeting dogs and cats. The clinic will be held at the Barantin Sulteng Office, Jalan Garuda, Birobuli Utara, Palu Selatan, Palu City, on Friday, 2 October 2026, opening about 09:00 WITA or until all doses are exhausted. Around 100 doses of rabies vaccine are prepared for community pets, with registration and pet presentation required. Ahmad Mansuri Alfian, head of Barantin Sulteng, cautions that rabies is a zoonosis that can spread from animals to humans, underscoring the preventive value of pet vaccination for human health. The drive follows a September 27 event during Palu City’s 48th anniversary, using about 20 doses. The program aligns with broader goals to reduce rabies in Central Sulawesi and Indonesia’s target to be rabies-free by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: ペットを狂犬病から守る、バランティン中スラウェシが人への感染影響を注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病流行の報告ではなく、ペット向け無料ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的ワクチン接種イベントの告知であり、実際の狂犬病感染拡大や症例急増の報告ではない。地元当局による通常の公衆衛生啓発活動。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Tangerang Selatan waspadai penularan cepat Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Tangerang City Health Office warns of rapid transmission of Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: South Tangerang City, Banten, Indonesia, warns of rapid transmission of Influenza A amid extreme weather, urging vaccination and hygiene practices. Dinkes Kota Tangsel reports 256 Influenza A cases detected in week 36 within Influenza-Like Illness surveillance. Symptoms include fever over 38°C, cough, runny nose, and sore throat, with transmission primarily via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking. Of these, eight cases were laboratory-confirmed Influenza A at Puskesmas Serpong 1 using the New All Record (NAR) system, dated 19 August (1), 1 September (3), 14 September (2), and 15 September (2). Preventive measures emphasize vaccination for vulnerable groups, regular handwashing with soap under running water, maintaining good indoor ventilation, avoiding close contact with the sick, and prompt medical care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市保健局、インフルエンザAの急速な感染拡大に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、異常性や重症度の高さ、国際的拡大リスクを示す情報がないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 地方保健局によるILIサーベイランスの一環としての注意喚起であり、季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の報告と考えられる。重症例・死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் எகிறும் டெங்கு! செப்டம்பரில் பாதிப்பு பல மடங்கு அதிகரிப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue spreading in Chennai! In September, infections surge severalfold.
article.articleSummary: Chennai saw a sharp dengue fever surge in September, with confirmed infections rising to about 1,290 compared with 605 in August. The surge follows monsoon-related rainfall patterns and widespread stagnant water across multiple zones within the Chennai Metropolitan Area, fueling mosquito proliferation. The public health department and Chennai Corporation have intensified war-footing anti-dengue measures, including new containment and sanitation campaigns citywide. Laboratory-confirmed cases in September indicate an abrupt escalation beyond expectations, with roughly 72 new dengue cases confirmed yesterday in Chennai alone, underscoring the ongoing outbreak. The report highlights the need for continued vector control and community hygiene to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱が急増！9月は感染者数が数倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的急増であり、地域当局が対応を強化しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低く、フルRRAの必要性は限定的。経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: モンスーン後の雨水停滞による蚊媒介性感染症の季節的増加。チェンナイ市当局が防除策を強化中。重症度や死亡例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh viện Chợ Rẫy phát hiện vi khuẩn hiếm ở người bệnh phổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chợ Rẫy Hospital detects rare bacteria in a patient with lung disease.
article.articleSummary: Chợ Rẫy Hospital in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, reports its fifth pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP) case in a 60-year-old man from Quảng Ngãi Province with chronic cough and progressive dyspnea. PAP is a rare disease where protein-rich material fills alveoli, impairing gas exchange and increasing risk of pneumonia, fibrosis and death (incidence ~0.6–7 per million). After two prior lung lavages with limited improvement, December 2025 admission led to a single bilateral lavage lasting about three hours; lavage fluid tested for pathogens revealed a very rare non-tuberculous bacterium, prompting antimicrobial therapy. Six months of targeted antibiotics produced marked radiographic improvement, near-resolution of symptoms, and no recurrence by June 2026. This is CHR Hospital’s fifth PAP case and first with a non-tuberculous co-infection, underscoring assessment for underlying causes when recurrence occurs.

triage.headline_ja: チョーライ病院、肺疾患患者から希少な細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一の稀少疾患（肺胞蛋白症）症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や人から人への感染リスクはなく、感染症アウトブレイクに該当しない。
triage.notes: 肺胞蛋白症（PAP）は非感染性の稀少疾患であり、非結核性細菌の合併感染も個人の症例に限定される。公衆衛生イベントとしての広がりはなく、感染症サーベイランスの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea Outbreak in Ganjam: Two Dead, Six Affected, Watch
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea and vomiting outbreak in Patashala Malik Sahi, Dharakote, Ganjam district, Odisha, with two deaths and six affected. Patients have been admitted to MKCG Medical College and Hospital in Berhampur. The exact cause is under investigation; a Health Department team is in Patashala Malik Sahi. Bleaching powder is being applied locally, and water and other samples have been collected and sent for laboratory testing. Residents report the sick attended a feast in Podamari; a death 15 days earlier in Marthapur after attending an Ekadashaha feast, and another Patashala Malik Sahi death occurred on Wednesday. It remains unconfirmed whether the illnesses and deaths are linked to the feast or to contaminated food or water. Laboratory reports are pending, and the outbreak is being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: ガンジャム地区の下痢流行：死者2名、罹患6名、警戒中
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州の一地区で下痢・嘔吐による死者2名、罹患6名の集団発生が報告されているが、原因（食品・水系汚染か感染症か）は調査中で未確定。局地的事案であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、続報（検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因は食品媒介性（宴会参加者の発症）または水質汚染の可能性が示唆されているが、検査結果待ちであり確定していない。地域保健当局が調査・対応中で、国際支援の必要性は現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Korban Influenza Meroket, Kimia Farma (KAEF) Kembangkan Anti Virus Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Victims Soar, Kimia Farma (KAEF) Develops This Antiviral.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Indonesian state-owned Kimia Farma (Persero) Tbk (KAEF) signed a sublicense with Medicines Patent Pool (MPP) to develop and manufacture a generic Baloxavir marboxil, Roche’s influenza antiviral. The voluntary license, announced on 25 September 2026 during the United Nations General Assembly in New York, designates Kimia Farma as the sole Indonesian producer among 11 global manufacturers. The sublicense provides access to the technical data package, bioequivalence study references, and ongoing technical support to accelerate development, registration, and regulatory approval in Indonesia. Local production of Baloxavir marboxil aims to strengthen essential medicines supply chains and reduce Indonesia’s dependence on imported antivirals. Kimia Farma joins regional/global producers from Brazil, China, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Uganda, Ukraine, and Vietnam in this initiative.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者急増、キミア・ファルマ(KAEF)が抗ウイルス薬を開発
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインフルエンザ治療薬（バロキサビル・マルボキシル）の現地製造ライセンス契約に関する企業・産業ニュースであり、疾病の異常発生や公衆衛生危機を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は抗ウイルス薬のライセンス契約・製造に関する産業ニュースであり、特定国での感染症流行を報じるものではないため、対象国リストの国名が挙がっていても疾病発生地としては確認できない。見出しの『インフルエンザ患者急増』は背景説明であり具体的な地域・規模のデータなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS appelle à renforcer durablement l'accès à l'oxygène médical [Radio Okapi] https://www.radiookapi.net/2026/10/01/actualite/sante/ebola-en-rdc-loms-appelle-renforcer-durablement-lacces-loxygene-medical
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO calls for sustained access to medical oxygen.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is highlighted, with the World Health Organization urging sustained access to medical oxygen as a critical resource in outbreak response. The piece appears under the Africa-focused portal Africain.info. However, the body text provided is a generic disclaimer about Africain.info indexing existing newspapers and disclaiming responsibility for published articles, and it contains no specific details on case counts, laboratory confirmation, transmission, symptomatology, or outbreak timeline. Consequently, no quantitative data, dates, or infection sources are presented within the article itself. The only actionable elements are the article title's pointer to the DRC Ebola situation and the WHO's call for medical oxygen, implying a public health concern that requires oxygen supply and supportive care. No imported/exported case details or additional context are included in the current text.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：WHOが医療用酸素への持続的アクセス強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOが医療資源（酸素）支援を呼びかけていることから、深刻性と国際支援の必要性が示唆されるためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事本文は具体的な症例数や感染経路等の詳細を欠き、WHOの資源支援要請のみが明示されている。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் டெங்கு பாதிப்பு அதிகரிப்பு: நேற்று ஒரே நாளில் 72 பேருக்கு காய்ச்சல் உறுதி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in dengue cases in Chennai: fever confirmed in 72 people in a single day yesterday.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 1, 2026, Chennai recorded 72 new dengue fever cases confirmed in a single day, signaling a sharp surge. August reported 605 cases; September rose to 1,290, roughly doubling. Across Tamil Nadu, about 18,000 dengue cases have occurred so far this year. Doctors say 90–95% of Chennai cases present as ordinary fever managed at home with rest and guidance; 5–10% require hospitalization for closer surveillance. In response, the Chennai Municipal Corporation has intensified vector-control: 3,500 field workers inspect homes, and drones disperse larvicides in major water bodies to curb Aedes breeding. The city is also imposing penalties for water stagnation in households and vacant premises. Public advisories urge residents to remove standing water on rooftops and balconies and to seek government hospitals or urban primary health centers for fever symptoms rather than self-medicating.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱症例が増加：昨日1日で72人の発熱が確認
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイで季節性デング熱の症例数が急増しているが、重症度は低く地域当局が対応中であり、IHR基準には該当しない。流行拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナドゥ州で毎年流行する季節性疾患。症例数は増加傾向（8月605件→9月1290件、州全体で年間約18000件）だが、90-95%は軽症で自宅療養可能。地方自治体（チェンナイ市）がベクター対策（幼虫駆除剤散布、家屋検査）を強化しており、地域レベルで管理されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு vs உண்ணிக் காய்ச்சல்: ஒரே மாதிரி அறிகுறிகள்... உஷாராக இருக்க வேண்டிய விஷயங்கள்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue vs Enteric Fever: Similar Symptoms... Things to Watch Out For!
article.articleSummary: Seasonal shifts are increasing fever cases in Tamil Nadu, with dengue fever and scrub typhus rising. More than 17,000 dengue cases have been confirmed in Tamil Nadu. Dengue is transmitted by female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes; illness typically lasts 5–6 days and can cause high fever, severe body and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, rash, fatigue, and low platelets. Transmission is daytime; mosquitoes breed in stagnant water, so removing standing water is vital. Scrub typhus spreads via small chigger mites in fields and forests and is not person-to-person. Symptoms include sudden high fever, rigors, severe headache around the neck and eyes, muscle and joint pains, fatigue, and an eschar at the bite site; lymph nodes may swell. Prevention: cover exposed skin and check for mites after outdoor activity. Do not self-medicate; seek medical testing and treatment—early treatment improves outcomes. Hydration is important; papaya leaf juice may be used per doctor’s guidance. Public health officials urge vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱 vs つつが虫病：似た症状…注意すべきこと！
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱（17,000件超）とつつが虫病の増加が報じられているが、季節性の健康啓発記事であり、異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の感染症に関する公衆衛生啓発記事。症例数は報告されているが、これは例年のデング・つつが虫病流行パターンの一部である可能性が高く、異常性の評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El G20 anuncia nuevos fondos por más de 415 millones de euros para combatir el brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The G20 announces new funds of more than 415 million euros to combat the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: G20 ministers announce more than 470 million USD (415 million EUR) in new commitments to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. With this injection, global funds pledged since the outbreak began in May 2026 surpass 2.0 billion USD (1.767 billion EUR). The United States, holding the rotating presidency, adds 267 million USD (236 million EUR) in health and humanitarian aid, raising its direct contribution to 887 million USD. Funds will finance treatment units, safe burial teams, large-scale PPE supplies, and contact-tracing implemented through local organizations. The response focuses on a region that is isolated and conflict-affected where current vaccines, diagnostics, and therapies do not fully cover the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The outbreak’s potential defeat is underscored by Uganda’s August end of a neighboring outbreak. Commitments also come from the World Bank, the United Kingdom, Germany, South Korea, France, and others.

triage.headline_ja: G20、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行対策に4億1500万ユーロ超の新規資金拠出を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行（ブンディブギョ株）に対し、G20・世界銀行等が20億ドル超の資金拠出を表明するなど国際的関心と支援の必要性が極めて高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには米国・韓国・フランス・ドイツ・ウガンダ・英国が含まれるが、これらは資金拠出国であり実際の発生地ではない。実際の流行地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみ。2026年5月発生、ブンディブギョ株で既存ワクチン・診断薬・治療薬のカバーが不十分な点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Canada : la prolongation des restrictions liées à Ebola maintient des
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada: the extension of Ebola-related restrictions maintains some
article.articleSummary: Canada extends Ebola-related exceptional measures under the decree through November 27, 2026, continuing to affect numerous nationals of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Immigration and travel documents remain suspended, leaving students, workers and families in prolonged limbo. Authorities say no additional action is required by those affected, yet suspended processes disrupt daily life. Many Congolese pursuing study or employment in Canada face growing uncertainty; some students are stuck in Kinshasa even though courses have begun in Canada, with no local Ebola cases reported there. Temporary residents encounter substantial financial losses from repeated travel postponements, ticket changes and penalties. Families fear missing important events; a mother cites her son’s graduation as at risk. Overall, students, workers, tourists and families share prolonged uncertainty as restrictions remain in force until further notice.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ:エボラ関連の渡航制限延長措置が一部維持される
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行に関連するカナダの既存渡航制限措置の延長を報じる記事であり、エボラ自体の新規発生・拡大に関する新情報は含まれていないため、続報の推移を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの移民・渡航制限政策の延長が主題であり、DRCにおけるエボラ発生状況自体の新規情報（症例数、拡大状況等）は含まれていない。既知のアウトブレイクに対する既存措置の継続報道のため、新規シグナルとしての優先度は低いが、関連情報として経過観察する。

article.articleHeadline: Мадагаскар ставит заслон Эболе: пассажиров из Конго встречают тепловизоры и карантин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madagascar blocks Ebola: passengers from the Congo are met by thermal scanners and quarantine
article.articleSummary: Madagascar has tightened Ebola prevention at Ivato International Airport in Antananarivo, with thermal scanners across all arrivals. Any fever prompts isolation for medical assessment; an on-site ambulance operates round the clock, and a dedicated MOH facility houses suspected cases away from general hospitals. Arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo face a strict regime: only Malagasy citizens, residents, diplomats, and visa holders are admitted, with a mandatory 21-day quarantine starting from Congo departure (including time spent in other countries). Four quarantine sites have been prepared—three hotels and one center in Vontovorona, near the capital. By MOH, 32 people are under preventive isolation, 22 have already returned home. All arrivals complete sanitary cards listing contacts and seat numbers; false information incurs penalties. No confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in Madagascar; travel to Ebola zones, especially DRC, is temporarily suspended.

triage.headline_ja: マダガスカル、エボラ対策を強化：コンゴからの入国者をサーモグラフィーと検疫で迎える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行に対し、マダガスカルが国境・空港レベルで渡航制限・21日間検疫等の厳格な措置を実施しており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマダガスカルにおける水際対策（検疫・サーモグラフィー導入）であり、マダガスカル国内でのエボラ症例は確認されていない。エボラの実発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Dengue Cases Double In September, 1,290 Affected: TN Health Dept
article.articleSummary: Chennai dengue cases rose to 1,290 in September, more than double August’s 605, with 72 Chennai cases on Sep 30. Across Tamil Nadu, dengue is rising. Thoothukudi Government Medical College Hospital has designated 60 adult and 40 paediatric dengue wards with isolation beds and mosquito nets, and reports adequate stocks of IV fluids, medicines, plasma, and blood components, with capacity to expand beds if admissions rise. Dengue typically progresses in three phases; the critical phase, typically on the fifth or sixth day, can involve severe abdominal pain, vomiting, muscle pain, and extreme fatigue, with thrombocytopenia increasing bleeding risk. Patients with high fever should seek immediate medical evaluation. Public health measures emphasize removing stagnant water, regularly emptying/cleaning containers, and keeping water storage covered to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイのデング熱症例が9月に倍増、1,290人が感染：タミル・ナードゥ州保健局
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイおよびタミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱症例が季節的に増加しているが、病院側は病床・医薬品等の対応能力を確保しており、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。流行性のある蚊媒介感染症であるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性・風土病的に発生しており、本記事は地域保健当局の対応状況を報告する内容。重症度や国際的拡大の兆候は明示されておらず、現時点ではPICKUPには該当しないが、症例数倍増という傾向から経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Mourners bury DR Congo official killed after defending Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a local UDSP politician who defended the government's Ebola response on radio, was beaten at his home and died of injuries after attackers set the house on fire. His funeral was held in Butembo on Wednesday. The killing occurs as DRC battles its 17th and deadliest Ebola outbreak, with over 8,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak has no vaccine or specific treatment, though researchers are testing candidates. The WHO lists Ebola in Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi and Tshopo, with Ituri the most affected. Village-based responses face distrust, with some residents denying Ebola and avoiding care. In eastern DRC, rebel-held areas and protracted conflict worsen the response, with Tedros warning of a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対応を擁護した当局者が殺害され埋葬される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最多規模（8000例超・死者約4000人）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ紛争地域での対応困難という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ対応を支持した政治家の殺害事件を報じているが、背景としてDRCの第17次・史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法未確立、紛争地域での対応困難）が継続している点が重要。WHOテドロス事務局長も疾病と紛争の「破滅的衝突」を警告しており、継続的な監視・フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Two of family die of Hepatitis A and E in Golaghat, child battles for life
article.articleSummary: Chinatoli Habichowa, Golaghat district, Assam, Oct 1, 2026: Four members of a single family tested positive for Hepatitis A and E (HAV/HEV). Two deaths reported: wife Himadri Saikia, 36, on Sept 20, and daughter Kristina Saikia, 9, on Sept 26. The 11-year-old son Tanmay Saikia remains hospitalised at Jorhat Medical College and Hospital; father Dilip Saikia has recovered after HAV/HEV infection. No other village residents tested positive. Water sample from the village was satisfactory; officials say HAV/HEV are curable but cannot rule out toxic hepatitis. Suspected factors include use of traditional jaundice remedies and possible food poisoning; hygienic issues in water collection and nearby environmental pollution from a dairy farm are noted. An awareness meeting is planned, and Assam Science Society will visit Oct 2 to assess environmental and water-collection concerns.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州ゴラガートで家族の2人がA型・E型肝炎で死亡、子どもは生死の境をさまよう
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族内のクラスターで、他の村民には感染が確認されておらず、水質検査も問題なしとされているため、国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 家族内クラスターで、死亡者は2名（妻・娘）、1名入院中、1名回復。水質は問題なしとされ、他の村民への感染拡大は確認されていない。伝統的な黄疸治療法や食中毒、酪農場からの環境汚染が疑われているが、地域的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la mort de Marie-Célestin Karondwa ravive les tensions autour d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the death of Marie-Célestin Karondwa rekindles tensions over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Marie-Célestin Karondwa, local UDPS official in Butembo, eastern DRC, died three days after a violent assault that also set his house on fire; his funeral took place in Lubero, Nord-Kivu. His death heightens tensions amid distrust of the Ebola response in Butembo, where health actors are intensifying community outreach and urging adherence to prevention measures. Family and party colleagues call for authorities to identify the perpetrators and clarify the circumstances. The episode comes as Ebola response efforts face suspicion that communities are skeptical or even hostile toward health workers, complicating surveillance and care. Dr Kalima Nzanzu, chief doctor at Matanda General Secondary Hospital, notes that people wrongly think health workers are paid to fight Ebola. The family seeks truth and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:マリー=セレスティン・カロンドワ氏の死がエボラ対応を巡る緊張を再燃させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応現場での地域社会の不信・暴力事案がサーベイランスや医療提供を妨げており、流行助長性・対応困難性の観点から懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 死因はエボラではなく暴行による死亡だが、地域住民のエボラ対応への不信・敵意が高まっており、既存のエボラ対応（ブテンボ）への影響が懸念される社会的事案。新規感染者数等の疫学情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 928 Kasus TBC di Ponorogo, 254 Penderitanya Anak di Bawah 14 Tahun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 928 TB cases in Ponorogo, 254 of them are children under 14 years old
article.articleSummary: TB remains a concern in Ponorogo Regency, East Java, Indonesia, where health authorities report 928 tuberculosis cases through September 2026, including 254 children under 14 years old. The Ponorogo Health Office warns that TB in children can be linked to growth disturbances, particularly when a child’s weight does not rise over time. Anik Setyarini, head of disease prevention and control, notes that TB in children is often observed alongside stunting, but a stagnant weight gain does not prove TB and requires further assessment by health workers. The department emphasizes active case finding to identify cases as early as possible, enabling prompt treatment and management based on medical condition. The article highlights the importance of pediatric screening and targeted investigations to differentiate TB from other growth-related issues.

triage.headline_ja: ポノロゴで結核928件、うち254件は14歳未満の子ども
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地方における既知の風土病状況の定例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す要素が見られない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアで長年の風土病であり、本記事は地方保健局による定例の症例報告・啓発活動の一環。パンデミックポテンシャルや新規性はない。

article.articleHeadline: "พัฒนา"ลุยน้ำท่วมปทุมฯซับน้ำตาผู้ประสบภัย เตือนระวังโรคฉี่หนู
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Phatana" wades through floodwaters in Pathum Thani, wiping away the tears of flood victims, and warns of leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Health Minister Phatana Phomphat visited flood shelters in Pathum Thani Province (Lam Luk Ka and Thanyaburi districts) to assess health operations and support vulnerable groups after flooding. Four sites were visited: Wat Mongkolrat shelter in Lam Luk Ka with 57 residents; Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi shelter for 150 children and 22 caregivers; Duang Kamol School shelter in Thanyaburi with 28 residents including eight bed-ridden; and a local hospital in Thanyaburi to support medical staff. Authorities distributed relief supplies and basic home medical kits, conducted health screenings for children, and reinforced infection control and sanitation. He warned the public to avoid floodwaters and venomous animals; wounds should be cleaned promptly to prevent leptospirosis, with medicines being distributed. People with exposure or symptoms such as headaches, body aches, or red eyes should seek care, checked via the MoR Prom app. Emphasis on protecting children, the elderly, and bed-bound patients while ensuring healthcare access during the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 「パタナ」氏、パトゥムタニ県の洪水地域を視察し被災者を慰問、レプトスピラ症（ネズミ尿病）に注意呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の衛生啓発・注意喚起であり、現時点で具体的な患者数や重症例の報告はないが、洪水継続による曝露拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 保健大臣による洪水被災地視察と注意喚起が主目的で、レプトスピラ症の実際の患者数データは記事中に明示されていない。洪水の長期化に伴う感染拡大リスクを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Dengue Cases Rise in Chennai, 1,290 People Affected in September: Tamil Nadu Health Department
article.articleSummary: Chennai, Tamil Nadu reports rising dengue cases, with 1,290 people diagnosed in September, more than double August's 605; across Tamil Nadu cases are increasing, and Chennai saw 72 dengue cases on September 30. In response, Thoothukudi Government Medical College Hospital established dedicated adult (60 beds) and paediatric (40 beds) dengue wards with isolation beds and mosquito nets to manage the seasonal surge, providing diagnostic testing and treatment for high fever and dengue-like symptoms. Medical Superintendent Dr R Padmanabhan notes dengue progresses in three phases: febrile, then a critical phase where platelet counts can fall causing thrombocytopenia and bleeding risk, requiring close monitoring. The hospital has adequate stocks of IV fluids, medicines, plasma and blood components. Officials urge fever patients to seek prompt evaluation and promote community measures to prevent mosquito breeding—empty stagnant water around homes, keep water containers covered. The hospital remains on alert and ready to expand capacity if admissions rise.

triage.headline_ja: インドニュース：チェンナイでデング熱症例が増加、9月に1,290人が感染：タミル・ナードゥ州保健局
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱症例増加であり、既知の感染症で対策も講じられているが、症例数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性流行で毎年発生。SFTS Virusは記事本文に言及なし（疾患タグに含まれるが内容と不一致の可能性）。病院は増床対応済みで管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Death of local official highlights tensions around Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Marie-Célestin Karondwa, a local UDPS official in Butembo, North Kivu, died three days after a violent attack on his way home; his house was later set on fire. Karondwa had appeared on local radio to discuss Ebola and politics. His death has shocked residents and sparked calls for a thorough investigation and for greater trust between communities and health workers fighting the Ebola outbreak. Mourners gathered in Butembo as his family demanded answers about who carried out the attack. The incident underscores mistrust surrounding the Ebola response in North Kivu, where some residents accuse health teams of financial motivation—claims health workers reject. Dr. Kalima Nzanzu, Chief Medical Officer at Matanda General Referral Hospital, emphasized that such accusations are unfounded. Karondwa was buried in Lubero.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:地元当局者の死亡がエボラ対応をめぐる緊張を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州の既存エボラ流行をめぐる住民の不信感と暴力事件を報じているが、感染拡大や新規症例増加に関する具体的情報はなく、既知流行に付随する社会的緊張の続報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行対応に対する地域コミュニティの不信感と、関連する暴力事件・政治的緊張に焦点を当てており、エボラ感染拡大自体の新規情報は含まれていない。既存流行の対応状況として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia: Lusaka Street Vendors Defy Eviction Deadline as Cholera Returns
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak declared in Zambia on 30 September 2026, with 304 cases and 11 deaths reported as of 29 September across seven districts including Lusaka. In Lusaka, street vendors operating on Cairo Road, Lumumba Road and Freedom Way persisted after a 29 September deadline to vacate undesignated trading areas, while enforcement was planned to begin 30 September. Mayor Chitambala Mwewa, elected August 2026, seeks to move traders into markets, citing the Markets and Bus Stations Act No. 7 of 2007 and Statutory Instrument No. 12 of 2018. Cholera is a waterborne disease that spreads where sanitation is poor; crowded markets lacking toilets or clean water are high risk. The eviction drive is framed as a public-health measure, with IMF talks in Lusaka and broader economic pressures potentially shaping resources for sanitation. No laboratory confirmation details or imported/exported cases are noted.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：ルサカの露天商、コレラ再流行の中で退去期限に従わず
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアで304例・11死亡のコレラアウトブレイクが7地区に拡大しており、衛生状態の悪い市場での感染拡大リスクと社会的関心（露天商の抵抗、行政対応）が認められるため。
triage.notes: コレラはザンビアで流行性の高い疾患であり、衛生インフラの不足が市場の露天商周辺で感染リスクを高めている。致死率(約3.6%)はやや高く、公衆衛生対応の強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Indonesia Muncul di Beberapa Wilayah, IDAI Ingatkan Ada Peluang Komplikasi pada Kelompok Rentan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Influenza A in Indonesia Have Emerged in Several Regions, IDAI Warns of Potential Complications in Vulnerable Groups
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases have emerged across multiple regions in Indonesia, with Influenza A H3N2 subclade K, popularly termed the ‘Super Flu,’ detected in 13 provinces. East Java reports rising case numbers in line with Southeast Asia transmission activity per the WHO Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Bulletin through epidemiological week 35 of 2026. The Indonesian Pediatric Association (IDAI) warns children aged 0–17 are about twice as likely to develop symptomatic influenza and at higher risk of serious complications, potentially making them sources of transmission within families and schools. Dr. Hikari Ambari Sjakti underscores kids’ immature immune systems. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono says most Influenza A infections are not dangerous and are self-limiting, with no significant national or global uptick observed. Influenza tends to rise during Indonesia’s rainy season, with cases expected to decline around February–March, as of 1 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでインフルエンザA型の症例が複数地域で発生、IDAIは脆弱層への合併症リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 新亜系統H3N2 subclade K（通称『スーパーフル』）が13州で検出され、政府高官やIDAIが注意喚起しており社会的・行政的関心が高い。ただし当局は重篤度は低いと評価している。
triage.notes: 保健省副大臣は『全国的・世界的な顕著な増加はなく、大半は軽症で自然治癒する』とコメントしており、重症度は限定的と評価されている。小児における合併症リスクとWHO地域監視速報における東南アジアの流行活動が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna humana obrigam escola e creche de MG a suspender as aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of human scabies force the school and daycare in Minas Gerais to suspend classes.
article.articleSummary: Cases of human scabies in Minas Gerais, Brazil prompted suspensions in a daycare in Andradas (72-hour closure) and a municipal school in Lagoa Santa (21 suspected cases among students and teachers). Lagoa Santa’s Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Maria suspended classes through Oct 2 for thorough cleaning, pest control, and water-tank sanitization; Andradas creche closed for 72 hours with similar cleaning and ongoing monitoring. Health authorities advise families not to send symptomatic children and to seek care. Scabies is caused by a skin mite and is highly contagious via skin contact and contaminated objects; main symptom is intense itching and red lesions, potentially affecting joints, inner elbows, behind the knees, and hands, with spread to the whole body. Treatment may involve topical cream and oral anti-helminthic, used together or separately depending on infestation extent.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州で疥癬の症例、学校と保育園が休校に
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は局所的な集団発生であり重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、IHR・WPRO基準をほぼ満たさないため見送り。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト感染するがIHR通知対象疾患ではなく、学校単位の局所的事案。重症度・国際的関心は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng ca cúm mùa, Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo người dân chủ động phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza cases on the rise; the Ministry of Health urges the public to take proactive measures to prevent illness.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza cases are rising in Vietnam, with surveillance reporting a modest uptick and no marked increase in severe illness or deaths. The Preventive Medicine Department of the Ministry of Health urges proactive protection for high-risk groups. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces; influenza occurs year-round but peaks during seasonal transitions. Most infections are mild with fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose, but serious outcomes can occur in the elderly, children under 5, pregnant women (late in pregnancy), and those with underlying conditions such as heart or lung disease, kidney or liver disease, diabetes, or immunodeficiency. Preventive measures include masking in health facilities and crowded spaces; cough etiquette, hand hygiene, surface cleaning, and improved ventilation. Those with symptoms should limit contact, rest, and seek medical advice if at-risk or symptoms worsen. Ongoing monitoring and guideline updates will continue.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザ患者が増加、保健省が住民に積極的な予防対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、重症化や死亡の顕著な増加は報告されていない。異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められない定例的な公衆衛生広報。
triage.notes: 季節的なインフルエンザ流行に関する通常の保健省からの注意喚起であり、重症例や死亡増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 民族國小9學生吃營養午餐後不適　蔣萬安：不排除諾羅
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 9 students at Minzu Elementary School fell ill after eating the nutritious school lunch; Chiang Wan-an: Norovirus cannot be ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Nine students from a second-grade class at Minzu Elementary School in Taipei’s Songshan District fell ill after a nutritious school lunch on the 24th, with 716 staff and students having eaten that meal. The lunch supplier is the same company serving Jin Hua Junior High School. Mayor Chiang Wan-an said doctors preliminarily diagnosed gastroenteritis but did not rule out norovirus; influenza or norovirus remained possible causes. The Taipei City Department of Health has sent specimens to a laboratory for testing, with results pending. Six of the nine ill students sought medical care; clinicians described the illness as gastroenteritis, noting that even students who ate vegetarian meals were affected. The school disinfected classrooms and the affected students have returned to class. An investigation continues to identify the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 民族国小9名の学生が給食後に体調不良　蒋万安市長：ノロウイルスの可能性も排除せず
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一小学校内での小規模な食中毒様症状（9名）であり、原因病原体も未確定。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や渡航・貿易制限リスクは認められず、対象国（台湾は非対象）でもない。
triage.notes: 台湾(Taipei)での学校給食後の集団体調不良事例。台湾は本評価の対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。原因病原体（ノロウイルス/インフルエンザ）は未確定で検査結果待ち。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू की दस्तक से अस्पताल अलर्ट, इस राज्य में तेजी से बढ़ रहे मामले... एक महीने में 1,290 डेंगू केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitals on alert as dengue makes its presence felt in this state; cases rising rapidly... 1,290 dengue cases in a month.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge in Tamil Nadu, India, with Chennai seeing rising cases. In September, Tamil Nadu reported 1,290 dengue cases, more than double August's 605; Chennai alone recorded 72 dengue cases on 30 September. In response, Thoothukudi Government Medical College Hospital established dedicated adult (about 60 beds) and pediatric (40 beds) wards, equipped with isolation beds, mosquito nets, and stockpiles of IV fluids, medications, plasma and blood components to manage a projected seasonal surge. Dengue typically presents in three phases: febrile, followed by a potential critical phase around day 5–6 causing abdominal pain, vomiting, myalgia, and extreme fatigue; platelets may fall, risking thrombocytopenia and bleeding (nose, mouth, or urinary tract). Doctors urge immediate medical evaluation for high fever and emphasize community measures to reduce mosquito breeding, such as eliminating standing water in homes, pots, containers, and ensuring water storage coverings. Hospitals are on alert to expand capacity if cases rise.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が始まり病院が警戒態勢に、この州で症例が急増中…1か月で1,290件のデング熱症例
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州でデング熱症例が急増し病院が対応を強化しているが、季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: SFTS Virusは記事サマリー・本文に言及なく、デング熱のみが主題。季節性のデング熱流行であり、地域医療体制内で対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea Claims 2 Lives In Odisha's Ganjam, 19 Hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea outbreak in Odisha's Ganjam district has claimed two lives and hospitalized at least 19 people across Marthapur village (Podamari panchayat, Sanakhemundi block) and Patashala village (Dharakote block). The deceased are Surendra Mallik, 60, who died during treatment at MKCG Medical College and Hospital, and Susanta Malik, 36, who died on Tuesday. More than 15 people in Patashala and several others in Marthapur have developed diarrhoea and vomiting after attending a feast. The exact cause is not yet established; food poisoning is suspected. Drinking water and other materials have been collected for laboratory testing. Health teams, ASHA workers, and a district special unit are conducting treatment and intensified surveillance. Sarpanch Santosh Bishoyi urged sanitation measures and disinfection of drinking-water sources by RWSS to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州ガンジャム県で下痢により2人死亡、19人入院
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑いの下痢集団発生で死者・入院者が出ているが、原因未確定かつ局地的な村落レベルの事案であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。続報（検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因は食中毒が疑われており、飲料水や食品の検査結果待ち。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く、地元保健当局による対応で管理可能と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Children, biggest victims of rabies - WHO
article.articleSummary: Rabies causes about 59,000 human deaths globally each year, with roughly 40% of fatalities in children under 15. Most cases occur in Asia and Africa. Domestic dogs are responsible for about 99% of human transmissions; other mammals such as cats, bats, and monkeys can also transmit. Rabies is 100% preventable, but once symptoms appear it is 100% fatal. It is a viral disease of warm-blooded animals that attacks the brain and nervous system. In humans, transmission is mainly via saliva, usually through a bite or scratch, with the virus entering through a skin break and death following brain involvement. In Ghana, the Veterinary Services Directorate reported in 2024 26 human rabies deaths from 31 cases across nine regions. The article frames rabies as a major public health threat.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもが狂犬病の最大の犠牲者 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病に関するWHOの一般的な啓発記事であり、新規の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。ガーナの2024年データも既知の風土病状況の紹介に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病に関する一般的な統計・啓発内容であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ガーナの2024年データ（26人死亡/31症例）は既存の風土病の文脈で言及されている。
