Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: MP में स्वाइन फ्लू से मौत: जिला अस्पताल आईसीयू वार्ड में 3 दिन से भर्ती था मरीज, डेंगू के 15 सैंपल भी पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death due to swine flu in Madhya Pradesh: The patient had been admitted to the district hospital ICU ward for 3 days, and 15 dengue samples were also positive.
article.articleSummary: Death due to swine influenza (H1N1) in Madhya Pradesh: A patient admitted to the district hospital ICU in Chhindwara for three days succumbed despite treatment. The death triggered heightened vigilance; infection-control measures were tightened in the ICU and other sensitive wards. In the same facility, 15 dengue samples returned positive, evidencing concurrent rising dengue activity. Health authorities are concerned about the dual burden of swine flu and dengue. Public health messaging emphasizes infection-control precautions, avoiding crowded places, and mask use. Doctors advise anyone with fever, cough, cold, or body aches to seek prompt medical consultation and testing. The report, from Chhindwara, notes no further details on age or gender. Ongoing surveillance and infection-prevention efforts are being intensified in the district hospital.

triage.headline_ja: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州で豚インフルエンザにより死亡：患者は県立病院ICUに3日間入院、デング熱サンプルも15件陽性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)とデング熱の同時発生による1件の死亡例であり、局地的な医療対応事案に留まるが、重症例・院内感染対策強化の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1とデング熱はインドで季節的に繰り返し発生する疾患であり、本件は単一地域(Chhindwara)の医療機関における局地的な事例。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、二重感染負荷への懸念から地元当局が警戒を強めている。

article.articleHeadline: Jakarta Darurat Influenza-DBD: RSUD Kewalahan, DPRD Desak RS Swasta Segera Buka Layanan BPJS!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jakarta in Influenza-Dengue Fever Emergency: Regional General Hospital Overwhelmed, DPRD Urges Private Hospitals to Open BPJS Services Immediately!
article.articleSummary: Jakarta is experiencing rising cases of Influenza A, dengue fever (DHF), and acute respiratory infection (ARI), with hospital capacity under pressure. The surge is most evident in South Jakarta’s Pasar Minggu, where several facilities are overwhelmed. Private hospitals that do not partner with BPJS Kesehatan are redirecting patients toward RSUD Pasar Minggu, contributing to full inpatient wards. Residents report waiting lists for admission of 50 and even hundreds of patients. Nabilah Aboebakar Alhabsyi of the Jakarta DPRD called for rapid action to strengthen health service capacity and reduce access bottlenecks. She urged the provincial government to expand BPJS access by encouraging private hospitals, particularly in Pasar Minggu, to join BPJS. The remarks were made during a Plenary Session with Governor Pramono Anung on 1 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタでインフルエンザ・デング熱非常事態：地域総合病院が対応不能、州議会が民間病院にBPJSサービスの早期開設を要求
triage.triage_reason: 季節性疾患（インフルエンザA・デング熱）の急増により病床が逼迫し、議会が公的対応を求めるなど社会的・政治的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAとデング熱は既知の季節性疾患であり新興病原体ではないが、ジャカルタ南部で病床逼迫・待機患者数百人規模という医療キャパシティ危機が報じられ、地方議会が緊急対応を要求している。新興感染症シグナルというより医療システム負荷の問題だが、社会的関心の高さからPICKUPとした。

article.articleHeadline: Aktivitas Influenza Naik hingga 56 Persen, DPR Minta Pemerintah Perkuat Surveilans dan Layanan Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Activity Rises by Up to 56 Percent, House of Representatives Urges Government to Strengthen Surveillance and Health Services
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia is rising, with surveillance through week 38 of 2026 showing about 56% of influenza tests positive, reflecting an uptick across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Jakarta-based lawmakers (Commission IX, Netty Prasetiyani) urged strengthened surveillance, health facility readiness, and consistent public communication to detect early changes in influenza patterns and respond appropriately, while avoiding public panic and prohibiting indiscriminate antivirals purchasing. They emphasized that monitoring should support timely public health actions and that antivirals like oseltamivir be used only per medical indication. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono noted that most influenza A infections are non-severe and self-limiting, with no significant national or global rise; patterns resemble typical influenza—up before the rainy season and diminishing around February–March.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ活動が56%まで上昇、国会が政府に監視体制と医療サービスの強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の変動範囲内であり、保健省副大臣も非重篤・自己限定的で国内外的に有意な増加はないと明言しているため、シグナルとしての該当基準がない。
triage.notes: 国会議員が監視強化を要請し政治的関心はあるが、保健当局は季節性の通常パターン（雨季前の上昇、2〜3月頃に減少）であり、インフルエンザA感染の大半は非重篤・自己限定的と評価している。重症例の急増や異常なヒト-ヒト感染拡大の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: G20 cam kết thêm hơn 470 triệu USD hỗ trợ Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo ứng phó Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: G20 pledges more than $470 million to support the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks are concentrated in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where conflict and weak health infrastructure hinder response. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which vaccines and diagnostics are less effective. As of 30 September 2026, G20 members and other donors pledged over $470 million to the DRC response, lifting total international commitments since May to over $2 billion. The United States pledged $267 million for health and humanitarian activities, bringing its direct aid to $887 million; other supporters include the World Bank, United Kingdom, Germany, South Korea, France, Italy, UAE, Australia, and Japan. Funds will cover treatment, personal protective equipment, testing, safe burials, community outreach, and surveillance, and bolster contact tracing, treatment capacity, and vaccine research. Neighbouring countries are urged to prepare to prevent cross-border spread; Uganda’s outbreak response is cited as a coordination model. The outbreak is described as controlled but remains at risk due to new foci and spread to a seventh province.

triage.headline_ja: G20、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応支援に4億7000万ドル超の追加拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）が新たな地域に拡大し、国際的な資金支援（G20による4.7億ドル超）が行われていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、フルリスク評価に進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれる韓国・米国・イタリア・日本・フランス・ドイツ・UAE・英国・オーストラリアは資金拠出国であり、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対応モデルとして言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生国ではなく対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا: تعهدات جديدة تتجاوز 470 مليون دولار لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S.: New commitments exceeding $470 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al-Ahram Portal
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-01, United States announced that a G20 ministers’ meeting to renew commitments to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo yielded pledges exceeding $470 million, lifting total global Ebola commitments to over $2 billion since the outbreak began in May 2026. As current G20 chair, United States invited health and humanitarian donors—including Poland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Singapore, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates—and organizations such as Africa CDC, UNOCHA, the Pandemic Fund, UNICEF, and the World Bank to an Ebola meeting. The statement urges intensified response in hotspots, expanded contact tracing, frontline protection, greater bed capacity, new diagnostics, and vaccine development investment. Uganda’s August outbreak containment is cited as evidence of the approach’s potential. United States also announced an additional $267 million in health aid, bringing direct US aid to $887 million to support Ebola treatment units, health services, safe-burial teams, PPE, and expanded surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対策に4億7000万ドル超の新規拠出表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（2026年5月発生）に対し、G20による大規模国際資金拠出が行われており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な継続的危機であるため、フルリスク評価の対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月からDRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対する国際的な資金拠出（G20関連）についてのアップデートであり、新規発生地ではなく既存の流行国（DRC）のみが対象国に該当。他国（米国、ノルウェー、オランダ、アイルランド、ポーランド、カタール、ウガンダ、シンガポール、UAE）は拠出国・会議参加国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra : l'OMS alerte, les décès atteignent un niveau inédit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera: WHO warns, deaths reach an unprecedented level.
article.articleSummary: Cholera caused 7,870 deaths in 2025, up 30% from 2024, with 451,499 cases in 47 countries—the highest toll since 1999. Burden is highly concentrated: Angola, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Sudan, South Sudan, Yemen, and the Democratic Republic of Congo account for about 90% of cases and deaths. In Africa, cases rose 34% and deaths 58% versus 2024. Vibrio cholerae transmits via contaminated water and food; over one-fifth of 2025 deaths occurred outside health facilities, underscoring care delays. Global CFR among treated patients remained under 1%, but 12 countries exceeded it in 2025. Vaccines expanded: production rose to ~80 million doses in 2025; the ICG approved 71 million doses for affected countries, including 20 million for preventive vaccination restarted in 2025. Meningitis belt reports 21,526 suspected cases and 971 deaths (4.5% CFR); Niger launched Men5CV/MMCV. Plague: 3,847 suspected cases, 423 deaths across 10 countries, mainly DRC and Madagascar; stresses ongoing surveillance and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ:WHOが警告、死者数が過去最高水準に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な規模、47カ国への国際拡大)に該当し、WHOが世界的警告を発している重大なグローバル感染症イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界コレラ・ペスト報告であり、主要被害国としてAngola/Bangladesh/Nigeria/Sudan/South Sudan/Yemen/DRCが挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Madagascarはペスト主要発生国として言及されるが対象国リストに非該当のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lawmaker urges govt to strengthen flu response as Indonesia cases rise
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in Indonesia, with Health Ministry data showing a 56% influenza positivity rate by the 38th week of 2026. Lawmaker Netty Prasetiyani urged stronger vigilance, surveillance, healthcare facility readiness, and consistent public communication, and cautioned against panic buying of antivirals such as oseltamivir, noting treatment should follow medical indications. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono said the current spread of influenza A is generally not dangerous and self-limiting, with no significant spike locally or globally; transmission typically peaks before Indonesia’s rainy season and declines around February–March. Officials emphasize early detection and ongoing severity monitoring, and public messaging should remain calm and guided by healthcare professionals. The stance aligns with Southeast Asia trends of rising flu activity while preventive measures are stressed.

triage.headline_ja: 議員、インドネシアでインフルエンザ患者増加につき政府にインフルエンザ対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型陽性率の上昇が報告されているが、政府当局は危険性が低く自己限定的と評価しており、現時点で重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 政府高官は季節性の流行であり重症度は低いと説明。議員からの政治的関心は示されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Moradabad News: संचारी रोगों से बचाव को निकली जागरूकता रैली
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moradabad News: Awareness rally launched for the prevention of communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, Moradabad organized an awareness rally under a Special Communicable Disease Control campaign led by the Health Department to prevent communicable diseases. Moradabad MLA Ritesh Gupta and Chief Medical Officer Dr. Kuldeep Singh flagged off the event, with District Panchayat President Saifali Gupta and BJP city president Girish Bhandola in attendance. The rally started at the Chief Medical Officer’s office and proceeded to Commissioner Housing, Jain Temple, ending at Company Bagh. Participants included malaria workers, ASHA workers, staff nurses, and ANMs. District Malaria Officer Dr. Praveen Shrivastav urged residents to prevent water stagnation around homes to reduce malaria risk and other water-related infections. The event focused on awareness and preventive measures rather than documenting cases or outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: モラダバードニュース：感染症予防のための啓発ラリーが実施される
triage.triage_reason: 特定の症例・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、マラリア等の感染症予防を目的とした啓発活動の報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体・保健当局による予防啓発イベントの報道であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: INFOGRAFIK: Waspada Lonjakan Kasus Influenza Tipe A - Infografik Katadata.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: INFOGRAPHIC: Beware of a surge in Influenza A cases - Infographic by Katadata.co.id.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports a surge in Influenza A with 293 cases over the past three weeks, a 692% rise from last year, and 93% of cases attributed to the H1N1pdm09 subtype. No deaths have been recorded as of September 30. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, muscle and joint pain, dry cough, headache, and extreme fatigue, with potential progression to pneumonia, myocarditis, or encephalitis. Children, the elderly, and those with underlying conditions are at higher risk for severe disease. Health officials note transmission rises during the rainy season and typically wanes around February–March. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin and Deputy Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono emphasize this strain is new but not inherently deadly, and urge against indiscriminate use of antivirals or antibiotics to avoid antimicrobial resistance. Public health guidance calls for hygiene, masking when ill, and prompt medical care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: インフォグラフィック：インフルエンザA型の急増に警戒 - Katadata.co.idインフォグラフィック
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09)の症例数急増（692%増）が報告されているが、死亡例はなく、新規株だが致死性は高くないと当局が説明しており、IHR基準の該当は限定的。経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Власти Таиланда предупредили туристов о риске заражения крысиной лихорадкой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai authorities warned tourists about the risk of contracting leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in Thailand amid seasonal floods. The Department of Disease Control under the Ministry of Public Health warns residents and tourists to avoid contact with floodwaters during movement in flooded areas and while cleaning. The microorganism Leptospira can enter via broken skin, abrasions, and mucous membranes; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, and red eyes after water exposure. Early antibiotic treatment reduces severity and mortality. Since the start of the year Thailand has logged about 3,300 leptospirosis cases and 46 deaths. Flooding from the monsoon has affected over 2.6 million people, with about 40 flood-related fatalities; Bangkok reports receding waters but some roads remain flooded. The advisory aims to mitigate transmission risk among locals and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: タイ当局、観光客にレプトスピラ症（鼠咬熱/ワイル病）感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性洪水に伴いタイで年間約3,300例・46名死亡のレプトスピラ症が発生しており、政府が公式に注意喚起している。洪水継続による曝露拡大と一定の重症度（死亡例）があり、社会的・行政的関心も確認されるためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年モンスーン期に発生する季節性・風土病的疾患であり、人-人感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし死亡者数（46名）と洪水による継続的曝露（260万人影響）から、観光客向けの注意喚起として一定の社会的関心が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化3年來首見本土登革熱群聚　2病例住家僅距110公尺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua's first locally transmitted dengue fever cluster in three years; two cases' homes are only 110 meters apart.
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan reports a new locally transmitted dengue fever case in Changhua City: a man in his 60s with dengue virus serotype 1 confirmed after late-September fever, diarrhea, and malaise; he is hospitalized. The patient’s residence lies about 110 meters from the site of the first local type-1 dengue case announced on Sept 18, suggesting a community cluster; sequencing will clarify linkage. Vector-control teams have surveyed breeding sites, cleared sources, and prepared community screening stations; by Sept 29 they identified 544 standing-water containers, 70 positive, and issued 21 enforcement records. Nationally, as of Sept 30, 178 dengue cases: 12 locally acquired (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2) and 166 imported; primary origins: Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20. Public health guidance emphasizes draining, cleaning, and eliminating breeding sites; use approved repellents and seek care for fever with travel/contact history.

triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化県・高雄市）における局地的デング熱クラスターであり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化爆發3年來首起本土登革熱群聚！ 兩住家僅距110公尺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua Reports First Local Dengue Fever Cluster in Three Years! Two Households Only 110 Meters Apart.
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan reports the first locally acquired dengue fever cluster in three years, with one new indigenous case in Changhua City. A man in his 60s developed fever, diarrhea and malaise in late September; dengue virus type 1 was confirmed and he remains hospitalized. His close contacts show no symptoms; the case resides about 110 meters from September 18’s first local dengue case, leading officials to treat it as a community cluster and plan sequencing to clarify linkage. Public health actions include vector surveillance and source reduction around residences and activity sites, with 544 standing-water containers checked and 70 positive; 21 inspection notices issued. A mobile epidemic-response team has conducted 34 deployments through September 29. Community screening stations are planned. Taiwan’s dengue tally by September 30: 178 confirmed cases, 12 local (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2) and 166 imported (Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20). Preventive guidance emphasizes “surveillance, drain, clean, repel” and urges medical care if dengue symptoms arise, with travel history disclosed.

article.articleHeadline: Khám sàng lọc, phát hiện bệnh lao và các bệnh lý hô hấp tại cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Screening and detection of tuberculosis and other respiratory diseases in the community.
article.articleSummary: Community screening in Ha Tinh Province and Yen Thanh district screened over 1,700 residents on Sept 28–29, 2026, identifying 139 people with lung lesions, 4 tuberculosis cases, and 159 respiratory diseases. In Yen Thanh, three sites (Tam Thanh Health Post, Hoa Thanh Health Post, and the town’s Health Post) screened about 700 people; chest X-rays found 81 lesions, with 61 GeneXpert tests conducted. Results: 4 TB cases and 70 other respiratory diseases, with TB patients managed per the national TB program. In Xuan Thanh, Quan Thanh Commune, 210 people were screened, detecting 16 respiratory diseases. In Van Du Commune, 791 people were screened; 58 X-ray lesions and 73 other respiratory diseases were found, with 30 GeneXpert tests. Overall, suspected TB underwent GeneXpert testing; residents received counseling and follow-up care. By mid-September 2026, nearly 738,000 residents of Ha Tinh had health checks, about 55% of the population.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza cases on the rise; the Ministry of Health recommends preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in Vietnam shows a modest uptick in cases over the past several weeks, but there has been no unusual rise in severe illness or deaths. The Ministry of Health advises the public to take preventive measures against influenza. Particular emphasis is on protecting high-risk groups who are more likely to experience complications: young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with underlying medical conditions. No alarming trend in hospitalizations or fatalities has been reported to date. The statement underscores continued surveillance and public health messaging to reduce transmission and safeguard vulnerable populations during the influenza season. Published 1 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Enggano Masih Bebas Rabies, Karantina Bengkulu Perketat Pengawasan di Laut-Udara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enggano Still Rabies-Free, Bengkulu Quarantine Tightens Surveillance at Sea and in the Air.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-free Enggano Island in Bengkulu Province remains protected as the Bengkulu Quarantine Office tightens maritime and air surveillance to prevent entry of rabies-positives such as dogs, cats, and primates. Authorized quarantine chief Betty Fajarwati says Enggano's island geography requires multi-entry-point oversight, including the Port of Pulau Baai, Malakoni, and Kahyapu, with ships M.H. Thamrin and KMP Pulau Tello docking at Malakoni and Kahyapu respectively. Air safety covers Fatmawati Soekarno Airport and Enggano Airport, with four weekly Susi Air Cessna 12-seat flights. Vaccination was conducted Sept 29-30 as part of Indonesia’s 149th Quarantine Day, focusing at the Enggano ferry terminal area. Besides HPR controls, authorities monitor staple commodities (rice, vegetables, fruits, onions, chilies) to avoid bottlenecks. A cat was refused entry once. Ongoing collaboration with police, naval, military, district authorities, and airport management aims to maintain rabies-free status and rapid response to non-compliant goods.

article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ebola: le G20 et d'autres donateurs annoncent plus de 470 millions de dollars supplémentaires, portant les engagements mondiaux à plus de 2 milliards
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC-Ebola: the G20 and other donors announce more than $470 million in additional funding, bringing global commitments to more than $2 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists; G20 and other donors commit over $470 million, pushing global funding above $2 billion since the outbreak began in May 2026 (late September 2026). The United States adds $267 million in health and humanitarian support, bringing direct Ebola assistance to $887 million; separate humanitarian aid this year totals $350 million. The World Bank pledges $90 million (80 for crisis response, 10 to protect essential health services); the United Kingdom $67.5 million (total $105.6m); Germany $24.8m; France $16m (total $34m); with additional contributions from South Korea $18m, Italy $11.3m, UAE $10m, Japan $5m, and Australia $3.5m. The response faces challenges: the outbreak is centered in an isolated, conflict-affected area, and vaccines, diagnostics and treatments are not fully effective against Bundibugyo virus. Authorities urge intensified contact tracing, responder protection, hospitalization capacity, new diagnostics, and vaccine development. Disbursement details are not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ：G20やその他の資金提供国が4億7000万ドル超の追加支援を発表、世界全体のコミットメントは20億ドルを超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクに関する大規模国際資金支援のニュースであり、IHR基準の重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は資金援助に関する報道であり、発生地域リストに含まれる韓国・米国・イタリア・日本・フランス・豪州・ドイツ・UAE・英国は資金拠出国であり、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。アウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の紛争影響地域に限定されており、ワクチン・診断・治療がブンディブギョウイルスに対して十分な効果を示していない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Cazurile de Covid sunt în creştere în Europa: "O recrudescență globală a epidemiei" / Pacienții cei mai expuși riscului sunt cei vulnerabili / "În cazul femeilor însărcinate, o infecție cu Covid poate duce uneori la avort spontan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases are on the rise in Europe: "A global recrudescence of the epidemic" / The patients most at risk are the vulnerable / "In the case of pregnant women, a COVID-19 infection can sometimes lead to spontaneous abortion."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Europe, signaling a global recrudescence of SARS-CoV-2. France reports increasing COVID-19 consultations across all age groups in the Santé publique France bulletin (week Sept 14–20), with a 76% jump from the prior week. Observers note upticks in China and ongoing increases in the United States and parts of Asia. Professor Antoine Flahault says the surge accompanies higher emergency visits and hospitalizations, with the most vulnerable—immunocompromised individuals, the elderly, and pregnant women—at greater risk; infection in pregnancy can occasionally cause spontaneous abortion. In France, no single driving variant has been identified; instead, circulating Omicron sublineages—already known in Europe since January 2022—are driving increased transmission. Experts warn other pandemics loom due to antimicrobial resistance and zoonoses, stressing European autonomy in medical supplies and industrial adaptation.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州でCOVID-19症例が増加:「世界的な流行再燃」／最もリスクが高いのは脆弱な患者／「妊婦の場合、COVID感染が時に流産を引き起こすことがある」

triage.notes: 記事の主題は欧州（特にフランス）における季節性COVID-19増加であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（中国・米国等）は言及されているものの主題ではないため除外した。既知のオミクロン系統による通常の季節変動と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Tangerang Waspadai Influenza Tipe A pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang Health Office Warns About Influenza Type A in Children
article.articleSummary: Influenza Type A in children prompts warning from the Tangerang City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Tangerang) in Indonesia. The advisory says Type A influenza can begin like a normal flu but may present with sudden high fever, cough, and sometimes shortness of breath, especially in children. Parents are urged to monitor for rapid fever escalation, weakness, digestive disturbances, or a cough severe enough to impair breathing, and to seek care at an advanced facility if home or primary care does not improve. Initial management remains symptomatic—rest and adequate nutrition. If high fever cannot be controlled at home or at primary care, patients should be referred to hospital for further evaluation. The Dinkes continues community education through puskesmas networks and social media, emphasizing hygiene and health maintenance, and that there is no need to panic but vigilance for pediatric influenza symptoms.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis B patients on the rise in the district; six tested positive in one month.
article.articleSummary: Six Hepatitis B cases were confirmed in Maharajganj district in September, as per the district hospital’s pathology lab, signaling a rising trend. In September, 770 people were tested for Hepatitis B, with six positives. Health authorities have moved to control the spread, directing CHC supervisors and in-charge medical officers to ensure timely vaccination for children; the vaccine is free at government hospitals. Hepatitis B is a serious viral liver infection with acute and chronic forms; chronic infection can lead to liver cirrhosis or cancer. Symptoms include extreme fatigue, dark urine, abdominal pain, nausea, and jaundice. Transmission occurs through contact with blood or other body fluids, unsafe sex, shared needles, mother-to-child transmission at birth, and via shared razors or personal items. Diagnosed patients are advised to take regular medication and maintain routine medical consultations.

triage.headline_ja: 県内でB型肝炎患者が増加、1か月で6人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 地域の慢性的なB型肝炎であり、ワクチン接種体制も整っていることから、異常性・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方の地域紙記事であり、感染者数（770人中6人陽性）は特段の異常値ではなく、通常の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種の徹底）で管理されている事例。

article.articleHeadline: Measles and malaria outbreak claims lives of 32 children in India's tribal heartland
article.articleSummary: Measles and falciparum malaria co-infection has killed at least 32 children in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, India, since May 2026, with deaths concentrated in Birsa and Baihar forest blocks and remote villages such as Bondari and Machurda. Victims belong predominantly to Baiga (PVTG) and Gond tribal communities; chronic malnutrition and lack of access to clean drinking water are key risk factors. Official vaccination records appear hollow, suggesting immunisation drives were not effectively implemented and enabling measles spread in a malnourished population already burdened by malaria. Investigations describe a breakdown in routine health surveillance and a dramatic healthcare access gap in the region. The Madhya Pradesh High Court has ordered surveys following a Public Interest Litigation; the Union Health Ministry dispatched a National Joint Outbreak Response Team on 12 August 2026 to probe the outbreak. Authorities stress emergency aid and long-term provision of clean water and functional village health centers.

triage.headline_ja: インドの部族地域で麻疹とマラリアの流行により子供32人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデシュ州の脆弱な部族コミュニティで麻疹とマラリアの重複感染により32人の子供が死亡し、予防接種体制の機能不全や保健サーベイランスの破綻が指摘されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウクライナ（Odeska Oblast, Bondari）が含まれているが、記事本文はインド・マディヤプラデシュ州のみを主題としており、Bluedotの地域付与誤りと判断しvetified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 台南第8例登革熱境外移入　越南旅遊返台發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's 8th imported dengue fever case; illness onset after returning to Taiwan from a trip to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: 8th imported dengue fever case in Tainan, Taiwan: a woman in her 50s from the Southern District traveled to Ha Long Bay, Vietnam (Sept 19–24). After returning, she developed fever on Sept 27 and was laboratory-confirmed with dengue fever type 1 on Sept 28. She had shopped for clothing at Shui Xian Gong Market (West Central District) and Guiren Market (Guiren District) on Sept 26–27. Tainan Dengue Prevention Center conducted emergency fogging around her residence and venues, cleared breeding sources, and planned indoor/outdoor chemical control to lower vector density and reduce community transmission risk. Taiwan totals 176 dengue cases: 11 locally transmitted, 165 imported, as of Oct 1, 2026, with Vietnam the leading source, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, the Maldives, and Malaysia. The case highlights ongoing importation risk from international travel.

triage.headline_ja: 台南第8例輸入性デング熱症例　ベトナム旅行後に台湾で発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱症例の通常の公衆衛生対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、特段の異常性もない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン・マレーシア・モルディブは感染源として言及されているが、実際の発症・流行国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化登革熱再增1例！與首例僅隔110公尺 疑社區群聚
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua dengue fever: another case reported! Only 110 meters from the first case; suspected community cluster.
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue fever cases reported in Changhua County, Taiwan, forming the first local cluster there since 2023. The latest patient is a man in his 60s from Changhua City who developed fever, diarrhea, and malaise in late September and is hospitalized after testing positive for dengue fever type 1. His home is about 110 meters from the site of the 18 September first local case, prompting authorities to classify a community cluster and perform sequencing to determine linkage. Mobile epidemic teams inspected 544 standing water containers, with 70 positive for larvae and 21 inspection records issued. Nationally, by 30 September there were 178 confirmed dengue cases: 12 locally transmitted (10 Kaohsiung, 2 Changhua) and 166 imported (Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines). Preventive guidance emphasizes patrol, drain, clean, and spray; use DEET, Picaridin, or IR-3535 repellents; seek medical care for fever and related symptoms and report travel/history.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化登革熱再増1例！與首例僅隔110公尺 疑社区群聚
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で局地的なデング熱クラスターが発生しているが、症例数は少なく重篤性や国際的拡大の兆候は限定的。対象国（台湾は対象外）には該当しないため、続報を注視。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（彰化・高雄）が主体であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。輸入症例の由来国としてベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンが言及されているが、これらは感染拡大国ではなく渡航歴による輸入例のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 9 xã, phường của Tây Ninh có người tử vong vì bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine communes and wards in Tay Ninh Province have deaths from rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam: As of October 1, 2026, 10 people have died from rabies this year across 9 communes/wards (Luong Hoa, Hung Dien, My Hanh, Duc Lap, My An, Loc Ninh, Hoa Khanh, Thanh Dien, Go Dau). Eight dog rabies cases were detected in six communes (Hung Dien, Chau Thanh, Dong Thanh, Duong Minh Chau, Tan Ninh, Ninh Thach). Deaths have risen from 4 in Q1 2026 to 10 to date. Notable case: P.V.D., 66, in Loc Ninh, bitten about a year ago, did not vaccinate and subsequently died after symptom onset. Domestic animal vaccination is weak: 109,678 doses given, 68.41% of target; 52/96 communes below 85% and 17 below 20%. WHO recommends at least 70% coverage. Authorities require 80% vaccination, leash/containment of dogs, and immediate wound washing with soap followed by medical care; stray dogs will be captured.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省の9つのコミューン・区で狂犬病による死亡者が発生
triage.triage_reason: タイニン省内で狂犬病による死亡者が年初から10人に増加し、動物ワクチン接種率が目標を大きく下回っているため、地域当局が追加対策を講じている。WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、州政府の対応強化という社会的関心も確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病的に発生しているが、本記事はタイニン省における死亡者数の急増（Q1の4人から10人へ）と、動物ワクチン接種率の著しい低さ（目標68.41%、多くのコミューンが85%未満）を報告。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内での感染リスク継続と対策不足が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Mengapa Infeksi Superflu Naik Lagi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Influenza Infections Are Rising Again
article.articleSummary: Influenza infections are rising in Indonesia, according to the Ministry of Health, which notes a sustained upward trend in recent weeks. Laboratory data through mid-September 2026 confirm that the most frequently detected virus is influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, a seasonal flu subtype long circulating in Indonesia. Yet this strain is not the sole contributor to the country’s seasonal influenza burden; other circulating influenza viruses are also involved, indicating a mixed circulation pattern for the 2026 season. The report highlights ongoing transmission across diverse age groups and regions, underscoring the need for continued influenza surveillance, vaccination considerations, and public health preparedness. No case counts or deaths are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: なぜスーパーフル感染が再び増加しているのか
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09等）の感染増加が報告されているが、重症度や死亡者数などの詳細情報がなく、異常性も認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健省が季節性インフルエンザ（主にH1N1pdm09）の増加傾向を報告しているが、症例数・死亡者数など具体的な重症度データは記事中に記載なし。既知の季節性株による流行であり、異常性は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Politician Killed After Defending Ebola Response in Butembo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists as the 17th and deadliest on record, with more than 8,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is no vaccine or specific treatment yet, though candidates are under evaluation by the WHO. Provinces affected include Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi and Tshopo, with Ituri the hardest hit. Public trust remains a major obstacle as health responders push a village-based containment strategy amid deep skepticism about Ebola and government efforts. In Butembo (North Kivu), local politician Marie-Celestin Karondwa was beaten at his home and died after defending the government’s Ebola response on the radio; attackers’ motives are unclear. The event underscores risks to responders and the challenge of reaching conflict-affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブテンボでエボラ対応を擁護した政治家が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（8000例超、死者約4000人）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、対応要員への暴力・治安悪化も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は複数州（Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi, Tshopo）にまたがる第17次アウトブレイクであり、史上最多の死者数を記録。ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で、地域住民の不信と紛争地域での対応困難が続いている。政治家殺害事件は社会的緊張の高まりを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Farmamundi alerta sobre el avance del ébola con más de 8.000 casos en RD Congo - Corresponsables
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farmamundi warns about the spread of Ebola with more than 8,000 cases in the DRC - Corresponsales.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 3,900 deaths, with 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths reported; North Kivu province is the hardest hit, recording a case-fatality rate of 60.6%. The epidemic spans 63 health zones across seven provinces. Ongoing conflict, insecurity, and displacement hinder surveillance, case finding, contact tracing, and care delivery. Farmamundi urges more resources to strengthen prevention, detection, and treatment, and to protect health workers and provide reliable information to communities. In Beni, Farmamundi, with local partner PPSSP, operates in five public health centers—Mukulya, Ndindi, Kuka, Ngadi, Nzuma—serving about 57,261 people. The program, in alliance with AECID, has accelerated outbreak preparedness—distribution of materials, training in Water, Sanitation and Hygiene and infection prevention and control, and community engagement to counter rumors. Attacks and road closures worsen access to health services.

triage.headline_ja: Farmamundi、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が拡大し症例数8,000人超と警告 - Corresponsables
triage.triage_reason: 致死率60.6%、8,000人超の症例・約3,900人の死者を伴うエボラ流行が7州63保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 紛争・治安不安・住民避難がサーベイランスや接触者追跡を妨げており、国際的な資源支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Petugas dan Warga Binaan Rutan Kelas IIB SoE Ikut CKG dan Skrining TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staff and Inmates of SoE Class IIB Detention Center Participate in CKG and TB Screening
article.articleSummary: On 30 September 2026, SoE Class IIB Detention Center in Timor Tengah Selatan Regency (TTS) collaborated with the TTS District Health Office and SoE City Health Center to conduct Free Health Checks (CKG) and tuberculosis (TB) screening for 60 staff and 160 inmates. A 35-member health team performed initial assessments including vital signs, medical history, height/weight, blood pressure, glucose, cholesterol, uric acid, and chest X-ray for TB screening, along with triple elimination testing for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis. Preliminary results identified 3 suspected syphilis cases and 8 suspected hepatitis cases, with follow-up medical evaluation and treatment planned. The initiative aims to detect health issues early and maintain a healthy prison environment, underscoring ongoing cross-sector collaboration to safeguard the health of inmates and staff.

triage.headline_ja: SoE第IIB級拘置所の職員と収容者がCKG（無料健康診断）と結核スクリーニングに参加
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生プログラム（無料健康診断・結核/HIV/梅毒/肝炎スクリーニング）の実施報告であり、異常な集団発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 定例の拘置所内健康診断・疾患スクリーニング活動の報告であり、疑い例（梅毒3例、肝炎8例）も確定診断ではなくフォローアップ予定の段階。感染症の急増やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: G20 cam kết hỗ trợ Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo hơn 470 triệu USD ứng phó Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: G20 commits more than USD 470 million to support the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: G20 and major donors pledged over USD 470 million to support the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola response, announced after the G20 Foreign Ministers' Ebola meeting convened by the United States. The outbreak, concentrated in isolated eastern Congo regions where conflict and weak health infrastructure hamper response, has drawn international commitments totaling over USD 2 billion since it began in May. The United States alone pledged USD 267 million for health and humanitarian operations, lifting its direct Ebola-related aid to the DRC to USD 887 million. Other new contributions came from the World Bank, the United Kingdom, Germany, South Korea, France, Italy, and the United Arab Emirates, with Australia and Japan also increasing support. Funds will cover treatment, PPE, testing, safe burials, community outreach, and surveillance, with calls for stronger contact tracing, treatment capacity, vaccine research, and cross-border containment.

triage.headline_ja: G20、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応に4億7000万ドル以上の支援を表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、G20・国際機関が大規模な資金支援を表明。致死率の高い感染症であり、紛争地域での脆弱な保健システム下での対応が困難なため、国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はG20による資金支援表明が主題だが、根底にあるコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月発生、紛争地域で対応困難）は継続中の重大な公衆衛生イベントである。発生地域リストに含まれる韓国・米国・イタリア・日本・フランス・豪州・ドイツ・UAE・英国はすべて資金拠出国であり、実際の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் 1,219 பேர் டெங்கு காய்ச்சலால் பாதிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Chennai, 1,219 people affected by dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Chennai has affected 1,219 people last month. Municipal authorities intensified vector-control efforts, spraying insecticide and removing stagnant water, while residents are urged to keep surroundings clean. The outbreak spans children to adults, with Aedes mosquitoes bred in standing rainwater driving transmission. Private hospitals report crowded dengue cases and ongoing fever management; dengue-positive patients are treated with full precautions, including use of mosquito nets. Despite control measures, cases are rising daily. Yesterday saw 74 new dengue-positive cases; 74 patients were admitted. Authorities continue to identify and clean mosquito-breeding sites across districts, remove plastic containers, and eliminate water-logged areas. Public cooperation is urged to maintain household cleanliness and discard old items from streets and homes to curb the outbreak. Dengue incidence remains lower than peaks seen in 2024 and 2017 but persists overall.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱により1,219人が感染
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイで季節性デング熱が継続しているが、2024年・2017年のピークより低く、地元自治体が通常の媒介生物対策で対応中。国際的な異常性や拡大リスクは低いが、症例増加が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地元メディア（タミル語）による報道で、チェンナイ市当局が蚊媒介対策を実施中。症例は例年ピークより低いが日々増加しており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Con bị tay chân miệng, bố mẹ trong ngành y có khi không kịp trở tay vì bệnh diễn tiến nhanh'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: My child has hand, foot, and mouth disease, and parents in the medical field may not be able to react in time because the illness progresses quickly.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in Vietnam can progress rapidly; a case in Ho Chi Minh City shows a child deteriorating within hours, despite parents being physicians. Severe HFMD may develop within 24 hours and cause neurological injury, encephalitis, respiratory failure, pulmonary edema, and shock, often requiring intensive care and ventilation. Transmission is primarily fecal-oral, but the virus is present in respiratory secretions and saliva, driving spread in daycare and homes. Children under 5, especially under 3, are most at risk. Determining the exact moment of deterioration is difficult; clinicians rely on overall clinical evolution and warning signs. In HCMC, week 38 of 2026 recorded 1,283 HFMD cases (Sept 14–20), with year-to-date 35,121 and higher incidence in Con Dao, Binh Khanh, and Hiep Phuoc. Vietnam launched a HFMD vaccine for children from 2 months old, deployed at nearly 300 centers via VNVC and Substipharm Biologics.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもが手足口病に、医療従事者の両親でも対応が間に合わないほど病状が急速に進行することがある
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の重症化事例（脳炎・呼吸不全等）が報告され、ホーチミン市で年間35,121例と大規模な発生が続いており、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性と社会的関心（医療従事者家庭の事例報道）が認められるため。
triage.notes: 手足口病はベトナムで季節性に発生する既知の疾患だが、重症例の増加と大規模な累積症例数（35,121例）、ワクチン導入という政府対応が報じられており、動向の継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 致死率98%！福建男自來水洗鼻感染食腦蟲 | 罕見病 | 器官衰竭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 98% Fatality Rate! Fujian Man Infected with Brain-Eating Amoeba After Nasal Irrigation with Tap Water | Rare Disease | Organ Failure
article.articleSummary: A 42-year-old man in Quanzhou, Fujian Province, China, contracted primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) due to Naegleria fowleri after prolonged nasal irrigation with tap water. He presented with recurrent high fever, severe headache, and vomiting, rapidly deteriorating to coma. On admission, CT showed severe intracranial infection and brain edema; arterial blood gas revealed hypoxemia with an index under 100 mmHg, and he developed acute respiratory distress syndrome. He also experienced cardiomyopathy with septic heart failure and multi-organ dysfunction, including liver and kidney injury, culminating in septic shock. Cerebrospinal fluid testing confirmed Naegleria fowleri infection. PAM, a thermophilic free-living amoeba found in warm freshwater and poorly maintained pools, reaches the CNS via the nasal mucosa along the olfactory nerve. It causes brain edema, hemorrhage, and necrosis, with about a 98% fatality rate. Experts advise using sterile saline, distilled or boiled water for nasal irrigation; avoid untreated tap water.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率98%！福建省の男性が水道水で鼻洗浄し脳食いアメーバに感染｜希少疾患｜臓器不全
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（ネグレリア・フォーレリ感染）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく環境曝露による孤発例のため、公衆衛生上の拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: ネグレリア・フォーレリ（脳食いアメーバ）は温水環境に生息する自由生活性アメーバで、ヒトからヒトへは感染しない。致死率は高いが単発例であり、感染拡大のリスクは極めて低いため公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要。注意喚起レベルの情報として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化爆發3年來首起本土登革熱群聚！　2病例相距僅110公尺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua reports its first local dengue fever cluster in three years! Two cases are only 110 meters apart.
article.articleSummary: Changhua reports its first local dengue fever cluster in three years, with two confirmed cases 110 meters apart. The latest patient had no recent international travel; exposure occurred at home in Changhua City and at work in a neighboring county. Symptoms began on Sept 26: fever, diarrhea, fatigue; initial tests for influenza and SARS-CoV-2 were negative, and an acute enteritis diagnosis was made. After symptoms persisted, Sept 30 NS1 antigen testing confirmed dengue, and the patient was hospitalized. Close contacts are asymptomatic. Authorities launched intensive measures around the residence and activity areas, including vector-density surveys, larval source reduction, and large-scale disinfection, with plans for community screening sites. Since Sept 17, a mobile outbreak team has inspected 544 standing-water containers; 70 tested positive for dengue vectors, and 21 inspection records were issued. Nationally, by 2026-09-30, 178 dengue cases: 12 local (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2); 166 imported, mainly from Vietnam and Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化で3年ぶりの国内登革熱クラスター発生！2症例はわずか110メートルの距離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で3年ぶりの国内感染登革熱クラスターが確認されたが、症例数は少なく（2例）、重症例・死亡は報告されていない。蚊媒介感染症として地域内拡大の可能性はあるが、対象国リストに台湾が含まれず、国際的な影響は限定的と判断。
triage.notes: 台湾彰化県での国内登革熱感染クラスター。全国178例中、国内感染は12例（高雄10、彰化2）、輸入例166例（主にベトナム・インドネシア由来）。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列。地元当局は媒介蚊対策・環境調査を強化しており、国際的な拡大リスクは低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Response Needs 1,400 More Health Workers, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bunia) requires 1,400+ more health professionals to support expanding treatment capacity. Bed capacity rose from 929 on July 27 to 1,510 by Sept 21 across 54 health facilities in 34 health zones, per WHO response assessment. The revised 180-day plan launched Sept 4 calls for US$1.3 billion over six months to fund the response. By Sept 30, WHO noted intensified efforts to detect cases earlier: 680 community volunteers deployed across 17 health zones by Sept 17, with a goal of 1,603 volunteers by end of October. About 2,000 alerts are reported daily as of Sept 30, up from 10 in May, with field teams investigating ~90% of alerts. Early detection hinges on community trust; difficulties reaching some communities and reluctance to report illness hinder rapid case finding.

article.articleHeadline: MP: Man dies of swine flu in Chhindwara
article.articleSummary: 68-year-old man dies of swine flu (H1N1) in Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh, the district's first swine flu death this year. The patient, a resident of Atarwada near Chhindwara, was admitted September 19 for cough and breathing difficulty. He tested positive for swine flu on September 23 and was moved to an isolation ward, where he died during treatment. A short post-mortem indicated swine flu as the cause. After the death, the isolation ward was sanitised and temporarily closed, and hospital staff were urged to take extra precautions against the virus. No contact with other patients or recent travel history was reported. Swine flu, caused by H1N1, typically presents with fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body pains, and fatigue; warning signs include persistent high fever, breathing difficulty, chest pain, and confusion.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 8.000 casi: la lezione per gli ospedali è prepararsi a cambiare mentre l'emergenza corre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, more than 8,000 cases: the lesson for hospitals is to be prepared to change as the emergency unfolds.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases. As of Sept 27 (ECDC update Sept 30), 8,116 confirmed cases and 3,924 deaths are reported, with 817 patients in isolation across 63 health zones in seven provinces; crude fatality rate near 50%. Health systems are reconfiguring to scale up care: bed capacity rose from 929 to 1,510 in under two months (July 27–Sept 21) across 54 facilities and 34 zones, with a target of about 1,830 beds and over 1,400 additional health workers. Diagnostics expanded from 15 to 26 labs; daily testing from ~200 to >450. Alerts investigated climbed to 92.5%; contact tracing coverage to 88.8%; about 9,800 decontamination operations completed. Mangala, Ituri reports hundreds of cases but no Ebola treatment centers, illustrating access barriers. Preparedness requires transformable hospitals, decentralized diagnostics, mobile labs, and sufficient personnel. No Ebola outbreak alert for Italy; importation risk remains low.

article.articleHeadline: Pangasinan town bans live pigs, frozen pork over ASF fears
article.articleSummary: Bayambang, Pangasinan bans entry and exit of live pigs and fresh and frozen pork for 30 days from October 1 to curb African Swine Fever after isolated ASF cases were detected in six barangays. Bayambang is a Red Zone for ASF. The move enforces strict movement controls aligned with DA guidelines; all pig and pork shipments must carry permits, pass through ASF inspection and quarantine checkpoints, and comply with zoning and biosecurity rules. Transporters require government authorization. If 2–3 confirmed infected hogs are within a 500-meter radius, culling under the Test-and-Destroy strategy; if animals are healthy, Test-and-Slaughter may be implemented per DA assessment. Authorities will monitor farms, markets, slaughterhouses and other facilities; Certificates of Freedom from ASF (CFS-ASF) and cash assistance for affected hog raisers up to P500,000 were discussed. Transmission occurs via contact with pigs, not via air.

article.articleHeadline: Rainy-Season Surveillance in Yangon Reveals Shifting Respiratory Virus
article.articleSummary: Yangon, Myanmar, rainy-season molecular surveillance of acute respiratory infections in outpatients at two Yangon hospitals (June–November 2024; n=646) found pathogens in 548 cases (84.8%). Of 331 rapid diagnostic tests (RDT)-positive samples, RT-PCR confirmed influenza A(H3N2) (40.5%), RSV A (21.5%), influenza B/Victoria (20.2%), and influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 (0.3%). Among 315 RDT-negative samples, the BioFire FilmArray panel detected rhinovirus/enterovirus in 42.5% and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) in 15.2%. Co-infections were identified in 35 of 229 BioFire-positive samples (15.3%). Median age was 3.7 years. Temporal patterns showed influenza peaking in July–August and RSV peaking in September, indicating distinct tropical-seasonality trajectories. The study underscores substantial viral etiology and pathogen diversity driving pediatric respiratory illness and highlights the value of multiplex molecular testing alongside rapid assays for sustained surveillance in settings with limited diagnostics.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Gets Out of Control: 3 Obstacles Hinder Containment Efforts - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 8,067 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths, with the outbreak spreading to seven provinces over the past three days per WHO-based reports. The current wave is linked to the Bonipiquo lineage, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Delayed detection and limited diagnostic capacity allow continued transmission as contacts remain unidentified and not promptly isolated. Security, logistical, geographical, and community challenges hinder response efforts, including attacks on health workers and facilities. Pervasive conflict and displacement complicate access and drive cross-border movement with Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda. International funding has fallen from about $1.4 billion in 2024 to roughly $400 million in early 2026, further constraining surveillance, testing, vaccination, and treatment and stressing an already weakened health system.

article.articleHeadline: El G20 moviliza nuevos fondos por más de 470 millones de dólares contra el ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The G20 mobilizes more than $470 million in new funds to fight Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: G20 foreign ministers, convened by the United States, unlocked over $470 million in new funding to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total pledges since the May 2026 outbreak to more than $2 billion. The response targets the Bundibugyo strain, with vaccines, diagnostics, and therapies not fully effective; the outbreak is concentrated in isolated, conflict-affected areas. Washington, presiding over the G20, urged intensified response activities, expanded contact tracing, frontline protection, expanded bed capacity, new diagnostics, and vaccine development. Separately, a September package added $267 million in health and humanitarian aid, lifting U.S. direct assistance to $887 million. Donors include Australia, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, South Korea, the United Kingdom, the UAE, and the World Bank. As of Sept 29, Congo reports 8,224 cases and 3,982 deaths; 63 health zones across Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. Uganda outbreak ended Aug 26 with 20 cases (15 imported from DRC), including 2 deaths.

article.articleSummary: In Balaghat district’s Baihar and Birsa development blocks in the Baiga tribal belt, 11-year-old Sushma Marskole died at the district hospital after malaria and other illnesses; malaria had been controlled, but she remained unconscious due to additional health problems, dying around 2:00 am on Wednesday with funeral planned for Thursday. Official figures indicate 34 child deaths in the Baiga area from malaria, measles, malnutrition and other diseases, though a Congress MLA Sanjay Uikey claims the toll is 43. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is slated to visit the region, reaching Jagla village around 3:00 pm to meet families of deceased children; four children have died in Jagla. article.articleHeadline: बिजनौर में 'मोहल्लेवाली आंटी' ने फैलाया HIV! संक्रमित 2 भाइयों की मौत; दहशत में लोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Bijnor, the 'neighborhood aunt' spread HIV! Two infected brothers died; people are in a panic.

The two cousins fell seriously ill about six months after onset of contact, and were treated across facilities in Bijnor, AIIMS Rishikesh, and Dehradun; eight days earlier one cousin died, and the second died days later. triage.headline_ja: ビジュノールで「近所のおばさん」がHIVを拡散！感染した兄弟2人死亡、住民は恐怖に
triage.triage_reason: 単一事例クラスター（個人間の性的接触による散発的なHIV感染）であり、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。地域住民の不安はあるが、国家・国際レベルの関心事項には該当しない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の性感染症であり、本事例は個人間の性的接触による散発的な感染・死亡事例。地域社会での不安・パニックは報告されているが、公衆衛生緊急事態としての基準には該当しない。CMOによるとHIV検査数は増加傾向にあるが、アウトブレイクとしての性質は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra à Fizi : trois décès en une semaine sur les rives du Tanganyika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in Fizi: Three deaths in one week on the shores of Lake Tanganyika.
article.articleSummary: Cholera has been confirmed in localities in Fizi territory, South Kivu, with three deaths recorded between September 14 and 20, per the provincial health division on September 30. About a dozen patients are reported along the shores of Lake Tanganyika, where acute diarrhea cases are rising. Health authorities urged the population to reinforce hygiene: handwashing with soap, safe food handling, and thorough cooking. Cholera transmits through contaminated water and food; lakeside outbreaks raise concerns about drinking-water access and sanitation in fishing zones where water and waste water mix. Fizi has faced outbreaks; MSF launched two emergency operations in November 2025 for malaria and cholera. Nationally, cholera persists as Ebola draws attention; the DRC has recorded thousands of deaths across 16 provinces. UNICEF notes South Kivu as highly exposed, with 86 cholera deaths since January; outbreaks remain preventable and treatable, but delays in care and lack of clean water drive mortality.

triage.headline_ja: フィジ地域のコレラ：タンガニーカ湖畔で1週間に3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州フィジ地域でコレラによる死亡例が継続発生しており、全国的に流行が拡大中（南キブ州だけで1月以降86人死亡）。水・衛生インフラの不備により流行しやすく、MSFなど外部支援も既に必要とされている。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにCalifornia/United States/Fijiが含まれているが、記事内容とは無関係でBluedotの誤分類と判断し除外した。DRCはコレラが繰り返し発生する地域であり『異常/予想外』には該当しないが、死亡者数増加と衛生インフラの脆弱性から継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ലോകത്ത് കോളറ മരണം കുത്തനെ ഉയരുന്നു; മരണസംഖ്യയിൽ 30% വർധനവ് | Azhimukham
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera deaths are rising sharply worldwide; a 30% increase in the death toll | Azhimukham
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths rose 30% in 2025, per a WHO report dated Sept 30, 2025. Global cholera cases reached 451,499 with 7,870 deaths in 47 countries—highest toll since 1999, though true burden is likely higher due to underreporting. About 90% of cases and deaths occur in seven countries: Angola, Bangladesh, DR Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen. Africa recorded rises in 2024: cases +34%, deaths +58% vs 2023. Oral cholera vaccines surged to 80 million doses (2022–2025), with campaigns resuming and 71 million doses allocated. Dehydration remains primary cause of death; hospital fatality rates exceeded 1% in 12 countries in 2025. Meningitis in Africa: 24 countries reported 21,526 cases and 971 deaths (4.5% CFR) in 2025; MenA vaccine cut disease by >99%, and Niger conducted Men5CV/MMCV campaign in 2025. Plague: 3,847 cases and 423 deaths (11% CFR) in 10 countries, DR Congo and Madagascar; flea-borne transmission emphasized; strengthened surveillance urged.

triage.headline_ja: 世界でコレラによる死者数が急増；死亡数は30%増加 | Azhimukham
triage.triage_reason: WHO報告によるとコレラ・ペストの世界的な死亡者数が大幅増加しており、対象国であるDRCが両疾患の高負担国として挙げられているため、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの世界的なコレラ・ペスト・髄膜炎の年次統計報告であり、新規発生というより既知の傾向の継続を示す。DRCは両疾患（コレラ高負担国・ペスト発生国）として明記されているため対象国に含めたが、マダガスカル・スーダン・アンゴラ・イエメン・バングラデシュ・ナイジェリア・ニジェールは対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong reports rat Hepatitis E virus infection, Linked to case from last week
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Hong Kong reports a second human infection of rat hepatitis E virus (rat HEV), linked to the case reported last week. An 80-year-old female, a family member of a 91-year-old man from the previous case, lives in the same Residential Care Home for the Elderly in Kowloon City District. Laboratory testing by the Public Health Laboratory Services Branch confirmed rat HEV infection. The patient is asymptomatic and remains stable; further hospital examination and assessment are planned. She had no travel history during the incubation period and no direct contact with rodents, and no rats were observed in the RCHE. She also periodically dines at a Homantin Plaza restaurant with her family. Family members, other RCHE residents and staff are under medical surveillance; no other confirmed cases have been identified. This is the fourth rat HEV case recorded in Hong Kong this year.

triage.headline_ja: 香港でネズミE型肝炎ウイルス感染を報告、先週の症例と関連
triage.triage_reason: 香港で稀な人獣共通感染症（ラットHEV）の家族内クラスターが発生し今年4例目だが、患者は無症状で重症度は低く、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠もないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ラットHEVのヒト感染は稀少で、今年香港で4例目という点で異常性はあるが、患者は無症状で感染源（ネズミとの接触）も特定されておらず、ヒト-ヒト感染のエビデンスはない。保健当局による監視が継続されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: 民族國小吐瀉案是諾羅病毒搞鬼？資深媒體人反問蔣萬安！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Norovirus Behind the Diarrhea Case at Minzu Elementary School? A Veteran Journalist Questions Chiang Wan-an!
article.articleSummary: Nine students at Minzu Elementary School in Songshan District, Taipei City, fell ill after lunch on the 24th, reporting vomiting and diarrhea following squid rolls; the same supplier linked to a recent illness at Jinhua Junior High School supplies. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an said doctors’ initial assessment points to a gastrointestinal virus, with norovirus not ruled out. A veteran journalist suggested the issue may be due to norovirus rather than a food-safety failure, noting that six of the nine ill have gastroenteritis. Laboratory confirmation has not yet been reported. Public health measures discussed include school disinfection with bleach and temporarily suspending attendance for symptomatic students for 48 hours before returning. Authorities are monitoring for additional cases and potential outbreak signals.

triage.headline_ja: 民族国小の嘔吐下痢案件はノロウイルスの仕業か？ベテランメディア関係者が蔣萬安に問いただす！
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の小学校での限定的な集団食中毒疑い事例であり、検査確定もされておらず、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。学校内の少人数の食中毒疑い事例で、検査未確定、地域メディアの関心のみ。対象国（China等）とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 台南登革熱境外第8例！個案遊越南返台接連跑兩市場
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan Dengue Fever: 8th Imported Case; The Patient Traveled to Vietnam, Returned to Taiwan, and Visited Two Markets in Succession.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-01, Tainan City reports its 8th imported dengue case of the year. A woman in her 50s living in a Southern District public housing community traveled to Ha Long Bay, Vietnam, Sept 19–24, then returned to Taiwan and visited Shui Xian Gong Market (West District) and Guiren Market. She developed fever on Sept 27 and tested PCR-positive the next day, diagnosed as dengue fever type 1. Her viremic period overlapped with crowded markets, prompting the Dengue Control Center to mobilize rapid fogging, source reduction, and vector-density surveys around her residence and the two markets, with planned indoor/outdoor chemical measures to curb transmission. Market operators were urged to inspect for breeding sites near stalls—drains, containers, barrels, and canvases. Nationally, Taiwan has 176 dengue cases this year: 11 locally transmitted, 165 imported, with Vietnam the top source, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, Maldives, and Malaysia.

triage.headline_ja: 台南デング熱、海外感染第8例目！ベトナム旅行から帰国後、2つの市場を訪れた事例
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例（ベトナム感染）に関する台湾当局の定型的なサーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）における輸入症例の定型報告。感染地であるベトナムは国内発生の文脈ではなく、旅行歴としての言及のため参考情報として記載。台湾は媒介蚊対策（燻蒸・発生源除去）を実施中であり、特段の異常事態は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化再添登革熱本土病例！2案住家僅距110公尺 8處列追查重點
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua adds more locally transmitted dengue fever cases! The homes of the two cases are only 110 meters apart; eight locations listed as investigation priorities.
article.articleSummary: Two locally transmitted dengue fever cases have been identified in Changhua City, Changhua County, as of Oct 1, 2026. The first, a man in his 30s, was diagnosed last month and marked the county’s first local dengue case this year. The second, a man in his 60s, began symptoms in late September, tested positive for dengue virus type 1, and is hospitalized. Close contacts have no symptoms. The two residences are about 110 meters apart, prompting officials to treat this as a community cluster; sequencing will determine linkage. An imported August Vietnam case carried the same dengue type 1 strain, suggesting local circulation. Eight privately owned dirty plots around Dongxing Li and Minquan Li are being cleared; noncompliance may trigger penalties under the Infectious Disease Prevention Act. Testing stations will be set up; residents are urged to seek testing and report travel or activity histories.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化再添登革熱本土病例！2案住家僅距110公尺 8處列追查重點
triage.triage_reason: 発生地域は台湾であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナムは輸入症例の渡航歴としてのみ言及されており、実際の流行地ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾彰化県での登革熱（デング熱）本土感染クラスターに関するもので、対象国（ベトナム含む）での発生ではない。ベトナムは8月の輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、同国内での流行を示すものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'insécurité entrave la riposte contre Ebola dans 3 zones de santé à Djugu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Insecurity hampers the Ebola response in three health zones in Djugu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response in Ituri's Djugu health zones Fataki, Drodro, and Lita is being hampered by insecurity attributed to militiamen CRP and CODECO. OCHA reports several organizations have suspended activities, hindering patient care. In Fataki, Gina health area, movements supporting an Ebola Treatment Center were suspended. In Drodro, CREC activities were halted in Saliboko, Jisa, Drodro, and Gokpa. Delays have occurred in laboratory sample transfers from Fataki to Bunia, and confirmed patients moving from Gina to Fataki for treatment have been disrupted since 27 September. In Lita, locals and some response personnel have fled to safer areas due to intensified armed-group activity; numbers affected remain unknown. OCHA and partners urge respect for international humanitarian law, civilian protection, preservation of humanitarian spaces, freedom of movement, and unhindered access to care.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：治安悪化がジュグ地域の3保健区域でのエボラ対応を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応が武装勢力による治安悪化で妨害されており、患者搬送・検体輸送・治療センターへのアクセスが遅延している。致死率の高い疾患であり、対応能力低下によるさらなる拡大リスクがあるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にSierra LeoneやRomaniaの地名が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCイトゥリ州ジュグ地域（Fataki, Drodro, Lita等）のエボラ対応に特化しており、他国への言及はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: संचारी रोग नियंत्रण: 31 अक्टूबर तक चलेगा विशेष अभियान, 12 अक्टूबर से घर-घर दस्तक देगा स्वास्थ्य विभाग - hardoi doortodoor health campaign targets 9 highrisk areas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Control of Communicable Diseases: A Special Campaign Will Run Until October 31; From October 12, the Health Department Will Conduct Door-to-Door Visits — Hardoi Door-to-Door Health Campaign Targets 9 High-Risk Areas
article.articleSummary: Hardoi district, Uttar Pradesh, India, is conducting the third phase of a special communicable disease control campaign through October 31, with a door-to-door Dastak drive from October 12–31. ASHA and Anganwadi workers will perform health surveys, identify fever, influenza-like illness, TB, leprosy, filariasis, kala-azar, and malnourished children, and create ABHA IDs for family members; data will be uploaded to the e-Kavach portal. Designated Gram pradhans act as village nodal points; the district aims to curb fever and vector- and water-borne diseases by improving sanitation and water supply. Nine sensitive areas (Ahirori, Bawan, Surasa, Tadiyawan, Shahabad, Harpalpur, Pihani, Madhoganj, Bilgram, and the Hardoi city urban area) will receive intensified campaigns. Anti-larval spraying under MGNREGA, regular drain and waterbody cleaning, pit filling, and shrub removal will be conducted. Schools will enforce full-sleeve uniforms; progress is reviewed weekly in inter-departmental meetings and reported to the state.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症対策:10月31日まで特別キャンペーン実施、10月12日から保健局が戸別訪問を開始—ハルドイ地区の戸別訪問健康キャンペーン、9つの高リスク地域を対象に
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的な感染症対策・サーベイランス強化キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ハルドイ地区における定例の感染症（インフルエンザ様疾患、結核、ハンセン病、フィラリア症、カラアザールなど）の予防的サーベイランス・公衆衛生キャンペーンに関する行政発表記事。具体的な発生数や異常増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: В селе Бурятии домашняя собака погибла от бешенства
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In a village in Buryatia, a domestic dog died of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a domestic dog in the village of Galtai, Mukhorshibirsky District, Republic of Buryatia, prompting a quarantine on Oct 1. Post-mortem testing established rabies; veterinary services will conduct necessary measures within the quarantine zone. Rabies is a deadly CNS infection transmitted via bites or scratches and through saliva contacting wounds, mucous membranes, or even contaminated objects. The virus travels from peripheral nerves to the brain, after which death is almost certain. Reservoirs include wolves, foxes, raccoon dogs, Arctic foxes (песцы), ferrets, etc. Authorities urge annual vaccination of pets, confinement of domestic animals, avoidance of stray dogs and cats, and not touching wild animals. Do not attempt to capture animals with abnormal behaviour. If bitten or scratched, wash the wound with soap and water, apply antiseptic, and seek medical care promptly; early rabies immunoprophylaxis improves outcome.

triage.headline_ja: ブリヤート共和国の村で飼い犬が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・ブリヤート共和国の一村における飼い犬1頭の狂犬病事例であり、対象国に該当せず、地域的検疫対応のみで国際的拡大リスクや社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndiaが付与されているが、記事はロシア・ブリヤート共和国の地域ニュースであり、インドやその他対象国とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）霍乱疫情已致近700人死亡-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed nearly 700 people - CRI Online
article.articleSummary: As of September 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s cholera outbreak has surpassed 30,400 cases with nearly 700 deaths. The eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu are the epicenters, with South Kivu reporting over 12,700 confirmed cases and 175 deaths. Flooding, mass displacement, and shortages of safe drinking water are fueling transmission. UNICEF says it is coordinating with partners on integrated outbreak control, including community surveillance and laboratory testing of suspected cases, and it urges urgent action to protect children. The report notes that cholera is spreading rapidly across West and Central Africa, putting many children at risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でコレラ流行、死者数が700人近くに - 国際在線
triage.triage_reason: 死者約700人・症例3万件超という大規模コレラ流行で、洪水や避難民増加により感染拡大継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事ではアンゴラも発生地域として付与されているが、本文はDRC（特に北・南キブ州）に焦点を当てているため、Angolaはverified_locationsに含めない。西アフリカ・中央アフリカ全体への拡大懸念が言及されているが対象国リストに該当国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kamwi opens malaria IRS campaign at Bukalo
article.articleSummary: Kamwi opens indoor residual spraying (IRS) malaria campaign at Bukalo, Katima Rural constituency, Zambezi region, officially launching the programme on Monday. The campaign runs through 11 December 2026 across 11 clusters including Bukalo, Schuckmannsburg, Lisikili, Ngoma, Chinchimani, Masokotwani, Sangwali, Kasheshe, Sibbinda, Sesheke, and Cheto; current spraying coverage is just over 40%, far short of WHO's 80% target. Zambezi malaria ambassador Dr Richard Kamwi, a former health minister, urged village headmen to allow IRS teams access to homes and said trained teams will be deployed to reduce malaria fatalities. Since January, 21 people have died of malaria, up from 19 in the same period last year; most deaths involve children under five and pregnant women. Governor Dorothy Kabula-Simushi, at Lusata Festival, noted over 30,000 cases in Jan–week ending 20 Sep 2026, up from 25,716 in 2025, and urged cooperation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: カムウィ氏、ブカロでマラリア室内残効性殺虫剤散布（IRS）キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ナミビア・ザンベジ地域における定例的なマラリア対策（IRS）キャンペーンの開始を報じる内容であり、新規異常事象ではなく対象国にも該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナミビア・ザンベジ地域のマラリア対策キャンペーンであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため verified_locations は空配列。DRC・Rwanda・Peruの地名はBluedotの位置情報付与の誤りとみられ、記事本文では言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）霍乱疫情已致近700人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has killed nearly 700 people.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has killed nearly 700 people this year. The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) reports over 30,400 cholera cases nationwide with about 700 fatalities. Eastern provinces North Kivu and South Kivu are the epicenters, with South Kivu alone recording more than 12,700 confirmed cases and 175 deaths. Flooding, population displacement, and a shortage of safe drinking water are driving transmission. UNICEF says it is working with partners on integrated prevention, including community surveillance and laboratory testing of suspected cases, and it appeals for urgent action to protect children. The outbreak is part of a rapid spread of cholera across West and Central Africa, placing many children at risk. Source: CCTV News via Beijing Daily App.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でコレラ流行、死者は700人近くに
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なコレラ流行で3万人超の症例・約700人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と拡大継続のリスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC全国及び北・南キブ州の流行状況を扱っており、Angolaや中央アフリカ地域への言及はないため除外した。見出しの「刚果（金）」はキンシャサではなくコンゴ民主共和国（旧ザイール、首都キンシャサ）を指す国名表記。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : deux premiers patients guéris d'Ebola sortent de l'hôpital général de référence de Lubero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nord-Kivu: The First Two Ebola Patients Cured Leave Lubero General Referral Hospital
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola virus disease patients were discharged from Lubero General Referral Hospital in North Kivu on 29 September 2026—a Congolese army (FARDC) soldier and a young woman. The discharge follows an outbreak response in which the Lubero health zone has recorded 22 Ebola cases since 2 August 2026, with 15 deaths, 2 recoveries, and 3 active patients; the two discharged had early presentation and recovery. Earlier, 12 positives arrived, of which 10 were at an advanced stage and did not survive. Officials urged timely care at first symptoms to improve survival. Public health challenges include lack of handwashing facilities and temperature screening in public spaces; logistical and financial support remains limited. Province-wide, 17 new recoveries raise the total cured to 2,105 as of 28 September 2026. Vaccination continues in Ituri and Bas-Uele, alongside community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラから回復した最初の2人の患者がルベロ総合リファレンス病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続アウトブレイクであり、致死率の高さ（15/22例死亡）と資金・物資不足などの公衆衛生上の課題が継続しているため、フルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクの経過報告だが、致死率の高さと手指衛生・体温スクリーニング設備の不足、資金・物流支援の限界が指摘されており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: BPOM Pastikan Stok Obat Antivirus untuk Influenza A di RI Cukup
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BPOM Ensures Sufficient Stock of Antiviral Drugs for Influenza A in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's BPOM RI assures nationwide antiviral stock for influenza A remains sufficient, with Kepala Taruna Ikrar stating adequate availability based on data from the Directorate of Drug Registration and Distribution. The message, delivered in Tangerang on 1 October 2026, aims to quell public panic amid earlier worries about oseltamivir shortages. Health Ministry official Lucia Rizka Andalusia attributes fear largely to rapid social media reporting and perceived regional stock disparities, urging reliance on verified information. For influenza cases without red flags, home management with adequate rest and fluids is advised to prevent dehydration and deterioration; antiviral treatment like oseltamivir is not required for every case. Patients with danger signs should promptly seek healthcare. The article provides no specific case counts or outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: BPOM、インドネシアにおけるインフルエンザA型用抗ウイルス薬の在庫が十分であることを保証
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインフルエンザAの発生状況ではなく、抗ウイルス薬（オセルタミビル）の在庫に関する行政側の安心喚起情報であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の証拠がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は薬剤供給に関する当局の説明であり、インフルエンザAの発生規模や重症度についての具体的データは含まれていない。続報で実際の症例報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Ungkap Aktivitas Influenza Mulai Naik di Sejumlah Negara Asia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Reveals Influenza Activity Beginning to Rise in Several Asian Countries
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in parts of Asia, though global levels remain low as of the week ending 20 September 2026. The WHO Global Respiratory Virus Activity: Weekly Update No. 597 notes about 10% influenza positivity globally, with higher activity reported in some Southeast Asian countries and in parts of Asia-Pacific, where positivity exceeds 30% in certain areas. The WHO Western Pacific region’s Epidemiological Week 37 bulletin shows regional increases from 14% (week 35) to 16% (week 37). Globally, influenza A remains the dominant virus. In Southeast Asia and other parts of Asia, A(H1N1)pdm09 is the leading subtype among regions with rising activity, while in the Western Pacific, A(H3) accounts for 48.4% of detections, followed by A(H1N1)pdm09 (26.7%) and B(Victoria) (23.8%). Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam did not show increased activity during this period. Citizens are advised to monitor respiratory symptoms, especially in crowded settings.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アジア各国でインフルエンザ活動が上昇し始めていることを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: WHOの定期的な季節性インフルエンザサーベイランス報告であり、特定の異常な集団発生や重症化の報告はない。記事内で言及されているマレーシア・フィリピン・ベトナムはむしろ活動増加が見られないとされている。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの世界的・地域的サーベイランス状況の定例報告。具体的な上昇国名は明示されず、対象国のうちマレーシア・フィリピン・ベトナムは『増加なし』と明記されているため該当国なし。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化現本土登革熱群聚　衛生局急圍堵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local dengue fever cluster detected in Changhua County; Health Bureau rushes to contain it.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cluster detected in Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan. Since July, overseas-imported dengue cases rose about twofold, prompting intensified preventive measures. Virus sequencing confirmed the local cluster originates from a dengue virus type 1 imported case, a person who returned from Vietnam in August. By mid-September, a 60-something resident in the same community developed fever, diarrhea, and malaise; testing confirmed dengue fever and linked to the source by genomic sequencing. This marks the first locally transmitted dengue case with an unknown source in four years. In response, health authorities expanded regional cleanup within a 400-meter radius, fined eight landlords for failing to remove mosquito breeding sites, and established rapid screening stations to detect hidden infections. Officials urge community participation, removal of breeding grounds, personal protective measures, and prompt medical care with travel history to block further community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化県で本土感染のデング熱集団発生、衛生局が緊急封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で4年ぶりとなる感染源不明の本土感染デング熱症例が確認され、衛生当局が緊急の媒介蚊対策と検査拠点設置を行っており、異常性・媒介感染継続・当局の高い関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域として台湾とベトナムが挙げられているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムは輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみでイベント発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。
