article.articleHeadline: छिंदवाड़ा में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली मौत, 68 साल के बुजुर्ग ने तोड़ा दम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First swine flu death in Chhindwara: 68-year-old man died.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) in Madhya Pradesh’s Chhindwara district records its first death this year: a 68-year-old man from Atarwara, admitted September 19 with cough and breathing difficulty. He tested positive for H1N1 on September 23 and was moved to a separate ward; he died on September 29, with a brief postmortem attributing death to swine flu. The ward was sanitized and temporarily closed, with hospital staff advised to take heightened infection precautions. Officials report no other patient contacts or travel links identified. This marks the district’s first swine flu death this year. Common H1N1 symptoms are fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, and fatigue; warning signs requiring urgent medical advice include persistent high fever, breathing trouble, chest pain, confusion, or worsening symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: チンドワラでスワインフルによる初の死亡、68歳男性が死去
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による単発死亡例で、地域的拡大や異常性の兆候はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、単発死亡例かつ接触者・渡航歴なし。病棟の消毒・一時閉鎖など通常の医療対応が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: ਕੈਂਸਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੰਬਾਕੂ-ਸ਼ਰਾਬ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ! ਸਰੀਰ 'ਚ ਲੁਕੇ ਇਹ 5 ਇਨਫੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਵੀ ਵਧਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ - Cancer Isnt Caused Only by Tobacco and Alcohol These 5 Hidden Infections Can Also Raise the Risk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cancer isn't caused only by tobacco and alcohol! These 5 hidden infections in the body can also raise the risk.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-10-01, Lifestyle Desk, New Delhi reports that infections contribute to about one in eight cancers globally, per a recent Lancet Oncology study. While conventional risk factors—tobacco, alcohol, unhealthy lifestyles, and family history—are well-known, the article notes that a common virus or bacterium can also drive carcinogenesis. The global burden means roughly 12.5% of cancer cases worldwide have infectious etiologies. The report underscores the need to recognize infections as a cancer risk, beyond the typical lifestyle factors; however, the piece provides no pathogen names or country-specific data. The Lancet Oncology study emphasizes that preventing infections may play a role in cancer prevention, alongside existing risk-reduction strategies. The article presents the finding as a global statistic, highlighting the broad impact of infectious agents on cancer incidence.

triage.headline_ja: がんはタバコ・アルコールだけが原因ではない！体内に潜むこれら5つの感染症も病気のリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、感染症とがんリスクに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、病原体名や国別データもないため、公衆衛生イベントのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクイベントではなく、感染症とがんリスクに関するライフスタイル・健康情報記事。地域（New Delhi/India）も記事内容の主題とは直接関係なし。

article.articleHeadline: Четыре человека погибли в ДР Конго после употребления мяса обезьяны
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four people died in the DRC after eating monkey meat.
article.articleSummary: Four residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo died within 24 hours after consuming monkey meat in Munsanga, Pinga health zone, in eastern DR Congo. On September 26, several people who shared a wild-meat meal developed severe gastroenteric symptoms; four fatalities occurred soon after symptom onset. The remaining participants are under medical observation as clinicians seek to determine the exact cause of poisoning; no laboratory confirmation has been reported yet. Radio Okapi cited the incident, and authorities note the context of a 2024 government ban on monkey meat amid a rapidly spreading monkeypox outbreak, reflecting ongoing public-health concerns about bush-meat consumption in the region. Investigations continue to establish whether deaths stem from infected monkey meat or another etiologic agent, with health teams monitoring the affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で猿肉を食べた後に4人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の集団死亡事例であり、2024年のMpox流行の文脈との関連が示唆されているが、検査確認はされておらず食中毒の可能性も排除できないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は野生肉（猿肉）摂取後の原因不明の急性死亡事例を報じており、Mpoxとの検査学的関連は確認されていない。2024年のMpox流行を背景とした猿肉禁止令の文脈が言及されているのみで、本件がMpoxによるものか食中毒等の別要因かは未確定。続報での病原体確定情報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化本土登革熱+1　疾管署初判與9/18個案相關成社區群聚事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua County locally transmitted dengue fever case +1; Taiwan CDC's preliminary assessment links it to the 9/18 case, forming a community cluster.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Taiwan: Changhua County reports 1 new locally transmitted case, a male resident of Changhua City in his 60s, confirmed dengue virus type 1. Symptoms began in late September (fever, diarrhea, malaise) and he is hospitalized. The patient’s residence is about 110 meters from the Sept 18 first local case, prompting a preliminary assessment of a community cluster; sequencing will be conducted to clarify linkage. This marks Changhua County’s first indigenous dengue cluster since 2023. Health authorities have intensified vector control around the residence and activity areas, with 34 mobile deployments, 544 water containers inspected (70 positive), and 21 inspection records issued. Nationally, as of Sept 30, 2026, 178 dengue cases confirmed: 12 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2) and 166 imported (Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20). Global dengue totals exceed 2.2 million through Aug 2026. Preventive guidance emphasizes eliminating breeding sites, wearing light clothing, and using approved repellents; clinicians should use TOCC and NS1 rapid testing for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化県で国内感染デング熱+1例、疾病管理署は9/18症例との関連を初判断し地域クラスターと認定
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県における国内感染デング熱の小規模クラスターで、既存の媒介動物対策で対応可能な通常範囲の公衆衛生事案。対象国（台湾は対象外）に該当する発生国もなく、国際的拡大や深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化県・高雄市）における国内発生のデング熱症例であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。フィリピン・インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入症例の出身国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: New Uracil-Based Compound Targets SARS-CoV-2 Enzyme Nsp15 With Promising
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers designed, synthesized and tested a uracil-derived small molecule, compound 5 (6-((2-aminophenyl)thio)-5-bromopyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione), targeting SARS-CoV-2 Nsp15 endoribonuclease (NendoU). In cell-based assays under biosafety level 3, compound 5 showed measurable protection against SARS-CoV-2, marking an early, promising entry into coronavirus drug discovery. Building on tipiracil, the team added a 2-aminophenylthio group at C-6 and a bromine at C-5 to enhance hydrophobic contacts and electronic tuning. Synthesis from 2,4,6-trichloropyrimidine proceeds in three steps with an overall ~14% yield. Docking against PDB 9HH5 (2.08 Å) gave a total interaction energy of -65.4 kcal/mol for compound 5 vs -56.4 for tipiracil, with key contacts at His235, Gly248, Trp333, Glu340, Thr341 and Tyr343; Trp333 provides substantial van der Waals and H-bonding. In silico toxicology suggested favorable safety, supporting diversification beyond Mpro and RdRp targets.

triage.headline_ja: 新規ウラシル系化合物がSARS-CoV-2酵素Nsp15を標的、有望な抗ウイルス活性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は創薬研究（化合物設計・ドッキング解析）に関する基礎研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生・公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの研究者による抗ウイルス化合物の基礎研究（in vitro/in silico）であり、実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の事象を報告するものではない。発生地域としてBrazilが付与されているが、感染症イベントの発生国ではなく研究実施国であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat di Bandung Pascatemuan 65 Kasus Positif, Sekda Jabar: Antisipasi dan Mitigasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Rises in Bandung After the Discovery of 65 Positive Cases, West Java Provincial Secretary: Anticipation and Mitigation.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in Bandung, West Java, shows 65 confirmed cases by 25 September 2026, as reported by the West Java Health Service and verified via swab tests and Whole Genome Sequencing. The increase is being watched in Kota Bandung, with officials stressing vigilance but avoiding panic. West Java Provincial Secretary Herman Suryatman urged residents to adopt anticipatory measures and mitigations: maintain a healthy lifestyle, practice hygiene, and wear masks to curb transmission. Individuals experiencing fever and extreme fatigue should promptly seek care at health facilities for testing and treatment. Authorities also emphasized readiness to respond, with the West Java Provincial Government and 27 regencies/cities prepared to deliver enhanced services to the public. The message underscores early identification, supportive care, and public health measures to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンでインフルエンザAが増加、65件の陽性例確認後に西ジャワ州副知事が注意喚起と対策を指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加と見られ、IHR基準の明確な該当はないが、当局が警戒・対応体制を強化しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザAの可能性が高く、重症度や死亡数などの詳細情報は記事に記載されていないため不明。地方政府は独自対応で管理可能としている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jabar Catat 65 Warga Bandung Positif Influenza Tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Provincial Health Office Records 65 Bandung Residents Positive for Influenza Type A
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, West Java’s Health Office records 65 Bandung residents positive for influenza type A based on swab tests. Cases are in Bandung City, with some patients still under intensive care in hospitals including RSUD Bandung Kiwari. The figure is provisional, reflecting those who voluntarily or clinically indicated underwent testing. Limited capacity for whole genome sequencing (WGS) hampers broader regional tracking across West Java. Officials urge calm; influenza A is a respiratory illness generally treatable, but individuals with comorbidities such as heart disease, diabetes, tuberculosis, or HIV should stay vigilant. Emphasis on vaccination, which is widely available, and early care for severe flu symptoms, especially for those with chronic conditions. Testing reluctance due to discomfort and costs is noted.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州保健局、バンドン市民65人がインフルエンザA型陽性と発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の集団発生で一部重症例もあるが、異常性や国際的拡大の根拠は乏しく、WGS能力不足など監視体制の課題から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局はインフルエンザAを通常の治療可能な疾患とし冷静な対応を呼びかけているが、WGS能力の制約により地域全体の感染動向把握が困難な点が懸念される。基礎疾患（結核・HIV等）保有者への注意喚起あり。

article.articleHeadline: Giải mã "cơn sốt" vắc xin tay chân miệng tại VNVC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Decoding the 'fever' surrounding the hand-foot-mouth disease vaccine at VNVC
article.articleSummary: VNVC reports nearly 30,000 doses of the EV71-targeted hand-foot-mouth disease vaccine administered across ~300 centers in Vietnam within the first week of rollout, with over 80% of parents securing a full schedule. In Ho Chi Minh City, a 4-year-old who previously required ECMO highlights ongoing risk, while the system mobilized 12,000+ staff and expanded cold-chain capacity to store over 400 million doses, extending service hours to meet demand. The initiative rests on more than 15 years of research, including a Phase 3 Vietnamese trial with ~2,500 children showing 96.8% efficacy and 100% protection against EV71-related hospitalization; real-world use exceeds 600,000 doses since 2023. Regional CDC data (2024–2026) report no severe EV71 HFMD cases. The vaccine is recommended for children 2 months to under 6 years, including those with prior infection, amid ongoing HFMD circulation in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: VNVCにおける手足口病ワクチン『フィーバー』を解き明かす
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン接種の普及状況に関する広報的な記事であり、重症例の急増や異常な流行拡大を示す情報はなく、地域CDCデータでも重症EV71症例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、EV71手足口病の新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。重症例（ECMO例）は過去の個別事例として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kako je ebola postala najsmrtonosnija epidemija u historiji DR Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Ebola Became the Deadliest Epidemic in the History of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Bunia and Mongbwalu, has become the deadliest in the country’s history. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Identified initially in Ituri, it has since spread to other areas. Three months after the May 15 declaration, health authorities report more than 4,900 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 2,300 deaths, eclipsing the 2018–2020 Zaire outbreak (2,299 deaths). Transmission began before official recognition: a patient admitted for surgery on April 2 at Mongbwalu General Hospital (operation on April 7) preceded early fatalities among surgical staff. There are no licensed vaccines or approved therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; response relies on early detection, supportive care, infection prevention, community engagement, and expanded laboratory capacity (now more than 12 in Ituri).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱はいかにしてコンゴ民主共和国史上最悪の流行となったか
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる流行が過去最多の死者数（2300人超）・症例数（4900人超）に達しており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であることから深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスには承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、DRC史上最悪の流行と報告されている。国際的拡大の有無や渡航制限措置については記事中で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kulon Progo Lacak Kasus TB dari Pegawai ASN Hingga Pedagang Sebagai Upaya Deteksi Dini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kulon Progo Health Office Traces TB Cases from Civil Servants to Traders as an Early Detection Effort
article.articleSummary: Kulon Progo Health Office in Indonesia conducted Free Health Checks at the Setda Kulon Progo Secretariat on 2026-10-01 to trace active tuberculosis (TB) cases via Active Case Finding (ACF). Led by Dinkes Kulon Progo head Eko Budiarto, the effort targets civil servants (ASN) and nearby residents to raise TB detection rates that remain below Ministry of Health targets. The program uses CKG to assess general health (blood pressure, vision, cholesterol) and ACF to identify TB through sputum samples and chest X-ray screening. Any TB-positive individuals are referred for treatment at Puskesmas and RSUD Wates, with all TB care fully funded by the government. Officials emphasize early diagnosis to prevent progression and urge community participation to improve TB awareness and outcomes in Kulon Progo.

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴ保健局、早期発見の取り組みとして公務員から商人まで結核症例を追跡調査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核早期発見プログラムに関する行政活動の報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾病であり、本記事は通常の検診・早期発見活動を報じるもので、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示唆するものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Rising: Infection Is Gone, But You Are Still Unwell? Understanding 'Long Flu' Symptoms
article.articleSummary: H1N1 is the dominant influenza strain in India, making up about 75% of influenza-positive samples per the latest WHO surveillance; Delhi recorded 3,218 H1N1 cases by August 31, the highest since 2019, with no deaths reported in the capital. Recovery can be prolonged: lingering cough, fatigue or weakness after fever may persist weeks and signal complications such as pneumonia, sinus infections or worse asthma. Pune doctors cite cases of extended recovery (2025), especially among older adults and people with diabetes, hypertension or heart disease. A 2023 Lancet Infectious Diseases analysis of hospitalised influenza patients (US VA) found increased risk of six longer-term outcomes—cough, hypoxemia, dyspnea, chest pain, tachycardia, and type 1 diabetes—with most burden post-acute, but results apply to hospitalised patients and not the general population. Mechanisms under study include immune cytokines and possible neuroinflammation; India lacks a universal 'long flu' definition or large national prevalence.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染者数が増加中：感染は治癒したのにまだ体調不良？「ロングフル」症状を理解する
triage.triage_reason: インドでH1N1症例が季節性に増加（デリーで2019年以降最多）しているが死亡報告はなく、記事内容は『ロングフル』症状に関する解説記事であり急性のアウトブレイク警報ではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はH1N1の季節性流行と『ロングフル』症状に関する医療解説記事であり、米国は参考研究（VA患者データ）の文脈でのみ言及されているため発生地域から除外した。デリーでの症例増加（2019年以降最多）は注視すべきだが、死亡例なしのため緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : deux patients positifs toujours à domicile après leur fuite d'un centre de traitement - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: two Ebola-positive patients still at home after escaping from a treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases of the Bundibugyo strain remain at home after escaping a Kisangani treatment center in Mangobo health zone, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. A Sept 30 INSP situation report notes these cases in Mangobo but provides no escape date or details of the relocation or isolation efforts. Overall in Tshopo, 45 confirmed cases and 16 related deaths are recorded; Mangobo accounts for six confirmed cases and three deaths. Contact tracing coverage is 83.7%, below the 95% target for effective exposure surveillance. SITRep No. 138 also reports multiplication of confirmed and suspected cases around a Kisangani health facility, with a provisional closure proposed and a call to strengthen isolation of confirmed positives. No new confirmed cases were reported on 29 September, highlighting the ongoing need for rapid detection, isolation, and comprehensive contact tracing to contain transmission in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：治療センターから逃走した陽性患者2名、依然として自宅に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の確認例・死亡例が継続して発生しており、陽性患者が治療センターから逃走し隔離が不十分なまま接触者追跡率も目標を下回っているため、国際的拡大リスクを含め深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: उतरौला में संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान शुरू, लोगों को किया जाएगा जागरूक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Communicable disease control campaign started in Utraula; people will be made aware.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Utraula in Balrampur district launched a special communicable disease control and awareness campaign from the Community Health Center, with the district magistrate and chief development officer flagging off an awareness rally. The program will go village to village identifying fever, tuberculosis, and malnutrition cases and educating residents on protecting themselves from mosquitoes, improving sanitation, and using safe drinking water. ASHA workers and Anganwadi workers will conduct door-to-door visits to disseminate preventive measures. Senior health officials, including the Chief Medical Officer and district immunization and malaria officers, attended the event. The initiative aims to boost community awareness and participation to curb the spread of communicable diseases by early detection and preventive practices.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balrampur News: Communicable Disease Control Campaign Launched, the District Magistrate flagged off the awareness vehicle.
article.articleSummary: Balrampur district launched a special Communicable Disease Control Campaign on October 1 to curb dengue, malaria, and other communicable diseases. District Magistrate Dr. Vipin Kumar Jain flagged off an awareness vehicle from the Community Health Center, initiating a drive from villages to urban areas. The program emphasizes sanitation, prevention of waterlogging, and elimination of mosquito breeding sites, with door-to-door education on symptoms, causes, and preventive measures. A multi-department collaboration includes Health, Panchayati Raj, Rural Development, Urban Bodies, Education, Women and Child Development, Nutrition, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, and Irrigation to monitor, diagnose, treat, and raise awareness. Schools will relay personal hygiene messages, and Anganwadi centers will promote health-related behaviors among mothers and children. The DM urged cleanliness at homes and neighborhoods and prompt medical attention if symptoms appear, stressing prevention as the most effective measure.

article.articleHeadline: Врач рассказал, как защититься от гонконгского гриппа - BlogNews.am
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor explained how to protect yourself from the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu vaccination is the most effective and safest defense, says pediatrician Roman Shiyan. In the segment 'Now You Know', he notes influenza vaccines are typically 40–60% effective, reducing influenza illness by about half among the vaccinated compared with the unvaccinated. Protection is strongest in children and weaker in older adults, yet seniors are prioritized due to higher complication risk. Even when vaccination does not fully prevent infection, it substantially lowers the risk of hospitalization and death, and vaccinated individuals often experience milder illness. As of 2026-10-01, vaccination remains the primary preventive measure against Hong Kong flu. Public health guidance emphasizes vaccination for all, especially children and the elderly.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sant Kabir Nagar Communicable Disease Control Campaign Begins, Awareness Rally Flagged Off | Sant Kabir News: Communicable Disease Control Campaign Begins, Balram Yadav Flagged Off the Rally
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, Sant Kabir Nagar district launched a special communicable disease control and awareness campaign, with District Panchayat President Balram Yadav flagging off an awareness rally from the Collectorate that proceeded through major city routes to the district hospital. The rally highlighted dengue, malaria, and chikungunya prevention. The Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Ramanuj Kannaujia, announced the campaign would run throughout October, with health and allied department teams visiting homes to promote cleanliness, mosquito-proofing, safe drinking water, and personal hygiene. The aim is to curb transmission of communicable diseases. Officials cautioned residents not to resort to unscientific remedies and to seek prompt care at nearby government health facilities if fever or symptoms appear.

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Penyebaran Influenza A, Pemkot Bandung Kaji PJJ PAUD-SMP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Spread of Influenza A, Bandung City Government Assesses PAUD-SMP Distance Learning
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Bandung reports increasing Influenza A cases among students, prompting the Bandung City Education Department to consider distance learning (PAUD, TK, SD, SMP) to curb spread. A circular was issued to all public and private schools emphasizing vigilance for flu symptoms lasting several days. If students fall ill, schools should first manage them via the School Health Unit (UKS), then coordinate with local health centers (puskesmas) or nearby facilities. If doctors permit, students may return wearing masks; otherwise they should stay home until recovered. The department notes the situation remains under control, not a state of emergency, with ongoing monitoring. A PJJ option could be invoked in emergencies, pending evaluation with the Health Department and coordination with the Mayor. Until then, in-person learning continues with masking for symptomatic individuals.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAの流行拡大を予防するため、バンドン市政府が幼稚園・小中学校の遠隔学習を検討
triage.triage_reason: バンドン市内の学校でインフルエンザA感染が増加しているが、当局は「制御下にあり緊急事態ではない」と明言しており、重症度や国際的拡大リスクの情報もないため、現時点ではフルRRAより継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる学校内感染拡大の可能性が高く、現地当局は既に対応中（UKS管理、マスク着用、PJJ検討）。重症度・死亡例の報告はなく、国際的な懸念材料は見られない。続報で重症度や感染規模の拡大有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special communicable disease control and door-to-door campaign started in Gaindas Buzurg.
article.articleSummary: Gaindas Buzurg, Balrampur district, launched the Special Communicable Disease Control and Door-to-Door Campaign for October 1–31. Initiated by the Block Development Officer Ram Kishun and Assistant Development Officer (Panchayat) Ashok Kumar Dubey, the program will visit villages to promote sanitation, prevent waterlogging, and guard against infectious diseases. Through the 'Dastak' campaign, health workers will conduct door-to-door fever surveillance, identify cases of dengue, malaria, and other communicable diseases, and ensure appropriate treatment. The event was attended by Block Program Manager Triloki Nath; PHFI UNICEF representative Israr Ahmad Gaur; Jagatram Verma; Ram Lakhan; Ajay Kumar; Shiv Kumar Yadav; Dinesh Kumar; Lalji Yadav; Block Motivator Amit Kashyap; and computer operator Dhanesh Kumar, along with several district officials and sanitation staff.

article.articleHeadline: В Таиланде предупредили об угрозе крысиной лихорадки из-за подтопления
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Thailand, authorities warned of the risk of leptospirosis due to flooding.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health warns of leptospirosis risk for people in flooded areas, including Bangkok, after heavy rains. The deputy head of the Department of Disease Control stated that prolonged exposure to mud or standing water increases infection risk. He advised wearing rubber boots or shielding feet with plastic bags, and maintaining regular handwashing and showers. Leptospirosis is a zoonotic infection transmitted to humans by animals, with symptoms such as fever, chills, headache, muscle pains, and skin rash. Bangkok had earlier declared a disaster area due to severe rainfall causing city flooding. The report relies on open-source data and provides no case counts, but emphasises preventative measures for residents and cleanup workers in affected zones.

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : Mateus Kanga interpelle l'éxécutif sur Ebola, l'insécurité et la gestion des deniers publics
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Mateus Kanga questions the executive about Ebola, insecurity and the management of public funds.
article.articleSummary: On 30 September 2026, the Tshopo Provincial Assembly opened its September session in Kisangani, highlighting Ebola crisis management and public-fund governance. Speaker Dr. Mateus Kanga Londimo criticized opacity in the Provincial Health Ministry, saying lack of transparency hampered Ebola outbreak response. He called for rigorous investigations and exemplary sanctions for anyone complicit in complacency, citing the nocturnal transfer of a body from Niania as a case. The Assembly urged measures to interrupt transmission and pressed for the immediate integration of epidemiologists and infectious-disease specialists into the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). While backing the national dialogue for peace, he warned against inter-service interference. The budget-focused session will scrutinize 2027 spending, land issues, and the management of provincial projects, ensuring funds reach frontline Ebola response and public health efforts in Kisangani and the broader Tshopo province.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：マテウス・カンガ議員が行政府にエボラ対応、治安、公金管理について質問

article.articleHeadline: CHOLERA OUTBREAK DECLARED AS 11 DEATHS RECORDED ACROSS SEVEN DISTRICTS - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Zambia has declared a cholera outbreak after 304 cases and 11 deaths across seven districts in five provinces. Eight community deaths and three at health facilities suggest delays in seeking care. As of Sept 29, 62 cases were laboratory-confirmed, with 35 patients in treatment and 230 discharged. Affected districts are Lusaka, Chilanga, and Chongwe (Lusaka Province); Chibombo (Central); Chiengi (Luapula); Nsama (Northern); and Chikankata (Southern). Chibombo and Lusaka account for the highest case counts. The Ministry of Health is strengthening surveillance, active case finding, laboratory testing, treatment, and community interventions to contain transmission. Public guidance urges safe water use, hand hygiene, and seeking medical attention promptly when symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ流行宣言、7地区で11人死亡確認 - ザンビア24

article.articleHeadline: Face à la surpopulation carcérale, la tuberculose gagne du terrain à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing prison overcrowding, tuberculosis is gaining ground.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis is spreading in the Mbuji-Mayi Central Prison in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where about 450 inmates live in facilities designed for 150. A new TB case identified during last week's screening by the Provincial TB Control Coordination raises the prison's TB caseload to more than 80. Overcrowding, malnutrition, and poor sanitation fuel transmission in confined spaces with limited ventilation; inmates sleep on the floor in cells housing more than 100 people. The infirmary is under-equipped and medicines are scarce. Fecal matter exposed to the open air creates odors that affect residents along Boulevard Laurent-Désiré Kabila. The provincial TB program recommends mass, systematic screening of inmates and prison staff and immediate isolation of confirmed cases to curb spread. The situation underscores ongoing penitentiary overcrowding and its challenges for health care within detention facilities.

triage.notes: 刑務所内の過密・衛生状態悪化による結核感染拡大。地域保健当局はスクリーニングと隔離を推奨しているが、国際的な公衆衛生リスクとしての情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Pato Branco registra surto de catapora e reforça alerta para vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pato Branco reports chickenpox outbreak and reiterates vaccination alert
article.articleSummary: Seven confirmed chickenpox cases in 2026 in Pato Branco, Brazil, as authorities report an ongoing outbreak. In 2025, four varicella outbreaks led to 14 infections, including three in daycares and one in a hospital. Health officials urge parents to review children’s vaccination records and complete any missing doses. The varicella vaccination schedule requires two doses in childhood: first at 15 months with the tetravalent vaccine and second at four years; routine vaccination in the public system is available up to six years, 11 months and 29 days. Vaccines are offered at local health units with active vaccination rooms; ID and vaccination card are preferred to verify immunization status. Neighborhood vaccination rooms operate Monday–Friday 7:30–11:30 and 13:00–16:30; the Central Vaccination Room runs 7:30–17:30 without a break. Maintaining up-to-date vaccination reduces infection risk and transmission, protecting vulnerable groups.

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав Таиланда предупредил о риске крысиной лихорадки после наводнения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warned about the risk of leptospirosis after flooding.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warns of leptospirosis risk in Bangkok and flood-affected provinces, with standing water harboring Leptospira bacteria. No cases have been detected yet in those areas. Volunteers and rescuers engaged in flood relief face exposure to contaminated water, as infection occurs mainly from rat urine entering the body via mucous membranes or skin micro-wounds. Early signs include high fever and muscle pains. Since the start of 2026, Thailand recorded 3,303 leptospirosis cases and 46 deaths. Flooding from mid-September monsoon affected over 2.6 million people, with around 40 fatalities. Disaster declarations cover Bangkok and other provinces; water levels in the capital have fallen, though some areas remain flooded.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、洪水後のレプトスピラ症（鼠咬熱/ワイル病）リスクについて警告

triage.notes: 本記事は洪水後のレプトスピラ症リスクに関する予防的な保健省警告であり、バンコク等の洪水被災地域での新規症例は未確認。ただし2026年初頭からタイ全体で3,303例・46名死亡が報告されており、洪水による曝露が継続する限り症例増加の可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化本土登革熱+1　疾管署初判與9/18個案相關成社區群聚事件 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua County reports 1 locally transmitted dengue fever case; CDC's initial assessment links it to the Sept. 18 case, forming a community cluster | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: On Oct 1, 2026, Taiwan’s CDC reports 1 new locally acquired dengue fever case in Changhua County, a man in his 60s living in Changhua City, infected with dengue virus serotype 1. The residence is about 110 meters from the Sept 18 local case, and authorities preliminarily view this as a community cluster—the first in Changhua since 2023. The patient developed fever, diarrhea and malaise in late September and is hospitalized; close contacts are asymptomatic so far. Nationwide, as of Sep 30, 2026, Taiwan has 178 confirmed dengue cases: 12 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung City 10; Changhua County 2) and 166 imported, mainly from Vietnam (43), Indonesia (29) and the Philippines (20). A mobile anti-epidemic team has conducted vector surveillance, finding 544 water containers and 70 positives, with 21 inspection records issued. Public health measures include environmental control, community screening, self-monitoring, and urging clinicians to use NS1 testing for early diagnosis. Global dengue totals exceed 2.22 million through Aug 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化県で国内感染デング熱症例+1例　疾病管理署は9/18症例との関連で地域クラスターと初期判断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県での小規模な局地的デング熱クラスターであり、通常の季節的流行・保健当局の定常的サーベイランス対応の範囲内。対象国での発生でもなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化県・高雄市）における国内感染デング熱クラスターであり、フィリピン・インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав Таиланда предупреждает о риске крысиной лихорадки после наводнений
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warns of the risk of leptospirosis after floods.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Ministry of Public Health warns of leptospirosis risk after floods in the country. To reduce infection risk, residents and rescuers should wear protective gloves and rubber boots when contacting contaminated water, avoid direct contact with standing water when possible, and wash hands thoroughly with soap after work or time in flooded zones. If symptoms such as high fever, muscle pains, headache, or conjunctival redness appear, seek medical care promptly for timely diagnosis and antibiotic treatment; early intervention lowers risk of complications and death. The Ministry is conducting sanitation and disinfection of flooded areas and informing the public through media and local organizations about safety measures. Authorities urge local communities to cooperate and report individuals in distress needing assistance.

article.articleHeadline: Mau Vaksin Rabies, Eh Oyen Malah Demam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wants to Get the Rabies Vaccine, but Oyen Ends Up with a Fever
article.articleSummary: At World Rabies Day 2026 activities in Bogor, Indonesia, a free rabies vaccination and health-check event was held at IPB Baranangsiang Campus, attended by Bogor Mayor Dedie A. Rachim. A pet cat named Oyen accompanied by owner Emaq experienced rising fever during the visit; after a health check, Oyen's temperature reached 39°C and later 40°C, prompting the vaccination to be canceled to avoid risks while unwell. The incident underscores pet health responsibilities beyond feeding, including timely vaccination. The Ministry of Health reiterates the importance of regular rabies vaccination for dogs and cats, as exposure risk persists in the environment. The article notes public awareness on pet welfare and vaccination, with emphasis on not vaccinating sick animals and ensuring proper care, including veterinary visits if fever arises. No laboratory confirmation is reported for rabies in this case.

article.articleHeadline: O avanço da Herpes no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of herpes in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Herpes zoster (shingles), caused by the varicella-zoster virus, is affecting Brazil. Health Ministry data show 2025 recorded 49,720 ambulatory visits and 3,060 hospitalizations nationwide. From January to June 2026, 33,141 outpatient visits and 1,559 hospitalizations were reported. In 2025, São Paulo registered the most cases (15,459), followed by Rio de Janeiro (9,931) and Minas Gerais (4,039). Despite increasing caseloads, the vaccine is not yet included in Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) vaccination calendar; treatment remains free through SUS. In early September, the Senate approved PL 4.426/25 proposing the immunization be added to the SUS calendar, signaling ongoing policy momentum toward vaccination inclusion to address the public health burden of shingles.

triage.notes: 記事は帯状疱疹（Herpes zoster）に関する医療政策・ワクチン接種議論が主題であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: После наводнений в Таиланде появилась новая угроза: умирают от "крысиной лихорадки"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After floods in Thailand, a new threat has emerged: people are dying from "rat fever".
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Thailand reports a rising leptospirosis threat following floods. The Department of Disease Control notes 3,303 cases and 46 deaths since the start of 2026, with Bangkok and Pattaya among affected areas. Risks increase for volunteers and flood-cleanup workers in contact with contaminated water and soil. Leptospira bacteria, carried by rats, mice, dogs, pigs, cattle, and buffalo, persist in dirty floodwater; infection occurs through skin wounds or mucous membranes, worsened by barefoot exposure. Incubation is about 5–14 days (up to 30). Early symptoms mimic influenza: high fever, chills, headache, nausea, vomiting, and muscle pain, especially calves and lower back. Severe disease can cause acute kidney failure, liver failure with jaundice, meningitis, respiratory distress, or pulmonary hemorrhage. Treatment relies on antibiotics; severe cases require hospitalization, dialysis, or ventilation. Prevention emphasizes avoiding floodwater, wearing closed waterproof footwear and gloves, sealing wounds, and washing exposed skin with soap after contact. The rainy season persists with forecasted heavy rain Oct 5–10.

article.articleHeadline: 彰化爆近3年首起本土登革熱群聚　確診者與上月個案僅隔110公尺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua sees first locally transmitted dengue fever cluster in nearly three years; the confirmed case is only 110 meters away from last month's case.
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan reports the first locally transmitted dengue fever cluster in almost three years, a Type 1 case in a man in his 60s. He developed fever and diarrhea from Sept 26; initial flu and COVID-19 tests were negative, and NS1 on Sept 30 confirmed dengue, with hospitalization. The residence sits about 110 meters from a Sept 18 case, indicating a community cluster; genome sequencing will confirm linkage. Public health teams have intensified vector surveillance, source reduction, and will set up screening sites. By Sept 29, 34 staff identified 544 water containers with larvae and 70 positive ones, plus 21 inspection records. No suspected secondary cases among close contacts. National totals to Sept 30: 178 dengue cases, including 12 locally (Kaohsiung City 10, Changhua County 2) and 166 imported, from Vietnam (43), Indonesia (29), Philippines (20). Globally, dengue remains widespread in 2026, with high counts in Vietnam, Bangladesh, Cambodia.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾・彰化県における約3年ぶりの国内感染デング熱クラスターで異常性はあるが、重症例・死亡例はなく地方当局で対応可能な規模。また発生地域は対象国リストに該当しないため、フルRRAには進めず経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: ଝାଡ଼ାବାନ୍ତି ନେଲାଣି ୪ ଜୀବନ Ganjam Diarrhoea Outbreak | 4 Dead in Sanakhemundi, More Cases Reported
article.articleSummary: Ganjam diarrhoea outbreak in Marthapur village, Sanakhemundi, Odisha, has reached four deaths with additional cases reported as of 01 Oct 2026. Diarrhoeal illness was recorded in Marthapur; one patient died during treatment, raising the toll to four among affected residents. Health officials and medical teams are monitoring the situation and providing care to those affected, while authorities work to determine the outbreak’s cause and curb spread. Reported symptoms center on diarrhoea; no further clinical details or laboratory confirmation are cited. The outbreak is localized to Ganjam district’s Sanakhemundi block, with Marthapur as the focal point. The article provides no information on specific infection sources or any imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Sekolah Dipantau, Disdik Bandung Siapkan Opsi PJJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in schools are being monitored; Bandung Education Office prepares distance-learning options.
article.articleSummary: Bandung City’s Department of Education keeps distance-learning (PJJ) as a contingency if Influenza A cases in schools rise significantly. The decision will not be automatic; evaluations of field conditions will determine whether to switch, in coordination with the Health Office. Because conditions vary by district and school, handling will be tailored to the level of transmission risk identified at each school. As of 1 October 2026, classes in Bandung’s schools continue to be held in person, with no suspension of on-site teaching yet. Should reports of Influenza A cases increase, the department will evaluate and report to the Mayor for further directives. Close coordination with Dinas Kesehatan is planned to monitor trends more comprehensively, ensuring that educational continuity does not compromise student health. Any PJJ deployment would follow evaluation results and government guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 学校でのインフルエンザA型症例を監視、バンドン教育局が遠隔学習(PJJ)の選択肢を準備
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの学校内発生で、現時点では対面授業継続中であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Merebak, Sekolah di Bandung Bisa Terapkan PJJ jika Kasus Meningkat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Spreads, Bandung Schools Could Implement Distance Learning If Cases Increase.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Bandung schools prompt readiness for distance learning if outbreaks worsen; as of 1 October 2026, in-person learning continues as authorities deem the situation under control. The Bandung City Education Office issued a circular to principals across TK/PAUD/SD/SMP, both public and private, advising vigilance and proactive measures to curb transmission, especially for multi-day flu symptoms. Health pathways emphasize initial care at the School Health Unit (UKS); if needs exceed school capacity, schools coordinate with nearby puskesmas (health centers). Sick students should receive treatment at puskesmas; upon doctor’s approval to return, they may rejoin classes with a mask; if not recovered, they may go home until ready. Ongoing monitoring of schools is underway; no reports of emergency conditions yet, with coordination ongoing with the Dinas Kesehatan Kota Bandung.

article.articleHeadline: Medecins Sans Frontieres staff member tests positive for Ebola in Congo, MSF says
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease while working on the Ebola response, MSF said on Thursday. The patient is being evacuated under a strict medical protocol in close coordination with health authorities in the DRC and the Netherlands, where the patient will be received by a designated hospital. MSF did not disclose the identity or location of the hospital or further clinical details. The statement underscores ongoing international cooperation to manage Ebola-related cases and transport suspected infections to appropriate facilities. No information on symptoms, exposure source, or case counts is provided in the report.

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov PBD sebut lebih 350 anak berpotensi TB belum terdeteksi - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PBD Provincial Government says more than 350 children at risk of TB have not yet been detected - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: Southwest Papua Province, Indonesia, reports more than 350 children at risk of undetected tuberculosis (TB) as of August 2026. Of an estimated 494 pediatric TB cases in 2026, only 144 (about 29%) were identified by August, according to acting regional secretary Yakob Kareth at a cross‑sector TB forum in Sorong. He stressed the need for intensified child-TB case finding and multi‑sector involvement beyond health, noting TB in children often results from adult transmission at home and is driven by stigma, limited health access, malnutrition, housing conditions, and poverty. The central government labels TB control a quick‑win program aimed at elimination by 2030, under Presidential Regulation No. 67 of 2021. Kareth urged regional planners to embed pediatric TB in budgeting, engaging Education (schools), DP3AKB/TP-PKK (families), and Social Services via social protection. UNICEF Papua endorsed cross‑sector collaboration to reach the 2030 elimination target.

article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ebola : un membre de MSF évacué vers les Pays-Bas, où l'hôpital de Leiden prépare son accueil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ebola: an MSF member evacuated to the Netherlands, where Leiden hospital is preparing to receive him.
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member infected with Ebola during the response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) was evacuated on 1 October 2026 to the Netherlands, where Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) is preparing to receive him in strict isolation. The patient fell ill in Beni, North Kivu, and a special flight is transporting him to a designated facility with isolation rooms and PPE; LUMC notes that other patients and visitors face no infection risk. In the DRC, 29 September figures show 8,224 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,982 deaths (case-fatality 48.4%) across seven provinces; the Beni health zone reports 348 cases and 229 deaths. Vaccination efforts are being organized in Beni with teams deployed; in Ituri, 731 people had been vaccinated as of 29 September with MSF support, while studies on ERVEBO efficacy against Bundibugyo virus continue.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aligarh News: Campaign launched for the prevention of communicable diseases, MLA Mukta Raja flagged off the rally.
article.articleSummary: On October 1, 2026, Aligarh district launches a month-long communicable disease control campaign running through October 31. A awareness rally began at Malakh Singh District Hospital, flagged off by MLA Mukta Sanjeev Raja, with Chief Medical Officer Dr. R.N. Singh welcoming participants. The program prioritizes sanitation, awareness, and timely treatment to curb communicable diseases. ASHA and Anganwadi workers will conduct door-to-door visits to identify fever cases and patients with malaria, lymphatic filariasis, leprosy (kushth), tuberculosis, and malnourished children, ensuring access to care. To enhance impact, the City Municipal Corporation is conducting intensive fogging and insecticide spraying across city areas. Posters, banners, and pamphlets educate residents on preventive measures. The awareness rally progressed through Raslganj, Hakim ki Sarai, and Koale wali gali, ending at a local primary school, with participation from health department and municipal officials.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shravasti News: Communicable Disease Control Campaign Began; DM and District Panchayat President Flagged Off Awareness Van.
article.articleSummary: Shravasti district in Uttar Pradesh launched a special Communicable Disease Control campaign from October 1–31, with a Dastak door-to-door drive October 12–31 to raise awareness in urban and rural areas. District Magistrate Annpurna Garg and District Panchayat President Dadadan Mishra flagged off an awareness van at the collectorate, with Chief Medical Officer Dr. A.K. Singh present. The initiative stresses inter-departmental collaboration across Urban Development, Panchayati Raj, Rural Development, Veterinary, Women and Child Development, Education, Disability Empowerment, Agriculture, Irrigation, and Information. Asha and Anganwadi workers will conduct house-to-house visits to promote waste disposal, prevent waterlogging, and mosquito protection, and report suspected tuberculosis cases to block headquarters with names, addresses, and mobile numbers. Dr. Singh urged prompt treatment for brain fever symptoms and vaccination; preventive measures include installing screens on doors/windows, using mosquito nets, covering water tanks, weekly draining of water from coolers and planters, and avoiding open defecation, plus JE vaccination.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mathura News: Launch of communicable disease control campaign, MLA flags off the rally.
article.articleSummary: Mathura, India — a special communicable disease control campaign was launched to curb dengue, malaria and other mosquito-borne and communicable diseases. The campaign runs October 1–31, with a door-to-door Dastak drive from October 12–31 aimed at sanitation and mosquito prevention. MLA Shrikant Sharma flagged off an awareness rally from the Chief Medical Officer’s office, urging cleanliness at home and around, elimination of water stagnation, and adherence to mosquito-control measures. Trainee ANMs, urban ASHA workers, Anganwadi workers, and Municipal Corporation staff participated; the rally concluded with a health-awareness gathering. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Radha Vallabh directed staff to pledge and implement the campaign effectively. Health department urged residents to cover water containers, drain standing water weekly, use mosquito nets and protective clothing, seek care for fever, complete prescribed medications, and avoid aspirin or Brufen without medical advice. Officials Dr. Ramgopal, Yogendra Singh, and Dr. Anuj Chaudhary attended.

article.articleHeadline: Agora nos preocupa ainda mais": focos do mosquito da dengue aumentam 70% em Rio Grande | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Now it worries us even more": dengue-carrying mosquito breeding sites increase by 70% in Rio Grande | South Zone
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande, Brazil (South Zone), reports 703 Aedes aegypti breeding sites from January–September 2026, a 70% rise versus the same period in 2025, per the Arboviruses Monitoring Bulletin by the City Health Secretariat (SMS) and the Strategic Health Surveillance Information Center (Cievs). In the last 15 days, five new larval habitats were identified in Aeroporto, Trevo, Getúlio Vargas, Linha do Parque, and Hidráulica. The center hosts the most sites (124), followed by Cidade Nova (79), Distrito Industrial (69), Quinta (66), and Vila Maria (37). Dengue notifications total 60 in 2026, with 3 autochthonous cases and 57 discarded; chikungunya has 13 notifications (11 discarded, 2 under investigation). Most breeding grounds are movable containers—buckets, plant pots, tires—alongside fixed containers, rubbish, and bromeliads. Prevention emphasizes removing standing water: sand in plant dishes, protect tires from rain, store bottles inverted, seal trash bags, and eliminate water-collecting receptacles, especially with upcoming warm, rainy months.

triage.headline_ja: 「今はもっと心配だ」：リオグランデでデング熱媒介蚊の発生地点が70％増加
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の発生地点は70%増加しているが、実際のデング・チクングニア確定症例数は少なく（デング自治体内感染3例、チクングニア確定0例）、現時点で重大な公衆衛生インパクトは認められないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の繁殖地点増加という予防的・環境的側面を中心に報じており、ヒト感染症例数自体は少数（デング自治体内感染3例、チクングニア確定0例）。今後の雨季に向けた増加リスクとして経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Diklaim Belum Ada di Ponorogo, Dinkes Ungkap Gejala Flu yang Harus Diwaspadai Masyarakat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Claimed Not Yet Present in Ponorogo, Health Office Reveals Flu Symptoms to Watch Out For
article.articleSummary: Influenza A not detected in Ponorogo, East Java, as of October 1, 2026. The Ponorogo Health Office (Dinkes) reports no confirmed Influenza A cases at health facilities, and specialized testing for Influenza A has not yet been performed. National surveillance through week 38 of 2026 shows influenza activity at a medium, seasonal level in Indonesia, with a 56% positivity rate. Of 265 specimens tested nationwide, 148 were positive for influenza, with Influenza A (H1N1pdm09) the dominant strain. Dinkes Ponorogo monitors influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) reported to SKDR, and cautions against panic while encouraging reporting of clustered or unusual cases. Symptoms to watch for Influenza A include persistent flu with fever ≥38°C, shortness of breath, and possible sudden collapse requiring hospitalization; laboratory confirmation is needed to confirm Influenza A.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAはポノロゴ県で未確認と主張、保健局が住民に注意すべきインフルエンザ症状を公表
triage.triage_reason: ポノロゴではインフルエンザA感染例は確認されておらず、全国的にも季節性の通常レベルの流行であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はポノロゴでインフルエンザA未検出であることを報告する予防啓発記事であり、全国サーベイランスも季節性・中程度レベルと通常範囲内。対象国リストのIndonesiaは該当するが、イベント自体が『発生なし』の内容のため地域検証上は除外（事案性が低いため）。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تشهد ارتفاعًا متسارعًا في حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is witnessing a rapid rise in Ebola virus infection cases - Urdu Point.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a rapid rise in Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, with total confirmed infections reaching 8,116, including 3,924 deaths and 2,088 recoveries, as of 1 October 2026. The Ministry of Health notes that the outbreak continues to expand amid a complex mix of societal and security challenges, logistical bottlenecks, and difficult geography, conditions that slow containment and vaccination efforts. Officials cite the evolving nature of the virus as an additional obstacle. International and regional organizations report substantial difficulties in mounting an effective response within one of the world's most challenging health and security environments. The report underscores the persistent public health threat posed by Ebola in the DRC and the need for sustained, coordinated measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染症の症例が急速に増加 - アルドゥポイント
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模に拡大しており（感染者8,116人、死者3,924人）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、治安・物流上の制約により封じ込めが困難な状況。国際支援の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Met ebolavirus besmette patiënt onderweg naar Nederland, wordt vandaag opgevangen in Leids ziekenhuis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An ebolavirus-infected patient en route to the Netherlands will be received today at Leiden hospital.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus-infected patient is en route to the Netherlands and will be received today at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) under strict isolation. The patient, a humanitarian aid worker from the Democratic Republic of Congo, will be transported with LUMC's safety measures and admitted in isolation upon arrival. In Congo, where the current outbreak was identified in May 2026, authorities report 8,067 infections and 3,901 deaths—the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history, though officials warn the actual case count may be higher. The LUMC says its department is prepared, with dedicated isolation rooms and protective equipment, and regularly rehearses handling patients with severe infectious diseases. The article also notes the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed about 11,000 people across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した患者がオランダへ搬送中、本日ライデンの病院で受け入れ予定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染8,067例、死亡3,901例）が継続中であり、感染者が国際搬送されるなど国際的拡大の兆候が見られるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は国際的拡大の一例だが、オランダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行の歴史的言及であり、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Museu da Cidade de Manaus recebe exposição nacional sobre memórias da pandemia da Covid-19 - Portal Zukka Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Museum of the City of Manaus hosts a national exhibition on memories of the COVID-19 pandemic - Portal Zukka Brasil
article.articleSummary: Manaus, Brazil—The Museum of the City of Manaus hosts the national exhibition A Infinita Memória da Pandemia: a história da Covid-19 por todos nós, brasileiros, promoted by the Ministry of Health. Opened Sept 30 at Paço da Liberdade in Manaus' center, the multimedia, interactive display gathers relatos, photographs, videos, posters, diaries, messages and testimonies from diverse regions and cultures. It revisits defining moments, including the 2021 oxygen shortage in Manaus. Since touring in Brasília and São Paulo, the exhibit has drawn more than 20,000 visitors. It aims to honor those affected by COVID-19 and stimulate reflection on science, public health, communication and social memory. Manaus Health Secretary Nagib Salem notes the municipal network has expanded since the pandemic, with larger facilities enabling better pre-attendance. The show runs until Nov 29, 2026. Notable stories include cacique Messias Kokama—father of dentist Miriam Moreira—and Danielle Alves, who lost close ones during the pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: マナウス市立博物館でコロナ禍の記憶をめぐる全国巡回展が開催 - Portal Zukka Brasil
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19パンデミックに関する過去の記憶を扱う博物館展示会の記事であり、現行の公衆衛生上の脅威や新規感染事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のパンデミックに関する文化的・歴史的な展示会の報道であり、現在進行形の感染症アウトブレイクではないため、ブラジルを含め対象国のverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化爆近3年首起本土登革熱群聚　確診者與上月個案僅隔110公尺 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever cluster in nearly three years, with confirmed cases only 110 meters apart from last month’s case | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan, reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever cluster in nearly three years, with two confirmed local cases and residences about 110 meters apart. The latest patient, a man in his 60s, developed fever, diarrhea and fatigue from Sept 26. NS1 rapid test on Sept 30 was positive for dengue virus type 1; he is hospitalized. He had no recent international travel; home and workplace exposures are under investigation, and sequencing will assess linkage to the Sept 18 local case. Health teams have begun vector surveillance and source reduction, inspecting 544 water containers and finding 70 positive larval habitats, issuing 21 enforcement notices. As of Sept 30, Taiwan’s domestic dengue total is 178 cases, including 12 local (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2); imported cases 166 (Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20). Globally, dengue activity remains high, with over 2.22 million cases by August, including Southeast Asia hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化で近3年ぶりの本土感染デング熱クラスターが発生、確定患者は先月の症例とわずか110メートルの距離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で3年ぶりの本土感染クラスターが確認され異常性は認められるが、重症度は低く国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化県・高雄市）での本土感染デング熱クラスター。フィリピン・インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、イベント発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当する発生地域はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化爆近3年首起本土登革熱群聚　確診者與上月個案僅隔110公尺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua County reports the first local dengue fever cluster in nearly three years, with the confirmed case and last month's case only 110 meters apart.
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan reports its first local dengue fever cluster in nearly three years. A man in his 60s tested positive for dengue virus type 1 on Sept 30 after fever, diarrhea and fatigue; he had not traveled abroad. His home is about 110 meters from a Sept 18 local case, prompting authorities to classify this as a community cluster. Initial testing for influenza and COVID-19 was negative; NS1 testing later yielded a positive result. Virus genome sequencing will be conducted to confirm linkage with the earlier case. Public health teams have intensified mosquito surveillance and source reduction, identifying 544 water-holding containers and 70 larval-positive containers, and issuing 21 inspection notices; a community screening site is planned. Taiwan’s total dengue cases through Sept 30: 178, including 12 local (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2) and 166 imported (Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20).

triage.headline_ja: 彰化県で約3年ぶりとなる本土感染デング熱クラスターが発生、確診者は先月の症例とわずか110メートルの距離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で約3年ぶりの地域内デング熱クラスターが報告されたが、症例数は少なく重症例の報告もないため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らず継続監視が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（彰化県・高雄市）で発生しており、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。フィリピン・インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、当該イベントの発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratamento de esquistossomose em crianças; entenda a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug for the treatment of schistosomiasis in children; understand the disease.
article.articleSummary: Arpraziquantel (arpraziquantel), produced by Fiocruz (Farmanguinhos), has been approved by Brazil’s Anvisa for treating schistosomiasis in children aged 3 months to 6 years, caused by Schistosoma mansoni or Schistosoma haematobium. Ingestion leads to absorption by worms in the bloodstream, causing muscular spasms and paralysis that disrupt attachment to vessels, and damage to the parasite’s tegument, promoting immune clearance. Schistosomiasis presents in an acute phase 2–6 weeks after water contact and a chronic phase months to years later. Transmission occurs through freshwater containing infected snails; symptoms typically appear 2–6 weeks post-infection. The disease is a major public health problem in tropical/subtropical regions of Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, and South America and is classified as a neglected tropical disease affecting predominantly low-income populations, with a spectrum from asymptomatic to severe.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、小児向け住血吸虫症治療薬を承認;病気について解説
triage.triage_reason: 新規薬剤承認に関する情報であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ராமேஸ்வரத்தில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு விழிப்புணர்வு... களமிறங்கிய அரசு பள்ளி மாணவர்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention awareness in Rameswaram: government school students join.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention awareness drive in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu: NSS students from the Government Boys Higher Secondary School, Ramanathapuram district, joined a 10-day National Service Scheme camp to educate the public. In front of the Ramanathaswamy Temple, students distributed dengue prevention pamphlets to pilgrims and tourists and explained how dengue spreads, how to curb mosquito breeding, and the importance of maintaining a clean environment. The activity formed part of social service during school holidays, with participation from teachers and volunteers, who also carried out daily sanitation and awareness programs. The push aligns with rising dengue activity across Tamil Nadu. The initiative aims to arm residents and visitors with basic dengue information and practical prevention steps.

triage.headline_ja: ラーメーシュワラムでデング熱予防啓発活動:政府系学校の生徒たちが参加
triage.triage_reason: 学校生徒によるデング熱予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州でのデング熱予防啓発活動（学生による地域啓発キャンペーン）に関する内容で、具体的な感染者数や流行規模のデータは含まれていない。「タミル・ナードゥ州全体でデング熱活動が増加している」との記述はあるが、定量的情報がなく評価不可。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-besmette AzG-medewerker naar LUMC Leiden voor zorg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected AZG employee to LUMC Leiden for care.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected staff member of Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) will be treated in the Netherlands. The employee, whose identity is not disclosed, contracted Ebola during a mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is to be admitted on Thursday to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in Leiden, the Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) confirms. MSF says it shares the staff member’s concern and notes that, despite strict precautions, infection can occur under demanding and complex field conditions. Precautions to prevent transmission are thorough, but the risk of exposure cannot be completely ruled out. MSF also states that the arrival of an Ebola patient does not pose a danger to people in the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したMSF職員、治療のためオランダ・ライデン大学医療センターへ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での任務中にエボラウイルスに感染したMSF職員がオランダへ国際搬送され治療を受けるという、国境を越えた感染症例であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染そのものはDRCでの任務中に発生しており、オランダはあくまで治療搬送先であるため、発生国としてはDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。RIVMとMSFが関与し国際的な医療搬送が行われている点から国際拡大リスクを認めたが、現時点でヒト-ヒト感染の二次拡大情報はなく、単一輸入症例としての評価にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: LUMC vangt patiënt met ebola op
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LUMC admits an Ebola patient.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case imported to the Netherlands: Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) admits a patient who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Dutch patient has been repatriated and is due to arrive at the hospital on Thursday, to be treated in a dedicated isolation ward. The DRC outbreak has intensified in recent weeks, with 7,672 infections and 3,699 deaths reported in the country. The patient traveled to DRC to provide care for people infected with the virus; this represents an imported case to the Netherlands, requiring strict isolation precautions. The report highlights the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Central Africa and the risk of international spread through repatriation of healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: LUMCがエボラ患者を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（感染7,672人、死亡3,699人）が継続中であり、オランダへの国際輸入例も発生していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が大規模化しており、医療従事者の帰還により先進国への輸入例が発生している点が国際的拡大の明確な証左。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: EUA confirmam 5ª morte por sarampo; vítima não tinha recebido vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. confirms 5th measles death; victim had not been vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Five measles deaths in the United States in 2026, the latest in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania; the victim was unvaccinated. The outbreak has spread across Pennsylvania, with more than 900 measles cases in 2026 across 39 counties. All five decedents were unvaccinated. National vaccination coverage dips below the 95% threshold, with kindergarten two-dose MMR rates dropping from 95.2% (2019–2020) to 92.4% (2025–2026), leaving about 280,000 preschoolers unprotected. Domestic transmission was eliminated in 2000, but misinformation and funding cuts have increased susceptibility. The CDC reports only two measles deaths in 2026, a discrepancy with state counts. Experts warn sustained community transmission in Pennsylvania could spread to other states; endemic transmission is not yet declared. Brazil notes São Paulo with 40 cases in 2026 and a vaccination campaign with age-based schedules: dose zero for 6–11 months; D1 at 12 months (MMR); D2 at 15 months (tetraviral).

triage.headline_ja: 米国で麻疹による5人目の死亡を確認、被害者はワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: 米国で麻疹の持続的伝播が発生し5人目の死者が出ており、2000年に排除宣言された疾患の再興という異常性と全米拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 主要な事象は米国（ペンシルベニア州含む39郡、900例超、死者5名）での麻疹流行であり、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル（サンパウロ州、40例、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）は記事内で実質的な事例として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Enfermedades tipo influenza en Argentina: se registraron más de 920.000 casos en 2026, la cifra más alta en una década para este período
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-like illnesses in Argentina: more than 920,000 cases were recorded in 2026, the highest figure in a decade for this period.
article.articleSummary: Argentina recorded 921,001 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases in 2026 through week 34, the highest for this period in a decade, with the season advanced by about three weeks. The surge began in week 9, peaked in weeks 21–22, and declined thereafter. Ambulatory influenza: 14 cases in week 35 with 24.5% positivity; hospitalized influenza: 35 confirmed cases in the last four weeks, RSV remaining the main respiratory virus among inpatients. Pneumonia incidence is below the previous two years, while bronchiolitis in children under two shows improvement after week 29. Over the last four weeks, 319 RSV-positive cases were reported, far exceeding influenza. Dengue shows low risk with no autochthonous transmission; 480 suspected since 2026–2027, 2 confirmed (travel to Brazil), 6 probable, 298 discarded, 174 under investigation. First chikungunya case of 2026–2027 detected in Orán, Salta. Emphasizes maternal vaccination to prevent RSV (32–36 weeks gestation).

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンのインフルエンザ様疾患：2026年に92万件以上の症例が記録され、この時期としては過去10年で最高値
triage.triage_reason: 過去10年で最多のILI症例数という異例性はあるが、重症度や国際的拡大の兆候は乏しく、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らない季節性サーベイランス情報と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンにおける季節性呼吸器疾患（インフルエンザ様疾患、RSV、デング、チクングニア）の流行状況であり、対象国リストに含まれるブラジルは渡航歴としてのみ言及されているため除外。アルゼンチン自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Dokter Umum RSPB Balikpapan Beberkan Tips Cegah Influenza Saat Musim Penyakit, Perbanyak Istirahat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: General Practitioner at RSPB Balikpapan Shares Tips to Prevent Influenza During the Disease Season, Get Plenty of Rest
article.articleSummary: Influenza prevention guidance is issued by Dr. Rony Kharisma, General Practitioner and head of OHIH at Pertamina Balikpapan Hospital, Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, Indonesia, during the influenza season. Key measures include maintaining good physical condition, increasing vitamin C intake, getting ample rest, and reducing outdoor activities. When outdoors, wearing a mask is advised, especially when air quality is poor or exposure to respiratory particles is likely. The guidance notes that influenza management depends on severity: mild cases may recover with rest, while more severe infections should be evaluated at a health facility for optimal therapy. The advice emphasizes that influenza is largely self-limiting and differentiates self-care from medical care based on symptoms. Date reference: October 1, 2026. Location: Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, Indonesia.

article.articleHeadline: インド製薬大手、武田と提携　初のデング熱ワクチン販売
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's leading pharmaceutical company partners with Takeda for the first dengue fever vaccine sale.
article.articleSummary: Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga has secured India's first regulatory approval for dengue vaccination, with Mumbai-based Dr. Reddy's Laboratories signing a sales and distribution agreement to market Qdenga in India. Takeda's Indian subsidiary received regulatory clearance in July, enabling the product's rollout in the country. The partners plan to begin supplying Qdenga in the first half of 2027 for both pediatric and adult populations. This collaboration marks a milestone in India's dengue prevention efforts, positioning Dr. Reddy's as the local sales channel for Takeda’s dengue vaccine through the Indian market. The article focuses on the collaboration and timing and does not provide clinical data or pricing details.

triage.notes: 記事はワクチン販売提携に関する商業的発表であり、デング熱の発生状況や症例数についての情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: PRIP funds 41 pharma projects, opens new discovery track
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-01, India's Department of Pharmaceuticals approved 41 PRIP projects totaling about Rs 1,600 crore, with an anticipated Rs 3,020 crore in private investment, lifting total portfolio R&D to around Rs 4,620 crore. Projects span early drug discovery to medical technology design, with 12 at early stage and 29 later stage; 19 led by startups/MSMEs and 22 by large companies. By priority, 27 are New Medicines, 5 Complex Generics and Biosimilars, and 9 Novel Medical Devices. Notable efforts include an antibacterial compound targeting multidrug-resistant Gram-negative infections, an exosome-based regenerative therapy for corneal disease, an in-vivo CAR-T platform, patient-derived breast cancer organoids, and a programmable RNA-targeting antiviral technology; plus portable plasmonic-PCR for point-of-care infection diagnosis and a microfluidic platform for tuberculosis detection. Six projects fall under the strategic priority framework addressing bacterial pneumonia and meningitis, dengue, influenza, and next-generation TB vaccines. A New Discovery track offers up to Rs 50 crore with 25% co-funding to attract early investors.

triage.headline_ja: PRIPが41件の製薬プロジェクトに資金提供、新たな発見トラックを開設

article.articleHeadline: Cựu Tổng Giám đốc Đồ hộp Hạ Long lĩnh 19 năm tù trong vụ 197 tấn thịt lợn bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former Ha Long Canned Foods CEO sentenced to 19 years in prison in case involving 197 tons of diseased pork.
article.articleSummary: Former Ha Long Canned Foods CEO Truong Sỹ Toan was sentenced to 19 years by Hai Phong People’s Court for food-safety violations linked to about 197 tons of African swine fever (ASF)–tainted pork. A total of 17 defendants were convicted; 15 others received prison terms for food-safety violations, one was jailed 4 years for bribery, and another 18 months for offering bribes. From May 2025 to Sept 8, 2025, Ha Long Canned Foods bought over 197 tons of ASF-infected lean pork from Bui Duc Trong, worth about 17.4 billion VND. The supply chain drew from farmers and small slaughterhouses in Hung Yen, Thai Binh, Bac Giang, Bac Ninh, and Hai Duong; Le Ba Doanh supplied ~97 tons and Trinh Ha Viet ~95 tons. On entry to the plant, Toan and QA staff bypassed testing; Le Nhat Huy bribed a local official to falsify records and issue safety certificates. About 9.7 billion VND of meat was destroyed. Ha Long Canned Foods, founded in 1957 in Hai Phong, is a leading Vietnamese canned foods company.

triage.headline_ja: 元ハロン缶詰食品CEO、ASF感染豚肉197トン事件で懲役19年の判決
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASF感染豚肉流通に関する食品安全・汚職事件の司法判決報道であり、新規の感染症発生情報ではなく、ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は豚の疾病でありヒトへの感染性はないため、公衆衛生リスクアセスメント対象外。記事内容は食品安全・贈収賄に関する刑事裁判の判決報道であり、2025年5月～9月の過去事案に対するもの。

article.articleHeadline: Ziekenhuis Leiden vangt hulpverlener uit Congo op met ebolabesmetting
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leiden hospital takes in Ebola-infected aid worker from Congo.
article.articleSummary: Leiden's LUMC hospital is preparing to receive an Ebola-infected aid worker from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The frontline worker contracted Ebola in DRC and will be flown to the Netherlands for treatment, transported in isolation to LUMC, where admission is planned later today per RIVM. Gender and nationality of the aid worker have not been disclosed. LUMC notes its department is specialized for severe infectious diseases, with dedicated isolation facilities and regular drills to maintain preparedness. Doctors Without Borders confirms the patient is a worker on Ebola response and expresses solidarity with frontline responders. The Congo Ebola outbreak is the largest on record in the country, with over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths since May 2026; MSF cautions the true toll is probably higher due to under-detection and under-reporting.

triage.headline_ja: ライデンの病院、コンゴからのエボラ感染援助従事者を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラアウトブレイク（8000例超、死者約4000人）が継続中で、感染した援助従事者が国際搬送される事例が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダ（ライデン）は感染者受け入れ先であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。DRCでのアウトブレイクは過去最大規模とされ、致死率も高く、継続的な公衆衛生上の重大懸念事項である。

article.articleHeadline: LUMC vangt patiënt met embola op, wordt vanuit Afrika naar ziekenhuis in Leiden gebracht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LUMC receives a patient with an embolus who is being transported from Africa to a hospital in Leiden.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected staff member of Doctors Without Borders is being repatriated from the Democratic Republic of Congo to the Netherlands for admission to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in Leiden. The patient is to be hospitalized on Thursday, transported by private aircraft under medical escort, and then taken directly from the airport to hospital in strict isolation. LUMC says it is prepared for Ebola screening and care. MSF states the arrival poses no danger to people in the Netherlands and notes the infection occurred while working in Africa. Ebola can cause severe bleeding and is transmitted through body fluids; a large outbreak is ongoing in the DRC and surrounding countries. MSF cautions that the risk of transmission can never be completely ruled out. Previously, in May, LUMC was in national news for hantavirus.

triage.headline_ja: LUMCがエボラ患者を受け入れ、アフリカからライデンの病院へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイクに関連する国際搬送事例であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）が複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はMSFスタッフのエボラ感染・国際搬送事例を報じているが、背景としてDRCおよび周辺国で大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続中である旨が明記されている。オランダ（搬送先）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ハンタウイルスは過去の別報道の言及であり本イベントとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Set Back as Transit Centre Burns in DR Congo Camp
article.articleSummary: Transit centre for Ebola patients at Kigonze camp in Ituri province burned, abandoning the facility and eroding response capacity as the outbreak expands across seven DRC provinces. Ituri remains the epicenter near Bunia and Mongbwalu; the outbreak has over 8,000 confirmed cases and around 4,000 deaths, driven by Bundibugyo virus, the largest and deadliest outbreak in the DRC to date. Affected provinces include Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, South Ubangi, and Tshopo. The fire follows violence displacing about 19,000 at Kigonze, with thousands more fleeing Rhoe in Djugu (at least four deaths, seven injuries) and Masisi displacing over 24,000 since mid-September. Two Ebola responders were killed in Lubero (Sept 27–28). WHO reports expansion: more than 1,800 beds across 54 facilities, 114 mobile burial teams, 57 community teams, but about 1,400 more health professionals are needed.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのキャンプでエボラ患者輸送センターが焼失し、対応に打撃
triage.triage_reason: DRC7州に拡大する過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8000例超、死者約4000人）で、暴力・避難民・医療従事者殺害など公衆衛生対応能力に深刻な影響が出ており、国際的拡大・支援ニーズも明確なためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによる史上最大規模のエボラ流行。治安悪化・施設焼失・医療従事者殺害により対応が著しく困難化しており、既存のWHO支援体制（ベッド数・埋葬チーム等）でも人員不足（約1400人の医療専門家不足）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Служител на "Лекари без граници" е с положителен тест за ебола в ДР Конго, съобщи хуманитарната организация
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An employee of Doctors Without Borders has tested positive for Ebola in the DRC, the humanitarian organization said.
article.articleSummary: An MSF employee tested positive for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo while participating in outbreak-control activities. The staff member was safely evacuated under strict medical protocols in coordination with DRC health authorities and Netherlands authorities, where they will be admitted to a specialized facility. As of 1 October 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 8,067 confirmed infections and 3,901 deaths, the largest and deadliest in the country's history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Only West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic is larger globally, with over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. MSF noted that despite high protective measures for personnel, no containment can fully eliminate infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団の職員がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ陽性反応、人道支援団体が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は8,067例・3,901人死亡と同国史上最大規模であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大（MSF職員のオランダへの搬送）が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: オランダへのMSF職員搬送は治療目的の国際移動であり、現地発生国はDRCのみ。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニア・アンゴラは過去の流行との比較で言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hulpverlener met ebola uit Congo voor behandeling naar LUMC in Leiden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aid worker with Ebola from Congo for treatment at LUMC in Leiden.
article.articleSummary: An aid worker with Ebola from the Democratic Republic of Congo is being treated in the Netherlands at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in Leiden. The individual, whose identity has not been disclosed, contracted Ebola during a deployment in the DRC and was transported to the Netherlands on a dedicated flight. The patient is being treated in strict isolation on arrival, with the LUMC confirming preparations and protective measures to prevent any spread, including specialized isolation facilities and staff training. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) acknowledges the worker's infection despite precautions, noting that the risk cannot be wholly ruled out under demanding field conditions. MSF says the arrival of an Ebola patient does not pose a danger to people in the Netherlands, and visitors at LUMC need not take extra precautions beyond standard measures, per the hospital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ出身のエボラ感染援助従事者、治療のためライデンのLUMCへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラに感染した援助従事者が国際搬送された事例であり、重症感染症かつ国際的移送を伴うためWPRO基準（異常性・重症度）を満たし、報道による社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本事例はDRCでのエボラ感染者が厳重な隔離体制下でオランダへ医療搬送された個別症例であり、オランダ国内での二次感染リスクは低いと報告されている。発生源であるDRCのエボラ流行状況については本記事からは詳細不明。
