article.articleHeadline: Crescem casos de sarna humana em escolas e creches de Minas Gerais, levando ao fechamento temporário de instituições - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cases of human scabies in schools and daycares in Minas Gerais, leading to the temporary closures of institutions - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Rising human scabies cases trigger temporary closures of schools and a daycare in Minas Gerais, Brazil. In Andradas, a daycare about 482 km from Belo Horizonte closed for 72 hours after 11 suspected scabies cases; in Lagoa Santa (Grande Belo Horizonte), a municipal school suspended classes until October 2 following 21 suspected cases among students and staff. Scabies is caused by a mite spreading through direct skin contact or contaminated objects, causing intense itching and red skin lesions. Common sites include joints, inner elbows, behind the knees, and between fingers. Health authorities advise families not to send symptomatic children and to seek evaluation and treatment. Cleaning, disinfection, water tank sanitation, and hygiene measures are being implemented; treatment may involve topical creams and oral anti-helminthics depending on extent.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の学校・保育所で人疥癬の症例が増加、施設の一時閉鎖へ - BH 24 Horas
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的に公衆衛生上重大な脅威とはみなされず、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも低い。局地的な学校・保育所の一時閉鎖にとどまり、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で集団生活施設（学校・保育所）内で広がりやすいが、重症度は低く、局地的な対応（消毒・治療）で管理可能。続報の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: MSF staff member tests positive for Ebola disease and is medically evacuated
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) confirmed in an MSF staff member assisting the Democratic Republic of the Congo response. The patient is evacuated under a strict medical protocol to a designated hospital in the Netherlands; MSF cannot share evacuation details to protect confidentiality. The DRC outbreak is the largest Ebola crisis seen in the country, with more than 8,000 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since May, toll likely higher due to surveillance gaps. Healthcare workers are among the most at risk. MSF continues to respond across Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé provinces, working with Congolese authorities and affected communities to bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: MSFスタッフがエボラ陽性と判明し、医療搬送される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8000例超、4000人超死亡）が継続中であり、医療従事者への感染と国際医療搬送が発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: オランダへの医療搬送は国際的な医療対応の一環であり、オランダ国内での感染拡大は確認されていないため対象国リストには含めない。DRC国内のTshopo・Ituri州は国単位で集約。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் இருமடங்கான டெங்கு பாதிப்பு: காய்ச்சல் அறிகுறிகளை அலட்சியப்படுத்த வேண்டாம்! | Theekkathir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Double dengue infection in Chennai: Do not ignore fever symptoms!
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections in Chennai have doubled in a month, according to the health department. In Tamil Nadu, about 18,000 dengue cases have been confirmed up to last week. In Chennai, August recorded 605 dengue cases, rising to 1,290 in September; a single day reported 72 confirmed cases. Public concern is rising, and authorities urge anyone with dengue symptoms to seek testing at a nearby hospital. Typical signs include fever, headache, muscle pain, and skin rashes. Early detection and proper treatment can control and cure dengue. Prevention measures emphasize eliminating standing water at home and surroundings, avoiding water accumulation in coconut shells, old tires, and broken items; cover drinking water containers; remove unnecessary containers that collect water; wear full-sleeved clothing and use mosquito repellents; and avoid self-medicating for fever—seek medical advice promptly.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱感染が倍増：発熱症状を軽視しないで！
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な症例増加であり既知の風土病であるが、症例数が急増しており公衆衛生上の注意が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナドゥ州チェンナイで季節的に流行する既知の疾患。症例数の倍増は懸念材料だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。重症度（死亡者数等）の情報が記事に含まれていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Leger Uten Grenser-ansatt i Kongo smittet av ebolavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF staff member in Congo infected with Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: One MSF staff member in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Ebola virus disease (EVD), Bundibugyo variant, and has been evacuated to the Netherlands under strict medical protocol. The employee was working with Ebola readiness efforts in the DRC and is being treated at a Dutch hospital. As of 1 October 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases for the first time, with the latest official tally listing 8,067 infections and 3,901 deaths. The outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC's history, overtaking the 2018–2020 epidemic. MSF is coordinating response activities across Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでMSF職員がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の過去最大規模の流行が継続中(8,067例、3,901死亡)で、MSF職員の国際搬送事例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSF職員がオランダに搬送され治療を受けているが、これは医療従事者の国際移送であり、記事の主題はDRCでの流行継続。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率(約48%)が高く、過去最大規模の流行として深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA di Palembang Melonjak, RSMP Catat 200 Pasien dalam 3 Bulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases in Palembang; RSMP records 200 patients in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Haze from forest and land fires in South Sumatra, including Palembang, has coincided with a surge in acute respiratory infections (ARI). At Muhammadiyah Palembang Hospital (RSMP), about 200 ARI patients were treated over the past two to three months, seen in both outpatient clinics and inpatient wards as of end September 2026. Many patients reported shortness of breath, sweating, coughing, and fever, with more severe cases experiencing dyspnea requiring intensive care and hospitalization. Patients with comorbidities were identified as needing closer monitoring and potentially intensive treatment. The events underscore potential health impacts of smoky air across Palembang and the South Sumatra region during the ongoing haze season. The article does not report laboratory confirmation or infection sources beyond air quality conditions.

triage.headline_ja: パレンバンでの急性呼吸器感染症（ARI）症例が急増、RSMPは3カ月で200人の患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 森林・土地火災によるヘイズに関連したARI症例増加だが、感染症（病原体由来）か大気汚染由来かが不明確で、ヒト-ヒト感染性の証拠もないため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症というより大気汚染（ヘイズ）による健康影響の可能性が高く、病原体の関与や検査確認の記載はない。毎年のヘイズ季節に繰り返される現象であり、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低いが、呼吸器症状の急増として経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: دعا إلى تدابير الوقاية من "إيبولا" فضُربوه حتى الموت.. ماذا حدث لممثل عن الحزب الحاكم في الكونغو؟ |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: He called for Ebola prevention measures, but he was beaten to death... What happened to a representative of the ruling party in Congo?
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Butembo with spread to seven provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Since first being announced on May 15, 2026, the outbreak has reached 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths, making it the largest and deadliest in the DRC and second-largest globally after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Ebola is transmitted via body fluids and causes fever, weakness, and hemorrhagic manifestations leading to organ failure if untreated. Violence surrounding the response is rising; a UDPS official, Mary-Celestine Karundwa, was beaten to death after promoting prevention on a radio program in Butembo, with his home set on fire. In nearby Beni, a handwashing checkpoint was attacked, killing at least one and injuring others. WHO and African CDC warn the outbreak could surpass West Africa numbers, exacerbated by conflict and aid cuts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の予防策を呼びかけたコンゴ与党代表者が殴打され死亡…何が起きたのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が7州に拡大し8,067例・3,901死亡と西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模になっており、治療薬・ワクチン未承認かつ対応への暴力も激化しているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーでは言及なしのため除外。暴力・治安悪化が対応を阻害しており、WHO/Africa CDCが西アフリカ規模超えの懸念を表明。

article.articleHeadline: В Таиланде зафиксировали вспышку крысиной лихорадки на фоне подтопления
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Thailand, a leptospirosis outbreak has been recorded amid flooding.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis (rat fever) outbreak recorded in Thailand amid floods, with Bangkok and other provinces affected. The Ministry of Public Health warns of transmission risk in floodwaters, mud, and standing water; case fatality rate is 1.39%. Deputy Director of the Department of Disease Control urged those entering flooded areas or assisting with cleanup to wear rubber boots or, if needed, cover feet with clean plastic bags to prevent skin contact, and to wash hands and shower regularly. Bangkok has seen up to 210 mm of rain in 24 hours, flooding dozens of streets and prompting some travel by boat; eastern districts report overflowing canals and slow drainage. Authorities advise residents to raise belongings, avoid unnecessary travel, and note possible flight delays at Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang airports as crews pump water and drain canals.

triage.headline_ja: タイで洪水に伴いレプトスピラ症（ネズミ熱）の集団発生が記録される
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴う季節性のレプトスピラ症発生であり、タイ国内の風土病的事象として異常性は低いが、曝露の継続と感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 洪水下でのレプトスピラ症流行はタイの季節的に繰り返される公衆衛生課題であり、保健省が対策を講じている。致死率1.39%との記載があるが規模（症例数）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'UNICEF appelle à maintenir les efforts jusqu'à zéro cas - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: UNICEF Urges Continued Efforts Until There Are Zero Cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains a threat with transmission ongoing in Bunia’s areas. On September 30, UNICEF’s Global Emergency Operations Director, Lucia Elmi, urged the military governor Kasongo Mulumba Batoka Gaby to sustain and intensify the response until transmission is interrupted completely and every child is protected. No case counts are provided; UNICEF emphasizes continued vigilance to prevent relapse and to reach zero transmission. Progress achieved through experience provides a solid foundation, but prevention and care mechanisms must stay robust. Beyond health measures, UNICEF will deepen multisectoral support for child protection, including hygiene and sanitation, and bolster the education sector—back-to-school support, teacher training, and parental awareness—to reduce transmission in schools and communities. The overarching aim remains zero Ebola cases with strengthened collaboration among authorities, partners, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：UNICEFがゼロ症例達成まで対策継続を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大疾患であり、DRCイツリ州で感染継続中との報告があるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 症例数の具体的な数値は記事に記載されておらず、感染拡大の規模や国際的拡大リスクについては不明。UNICEFによる継続的な対応要請が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: ભુજ ITIમાં HIV, TB, હિપેટાઇટિસ અને STI અંગે માર્ગદર્શન અપાયું: તાલીમાર્થીઓને ચેપી રોગોની સાચી સમજ અને ગેરમાન્યતાઓ દૂર કરવા માર્ગદર્શન મળ્યું
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guidance on HIV, TB, hepatitis and STIs given at Bhuj ITI: Trainees were guided to gain an accurate understanding of contagious diseases and to dispel misconceptions.
article.articleSummary: Bhuj ITI in Gujarat held a health awareness session under Seva Sankalp Abhiyan and IEC 3.0 to equip youths with accurate, scientific information on contagious diseases and dispel misconceptions. Guided by the District Collector and District Development Officer, and led by District Health Officer Dr. Mitesh Bhanderi and chaired by District TB Officer Dr. Manoj Dave, with support from Indian Counseling of Social Welfare, the program covered HIV/AIDS, STI, TB and hepatitis. Dr. Dave outlined causes, transmission, symptoms, and preventive precautions; emphasized timely HIV testing, ART, and nondiscrimination toward people living with HIV. For TB, he urged immediate testing for persistent cough, fever, or weight loss; for hepatitis and STI, safe practices, timely medical advice, and appropriate treatment. Trainees completed self-risk assessments; information on the 1097 helpline and Break Free India was provided. ITI Principal Mallikbhai Rawal and staff, with IC SW Welfare colleagues, supported the initiative.

triage.headline_ja: ブジITIでHIV、結核、肝炎、性感染症に関する指導が行われる：研修生が感染症の正確な理解と誤解の解消について指導を受けた
triage.triage_reason: これは特定の疾病アウトブレイクではなく、啓発プログラム・健康教育イベントの報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はGujarat州Bhujでの啓発活動を報じるもので、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Congolese Politician Is Killed For Defending Ebola Efforts As Mistrust Complicates Response
article.articleSummary: In eastern Congo’s North Kivu, Butembo hosts the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, driven by the Bundibugyo virus. More than 8,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths have been reported in the 17th outbreak, with Ituri province home to ongoing clinical trials for vaccines and treatments. There are no approved vaccines or therapies yet. Responders warn persistent challenges in timely case detection and delivery of care as the outbreak outpaces efforts to track and slow it, according to WHO. Mistrust of authorities and health workers remains a central obstacle, with residents in rebel-controlled and remote areas rejecting Ebola as a hoax or distrustful of the government. A local official, Marie-Célestin Karondwa of UDPS, was beaten and killed for publicly defending the response; his house was set on fire. A village-centered approach was launched this month to improve outreach and adherence to measures such as social distancing and handwashing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ人政治家、エボラ対策擁護により殺害 ― 不信感が対応を複雑化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)流行が8,000例・死者約4,000人に達し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、対応要員への暴力や住民の不信感により封じ込めが困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: WHOも「史上最速拡大」と警告する大規模アウトブレイクであり、治安悪化・住民の不信感・医療従事者への暴力が対応を妨げている。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Ebola-Infizierter im Ärzte Ohne Grenzen Team
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola-infected person in the Doctors Without Borders team.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola infection has been confirmed in a staff member working for Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient is being evacuated under strict safety precautions to a hospital in the Netherlands; MSF did not disclose gender or nationality to protect medical confidentiality. All MSF personnel are trained and equipped with protective gear, but a residual risk remains. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing the largest Ebola outbreak on record, with about 8,000 known cases and roughly 4,000 deaths. Experts warn the true case count is likely higher due to underreporting. The outbreak persists in a conflict-affected region with hundreds of thousands displaced, complicating containment and response measures. The report provides no further details on transmission routes or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団チームでエボラ感染者が確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的な医療従事者感染と国境を越えた患者搬送が発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダは感染者の搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRCは約8000症例・4000人死亡という過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、紛争地域における対応の複雑化が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Medizinisches Personal: Ebola-Fall bei Ärzte ohne Grenzen: Person wird ausgeflogen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical personnel: Ebola case at Doctors Without Borders: A person is being airlifted.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case has been identified among Doctors Without Borders (MSF) personnel in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The infected individual is being airlifted to a hospital in the Netherlands for treatment, with MSF reporting strict safety measures. Identity and local/foreign status are undisclosed to protect medical confidentiality. All MSF staff are trained and equipped with protective gear, but a residual risk remains. The DRC is experiencing the largest Ebola outbreak on record, with about 8,000 known cases and roughly 4,000 deaths; experts warn many infections likely go unreported. The outbreak is in a conflict-affected region with hundreds of thousands displaced, complicating containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 医療従事者：国境なき医師団でエボラ感染例、患者は空輸へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的規模のエボラ流行（約8000例、4000死亡）が継続中であり、国際医療スタッフの感染と国際搬送が発生していることから、国際的拡大リスク・重篤性・紛争地域での対応困難さが認められるため。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は医療目的の国際移動であり、オランダ国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。流行の主体はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'Unicef appelle à doubler les efforts pour éradiquer définitivement l'épidémie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: UNICEF calls for doubling efforts to definitively eradicate the Ebola outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: UNICEF’s global director of emergency operations, Lucia Elmi, in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, urged partners to double efforts to definitively eradicate Ebola, aiming for zero cases and protection for all children. In discussions with the military governor, Major General Gaby Kasongo, she highlighted progress from strengthened field teams and lessons learned, while stressing continued vigilance as Ebola remains present in affected zones. UNICEF reaffirmed its unwavering commitment to support authorities in Bunia and across affected areas, including public health actions, sanitation, hygiene, schooling, and training of teachers and parents. The call underscores mobilization to sustain outbreak response and protect communities, particularly children, until transmission is halted.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：ユニセフ、エボラ流行の完全根絶へ向け取り組み倍加を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行についてユニセフが継続的な警戒と対応強化を呼びかけており、重症度・流行継続性・国際支援の必要性からフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行の継続対応に関するユニセフの呼びかけであり、新規症例数や感染拡大の具体的データは記載されていない。続報での症例動向確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : les efforts du gouvernement dans la lutte contre Ebola salués - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uele: the government's efforts in the fight against Ebola praised - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has re-emerged in Haut-Uele province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Isiro as the focal city. During the opening of the September 2026 ordinary session, Zamba Ndezu, president of the Haut-Uélé Provincial Assembly, commended national and provincial government efforts and partner support in patient care and in measures to eradicate the outbreak, noting heightened insecurity in the region. He urged residents of Haut-Uele and Isiro to continue observing barrier measures to interrupt transmission, as directed by the response team. The ceremony was attended by Governor Jean Bakomito, the provincial security committee, heads of state and para-statal services, and other guests in Isiro’s assembly chamber. The remarks emphasize ongoing vigilance and adherence to public health measures to control the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州：エボラ対策における政府の取り組みが称賛される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オート・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、治安悪化により感染制御が困難な状況が示唆される。政府・パートナー支援への言及があり、社会的・政治的関心も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行への政府対応を称賛する内容であり新規発生の報告ではないが、治安悪化により感染制御リスクが継続している点が懸念材料。続報（症例数・死亡者数等の疫学データ）の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD, Kelurahan Kelapa Dua Wetan Jaktim gerebek saluran air
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever: Kelapa Dua Wetan Urban Village in East Jakarta Raids a Drainage Channel
article.articleSummary: Rising dengue fever risk in Kelapa Dua Wetan Urban Village (Kelurahan Kelapa Dua Wetan), Ciracas District, East Jakarta, as local authorities and 10 PPSU workers conduct routine drainage-channel cleanings to reduce flood and dengue transmission. The focus area is RT 05/RW 02, with manual cleaning chosen due to narrow alleys that prevent heavy equipment access. Each session targets about 50 meters of channel, and crews typically remove around 50 sacks of sediment and debris per action. Cleanings occur on Tuesdays and Fridays, with continuation if the drainage is not fully cleared. Community education urged to improve environmental hygiene and avoid littering to curb dengue spread. As of Oct 1, 2026, the area is experiencing increasing dengue cases. (Published Oct 1, 2026)

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防のため、東ジャカルタ・クラパ・ドゥア・ウェタン地区で排水路の一斉清掃を実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域住民による日常的な排水路清掃という予防活動の報道であり、重症度や国際的拡大等の懸念要素は見られず、通常のデング熱対策の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱症例数の具体的な規模や重症度に関するデータが記事内に無く、地域の日常的な防疫活動の報道に留まる。インドネシアでは季節的にデング熱が流行することが多く、特異な状況とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : les épidémiologistes appelés à intégrer les équipes de riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo Province: Epidemiologists Called to Join the Response Teams - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts call to strengthen response teams. In Kisangani on Oct 1, 2026, the president of the Provincial Assembly urged integrating epidemiology and infectiology specialists as full members of Ebola response teams in northern DRC, to help cut transmission as movement of people and goods links multiple provinces. Dr. Mateus Kanga stressed that Tshopo should act as a sanitary shield, with support from national authorities, health services, partners, and the population. He also challenged the provincial Health Minister over response management and called for investigations to establish accountability for past shortcomings. The appeal underlines an ongoing effort to reinforce Ebola containment amid broader provincial and national concerns about the outbreak and its management.

triage.headline_ja: トショ州のエボラ出血熱：疫学専門家に対応チームへの参加呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国トショ州でエボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクが報告されており、複数州にまたがる人の移動による感染拡大懸念と対応体制強化の必要性が指摘されているため。
triage.notes: エボラはDRCで既知の疾患だが、複数州にまたがる感染拡大リスクと対応体制の課題（説明責任追及の呼びかけ）が指摘されており、フルリスク評価が妥当。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Face à la surpopulation carcérale, la tuberculose gagne du terrain à la prison centrale de Mbuji-Mayi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Faced with prison overcrowding, tuberculosis is gaining ground at the Mbuji-Mayi Central Prison.
article.articleSummary: In DR Congo's Mbuji-Mayi Central Prison, overcrowding (450 inmates, designed for 150) is fueling tuberculosis transmission. A new TB case was identified in last week's screening by the Provincial TB Control Coordination, bringing the number of inmates with TB to over 80. Poor nutrition, crowding, and inadequate ventilation contribute to rapid spread in confined cells where spaces house more than 100 inmates; inmates sleep on the floor and sanitation is insufficient. The prison infirmary is under-equipped with limited medications. Health authorities recommend mass, systematic screening of detainees and staff and immediate isolation of confirmed cases to curb transmission. The situation underscores persistent health and overcrowding challenges within DR Congo's prison system.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: 刑務所の過密化により、ムブジマイ中央刑務所で結核が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での結核症例増加（80名超）は深刻だが、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められず、局所的な公衆衛生課題として続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 結核はDRCで既知の疾患であり、今回の報道は刑務所の過密・衛生状態悪化による院内感染拡大を示すもの。国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しないが、刑務所内の管理体制と外部支援の必要性が示唆されるため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Служител на "Лекари без граници" с ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Doctors Without Borders staff member with Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member tested positive for Ebola virus disease while on assignment to control the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient was safely evacuated under strict medical protocols and will be admitted to a specialized facility in the Netherlands, with coordination between Dutch and DRC health authorities. The outbreak in DRC now includes 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths, the largest and deadliest in the country’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 period. As of June, the WHO reported 75 health workers infected in DRC, 17 fatalities. Globally, the crisis ranks only behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which affected more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The incident underscores ongoing transmission risk despite protective measures and highlights international cooperation in patient management and containment.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団の職員がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱に感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8067症例、3901死亡）に加え、MSF職員の感染・国際搬送という国際的拡大事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は医療対応の一環であり、発生国としてはDRCのみを該当とした。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba tem 14 mortes por dengue e mais de 7,2 mil casos prováveis da doença em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba has 14 dengue deaths and more than 7,200 probable dengue cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paraíba state, Brazil reports 14 dengue deaths in 2026 and 7,296 probable dengue cases as of September 30, a 55.2% increase from 2025. Dengue is the leading arboviral disease this year. Fatalities occurred in Alagoa Nova, Bayeux, Brejo do Cruz, Campina Grande (two), Camalaú, Guarabira, João Pessoa, Monteiro, São Bento (four), and Sumé. Dengue serotype 3 is currently the most prevalent; serotypes 1, 2 and 3 are circulating. In João Pessoa, environmental surveillance teams visit homes to identify and remove Aedes aegypti breeding sites, and traps are installed at strategic points to disseminate larvicide. Residents are advised to periodically inspect properties for water-accumulation sites to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年にデング熱による死亡14人、推定症例7,200件以上
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パライバ州でのデング熱症例増加（前年比55.2%増）と14人の死亡が報告されているが、デング熱は同地域で季節性・風土病的に発生しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、通常の公衆衛生サーベイランス報告の範囲内と考えられるため、続報の注視対象とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病的な季節性疾患であり、血清型3の優勢化と症例増加が報告されているものの、現時点では地域の通常の公衆衛生対応（媒介蚊対策・サーベイランス）の範囲内と判断される。継続的な症例数・死亡者数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Ubangi : deux cas d'Ebola confirmés sur fond de grève des médecins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sud-Ubangi: two confirmed Ebola cases amid a doctors' strike.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in Sud-Ubangi province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, announced by the Provincial Division of Health (DPS) at its eighth epidemiological update. Declared on 10 September, the outbreak remains centered in the Gbulu health zone, identified as the epicenter. Response measures include case detection and isolation, contact tracing, and strengthened surveillance. Meanwhile, a doctors' strike continues, with physicians demanding listing on the DPS/Sud-Ubangi register. Doctor Grâce Ngilase reiterates the demand in a Gemena community radio interview. The DPS rejects the accusations, stating the administrative file is not under its remit. Authorities persist with the Ebola response in Gbulu, even as the physicians’ protest sustains concerns about the health sector in Sud-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: 南ウバンギ州：医師ストライキの最中にエボラ出血熱の2症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象であり、DRCで既に発生宣言された流行の継続報告であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 医師のストライキが対応能力に影響を及ぼす可能性があり、流行対応の持続性にリスクを与えている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : fermetures préventives d'une école et d'un hôpital - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Preventive closures of a school and a hospital - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, in the Tshopo Province of northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is implementing preventive closures of a hospital and a kindergarten amid Ebola virus disease concerns. The hospital DH Kis is designated as an epicenter after more than a dozen staff members tested positive and more than 123 contacts were identified. The nearby La Borne kindergarten was closed for 21 days following a confirmed Ebola case among a teacher, who is married to a DH Kis health worker diagnosed positive. Preventive disinfection will be carried out before activities resume. Contacts placed under observation for up to 21 days, during which they are monitored for symptoms; those without symptoms at the end may be released. Governor Paulin Lendongolia underscored these actions are precautionary measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：学校と病院の予防的閉鎖 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の院内感染クラスターが発生し、医療従事者十数名が陽性、123人以上の接触者が確認されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 病院内クラスターであり、医療従事者感染と接触者数の多さから地域拡大リスクが高い。続報でのWHO/国際対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt wordt met speciaal vliegtuig naar Nederland gebracht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient flown to the Netherlands by a special plane.
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, a patient infected with the Ebola virus was flown to the Netherlands by a dedicated aircraft and is being admitted to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in isolated conditions. The patient, a healthcare worker who contracted Ebola while serving in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is confirmed by Médecins Sans Frontières as an MSF staff member. LUMC will receive the patient directly and keep them in strict isolation in a specialized facility; gender and exact arrival time are not disclosed for privacy. The transfer followed standard precautions, and the hospital says the containment requires no additional measures for other patients or visitors. The hospital emphasizes preparedness to manage severe infectious diseases and notes there is no impact on other patients; the case is imported to the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が特別機でオランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染したエボラ患者が国際医療搬送によりオランダへ運ばれたことは、DRCでのエボラ流行継続と国際的拡大の兆候を示しており、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国でMSFスタッフとして勤務中に感染し、オランダ（対象国外）の医療機関へ搬送された。感染発生地はDRCであり、同国で継続中のエボラ流行の一端を示す事例として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MSF staff member tests positive for Ebola in Congo, aid organization says
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 8,067 with 3,901 deaths, as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak becomes the country’s largest and deadliest on record. A Médecins Sans Frontières staff member involved in the Ebola response tested positive for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease and is being evacuated under strict medical protocol to the Netherlands for care, in coordination with DRC health authorities. MSF notes protective measures are in place but exposure risk cannot be eliminated. The outbreak is ongoing across Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé provinces. The Bundibugyo strain underpins the surge, placing Congo behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak in scale (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). MSF continues its response across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでMSFスタッフがエボラ陽性反応、国際援助団体が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、MSFスタッフの感染・国際搬送という国際的拡大のリスクも顕在化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダ・アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事内容は患者搬送先・近隣国としての言及に留まり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Funcionário do MSF testa positivo para Ebola no Congo, diz organização humanitária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF staff member tests positive for Ebola in Congo, humanitarian organization says.
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member tested positive for Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and will be evacuated to the Netherlands under strict medical protocols for transfer to a designated hospital there. The case occurs amid the largest and most deadly Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with official figures exceeding 8,000 confirmed cases and about 3,900 deaths; the latest health institute report cites 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé provinces. The Bundibugyo outbreak is the biggest in Congo’s history, surpassing 2018–2020, and is second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic in scale. MSF notes that despite providing the highest protection levels to teams, no-zero risk of exposure remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでMSFスタッフがエボラ陽性、人道支援団体が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8,000例超・死亡3,900例超）が継続中であり、MSFスタッフの感染とオランダへの緊急搬送という国際的拡大事例が発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行とMSFスタッフの感染・オランダへの国際搬送を主題としている。オランダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。渡航・貿易制限については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Save the Children: Siete niños mueren de ébola a diario en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Save the Children: Seven children die of Ebola every day in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Seven children die of Ebola daily in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Save the Children warns, citing health ministry data: 961 child deaths from Ebola, 623 under five. Global case fatality is 48.4%, rising to 61% for ages 0–4. Since the outbreak was officially declared in eastern DRC on May 15, at least 2,071 minors have been infected, and 180 have lost both parents or primary caregivers. As of September 29, the epidemic totals 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths; 2,212 patients have recovered and 851 are hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally. The epidemic has also reached Uganda, where the WHO declared the end of the outbreak there on Aug 26 after 20 confirmed infections, including 15 imported from the DRC, with two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: セーブ・ザ・チルドレン：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより毎日7人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行が継続中で、8,224症例・3,982死亡、7州63保健地域に拡大しウガンダにも越境しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境事例は報告されているが、WHOは8月26日にウガンダでの流行終息を宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行は依然拡大中で致死率48.4%（5歳未満61%）と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh dại: Bị chó mèo cắn, cần làm gì ngay?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies: What should you do immediately if bitten by a dog or a cat?
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Vietnam: nationwide 54 rabies deaths in 2026 across 20 provinces; Hanoi reports no human rabies since 2023, though dog rabies outbreaks persist. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, but timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) can prevent infection. From 2023–2025, Hanoi had 14 dog rabies outbreaks in 8 wards; in 2026, 8 outbreaks in 6 communes, with 10 people bitten and 16 exposed to dog saliva requiring PEP; all exposures received full prophylaxis. By August 2026, Hanoi vaccination centers have vaccinated over 36,000 people. Immediate post-exposure management is critical: wash the wound with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes, then disinfect and seek medical assessment; do not delay to observe the animal or treat at home. WHO guidance: PEP includes wound care, vaccination, and Rabies Immunoglobulin (RIG) when indicated; RIG provides immediate antibodies, vaccination builds active immunity. Control relies on dog vaccination, surveillance, and rapid outbreak response to achieve zero dog-mediated transmission by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病：犬や猫に噛まれたら、すぐに何をすべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は毎年発生する既知の風土病であり、本記事は一般向けの予防啓発情報である。新規の異常な発生や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病予防に関する公衆衛生啓発記事であり、ハノイでは2023年以降ヒトの狂犬病死亡例はない。犬媒介の動物流行は継続しているが、全国的な既存対策（PEP、ワクチン接種）が機能しており、2030年までのゼロ狂犬病目標に向けた取り組みの一環として報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov Bengkulu: Pulau Enggano pertahankan status bebas rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkulu Provincial Government: Enggano Island Maintains Rabies-Free Status
article.articleSummary: Enggano Island, the outermost Indonesian territory in Bengkulu Province, remains rabies-free based on animal health surveillance. Located about 90 nautical miles from Bengkulu city, the island’s rabies-free status is maintained through ongoing vaccination and preventive measures, especially in high-risk areas with rabies-susceptible animals. The province reports a vaccine stock of around 4,350 doses, sourced 4,000 doses from the national APBN and 2,000 doses from the provincial APBD to support vaccination in priority zones, though figures appear variably stated. Vaccination and health monitoring continue to safeguard both animal and human health. Access to Enggano is via ferry (roughly 12 hours, longer in bad weather) or limited air service twice weekly, weather permitting, underscoring logistical considerations for sustaining rabies-free status.

triage.headline_ja: ブンクル州政府:エンガノ島、狂犬病フリーの状況を維持
triage.triage_reason: 記事は狂犬病フリー状態の維持を報じるものであり、実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の脅威は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な狂犬病対策とフリー状態維持の報告であり、新規感染事例の発生は記載されていないため対象国リストに該当する発生イベントなし。

article.articleHeadline: " Là où l'humanité est en péril, l'unité s'impose " : les confessions religieuses se mobilisent pour appuyer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where humanity is in peril, unity must prevail: religious denominations mobilize to support the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, hosts a Caritas Congo–organized roundtable on October 1, 2026 to mobilize religious denominations in response to the 17th Ebola outbreak declared May 15, 2026. With ongoing transmission, misinformation, stigma, community resistance, and access challenges amid insecurity, religious leaders aim to strengthen prevention, awareness, and psychosocial support through closer community engagement. Monseigneur Donatien Nshole, secretary-general of CENCO, argues that an effective response cannot rest on health institutions alone and must be holistic, coordinated, and participative, leveraging churches, schools, faith-based health facilities, and community networks to reach broad populations and counter rumors. The roundtable seeks strategic guidance, identification of religious-sector challenges, and the development of a joint roadmap detailing actions, responsibilities, timelines, and monitoring mechanisms. Caritas Congo’s Edouard Makimba welcomes the diverse participation as a sign of unified mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: 「人類が危機に瀕するところ、団結が必要だ」：宗教団体がエボラ対応支援のために結集
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の第17次エボラ流行に関する内容であり、エボラは重篤な感染症でIHR基準に複数該当するため、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規情報ではなく、宗教団体による対応支援の動員に関する内容。既存の第17次エボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言）の継続状況を示す続報として、既存イベントのRRA更新対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Super Flu di Sidoarjo Melonjak, RSU Assakinah Medika Sulap Ruang Manajemen Jadi Ruang Rawat Darurat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super Flu cases in Sidoarjo surge as Assakinah Medika General Hospital transforms the management room into an emergency ward.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (often called super flu) cases at RSU Assakinah Medika, Sukodono, Sidoarjo, East Java, have surged over three weeks, filling all beds (capacity 110, expanded to 120 by converting the management room into an emergency ward). About 80% of inpatients exhibit influenza-like illness. Activity is seen across East Java, with increases in Surabaya and Sidoarjo since early September; some Surabaya hospitals conducting swab tests have reported positive influenza. Pediatric patients are particularly vulnerable due to immature immunity and smaller body size, though adults can be affected. Typical symptoms include dry cough, runny nose, and high fever (39-40°C) during the first three days, plus malaise; risk of pneumonia and respiratory distress if not managed. Parents should monitor dehydration signs and seek care for persistent fever or breathing difficulties. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, vaccination, and healthy living; emphasis on annual influenza vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョでスーパーフル症例が急増、アサキナ・メディカ総合病院は管理室を救急病棟に転用
triage.triage_reason: 東ジャワ地域でインフルエンザA様症例が急増し病床逼迫が生じているが、病原体の異常性や国際的拡大の根拠は乏しく、季節性インフルエンザの可能性が高いため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 「スーパーフル」という呼称が用いられているが、記事内容はインフルエンザA（季節性インフル様疾患）の急増であり、新型・異常株との明確な記載はない。病床逼迫や小児への影響が強調されており、現地医療体制への負荷が懸念される。続報でウイルス株特定や重症度データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Ärzte ohne Grenzen fliegt Ebolainfizierte Person aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Doctors Without Borders airlift an Ebola-infected person.
article.articleSummary: MSF employee deployed in Ebola relief in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola and was evacuated under strict precautions to a hospital in the Netherlands. The organization did not disclose gender or nationality to protect confidentiality. All staff are trained and equipped with protective materials, but residual risk remains. The DRC outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history, with about 8,000 known cases and around 4,000 deaths; experts warn the true toll is likely higher in a conflict region with hundreds of thousands displaced, hindering response efforts. Globally, this outbreak ranks as the second-worst Ebola wave after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団がエボラ感染者を国外搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が同国史上最大・最悪規模（約8000症例、4000死亡）であり、国際搬送事例も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は医療後送であり発生国ではないため除外。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年流行の歴史的言及であり、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Arztpersonal in DR Kongo an Ebola erkrankt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical staff in the Democratic Republic of the Congo contract Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was evacuated to a hospital in the Netherlands under strict safety precautions, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) reported. Medical confidentiality prevented disclosure of the patient’s gender or nationality. The Congo is experiencing the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded, with approximately 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths across seven provinces of the country, the second-largest in Africa. MSF noted that all healthcare workers involved are trained and equipped with protective gear, but a residual risk remains. The situation underscores the severity of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the ongoing challenges in controlling transmission, as international health authorities maintain vigilance against further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で医療スタッフがエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、国際搬送事例も発生していることから、国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は医療対応の一環であり、オランダ国内での発生ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders to evacuate worker who has contracted Ebola
article.articleSummary: An MSF worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo contracted Ebola and will be flown to a hospital in the Netherlands under strict safety precautions. MSF declined to disclose the worker’s gender or nationality for medical confidentiality, stating that all professionals are trained and equipped with protective materials, though residual risk remains. The DRC is currently experiencing the largest Ebola outbreak on record, with around 8,000 reported cases and about 4,000 deaths; experts believe the true number of unreported cases is significantly higher. The outbreak persists in a conflict-torn region with hundreds of thousands displaced, complicating the implementation of control measures. The evacuation underscores ongoing transmission risk and the need for robust safety protocols for aid workers.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、エボラ出血熱に感染した職員を国外退避させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際機関職員の感染・国外搬送という国際的拡大リスクが明確なため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: オランダは感染者の搬送先であり、流行の発生地ではないため対象国リストに該当せず除外。DRCでの紛争による避難民多数が感染対策を複雑化させている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго четыре человека умерли после употребления мяса обезьяны
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, four people died after consuming monkey meat.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, four residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo died within 24 hours after consuming monkey meat in Munsanga, a village in the eastern DR Congo. The meal occurred on September 26; several others who shared the game meals developed severe gastrointestinal symptoms and are under medical observation. Health authorities are still trying to establish the exact poison or disease causing the deaths, with laboratory confirmation not reported in the article. The episode follows a 2024 ban by the DRC Ministry of Health on monkey meat amid the spread of monkeypox, reflecting ongoing public health concerns about wild game consumption. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. The incident highlights acute foodborne risk and the need for rapid surveillance in eastern DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、サル肉を食べた後に4人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で原因不明の急死4例とGI症状の集団発生があり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」及び「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではMpoxとの関連は確認されておらず、死因は未特定（食中毒・中毒・感染症のいずれか不明）。Bluedotの疾患タグ付け（Mpox）は2024年のサル肉禁止令の文脈的言及に基づくものであり、実際の死因とは直接関連していない可能性が高い。続報でラボ確認結果を待つ必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Сотрудник "Врачей без границ" заразился Эболой в ДР Конго - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A staff member of Doctors Without Borders contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus was laboratory-confirmed in a Doctors Without Borders staff member working in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The worker, whose name, health status, and citizenship were not disclosed, was evacuated to the Netherlands under medical protocol. The outbreak areas include Ituri, North Kivu, Chopo, and Haut-Uele provinces, with total cases reaching 8,116 and deaths 3,924 across seven of the DRC’s 26 provinces. MSF personnel continue responding to the surge of EVD. Ebola is highly infectious with high mortality; primary fatal outcomes involve massive hemorrhage, toxemia, hypovolemia, and septic shock. Background notes reference the virus’s first identification in 1976 near the Ebola River (Sudan and DRC) and the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 28,000 cases, ~11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団のスタッフがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（8,116症例、3,924死亡）があり、国際援助者の感染・国外（オランダ）への医療搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダは感染したMSFスタッフの搬送先であり発生地ではないため除外。スーダンは歴史的背景（1976年の初発見地）としての言及であり現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため除外。アンゴラへの言及はサマリー上見られず除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les violences entravent la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Violence hampers the Ebola response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Violence in Ituri's Djugu territory, Democratic Republic of Congo, is hampering the Ebola response as more than 5,000 people have fled, including over 3,000 to Rhoe displacement site. Four killed and seven wounded in armed clashes around Rhoe; Blukwa homes burned. OCHA notes renewed fighting after months of calm, with women and children disproportionately affected. An Ebola transit center burned at Kigonze camp, leaving services disrupted and raising security concerns for health facilities in Fataki, Drodro, and Lita. Humanitarian movements are suspended; sample transport from Fataki to Bunia and patient transfers from Gina to Fataki have been impeded. RN27 access is threatened, complicating aid delivery. In North Kivu, two Ebola responders were killed in Lubero on Sept 27–28; Masisi displacement >24,000 since mid-September. As of Sept 29, WHO reports 3,982 Ebola deaths and 8,224+ cases across seven provinces and 63 health zones. OCHA appeals for civilian protection and unimpeded access.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：イツリ州でのエボラ対応、暴力により妨害される
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ流行（累計死者3,982人、症例8,224人以上、7州63保健区域）が武装勢力の暴力により対応が妨げられており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRomania/Clujが含まれるが記事主題と無関係なBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。既存の大規模エボラ流行に加え、武装勢力による暴力でワクチン接種・検体輸送・患者搬送・対応要員の安全が脅かされており、流行制御の悪化と拡大リスクが高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: SP chega a 40 casos confirmados de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 40 confirmed measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state reports 40 confirmed measles cases in 2026, with three new diagnoses: two men aged 18 and 21 and a 1-year-old infant, all linked to transmission chains monitored since June. No deaths. Of the total, 36 cases are in the city of São Paulo, two in São Bernardo do Campo, one in Guarulhos, and one in Santo André. Approximately 60% are under 2 years old, and 30 of the 40 patients were unvaccinated or had incomplete vaccination. Despite the uptick, the Epidemiological Surveillance Center (CVE) notes a deceleration in circulation. Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo are nearing the end of transmission chains (90 days without new records). Vaccination remains free across 645 municipalities via the triple (MMR) and tetraviral vaccines; standard schedule includes doses at 12 and 15 months, with a zero-dose for infants 6–11 months in areas with active transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹確定症例が40件に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の感染拡大は特定の伝播チェーンに限定され、死亡例もなく収束傾向にあるが、未接種者を中心に感染が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州内の複数自治体（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、グアルーリョス、サント・アンドレ）で症例が確認されているが、一部地域では90日間新規症例なしで伝播終息に近づいている。未接種・接種不完全者が全体の75%を占める点が継続的リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Rahul Gandhi meets tribals in MP after 32 die of diseases
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 1, 2026, Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh reports 32 tribal child deaths over the past few months from suspected infectious diseases, with malaria, measles, malnutrition and related complications cited as factors. Victims primarily come from Baiga-dominated villages in Birsa and Baihar blocks. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi visited Jagla and Mate villages, meeting families and about 1,200 locals, criticizing the BJP government for inadequate healthcare, education and employment support, and saying the issue would be raised in Parliament. He urged full compensation for families awaiting aid and called for restoring healthcare and education facilities, reviving MGNREGA (Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission-Gramin), and implementing the Forest Rights Act to grant land rights. The Madhya Pradesh High Court has sought the state’s response to a petition about the deaths; no lab-confirmed outbreak details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ラーフル・ガンディー氏、32人が疾病で死亡したマディヤ・プラデーシュ州の部族民と面会
triage.triage_reason: 部族居住地域で32人の子供が麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調関連で死亡し、政治問題化（州高裁審理、野党党首の現地訪問）しており、公衆衛生上の深刻さと社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 検査確定情報（ラボ確定診断）が示されておらず、死亡原因の内訳（麻疹/マラリア/栄養失調の比率）も不明。政治的注目度は高いが、公衆衛生当局による正式な疫学調査結果の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba tem 14 mortes por dengue e mais de 7,2 mil casos prováveis da doença em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records 14 dengue deaths and more than 7,200 probable dengue cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paraíba, Brazil reports 14 dengue deaths in 2026, up 55.2% from 2025, with 7,296 probable dengue cases through September 30. Dengue remains the state’s leading arboviral disease this year. Confirmed deaths occurred in Alagoa Nova, Bayeux, Brejo do Cruz, Campina Grande (2), Camalaú, Guarabira, João Pessoa, Monteiro, São Bento (4), and Sumé. Dengue serotype 3 is currently the most prevalent; serotypes 1, 2 and 3 are circulating. Control focuses on elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites through community participation, especially around homes and recyclable-material storage. In João Pessoa, Environmental Surveillance teams visit properties to identify breeding sites and trigger vector-control measures and larviciding, with strategic traps. Residents are advised to inspect properties for standing water, protect drains and plants, use screens, and avoid improper waste disposal. With higher temperatures, ongoing vigilance and periodic removal of water containers are urged; education extends to schools and daycare centers.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年にデング熱による死者14人、疑い症例7,200件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パライバ州における季節性デング熱の年次流行報告で、死亡者数は前年比増加しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、地域の通常対応の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は地域（パライバ州）の年次統計報告。血清型3優勢で複数血清型が共存している点は免疫学的に注視すべきだが、現時点で国際的な懸念材料とはならない。地元環境監視当局による蚊媒介対策（Aedes aegypti駆除）が継続的に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: MSF staff member tests positive for Ebola in Congo, aid organisation says
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where MSF reports a staff member contracted the virus while supporting the outbreak response in Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé provinces. The patient is being evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment and will be cared for in a specialised isolation unit at University Medical Center Leiden, under strict medical protocol. Congo’s Bundibugyo outbreak is the country’s largest and deadliest on record, with confirmed cases reaching 8,067 and deaths 3,901 as of 28 September 2026. The evacuated clinician is an MSF doctor deployed to Congo; MSF notes that extensive protective measures are in place, yet exposure risk cannot be completely eliminated. The incident demonstrates cross-border management of imported cases and ongoing international coordination with health authorities in the DRC and the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでMSFスタッフがエボラ陽性、支援団体が発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大・最も致死的なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中であり、感染した医療従事者がオランダへ国際搬送されるなど、国際的拡大のリスクが現実化している。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は国際対応事例であるが、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。本流行はコンゴ国内が発生地であり、過去最大規模（確定例8,067、死亡3,901）という点で重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Smrti od kolere porasle za 30 %: WHO objavio nove podatke o trima zaraznim bolestima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from cholera rose by 30%: WHO released new data on three infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths rose 30% in 2025, with 451,499 cases and 7,870 deaths in 47 countries. Although cases declined vs 2024, mortality increased, with about 90% of deaths in Angola, Bangladesh, DR Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen. Africa bore the heaviest burden (cases up 34%, deaths up 58% from 2024). Cholera, caused by Vibrio cholerae, spreads via contaminated food or water; rapid dehydration can be fatal, and in-facility case-fatality rates remain under 1% globally but exceed 1% in 12 countries. Vaccines are expanding: production rose from ~30 million (2022) to ~80 million in 2025; the ICG approved 71 million doses in 2025, including 20 million for preventive vaccination resumed in early 2026. In the African meningitis belt (Senegal to Ethiopia), 21,526 suspected meningitis cases and 971 deaths were reported in 2025; MenA vaccination reduced serogroup A cases by >99%, and Niger led a nationwide Men5CV/MMCV campaign. Plague surveillance remains crucial: 3,847 suspected and 423 deaths (≈11% CFR) across 10 countries, led by DR Congo and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: コレラによる死者数が30%増加：WHOが3つの感染症に関する新データを発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOの報告によりコレラ死亡率が世界的に30%増加し、47カ国で深刻な公衆衛生被害が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な影響・国際的拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの世界的な統計報告（コレラ・髄膜炎・ペストの2025年データ）であり、対象国の中ではDRCがコレラ死亡上位国およびペスト流行の主要国として明記されている。マダガスカル、スーダン、アンゴラ、イエメン、エチオピア、セネガル、ニジェール、ナイジェリア、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Early Oxygen-Boosting Enzyme Therapy Shows Promise Against Tuberculous
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis-causing Mycobacterium tuberculosis forms hypoxic granulomas that impede antibiotics. In China, researchers at Chongqing Medical University tested whether locally generating oxygen inside granulomas could alter disease progression, using a murine subcutaneous granuloma model with BCG. Catalase was delivered early (day 6) or late (day 12) after infection; it breaks down hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen. Early catalase reduced hypoxia-inducible factor-1α and VEGF, improved granuloma vasculature and permeability, and decreased collagen and lipid deposition. Lipidomics showed targeted remodeling: downregulation of phosphatidylserine 18:0/18:0 and upregulation of phosphatidylinositol and phosphatidylethanolamine, signaling metabolic shifts within the lesion. Late treatment offered limited benefit, and cobalt chloride-induced hypoxia worsened pathology, reinforcing hypoxia as a driver of persistence. Restoring oxygen may create drug-access windows for anti-tuberculosis therapies.

triage.headline_ja: 初期段階の酸素促進酵素療法、マウスにおける結核性肉芽腫に対する有望性を示す
triage.triage_reason: マウスモデルを用いた基礎研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や流行状況に関する情報はなく、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は基礎医学研究（動物実験）であり、実際のヒト感染事例や公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではないため、地域検証の対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Productores confían en recuperación de la porcicultura pese al impacto de la PPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Producers confident in the recovery of pig farming despite the impact of African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) continues to impact Dominican Republic pig farming, centered in Moca, Espaillat. Authorities aim to control and eradicate ASF rather than coexist with the virus, noting no identified natural reservoirs and that human activity drives transmission. Environmental samples from depopulated farms tested positive for ASF, while veterinary clinic samples were negative. Production has fallen from about 2,000 pigs per week prior to ASF to 700–800 currently, though some producers are repopulating under stricter biosecurity. Farms with high biosecurity have remained disease-free despite surrounding circulation. About 75% of the country’s pork consumption is imported, pressuring the sector to reduce costs and boost efficiency. Brazilian expert Juliana Calveyra highlighted price fluctuations even in well-managed markets, suggesting Dominican producers may need to reform production systems. The II Foro Porcino 2026 in Moca also examined ASF evolution in Spain and the Dominican Republic and broader sanitary trends.

triage.headline_ja: 生産者、アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の影響にもかかわらず養豚業の回復に自信
triage.triage_reason: ドミニカ共和国における動物疾病（ASF）の経済的影響に関する記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはなく、対象国（Brazil等）も記事の主題国ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒトへの感染性はない。記事の主題はドミニカ共和国の養豚業への経済的影響であり、ブラジルは専門家の出身国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。対象国リストにドミニカ共和国は含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'UNICEF appelle à doubler les efforts et à renforcer la protection des enfants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: UNICEF calls for doubling efforts and strengthening the protection of children.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. UNICEF's emergency director Lucia Elmi visited Ituri and discussed with the provincial governor to sustain and intensify the response, reaffirming UNICEF's support both in Bunia and other zones. She called for doubling efforts and strengthening community engagement and child protection during this phase of the response. While acknowledging progress—larger teams and experience—the UNICEF official emphasized ongoing challenges and the need to keep up until zero cases and protection for all children. UNICEF will continue assisting authorities and partners in community outreach, water, sanitation and hygiene, and infection prevention and control, along with preventive measures. The agency also supports the education sector through teacher training and parental awareness, maintaining a presence to bolster response and child protection in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱：UNICEFが対応強化と子どもの保護強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上常に重大・異常とみなされる疾患であり、DRCイトゥリ州での継続的な対応強化要請は国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性を示唆するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数や死亡者数などの定量データを含まず、UNICEFの支援活動に関する内容が中心。エボラという疾患の性質上、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA Meningkat di Jember, Influenza A Belum Terkonfirmasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infections on the Rise in Jember, Influenza A Not Yet Confirmed
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) cases are rising in Jember Regency, East Java, with 246 ISPA cases presenting severe clinical symptoms over the four weeks ending Sept 27, 2026 (weeks 36–38), during the seasonal transitional period. Health authorities note no diagnosed Influenza A cases in Jember, and no rapid tests or PCR have been conducted to confirm Influenza A. Surveillance relies on ISPA and influenza-like illness (ILI) data via the SKDR Early Warning and Response System, managed by the Jember Health Office (Dinkes P2KB). Most severe ISPA cases are treatable at community health centers (puskesmas) or through outpatient care, while a minority require hospitalization. Ongoing monitoring tracks geographic distribution across districts within Jember.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンバルで急性呼吸器感染症（ISPA）の症例が増加、インフルエンザAは未確認
triage.triage_reason: ISPA症例の増加が報告されているが、インフルエンザA確定診断はなく検査も未実施であり、情報不足のため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAは未確認であり、現時点ではISPA（急性呼吸器感染症）の季節的増加として地元保健当局がサーベイランスを継続している段階。病原体特定のための検査結果など続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Com 3 novos casos de sarampo em São Paulo, estado vai a 40 - 01/10/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 3 new measles cases in São Paulo, the state reaches 40 - 01/10/2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, São Paulo state reports 40 measles cases with no deaths; three new infections in the capital—two men aged 18 and 21 and a 1-year-old infant—linked to transmission chains tracked since June. In 2025, two cases occurred in the state. Of the 40, 36 are in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Santo André, and 1 in Guarulhos. Measles is highly contagious and spread via airborne transmission; symptoms include high fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a rash appearing 7–14 days post-exposure. About 60% of cases affect children under two. Thirty of 40 cases are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated; the 21-year-old and infant have one dose, the 18-year-old is not immunized. Over 1,700 suspected cases have been discarded. Vaccination coverage rose in 2026 to first dose 93.24% and second dose 78.37% by July, with a 95% target; 2.5+ million doses were administered during September’s Multivaccination Campaign. Transmission chains in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo may end after 90 days without linked cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹新規3例、累計40例に - 2026年10月1日
triage.triage_reason: 2025年は州内2例のみだったが2026年に40例へ急増し、未接種者を中心に6月から続く伝播チェーンが継続中であり、WPRO基準（異常性・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 死亡例はなく重症度は低いが、未接種者を中心とした感染拡大が継続しており、ワクチン接種率向上（1回目93.24%、2回目78.37%）とキャンペーン実施など国内対応は進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: SP chega a 40 casos de sarampo em 2026; três são na mesma região | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 40 measles cases in 2026; three are in the same region | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-01, São Paulo state reports 40 confirmed measles cases in 2026, with three new infections on 2026-09-28: two men (ages 21 and 18) and a 1-year-old girl, all from the capital. They belong to transmission chains identified since June. A first chain linked to two imported cases (March–April) has closed after 12 weeks without new linked cases; other chains from June–August remain under 90-day surveillance to interrupt transmission. Of 40 cases, 30 occurred in unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated individuals; among the three new cases, two have one vaccine dose and one is unvaccinated. The capital accounts for 36 cases; São Bernardo do Campo has 2; Guarulhos and Santo André have 1 each. No deaths reported. Lab confirmation includes Instituto Adolfo Lutz analyses and Fiocruz-supported genotype sequencing. Vaccination coverage rose to 93.24% (first dose) and 78.37% (second dose); September multivaccination drive delivered >2.5 million doses. Brazil maintains endemic measles elimination; PAHO classifies Brazil/São Paulo as transmission-limited with identified chains.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹症例が40件に到達；うち3件は同一地域で発生
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例なく重症度は低いが、未接種者を中心に複数の伝播チェーンが継続監視下にあり、流行の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹排除国としての地位を維持しており、PAHOも伝播制限状態と分類。ワクチン接種率上昇（1回目93.24%、2回目78.37%）や大規模接種キャンペーンなど対応は進行中で、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود: إصابة أحد موظفينا في الكونغو بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: A member of our staff in Congo infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: MSF confirms a staff member in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, amid ongoing outbreak response efforts. The infected worker is being evacuated safely under strict medical protocols and in coordination with health authorities in the DRC and the Netherlands, to a hospital prepared for such cases. Government data indicate the Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases for the first time, with the latest public-health report listing about 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths. This incident underscores continued transmission within Congo and the ongoing need for containment, surveillance, and healthcare capacity as MSF and partners maintain their response operations in affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団:コンゴの職員1名がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクが8,000症例を超え致死率も高く、国際機関職員の感染・国際搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: オランダは感染者の搬送先として言及されているのみで、発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のため、オランダはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Sete crianças morreram, em média, todos os dias na RDCongo desde maio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Seven children died on average every day in the DRC since May.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has persisted since May. Save the Children reports an average of seven child deaths per day: since May 15, at least 2,071 children under 18 infected and 961 killed (0–4 years CFR 61%, higher than the overall 48%). By Sept 29, the outbreak totaled 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths, with 2,212 recoveries and 851 in hospital or isolation. The crisis affects 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. About 81.5% of recent deaths occurred in communities, not treatment centers, underscoring need for community engagement. At least 180 children have lost both parents. Cross-border spread reached Uganda, which reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths; the current outbreak is the second deadliest in history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：5月以降、コンゴ民主共和国で平均して毎日7人の子供が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認された大規模エボラアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。本件は史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行とされ、8,224人の確定症例、3,982人死亡（9月29日時点）と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kuningan memperkuat "surveilans" antisipasi potensi Ispa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kuningan Health Office Strengthens 'Surveillance' to Anticipate Potential Acute Respiratory Infections.
article.articleSummary: Kuningan, West Java, Indonesia — The Kuningan Health Office (Dinkes) is strengthening surveillance for acute respiratory infections (ARIs) at health facilities to anticipate rising visits at RSUD 45 Kuningan. Dinkes head Edi Martono said monitoring through surveillance and reports will detect ARI trends and flag clusters in schools and pesantren, with field investigations and reporting between puskesmas, hospitals, and Dinkes to prevent data mixing. In September 2026, RSUD 45 Kuningan reported increases: inpatient admissions up about 21%, outpatient visits nearly 40%, and department visits over 60%. By Sept 28, outpatient visits neared 7,000 and ED visits exceeded 2,000. While many ARI presentations are due to various causes, including influenza-like illness, flu, sore throat, and tonsillitis, pediatric patient load is noted. The hospital added pediatric beds within its 204-bed capacity and coordinates with surrounding referral hospitals if capacity is reached. Laboratory confirmation is needed to attribute cases to Influenza A.

triage.headline_ja: クニンガン保健局、急性呼吸器感染症(ISPA)の潜在的増加に備え、サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 急性呼吸器感染症の受診数増加が報告され当局がサーベイランスを強化しているが、病原体はラボ確認待ちで特定されておらず、重症度や国際的拡大の情報も不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ARI/ISPA症例の増加は報告されているが、インフルエンザA型への帰属はラボ確認待ちであり、確定診断情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat, Internis ITS: Jangan Asal Konsumsi Antibiotik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the Rise, ITS Internist: Do Not Take Antibiotics Indiscriminately.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Indonesia, with ITS internist Dr. Edwin Nugroho Njoto warning against indiscriminate antibiotic use. The virus mutates readily and spreads via respiratory droplets, with weather influencing seasonal surges. Symptoms include runny nose, cough, fever, and sore throat; more severe signs include reduced appetite and shortness of breath, especially in the elderly, children, pregnant women, and people with diabetes or kidney disease. Antibiotics are ineffective against influenza and should not be routinely prescribed; they may be considered only for suspected secondary bacterial infections. Preventive measures include adequate rest, fluids, nutritious food, exercise, hand hygiene, masking when outdoors, proper cough etiquette, and annual influenza vaccination. A September 2026 influenza positivity rate of 56% is noted, with a projection for decline by year-end; no specific case counts or fatalities are reported, but the surge is framed as a seasonal outbreak, with ITS cited as a local reference.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが増加、ITSの内科医「むやみに抗生物質を服用しないように」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、重症例や死亡の報告もなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも強く該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの陽性率上昇（56%）が言及されているが、具体的な症例数や死亡者数は報告されておらず、通常の季節性流行として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new measles cases; the total reaches 40 this year.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, São Paulo State Health Secretariat reports four new measles cases, bringing the annual total to 40. Three infections are in the capital (two men aged 18 and 21, and a 1-year-old infant). The updated tally shows 36 cases in São Paulo city, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one case in Guarulhos and Santo André. Transmission chains identified since June are being monitored, with a trend toward reduced transmission and efforts to end chains in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo. Of the 40 cases this year, 30 involved individuals with no vaccination history or incomplete immunization. Vaccination remains free via the SUS with the MMR vaccine, offered at Basic Health Units across 645 municipalities. Target groups: 12 months and 15 months for children; ages 15 months–29 years two doses; 30–59 years at least one dose; health workers two doses; dose zero for 6–11 months in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo for contacts (not a substitute for routine doses).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹の新規症例3件、今年の累計が40件に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹の限定的な感染連鎖が継続しているが、規模は小さく減少傾向にあり、未接種者が中心であるため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むほどの国際拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: サンパウロ市・近郊で6月以降の感染連鎖が特定されており、ワクチン未接種者を中心に拡大しているが、減少傾向にあり当局が対応中。ワクチン接種体制（SUS）が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود": إصابة أحد موظفينا في الكونغو الديمقراطية بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: One of our staff contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains an active outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths reported by the Public Health Institute—the first time cases exceed 8,000 since the outbreak began. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) announced that a staff member contracted Bundibugyo Ebola while aiding containment efforts and is being evacuated safely to the Netherlands under strict medical protocol, with a hospital prepared to receive them. The evacuation is coordinated with health authorities in both the DRC and the Netherlands. The latest figures underscore the ongoing, high-magnitude outbreak in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：当団体職員1名がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は8,067例・死亡3,901例に達し過去最大規模となっており、国際機関職員の感染・国際搬送も発生していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: オランダは患者搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。感染者数・死者数が過去最多を更新しており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: un membre de Médecins sans frontières infecté par Ebola évacué vers les Pays-Bas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: an MSF staff member infected with Ebola evacuated to the Netherlands.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, MSF reports a staff member infected with Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been evacuated to the Netherlands. Congolese authorities authorized the move at the NGO’s request, transferring directly from Beni on a special flight without a Kinshasa stop. Leiden University Medical Center is preparing a high-level isolation unit to receive the patient, with MSF coordinating a strict medical protocol with national health authorities. The minister recalled that two Americans were evacuated from Bunia to Berlin at the outset of the outbreak; frontline infections have since declined, but exposure risk remains. The patient had not yet been vaccinated; vaccination is being prepared in Beni, with teams deployed in Ituri with MSF support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団（MSF）のスタッフがエボラウイルス感染により、オランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ流行に関連し、感染したMSFスタッフが国際的に医療搬送された事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はベニからオランダへ特別便で搬送され、ライデン大学医療センターで高度隔離治療を受ける予定。過去にも米国人2名がブニアからベルリンへ搬送された事例あり。ワクチン未接種の状態での感染であり、現地では引き続き曝露リスクが残存している。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱進入社區？彰化市2病例相隔僅110公尺 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever enters the community? Two cases in Changhua City are only 110 meters apart - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue cases in Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan, are 110 meters apart. The latest case is a man in his 60s diagnosed with dengue fever type 1, currently hospitalized with fever, diarrhea and malaise; he has no overseas travel during incubation, and close contacts are asymptomatic. His residence lies about 110 meters from the Sept 18 first local case, with no overlapping activity history; genome sequencing will determine linkage, suggesting a community cluster—the county's second local transmission this year. An earlier August case, a Vietnam-returned visitor, yielded the same virus strain by sequencing, implying surrounding vectors remain. Eight private land sites in Dongxingli and Minquanli are targeted for cleanup; noncompliance may trigger penalties. A local dengue screening site opens Oct 2: 9:00–15:30 at the county government hall atrium, and 17:00–20:00 near 39 Dongmin Street. Residents urged to remove standing water and seek care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱が地域社会に浸透？彰化市の2症例はわずか110メートルの距離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化市で地域内感染によるデング熱クラスターが形成されつつあるが、症例数は少なく地元保健当局が対応中であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。ベトナムは8月症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、今回の発生地ではないため除外。台湾彰化県で地域内伝播によるデング熱クラスターが拡大しており、周辺に媒介蚊が残存している可能性が指摘されているが、県レベルでの対応（スクリーニング、清掃活動）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Pawai News: पवई अस्पताल में 100 टीबी मरीजों को पोषण किट बांटी, कोनी में 113 पशुओं का उपचार | Nutrition kits distributed to 100 TB patients at Powai Hospital; 113 animals treated in Koni.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Powai News: Nutrition kits distributed to 100 TB patients at Powai Hospital; 113 animals treated in Koni.
article.articleSummary: Under corporate social responsibility, JK Cement conducted health, livestock, and cleanliness initiatives in Powai and Konni. At Powai Government Hospital, 100 tuberculosis patients received nutrition kits to support treatment and nutrition; awareness on TB prevention, regular treatment, and nutrition emphasized. In Konni village, an animal health camp treated 113 livestock with tick control and deworming medicines; 25 barren animals treated; 46 newborn calves given deworming medication; 40 kg mineral mix distributed to needy animals. During Swachhata Pakhwada, volunteers conducted cleanliness drives and raised awareness on hygiene, encouraging routines. Company vows to continue health, livestock, and sanitation programs as part of social responsibility.

triage.headline_ja: パワイニュース：パワイ病院で結核患者100人に栄養キットを配布、コニ村で家畜113頭を治療
triage.triage_reason: 企業のCSR活動による既存結核患者への栄養支援と家畜健康キャンプの報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の新規発生報告ではなく、既存患者への栄養支援活動と家畜への寄生虫対策を伝える地域CSR活動の記事。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تعلن إصابة أحد عامليها بإيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders announce that one of their workers has contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) confirmed one Ebola infection among staff in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patient will be airlifted, under strict precautions, to a hospital in the Netherlands. MSF did not disclose the patient’s sex or whether they are local or foreign, citing medical confidentiality. The organization says all personnel are trained and equipped with protective gear, though transmission risk remains. The DRC is currently facing the largest Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 8,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths; experts warn that true case counts may be higher. The conflict-affected region houses hundreds of thousands of displaced people, complicating public health measures for humanitarian workers.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国でスタッフ1名がエボラに感染したと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が続く中、現地スタッフの感染と国際搬送が発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目で懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 患者はオランダへ空輸されたが、発生国はDRCであり、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCは既往最大規模のエボラ流行（8000例超、死者約4000人）が継続中で、紛争地域における避難民の存在が公衆衛生対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Internist Judith van Paassen: 'We zijn hierop ingericht'. Hulpverlener met ebola uit Congo voor behandeling naar LUMC in Leiden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Internist Judith van Paassen: "We are prepared for this." Aid worker with Ebola from Congo to be treated at LUMC in Leiden.
article.articleSummary: An MSF aid worker infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo will be treated at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in the Netherlands. The identity is confidential, and infection occurred during a deployment in the DRC. The patient will be flown to the Netherlands on a dedicated flight and will be immediately isolated on arrival, per RIVM guidelines. LUMC, one of the Netherlands’ two Viral Hemorrhagic Fever centers, is prepared for Ebola cases; this is the first Ebola patient treated there. Facilities include isolation rooms with negative pressure and a trained team of eight nurses and two doctors, operating with double staffing; several ICU beds may be temporarily closed. There is no cure; care is supportive, with fluids and electrolytes, and an experimental antiviral when available. Incubation is 2–3 weeks; prognosis varies; authorities say there is no danger to the Dutch public.

triage.headline_ja: 内科医ユディト・ファン・パーセン:「これに対応できる準備ができている」。コンゴからのエボラ感染者、ライデンのLUMCで治療へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラに感染したMSF援助従事者がオランダへ国際搬送され治療される事例であり、IHR基準のうち重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大の2つに該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染はDRCでの活動中に発生し、患者はオランダへ搬送・隔離治療される。オランダ(Zuid-Holland, Leiden, Netherlands)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCにおける基礎疾患発生状況（アウトブレイク規模等）は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 彰市本土登革熱疫情延燒群聚 衛局設快篩圍堵
