article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local dengue fever outbreak in Changhua City continues to spread in clusters; Health Bureau deploys rapid screening to contain it.
article.articleSummary: Local dengue fever outbreak in Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan, continues with a confirmed local case. A man in his 60s developed fever, diarrhea, and weakness from late September; after hospitalization and testing, dengue fever was confirmed, with dengue virus type 1 detected by sequencing. The case is linked to an August visitor from Vietnam; local mosquito transmission has formed a community cluster. Since July, imported dengue cases in Changhua rose about twofold, and mid-September marked the first local dengue case in four years. The Health Bureau expanded environmental disinfection within a 400-meter radius, fined eight landlords for not clearing breeding sources, and opened rapid screening stations to detect hidden infections. Authorities, including the Environmental Protection Bureau, sanitation teams, health clinics, police, and community leaders, conduct vector-density surveys, source elimination, disinfection, door-to-door education, and health monitoring. Public urged to remove standing water and follow weekly patrol, drain, clean, scrub steps.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化市本土デング熱疫情が群発的に拡大、衛生局が迅速検査で封じ込めを実施
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化市で4年ぶりの本土デング熱症例とクラスター形成が確認されており、WPRO基準の一部（異常性・流行しやすさ）に該当するが、重症度や国際的拡大の明確な情報は不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（対象国リスト外）。ベトナムは感染者の訪問歴（輸入症例の起源）として言及されているのみで、ベトナム国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Járvány tört ki az egyik általános iskolában, egy sportverseny résztvevői is lebetegedtek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak broke out at one elementary school, and participants in a sports competition also fell ill.
article.articleSummary: Baranya County reported three Campylobacteriosis, two Salmonellosis, one Rotavirus gastroenteritis, and one infectious hepatitis case in week 38; no additional Baranya infections were reported for other diseases. Komárom-Esztergom County saw an enteric outbreak at an elementary school starting Sept 9, affecting 468 pupils, with 57 ill; diarrhea, vomiting, and fever were common, and one patient was hospitalized. Nine cases were laboratory-tested, five positive for calicivirus, with transmission likely via direct contact rather than food. In Budapest, an international sports competition outbreak sickened 72 of 250 participants, presenting with vomiting and diarrhea; no hospitalizations. Two imported dengue fever cases were identified: a 27-year-old man in Győr-Moson-Sopron who spent the incubation period in India, and a 54-year-old man in Budapest who vacationed in the Maldives; both lab-confirmed. A domestically acquired West Nile fever case was reported in an 82-year-old man from Csongrád-Csanád County, bringing Hungary’s 2026 total to five; 80% male, mean age 71, all hospitalized with neurological symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ある小学校で感染症の流行が発生し、スポーツ大会の参加者も発病した
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内で複数の小規模アウトブレイク（学校でのカリシウイルス、スポーツ大会での胃腸炎、国内発生の西ナイル熱、輸入デング熱）が報告されているが、いずれも規模・重症度は限定的で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はハンガリー国内の複数の散発的アウトブレイク（学校・スポーツ大会での胃腸炎、国内発生西ナイル熱）が主題であり、インド・モルディブは輸入デング熱症例の感染地として言及されているのみで、イベントの発生国ではないため対象国リストからは除外した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N6
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: Live Poultry Markets, Not Wild Birds, Drive Avian Influenza Exposure Risk
article.articleSummary: Three-year surveillance (2023–2025) in Quzhou City, western Zhejiang Province, China, found poultry-associated environments, especially live poultry markets and farms, harbor far more avian influenza virus than migratory-bird habitats. Using RT-qPCR on 2,020 migratory-bird samples, 920 poultry-environmental samples, and 171 serum samples from workers, researchers detected viral RNA in 39 migratory-bird specimens (1.93%), with low loads and no subtyping. In poultry settings, 247 of 920 samples were positive (26.85%), with H9 identified in 122, H7 in 6, H5 in 3, and 115 unsubtyped. Among exposed workers, 23 of 171 (13.45%) were seropositive, most for H9N2 (17) and four for H5N6; H9N2 infections in humans are typically mild or asymptomatic. Antibody detection used HI assays. The findings implicate live poultry trade settings as the key human-exposure interface; H9N2 is endemic in Chinese poultry, while H5/H7 lineages pose greater zoonotic risk. Quzhou lies on the East Asian-Australasian Flyway, a strategic monitoring hub.

triage.headline_ja: 生きた家禽市場が、野鳥ではなく、鳥インフルエンザ曝露リスクの主因
triage.triage_reason: 中国浙江省での3年間のサーベイランス研究であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではないが、生体家禽市場における持続的なH9N2/H5N6曝露リスクが示されており、続報・関連症例報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の急性アウトブレイク報告ではなく、2023-2025年の横断的サーベイランス研究結果。生体家禽市場作業者のうちH9N2陽性17名、H5N6陽性4名が血清学的に確認されており、H5/H7系統の人獣共通感染リスクが指摘されている点は今後のモニタリング対象として留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new measles cases; total reaches 40 this year.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state totals 40 cases in 2026, with four new cases confirmed on Oct 1, 2026. Three patients are in the capital: two men aged 18 and 21, and a 1-year-old infant. Transmission chains identified since June, with monitoring indicating a trend toward reduced transmission. Updated distribution: 36 cases in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 each in Guarulhos and Santo André. Of the 40 cases, 30 involved individuals with no vaccination history or incomplete vaccination against measles. Vaccination with the MMR vaccine is provided free by the SUS and available through Basic Health Units in all 645 municipalities of the state. Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second dose at 15 months; for ages 15 months–29 years, two doses at least 30 days apart, with at least one dose on record. Dose zero may be given for contacts to children 6–11 months 29 days in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, but does not replace routine doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州ではしかの新規3例確認、今年の累計は40例に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の継続的な伝播が確認されているが、減少傾向にあり重症例や死亡の報告もないため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らない。未接種者among患者が多く流行の可能性は残るため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州（ブラジル）における麻疹の局地的流行を報じており、6月以降の伝播チェーンが特定されているが、監視データは減少傾向を示す。未接種者が感染者の大半を占めており、ワクチン接種率の向上が課題。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود: إصابة أحد موظفينا في الكونغو بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: One of Our Staff Members Contracted the Ebola Virus in Congo
article.articleSummary: MSF confirms one staff member infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus during outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is evacuated safely under strict medical protocol to a hospital in the Netherlands, with coordination between DRC authorities and Dutch officials. The Congo outbreak began on May 15 and is centered in Ituri and North Kivu, including the town of Butembo, with 63 health zones across seven of the country’s 26 provinces. As of Sept 26, 2026, lab-confirmed Ebola cases exceed 8,000, with 3,901 deaths. Bundibugyo is a rare strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization notes rising mortality, especially in villages, and ongoing challenges in timely detection and care. The UN OCHA report highlights disruption to essential health services in affected areas, with primary care visits in Ituri down by about 13 percent from April to June.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴで職員の一人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,000人超の確定症例、3,901人の死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、稀な株（Bundibugyo）で治療法・ワクチンがなく、職員が国際搬送されるなど国際的波及も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダは感染拡大先ではなく、感染したMSF職員の治療のための搬送先であり、対象国リストにも含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。コンゴの流行はイトゥリ州・北キブ州を中心に26州中7州・63保健地区に及ぶ大規模なものであり、WHOとUN OCHAも深刻な影響と医療アクセス低下を報告している。

article.articleHeadline: São Félix de Minas realiza levantamento para monitorar presença do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Félix de Minas conducts survey to monitor the presence of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: São Félix de Minas conducted a vector-surveillance survey between September 14 and 18, 2026, to monitor Aedes aegypti, the mosquito transmitting dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Led by the Municipal Health Secretariat and the Endemias team, the exercise collected information on the mosquito's presence within the municipality and will guide targeted interventions in areas requiring greater attention. Findings will support planning of prevention and control measures against arboviruses. The article emphasizes that combating Aedes aegypti requires ongoing public services and resident cooperation: keeping yards clean, eliminating containers that can hold water, and enabling health workers to access properties. The report does not provide case counts or lab-confirmed infections. It underscores community engagement as essential to reduce mosquito breeding sites in São Félix de Minas, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: サンフェリックス・デ・ミナス市、ネッタイシマカの生息状況調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: これは定例の蚊媒介対策調査に関する報告であり、症例数や感染確認情報は含まれず、異常事態や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の生息調査という予防活動の報告であり、症例数・感染拡大の報告なし。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、感染症イベントとしての実質的な情報がないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : des autorités de base formées sur les pratiques de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: local authorities trained in prevention practices - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, hosts trained community links against Ebola. Seventy-five relay community authorities from the Masuli health zone completed a training on essential Ebola prevention practices and community engagement to serve as a bridge between the community and response teams. Coordinated by Désiré Buyana of the CREC, the beneficiaries include cell chiefs, leaders of ten households, and other local authorities. The aim is to reduce community resistance to the outbreak response and accelerate adherence to measures to eradicate the Ebola epidemic in North Kivu. Butembo has been the epicenter of the province’s 17th Ebola outbreak and is reporting improvements with a decline in confirmed cases compared with previous months; vigilance and adherence to barrier measures remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ：地域当局者が予防対策について研修を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知の第17次エボラ流行（北キブ州）における予防研修活動の報告であり、症例は減少傾向にあるため新規の深刻化や異常事態を示すものではないが、エボラという疾患の性質上継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines（Masoli, Bicol）が含まれるが、これは地名の同名一致によるものであり、記事内容はDRC北キブ州ブテンボの第17次エボラ流行に関するものであるため除外した。既存流行の対応活動報告であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、エボラの重篤性から経過観察を継続する。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : aucun cas d'Ebola à la prison centrale de Beni-Kangbayi malgré la surpopulation - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: no Ebola case at the Beni-Kangbayi Central Prison despite overcrowding - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo: Beni-Kangbayi Central Prison reports zero Ebola virus disease cases since resurgence, despite severe overcrowding. Prison authorities in Beni say no positive Ebola cases have been detected within the facility. Entry temperature checks with thermo-flashes are routine. A local medical team of four doctors and six nurses provides care; patients needing advanced treatment are referred to the General Reference Hospital. To minimize transmission, visits are restricted to the visiting room with no physical contact. The director, Tsongo Makelele, stresses ongoing education and strict adherence to barrier measures. Overcrowding remains the main obstacle to social distancing, with the prison housing 2,347 inmates (2,267 men and 80 women) against a capacity of 250.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：過密状態にもかかわらずベニ・カンバイ中央刑務所でエボラ出血熱の症例なし - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内でのエボラ症例は報告されていないが、「再流行(resurgence)」の文言から周辺地域でエボラ出血熱の活動が継続している可能性があり、過密状態という流行しやすい環境条件も存在するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は『症例ゼロ』という否定的（安心材料となる）内容だが、『resurgence（再流行）』という表現からDRC北キブ州で別途エボラ出血熱の活動が継続している可能性が示唆される。過密状態（定員250名に対し収容者2,347名）は感染拡大の温床となり得るため、関連する一次情報（再流行の規模・感染者数等）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : reprise des activités dans un centre de santé à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: resumption of activities at a health center in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, the Tely reference health center in Isiro, Haut-Uélé, Democratic Republic of the Congo, resumed operations after a month-long closure due to Ebola-related deaths and healthcare worker infections. To break transmission, staff and patients were quarantined; the facility underwent complete decontamination and amplified surveillance. Tely's triage was strengthened, with all entrants passing through a functional screening area, including providers. Positive Ebola cases identified at Tely were transferred to the Ebola Treatment Center at Isiro General Reference Hospital, where all treated patients recovered, and those under observation without infection remained in good condition. Since reopening, no alerts have been reported at Tely. PPE kits from the response team were distributed to prevent new contamination, underscoring ongoing Ebola risk in Haut-Uélé and the need for continued community adherence to barrier measures.

triage.headline_ja: 北ウエレ州のエボラ：イシロの保健センターで活動再開
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱による死亡例・医療従事者感染が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常事象）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する医療施設の再開を報じる続報であり、死亡例・医療従事者感染が過去に発生していることから継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 2.3 مليون حالة سرطان جديدة عالمياً ناجمة عن العدوى والدول النامية تحملت العبء الأكبر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 2.3 million new cancer cases worldwide caused by infections, with developing countries bearing the brunt.
article.articleSummary: 2.3 million infection-attributable cancer cases were recorded worldwide in 2024, about 12% of all new cancers, according to an IARC study for the World Health Organization. There are stark geographic and income disparities, with low- and middle-income countries bearing roughly three-quarters of the global burden. East Asia reported the most infection-related cancers (about 990,000 cases, 42% of the global total), driven by Helicobacter pylori infection and hepatitis B virus. Sub-Saharan Africa accounts for about a quarter of infection-attributable cancers within the region, notably HPV-linked cervical cancer. The leading infectious causes are Helicobacter pylori (about 760,000 cases), HPV (about 750,000 cervical cancers), and hepatitis B virus. Researchers stress infection control as essential to reducing the cancer burden and urge investment in new preventive tools, including an Epstein-Barr virus vaccine, as no EBV vaccine exists yet; EBV is linked to six cancer types.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:世界で230万人の新規がん患者が感染症に起因、途上国が最大の負担を負う
triage.triage_reason: 個別の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、IARC/WHOによる感染関連がんの世界統計報告であり、急性公衆衛生イベントとしての特徴（異常性、国際拡大リスク等）は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の国・地域での急性アウトブレイクではなく、慢性感染症とがんリスクに関する世界的な疫学統計レポート。東アジアや中国への言及は地域統計の一部であり、特定の発生地域を示すものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Fungus Hidden in Mangrove Leaves Wields Powerful Weapons Against
article.articleSummary: Endophytic fungus Daldinia sp. from healthy Avicennia officinalis leaves on Chorao Island, Goa, India, shows antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity against Escherichia coli and Shigella (MicrobiologyOpen). Endophytism confirmed by surface sterilization, morphology, and a 100% ITS sequence match. Grown in potato dextrose broth for 21 days, the ethyl acetate extract AO-EA had the strongest activity. Agar diffusion showed inhibition zones of 13.67–17.33 mm against E. coli and Shigella, compared with ciprofloxacin 30–33 mm. MICs: 625 μg/mL (E. coli) and 312.5 μg/mL (Shigella); MBCs 625 μg/mL for both. Time-kill over 24 h at MIC reduced viability; SEM after 3 h showed cell deformation. AO-EA is a crude mix; purification could boost potency. The finding occurs amid global antimicrobial resistance concerns highlighted by the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: マングローブの葉に潜む真菌、薬剤耐性菌に対する強力な武器を持つ
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、内生菌由来の抗菌活性に関する基礎研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心を示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・ゴア州チョラオ島で採取されたマングローブ内生菌の抗菌作用に関する研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため対象国として扱わない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada Laporan Influenza A di Ponorogo, Dinkes Ingatkan Gejala Flu Berat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There have been no reports of Influenza A in Ponorogo; the Health Department reminds of the symptoms of severe flu.
article.articleSummary: As of 01 October 2026, Ponorogo District Health Office (East Java, Indonesia) reports no Influenza A cases in local healthcare facilities, though vigilance remains for prolonged flu. National data show influenza activity at a moderate, seasonal level with a 56% positivity rate across 265 specimens, and 148 positives; Influenza A (H1N1)pdm09 is the dominant circulating strain. Ponorogo continues surveillance through the SKDR system for influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) among 17 monitored diseases; laboratory confirmation for Ponorogo cases has not been performed, and no Influenza A detections have been reported locally. Public urged not to panic but to report clustered or unusual respiratory illnesses. Key warning signs include prolonged flu lasting, fever ≥38°C, and shortness of breath, with hospitalization if conditions worsen.

triage.headline_ja: ポノロゴでインフルエンザA型の報告はなし、保健局が重度のインフルエンザ症状に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 現地では症例報告がなく、全国的にも季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地元保健局による予防的な注意喚起であり、季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス活動の一環。症例の確認や異常な拡大は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em São Paulo: estado registra 40 casos confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in São Paulo: state records 40 confirmed cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state reports 40 confirmed measles cases in 2026 as of October 1, with 36 in the capital and single cases in São Bernardo do Campo (2), Guarulhos (1), and Santo André (1). The three most recent diagnoses—two men aged 18 and 21, and a 1‑year‑old—are all from the capital, which accounts for about 90% of current infections. All new cases are linked to already identified transmission chains monitored since June. Of the 40 cases, 30 involve individuals without vaccination or with incomplete immunization. The Unified Health System provides free measles vaccination (part of the triple viral vaccine) across 645 municipalities. Schedules: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; 15–29 years require two doses (minimum 30 days apart); 30–59 years at least one dose; health workers two doses. In high-transmission areas (São Paulo, Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo), a “dose zero” is given to 6–11‑month-olds, not substituting routine vaccines. Public health teams continue to interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの麻疹：2026年に州で40件の確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種者を中心とした麻疹の伝播が継続しているが、既知の感染チェーンに限定され公衆衛生当局が対応中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 症例の大部分（30/40）が未接種または不完全接種者であり、既知の伝播チェーンに関連。州保健当局がワクチン接種キャンペーンと伝播遮断を継続中。重症度や死亡例の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new measles cases; total rises to 40 this year.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, three new measles cases in São Paulo city (the capital) bring the year's total to 40. The patients are two men, aged 18 and 21, and a 1-year-old infant. Transmission chains traced since June connect these infections to ongoing transmission pathways, illustrating how the measles virus passes from sick to healthy individuals. Municipal and state surveillance report a downward trend in transmission, with authorities in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo monitoring the possible end of the transmission chains linked to the cases. The capital accounts for 90% of state infections. Updated tally: 36 cases in the city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André. Low vaccination adherence among cases—30 of 40—have no vaccination history or incomplete measles immunization.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで麻疹の新規感染者3人、今年の累計は40人に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の年間累計40例で下降傾向にあるが、ワクチン未接種者が多く感染伝播が継続しているため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（特に州都サンパウロ市）における麻疹の継続的な感染連鎖が報告されているが、地方自治体によるサーベイランスで下降傾向が確認されており、現時点では重篤例や国際的拡大の兆候はない。ワクチン未接種率の高さ（40例中30例）が今後の流行リスク要因として注視点となる。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo: Violência em Ituri destrói centro de trânsito e atrasa combate ao ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Violence in Ituri destroys a transit center and delays the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Violence in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, destroyed the Kigonze transit center used for Ebola patients, halting a key refuge and delaying outbreak containment. The attack left the field abandoned, signaling a major setback amid staff and funding shortages. The incident follows mass displacement, with the Kigonze camp housing about 19,000 people; in recent days over 3,000 fled the Rhoe camp since Sept 27 amid clashes, with four killed, seven injured, and several homes burned in Blukwa. Access to health zones Fataki, Drodro, and Lita has deteriorated, delaying laboratory diagnostics for Ebola samples from Fataki to Bunia and suspending treatment for confirmed patients. Humanitarian teams are withdrawing due to security risks, risking further spread near the Rwanda border, with Djugu also affected. The UN warns the collapse in health services could allow the virus to spread uncontrolled.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：イトゥリ州での暴力により移送センターが破壊され、エボラ対策に遅れ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は常にWHO通知対象疾患であり、治安悪化により封じ込め活動が阻害され国際拡大リスクも高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルーマニアは地名の誤検出（Bluedotの地域抽出ミス）と判断。ルワンダは越境リスクとして言及されているが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية - احتراق مركز لعبور المرضى يعرقل جهود احتواء الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Fire at a patient-transfer center hampers Ebola containment efforts
article.articleSummary: Fire at a patient-transfer center in Kigonzi camp in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, hampers Ebola containment as the facility—part of a crossing-and-treatment network that housed about 19,000 displaced people—appears abandoned after reports of soldiers searching for weapons and individuals suspected of affiliation with armed groups. The UN Ebola response lead warns the loss of a major intake and care site erodes capacity and forces a restart of containment investments. The outbreak has spread to seven Congolese provinces since WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May, with Bunia and Mongbwalu bearing most cases. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current surge—the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date—surpassing the 2018–2020 emergency, and second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (over 28,600 cases and >11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). More than 8,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths are confirmed. UN and authorities are working to protect health facilities amid ongoing violence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - 患者移送センターの火災がエボラ封じ込め活動を妨害
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ大規模流行（8,000例超、死亡4,000人超）に関する続報で、治療拠点の焼失が封じ込めをさらに悪化させており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: SP chega a 40 casos de sarampo em 2026; Guarulhos monitora transmissão - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo reaches 40 measles cases in 2026; Guarulhos monitors transmission - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo State, Brazil reaches 40 confirmed cases in 2026 as of Oct 1, with four new cases. Three patients are residents of São Paulo city (ages 18, 21) and a 1-year-old infant; cases linked to transmission chains under surveillance since June. Transmission appears to be subsiding; Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo monitor chains and consider ending transmission. São Paulo city accounts for most cases; remaining cases are in São Bernardo do Campo, Guarulhos, and Santo André. Of the 40 patients, 30 are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Vaccination via SUS uses the measles–mumps–rubella vaccine. Routine: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; up to 29 years two doses; 30–59 years one dose; health workers two doses. Dose zero may be given for 6–11 months in areas with circulation; it is additive, not substituting routine doses. Check vaccination card and eligibility with health units.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で2026年の麻疹症例が40件に到達；グアルーリョス市は感染連鎖を監視
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の地域的流行だが重症例・死亡の報告はなく、感染は収束傾向にあるため緊急性は低いが、未接種者が多く再燃の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 40症例中30例が未接種または不完全接種であり、感染拡大のリスクは残るが、現時点では地方自治体が監視・対応中であり国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Служител на "Лекари без граници" е с положителен тест за ебола в Конго - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A staff member of Doctors Without Borders has tested positive for Ebola in Congo - News from Dnes.bg.
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member has tested positive for Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of Congo while participating in outbreak response activities. The case was lab-confirmed and the person was safely evacuated under strict medical protocols in close collaboration with Congolese health authorities and Dutch officials, with admission to a specialized facility in the Netherlands. The DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases, reaching 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths according to the latest government health institute data, making it the largest and deadliest in the country’s history and surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. It remains second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which had about 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. MSF notes that risk cannot be fully eliminated and continues work in Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, and O‑Uélé provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで国境なき医師団の職員がエボラ出血熱の陽性反応 - Dnes.bgニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は8,067症例・3,901死亡に達し同国史上最大規模となっており、国際機関職員の感染・国外搬送も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 本件は2018-2020年流行を超える同国史上最大のエボラ流行であり、MSF職員の感染・オランダへの搬送という国際的波及も生じている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみで、オランダ・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは記事の主題（過去流行との比較・搬送先）であり発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : le respect des consignes de la riposte exigé par un cadre de base - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Adherence to the Response Guidelines Required by a Frontline Supervisor - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Ebola responses in Beni, Nord-Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, were emphasized at a community meeting in the Ngongolio neighborhood of Mulekera. A local supervisor urged strict adherence to response guidelines, including barrier precautions and acceptance of test results when Ebola is suspected or confirmed. He warned against challenging health workers, citing high transmission risk tied to deceased individuals and past problems encountered in managing the outbreak. The official also recalled provincial measures requiring dignified and secure burial teams (EDS) to be escorted by security personnel at cemeteries in Beni to prevent disruptions or attacks. The push highlights ongoing infection control, safe burial practices, and the protection of frontline responders amid continued Ebola-related concerns in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：対応ガイドラインの遵守が現場責任者により求められる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ベニで継続中の既知のエボラ対応状況に関するフォローアップ記事であり、新規感染拡大や新事実は確認されないため、既存アウトブレイクの経過観察として扱う。
triage.notes: 記事はベニ地域における既存のエボラ対応（感染対策・安全な埋葬）の継続的な実施状況を伝えるもので、新規アウトブレイクや感染者数の急増など具体的な新情報は含まれていない。既存のRRA対象イベントとして継続フォローが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : désinfection bihebdomadaire des engins de transport en commun - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: Twice-weekly disinfection of public transport vehicles - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, public transport vehicles must be disinfected twice weekly to prevent Ebola transmission. The provincial government via Bunia City Hall mandates disinfection every Wednesday and Saturday to protect passengers and the community. Gislain Amayo, ACCO/Ituri MS Translux communications officer, urged drivers and conveyors to comply and to continuously educate staff on sanitary measures, stressing that Ebola virus disease has not been eradicated. The measure emphasizes regular disinfection of transport vehicles and adherence to other health directives issued by authorities. No Ebola case or death counts are cited in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ対策：公共交通機関の週2回消毒 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州ブニアで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する公衆衛生対応（交通機関の定期消毒義務化）が報じられており、疾患の重篤性と異常性からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例・死亡者数を報告しておらず、既存のエボラ流行に対する予防的な交通機関消毒措置についての続報。疾患固有の重篤性と継続的な流行状況からPICKUPと判定したが、最新の症例動向については追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Merebak, OJK hingga AAJI Cermati Perkembangan dan Efeknya ke Klaim Asuransi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Spreads, OJK and AAJI Monitor Developments and Their Effects on Insurance Claims.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A spreads in Indonesia, prompting ongoing monitoring by the Financial Services Authority (OJK) and the Indonesian Life Insurance Association (AAJI). Allianz Life Indonesia reports influenza-related health insurance claims totaling Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases through the second week of September 2026, with inpatient admissions up 47% from the same period in 2025. OJK Head of Insurance Supervision and Supporting Services, Sumarjono, says no influenza-claims data has been received yet, but authorities will watch for potential effects on premiums and the wider health-insurance ecosystem. AAJI Chair Albertus Wiroyo notes some firms have higher claims but expects the impact to remain manageable thanks to prevention and vaccination. The Ministry of Health recorded a 56% influenza positivity rate on Sept 28, 2026 (week 38 sentinel), still medium risk. Regionally, WHO notes rising influenza activity in Southeast Asia; Influenza A(H3) is dominant in the Western Pacific by week 37, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが流行、OJKとAAJIが保険金請求への影響を注視
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザA(H3優勢)の陽性率上昇・入院増加が報告されているが、中リスクとされ重症度や死亡等の詳細情報が不足しており、保険業界への影響が主な論点となっている。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、記事の主眼は公衆衛生対応よりも保険金請求・金融業界への影響。重症度や死亡者数などの詳細な臨床データは記載されておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: escola em MG suspende aulas após 21 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human Scabies: A School in Minas Gerais Suspends Classes After 21 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-one confirmed cases of human scabies prompted suspension of classes at a municipal school in Lagoa Santa, Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The outbreak led authorities to pause activities on Oct 1-2 for hygiene and control measures, including full cleaning, pest extermination, and water tank disinfection. The first case was identified on Sept 18; by Sept 29 the school reported 14 student attestations and two staff off with an initial diagnosis. Scabies, caused by Sarcoptes scabiei, spreads mainly through direct prolonged contact and via contaminated bedding or objects. Key symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions such as papules, vesicles, or fissures; in children, lesions may appear on palms, soles, and scalp, with other common sites on hands, wrists, armpits, and waist.

triage.headline_ja: 人疥癬：ミナスジェライス州の学校で21件発生し休校
triage.triage_reason: 学校内での疥癬集団発生で学校閉鎖措置が取られたが、重症度は低く地域当局により管理されているため、フルリスク評価は現時点で不要と判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で重症度が低く、学校側が既に衛生対策（清掃・消毒・害虫駆除）を実施済み。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、地域内で管理可能と考えられる。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : huit cas confirmés d'Ebola, six décès et deux guéris à Gety (médecin chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: eight confirmed Ebola cases, six deaths and two recoveries in Gety (chief medical officer of the health zone) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Gety health zone, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo: eight confirmed cases, six deaths, and two recoveries reported as of October 1, 2026. Four health areas are affected: Songolo (one case, recovered), Olongba (two deaths), Gety (four cases, three deaths, one recovery), and Sura (one death). The first case was declared on May 27, 2026; after an initial period of apparent control, transmission rose in August–September amid low community engagement. Dr. Raymond Ugentho, chief health zone physician, urged heightened community involvement and adherence to barrier measures, stressing that containment requires broader participation beyond health workers. The report underscores ongoing Ebola transmission in Gety and the need for intensified public health measures to interrupt chains of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:エボラ確定症例8例、ゲティで死亡6例・回復2例(保健ゾーン医長)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱のDRCにおける継続的な人-人感染が確認され、致死率は75%と高く、公衆衛生上重大な懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: スウェーデンの地名（Västmanland County, Sura）はBluedotの地理誤認識とみられ、記事本文はDRC・イトゥリ州ゲティ地域のエボラ流行に関するものである。地域住民の協力不足により感染拡大が継続している点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola case drop in DRC may mask continued spread: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows a decline in reported cases that Africa CDC cautions may reflect surveillance disruptions rather than reduced transmission. Since mid-May, Ebola has spread from three health zones to 63 across seven provinces, with 45 zones still reporting active transmission. As of Sept 29, 2026, 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%). The latest week shows a plateau and a drop, but authorities warn the downturn is not proof the outbreak is under control. Insecurity and community resistance hinder surveillance; only about 14 contacts are identified per case (vs ~60 expected), with roughly 23% of estimated contacts followed up and nearly 80% of new cases detected outside known lists. Ituri declined ~32% over three weeks, while North Kivu rose. Health worker deaths in Kisangani (Sept 24) and violence in Butembo/Beni further threaten response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ症例減少、実際は感染拡大を隠している可能性－アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（確定8,224例、死亡3,982例、CFR48.4%）が複数州に拡大し、治安悪化とサーベイランス機能不全により感染状況把握が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが公式に懸念を表明しており、感染経路の追跡率低下（接触者追跡率約23%）や新規症例の約80%が既知リスト外から検出されるなど、サーベイランス崩壊の兆候が顕著。治安悪化（Butembo/Beniでの暴力、Kisanganiでの医療従事者死亡）が対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: L'oxygène, un élément important dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxygen, an important element in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease persists with 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths (case fatality rate >48%). The World Health Organization emphasizes oxygen supply as a critical component of care. Dr. Janet Diaz of WHO notes that early treatment markedly improves survival, but many patients still die at home or in communities before reaching care. For those admitted to Ebola treatment centers, oxygen therapy is essential, since more than 50% develop life-threatening complications including multiorgan failure, respiratory failure, and septic shock with severe hypoxemia. With a Bundibugyo strain circulating, in the absence of a licensed vaccine or antiviral, supportive care—hydration and oxygen—forms a vital medical barrier enabling immune response. WHO stresses that oxygen access requires functional health systems, reliable infrastructure, trained staff, and durable distribution to reach patients wherever they are.

triage.headline_ja: 酸素供給、エボラ対応における重要な要素
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例8,067件・死亡3,901件、致死率48%超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株が流行しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行の継続報道だが、致死率の高さとワクチン未承認株の流行という点で引き続きフルリスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Escola municipal suspende aulas após surto de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Municipal School Suspends Classes After an Outbreak of Human Scabies.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies outbreak in Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Brazil, leads to school closure. Twenty confirmed cases since September 18 among students at Escola Municipal Professora Mércia Margarida Lacerda Machado in the Moradas da Lapinha neighborhood, with a teacher also diagnosed and in treatment. The municipality states the class suspension aims to interrupt transmission, as some parents continue sending children to school despite confirmed cases. Classes at the municipal school are halted on Thursday, October 1 and Friday, October 2, 2026. Local authorities are managing the outbreak in Lagoa Santa as of 2026-10-01, with no mention of further schools affected.

triage.headline_ja: フォーリャ・ダ・レジオン：疥癬アウトブレイクを受け市立学校が休校

article.articleHeadline: Cláudio utiliza drone para reforçar combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cláudio uses a drone to reinforce the fight against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Drone-assisted surveillance for Aedes aegypti in Cláudio, Brazil, using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to monitor hard-to-reach areas and pinpoint potential breeding sites. A mapping on September 3 identified Valongo, Bela Vista, and Cachoeirinha as areas with higher conditions favorable to mosquito breeding. Imagery guides field teams and improves inspection precision. While technology aids surveillance, eliminating breeding sites remains the main preventive measure. Residents should regularly inspect yards, wash water-storage containers with water, soap and brush, keep water tanks sealed, discard items that collect water, and keep drains and gutters clean. No case counts are reported; the effort supports ongoing dengue prevention. Information from Jornal Panorama and Prefeitura de Cláudio. Published 1 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Acre inicia vacinação contra brucelose e declaração de rebanhos; veja prazos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre begins vaccination against brucellosis and declaration of herds; see deadlines.
article.articleSummary: Acre, Brazil: The Institute of Agricultural and Forest Defense of Acre (Idaf) launches the second stage of brucellosis vaccination and the Annual Herd Declaration. The declaration, mandatory for all livestock owners, must be filed by November 30 and updates the state's animal population; penalties include fines and restrictions on the Animal Transit Guide (GTA). In October 2026, the vaccination targets breeding females (cattle and buffalo) aged 3–8 months. Brucellosis is an infectious disease causing reproductive problems in animals and can be transmitted to humans. Declarations cover a wide range of species, including cattle, buffalo, horses, donkeys, mules, pigs, sheep, goats, chickens, other birds, fish, and beehives.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar doença parasita em crianças | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug to treat parasitic disease in children | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-01, Brazil's Anvisa approved the registration of Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel to treat schistosomiasis in children aged 3 months to 6 years. Schistosomiasis, also known as snail fever (barriga d'água), is a neglected tropical disease caused by Schistosoma mansoni or Schistosoma haematobium and transmitted through water containing infected snails. The drug is absorbed by worms in blood vessels, causing muscular spasms and paralysis and damaging the parasite's tegument, enabling destruction by the host immune system. The disease mainly affects low-income populations with poor sanitation; exposure to contaminated water is a key risk. Symptoms typically appear 2–6 weeks after exposure, with acute and chronic phases and potential fatal outcomes in severe cases. Diagnosis is via stool examination for parasite eggs. Praziquantel remains an existing treatment, administered in a single dose and provided free by the Ministry of Health.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF insiste qu'ERVEBO ne remplace pas les mesures de prévention contre le virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF insists that ERVEBO does not replace preventive measures against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). MSF stresses that ERVEBO vaccination under the BRAVO study is not a substitute for infection-control measures. BRAVO, launched Sept 19, 2026 in Bunia, Ituri, by MSF and its Epicentre research center, aims to evaluate ERVEBO in frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu. ERVEBO is licensed for Ebola Zaire, not Bundibugyo; early data hint at potential protection against Bundibugyo, and BRAVO will document this. Vaccination is an additional protection for those at high exposure, not a replacement for PPE, safe-care procedures, and prompt symptom reporting. BRAVO intends to enroll 20,000 frontline workers over 9–12 months, with three months of vaccination and at least six months of follow-up. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in development; ERVEBO is being studied as a transitional measure to gauge added protection. Participation and vaccination are voluntary.

article.articleHeadline: 494 Anak Diperkirakan Terkena TB di Papua Barat Daya, Baru 144 yang Ditemukan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 494 Children Estimated to Have TB in Southwest Papua, Only 144 Found.
article.articleSummary: In Southwest Papua (Papua Barat Daya), Indonesia, an estimated 494 children are affected by tuberculosis (TB) in 2026, but by August only 144 have been identified and treated (about 29%). Secretary Yakob Kareth warned that over 350 children may be ill without diagnosis, indicating ongoing transmission from adults. The Papua Barat Daya government backs TB elimination as a national priority, aiming to halve TB cases by 2030 under Presidential Regulation No. 67/2021 and the President’s Quick Win program. UNICEF cautioned that pediatric TB remains a serious threat, representing roughly 10-15% of total TB cases, driven by poverty, poor housing, malnutrition, stigma, and limited access to services. The two-day workshop by Dinas Kesehatan, Pengendalian Penduduk dan Keluarga Berencana (Dinkes P2KB) Papua Barat Daya and UNICEF seeks concrete actions to accelerate detection, prevention, and treatment across districts, engaging multi-sectoral stakeholders.

triage.triage_reason: 小児結核の未診断例が多数存在し継続的な伝播が懸念されるが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域保健当局による既存の対策プログラム内の課題として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands flee Congo Ebola-hit camp, stoking concerns about disease spread
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled the Kigonze camp in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after security forces entered to search for weapons, leaving about 19,000 displaced residents abandoned. The camp hosts roughly 1,000 Ebola contacts, with only about 20% traced, hindering outbreak control. An Ebola transit centre for isolation, testing and treatment was burned down. The UN refugee agency reports 88 confirmed Ebola cases in Congo displacement sites and 56 deaths, with likely undercounting. Ituri is the worst-affected province in the current outbreak, declared in May and the deadliest in Congo’s history, with at least 3,982 deaths. Reuters cited that in June more than 30 camp deaths occurred in just over a month, many from Ebola. Overcrowding and poor sanitation in camps amplify transmission; halting spread is an enormous challenge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが発生したキャンプから数千人が避難、感染拡大への懸念高まる

triage.notes: 接触者追跡率が約20%と低く、治療施設の破壊や避難民の大規模移動により感染拡大リスクが非常に高い。コンゴ史上最も致死率の高いエボラ流行とされており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza novo medicamento pediátrico contra a esquistossomose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes new pediatric drug for schistosomiasis.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approved on 2026-09-30 the registration of Farmanguinhos Praziquantel to treat schistosomiasis in children aged 3 months to 6 years, expanding pediatric treatment options in Brazil. Schistosomiasis is a neglected tropical disease transmitted when skin contacts water contaminated by snail hosts of Schistosoma. The drug induces parasite muscle spasms and paralysis and disrupts the parasite tegument, aiding immune clearance. Diagnosis relies on stool tests detecting parasite eggs; early detection is crucial to prevent progression. For cases not covered by the pediatric indication, conventional Praziquantel remains freely distributed by the Ministry of Health and is administered as a single dose under medical guidance. This regulatory update supports early-life management and public-health efforts to reduce morbidity from schistosomiasis in Brazil.

article.articleHeadline: Penyakit Kuno yang Belum Punah, WHO Kembali Soroti Wabah Pes yang Renggut Ratusan Nyawa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ancient Diseases That Have Not Yet Been Eradicated, WHO Again Highlights the Plague Outbreak That Has Claimed Hundreds of Lives.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization confirms human plague cases in six countries, with 423 deaths reported over the past six years. From 2019 to 2025, ten countries reported suspected plague cases to WHO, with six providing laboratory-confirmed results; in total, 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths were reported, a case-fatality rate of about 11%. Most cases occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, where plague remains endemic in parts of the countries; the disease can also arise in nations that do not report cases. WHO stresses routine surveillance of rodents and other mammals and rapid outbreak response to detect plague early, cut transmission, and prevent larger outbreaks. Russian Academy of Sciences expert Gennady Onishchenko highlighted plague as a major health threat alongside seasonal flu, respiratory infections, coronavirus, viral hemorrhagic fevers, and cholera.

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 3 novos casos de sarampo; estado chega a 40
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 3 new measles cases; state reaches 40.
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, São Paulo state confirms 3 new measles cases, totaling 40 in 2026. The cases involve two men (ages 18 and 21) and a 1-year-old girl, all residents of São Paulo city. Of the 40 total, 30 are in unvaccinated or under-vaccinated individuals; among the new cases, the 21-year-old and the 1-year-old have one dose registered, while the 18-year-old has no vaccination record. The capital accounts for 36 cases; the remaining four are in the Metropolitan Region (two in São Bernardo do Campo, one in Guarulhos, one in Santo André). Transmission chains identified since June show a downward trend, with surveillance monitoring potential end points in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo. Laboratory confirmation occurred within ongoing contact tracing; more than 1,700 suspected notifications have been ruled out. Vaccination: MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine available in all 645 municipalities. Recommendations: children at 12 and 15 months; 15 months–29 years with two doses; 30–59 years with at least one dose; healthcare workers two doses. Dose zero for babies 6–11 months in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, including contacts, not substituting scheduled doses.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : la riposte intègre le suivi psychosocial des malades et soignants - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: the response integrates the psychosocial follow-up of patients and caregivers - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, Ebola response in Isiro and health zones of Wamba, Bomangbetu, and Isiro in Haut-Uélé, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, integrates psychosocial follow-up for patients, caregivers, and frontline workers at Ebola Treatment Centers. André Lubango, a response-team member, states the psychosocial care pillar tracks patients, accompanying persons, staff, and first responders, prioritizing stress management to sustain field effectiveness. Activities include comfort visits to families of Ebola victims and coordination with Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) and Safe and Dignified Burials (SDB/EDS) teams. Given cultural mourning practices, outreach aims to soothe tensions when restrictions prevent traditional rites around the deceased. Communities are urged to strictly observe barrier measures, avoid kissing and handshakes, and discard rumors of contamination via toilets, since transmission remains linked to contact with cases. The psychosocial pillar collaborates closely with other response commissions in the Ebola outbreak management.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : plus de 2 000 élèves sensibilisés à la prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: more than 2,000 students educated about prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention education reached Bunia, with over 2,000 students from the Fabia School Complex (kindergarten through secondary) receiving sensitization as part of INSP response activities as of 1 October 2026. The interactive sessions clarified the main transmission routes and protective behaviors to reduce contamination, complemented by a practical handwashing demonstration to reinforce hygiene practices in the school community. Information, education and communication materials were supplied to sustain ongoing awareness efforts. Fabia School Complex director Fura Fifi stated the initiative addresses a real need and should be regularly renewed in schools. The INSP aims to strengthen school-based information and prevention to better prepare communities against Ebola virus disease.

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : les personnes du troisième âge encouragées à sensibiliser contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: The elderly encouraged to raise awareness about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On October 1, 2026, in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, elderly people were urged to participate in Ebola prevention awareness for the International Day of Older Persons. Norbert Muhindo, coordinator of the Association of Young People Supporting the Elderly (AJSTA), called on seniors to educate youths to protect themselves from Ebola and to avoid conflicts with health workers. He noted that older adults are fully aware of Ebola’s existence and urged the population to acknowledge the disease and take precautions. The elderly’s role, Muhindo said, is to raise awareness among the young while safeguarding themselves; youths sometimes doubt the disease’s existence, but seniors are convinced. Following the message, seniors began regular handwashing. The event, held at AJSTA’s office, featured talks on rights, duties, and empowerment, centered on ensuring voices and rights align with the DRC constitution.

article.articleHeadline: "Il Covid è diventato endemico, ci saranno due ondate ogni anno". Il microbiologo Broccolo spiega l'aumento dei casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 has become endemic; there will be two waves each year.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is now endemic, with resurgences occurring biannually; there is no rigid influenza-like seasonality. In China between late July and early August, test positivity rose above 20%, with the NB181 SARS-CoV-2 variant responsible for more than 95% of sequenced cases, and XFG also prevalent. Both variants descend from the JN-1 lineage and carry Spike protein mutations that improve antibody evasion, increasing reinfection risk. New variants are more transmissible but not more virulent. Ongoing transmission is driven by factors such as returning to school and work, time spent indoors, and waning population immunity. Key measures remain protecting the vulnerable, testing symptomatic individuals, avoiding contact with vulnerable groups, ventilating spaces, and maintaining genomic surveillance and laboratory diagnostics as early warning systems, even outside emergencies. Chinese authorities reported no hospital crowding and a wave intensity comparable to Europe’s previous two years.

triage.headline_ja: 「COVID-19は風土病化した、毎年2回の波が来るだろう」微生物学者ブロッコロが症例増加を解説
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に風土病化しており、中国での変異株流行も病院逼迫なしで欧州と同程度の波とされ、公衆衛生上の重大な異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家の解説記事であり、COVID-19の季節性・風土病化に関する一般的な医学解説が主題。中国の症例増加に言及があるが、病院逼迫なし・重症度増加なしと明記されており、通常の季節変動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Cancer: One in eight cases worldwide caused by infections like Epstein-Barr, study finds
article.articleSummary: Infections caused 2.3 million new cancer cases in 2024, about 12% of total global cancers, according to an IARC study. Helicobacter pylori is the leading infectious cancer driver with about 760,000 cases, including 410,000 in East Asia and predominantly gastric cancer. Human papillomavirus accounts for around 750,000 cancers, predominantly cervical cancer. Hepatitis B virus causes about 360,000 cancers, mainly liver cancer. Epstein-Barr virus contributes roughly 260,000 cases, predominantly nasopharyngeal cancer, gastric cancer, and Hodgkin lymphoma. The overall proportion of cancers caused by infections has remained largely stable since the last IARC publication, based on 2024 data, with notable regional patterns in East Asia and across HPV-, HBV-, H. pylori-, and EBV-associated cancers.

triage.notes: 本記事はIARC（国際がん研究機関）による世界的な感染症関連がんの統計研究であり、特定地域でのアウトブレイクや公衆衛生危機を報告するものではない。発生地域としてChina/Shanghaiが付与されているが、記事内容は世界全体の統計であり特定国の事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Manuel Masalva revela que sufrió amputación tras grave infección
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Manuel Masalva reveals that he suffered an amputation after a severe infection.
article.articleSummary: Mexican actor Manuel Masalva, known for Narcos: México, disclosed that a severe Burkholderia infection during a 2025 trip to the Philippines with a Dubai layover led to life‑threatening sepsis and extensive tissue damage. The bacteria circulated in his blood, severely compromising his circulation; upon waking from an induced coma his feet appeared almost completely black with necrosis. Doctors spent about six weeks trying to control the infection and limit damage, but amputation of his toes became unavoidable. Masalva accepted the procedure, noting his concern for his family’s pain during hospitalization. He spent about 105 days hospitalized in Dubai and underwent multiple interventions. By April 2025 he was gradually regaining consciousness; by July 2025 he remained in recovery. Now using prosthetics to walk, he describes renewed mobility and hope as he adjusts to a new gait and life.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé : remise de kits nutritionnels aux enfants séparés de leurs mères à Pawa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: distribution of nutritional kits to children separated from their mothers in Pawa - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Isiro, October 1, 2026 — An Ebola response team in the Pawa health zone, Haut-Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, distributed nutritional kits to three children separated from their mothers who tested positive for Ebola. Alongside work on two confirmed cases, the mission provided therapeutic milk and nutritional supplements to these infants (ages 15 months, 7 months, and 8 months) who have been weaned. Caregivers were briefed on feeding practices to maintain child health. Mothers are no longer allowed to breastfeed due to infection, placing the children in the high-risk contact category and requiring ongoing follow-up in the community. André Lubangu, community activities focal point at the Provincial Health Division, stated the objective of monitoring these children and sustaining nutrition until safety conditions improve.

article.articleHeadline: Covid, casi in ripresa e varianti NB181 e XFG: cosa dice il microbiologo Francesco Broccolo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, rising cases and NB181 and XFG variants: what microbiologist Francesco Broccolo says.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again, aligned with typical waves, says Francesco Broccolo, clinical microbiologist at the University of Salento; SARS-CoV-2 is now endemic, lacking strict seasonality and capable of one or two annual waves. In late July–early August 2026, China reported >20% test positivity, with NB181 causing over 95% of sequenced cases and XFG also prevalent. Both descend from the JN-1 lineage and carry Spike protein mutations that may help antibody evasion and reinfections, though there is no evidence of greater clinical severity. Drivers include school/work returns, time indoors, and waning immunity. He urges testing symptomatic individuals and avoiding contact with vulnerable people, plus adequate ventilation. Genomic surveillance and laboratory diagnostics should be sustained as early-warning tools even in non-emergency periods.

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ・エボラ流行、避難民キャンプから数千人が流出、感染拡大に懸念
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak: thousands flee from refugee camps, raising concerns about the spread of infection.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies as thousands flee refugee camps near Bunia in Ituri Province amid clashes with security forces. The mass displacement hinders surveillance and complicates efforts to trace transmission as the virus spreads within and beyond affected areas. WHO and Congolese authorities warn that ongoing eastern Congo transmission risks wider regional spread, amplified by population movements. As of late September, Ebola has reached seven provinces and 63 health zones, with more than 8,000 confirmed cases and about 3,900 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Public health measures focus on rapid case finding, contact tracing, and community outreach, but continued refugee movements threaten containment and cross-border monitoring. The challenge is to balance outbreak control with civilian safety amid protracted conflict.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が7州63保健ゾーンに拡大し8,000例超・死者約3,900人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、避難民の大量移動によりサーベイランスと封じ込めが困難化し国際的拡大リスクが高いため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRA対象と判断。
triage.notes: 紛争による治安悪化と避難民の大量移動がサーベイランス・接触者追跡を妨げており、国境を越えた拡大リスクが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Namibie et fièvre aphteuse: l'UE examine, Windhoek négocie, les exportateurs de bovin retiennent leur souffle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namibia and foot-and-mouth disease: the EU examines, Windhoek negotiates, cattle exporters hold their breath.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Namibia's Kharas region triggers EU review of the country's status as a cattle exporter. By 1 October 2026, EU Ambassador Ana Beatriz Martins praised Namibia's rapid, transparent response and urged continued dialogue. A cargo valued at about NAD 400 million could be returned as authorities verify the meat's origin and negotiate with trading partners. Surveillance and testing continue in remote Kharas zones after FMD confirmation; some movements north of the veterinary fence remain restricted, though negatives from cattle moved to Otjozondjupa allowed limited lifting. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle, sheep, goats, pigs and certain wildlife. Namibia's 2025 meat exports reached NAD 2.1 billion; livestock accounted for 3.5% of GDP, with 2024 exports of 210–225 million USD to the EU, Norway, China, and South Africa. The FMD control fund has mobilized over NAD 1.5 million toward an initial 50 million.

triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（口蹄疫）の経済・貿易影響に関する記事であり、対象国（ナミビア）はリストに含まれず、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクも報告されていないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-patiënt overgebracht naar Nederland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient transferred to the Netherlands.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected frontline healthcare worker, infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is transported to the Netherlands for medical care. The patient is flown by a dedicated aircraft to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) and immediately quarantined. Care is provided by an infectious-diseases team in a highly secured unit designed for extremely contagious pathogens, with isolation rooms featuring double doors and airlocks, including two for intensive care. The hospital stresses strict safety protocols to prevent transmission. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the current outbreak, active for months in Uganda and the DRC, prompting the WHO to declare a global health emergency. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected body fluids such as saliva, sweat, blood, or vomit. Early symptoms mimic flu—muscle pains, headache, fever—progressing to severe bleeding. Mortality is around 50% per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、オランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: WHOがグローバル公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言したエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行の患者がDRCから国際搬送されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで感染した医療従事者のオランダへの国際搬送を報じている。ウガンダも流行地域として言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。オランダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Un membre de Médecins sans frontières infecté par Ebola évacué vers les Pays-Bas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: A member of Doctors Without Borders infected with Ebola evacuated to the Netherlands.
article.articleSummary: A Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) staff member involved in Congo Ebola response tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was evacuated to the Netherlands on Oct 1, 2026. The infection was acquired in Beni, North Kivu, with the European expatriate (nationality undisclosed) not yet vaccinated. Congolese health minister Roger Kamba said authorities approved the transfer, flown directly from Beni to the Netherlands via a special flight, avoiding Kinshasa. The patient will be treated at the University Hospital Leiden in a high-level isolation unit under strict protocols, coordinated with health authorities of both countries. As of Sept 29, nearly 4,000 deaths had been reported in the DRC. Vaccination is being prepared in Beni, with MSF support in Ituri. MSF cautions that frontline exposure risk cannot be entirely eliminated despite training and protections.

article.articleHeadline: Sakrebailu tusker succumbs to infection, injuries
article.articleSummary: Shivamogga, Karnataka: Shourya, a 35-year-old rescued tusker at Sakrebailu Elephant Camp near Shivamogga, died 2026-10-01 after a months-long infected leg injury, with internal injuries, deep tissue necrosis and systemic exhaustion. Diagnostics showed tissue necrosis and pus in the rear-left thigh; preliminary cause cited as toxaemia and septic shock from a severe bacterial infection. Collapse occurred 2026-09-30 around 11pm; death at ~8am on 2026-10-01 despite intravenous fluids, glucose and supportive care by forest veterinarians, Shivamogga Veterinary College specialists, Haathi Foundation and Wildlife SOS. Shourya had been captured 2026-02-22 from Balehonnur, Chikkamagaluru district after human-elephant conflicts and housed in a kraal for taming. This death follows a separate elephant fatality at Dubare Camp (Kodagu), prompting a high-level inquiry ordered by PCCF wildlife Kumar Pushkar; Sakrebailu’s elephant population is now 23. A formal postmortem is underway.

article.articleHeadline: Naučnici u Kini otkrili NOVI VIRUS: Izaziva jak umor i mučninu, a ovo su svi uočeni simptomi - evo ko ga prenosi...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists in China have discovered a NEW VIRUS: it causes severe fatigue and nausea, and these are all the observed symptoms — and who transmits it....
article.articleSummary: China-based study identifies ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), a novel pathogen transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks, causing influenza-like fever and severe gastrointestinal symptoms. In 3,163 patients across Chinese provinces, 10.4% tested positive for ALTNV. In cases infected solely with ALTNV, 84% reported intense fatigue, 80% experienced nausea and GI upset, 38% had thrombocytopenia, and 36% showed elevated aminotransferases; all patients recovered with timely medical care. Researchers warn that co-infection with Dabie virus (DBV), which drives severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, markedly worsens outcomes: 61% developed respiratory problems and 84% experienced kidney failure. Analyses of over 47,000 ticks identified Asian longhorned tick Haemaphysalis longicornis as the principal vector. The authors advocate enhanced diagnostics in tick-endemic areas to enable early detection and prevent severe complications.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者が新型ウイルスを発見：強い倦怠感と吐き気を引き起こす、観察されたすべての症状と感染経路は以下の通り…
triage.triage_reason: 中国でマダニ媒介の新規病原体（ALTNV）が発見され、重症化例（Dabieウイルスとの共感染で急性腎不全・呼吸不全）が報告されており、新規性と公衆衛生上の潜在的リスクからフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ALTNV（Asian longhorned tick nairovirus）は中国の研究チームが特定した新規病原体で、Haemaphysalis longicornisマダニが媒介。単独感染は比較的軽症で回復率が高いが、Dabieウイルス（SFTS）との共感染で重症化率が高い点に注意。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低いとみられるが、新興感染症として継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: El ministro francés de Exteriores visitará el epicentro de la epidemia de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The French Minister of Foreign Affairs will visit the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the deadliest in the country’s history, with over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths across seven provinces (Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi). The epicenter is Bunia, Ituri, in the northeast, though transmission spans a broader area. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot will visit Kinshasa (October 2–3) and Bunia to discuss humanitarian assistance, strengthen health-system capacity, and pursue scientific cooperation with Congolese authorities, NGOs, and international partners. He will address humanitarian-law violations amid northeast violence and frame health security as a shared concern across porous borders. The trip precedes France’s National Humanitarian Conference in Paris on October 6, aimed at renewing international commitments amid tighter funding constraints across donor nations.

article.articleHeadline: Manuel Masalva sufre amputación tras bacteria que contrajo en Dubái y que casi lo mata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Manuel Masalva suffers amputation after contracting a bacterium in Dubai that nearly killed him.
article.articleSummary: Mexican actor Manuel Masalva, known for La rosa de Guadalupe and Narcos: México, contracted a severe Burkholderia infection during a trip from the Philippines with a layover in Dubai in March 2025. Lab-confirmed infection rapidly affected multiple organs and the bloodstream, causing critical circulatory failure and a coma. After weeks of treatment in Dubai, doctors decided to amputate the toes of his feet to control the infection. He remained hospitalized for months and was discharged in July. In the months since, Masalva has been learning to walk again with prosthetic devices, a challenging rehabilitation that has helped restore some mobility and hope. He described waking from the coma to feet that looked nearly black due to necrosis/gangrene and stressed gratitude for the support of family, fans, and medical staff as he adapts to a new normal.
