article.articleHeadline: Тысячи беженцев бежали из лагеря с Эболой в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of refugees fled from an Ebola camp in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Thousands of refugees fled the Ebola-stricken Kigonze camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province after soldiers entered, emptying a site that once housed about 19,000 displaced people. The flare-up has raised concerns about further spread, as about 1,000 Ebola contacts were identified in the camp, with only roughly one-fifth traced to date. The UN notes that the enormous challenge of stopping Ebola in the DRC has been compounded by the incident, including the burning of a transit center where suspected cases could be isolated, tested, and treated. UNHCR reported 88 confirmed Ebola cases and 56 deaths in camps in the DRC, including Kigonze, with higher totals likely. The IOM says mortality among Ebola patients in other camps exceeds 80%, far above typical levels near 50%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行キャンプから数千人の難民が逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが難民キャンプで発生し、接触者追跡の中断や治療施設の焼失により感染拡大リスクが高く、致死率も異常に高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡が約2割にとどまり、致死率が80%超との報告あり。軍の介入によりキャンプが混乱し、感染拡大の可能性が高い。続報でWHO/UNHCRの公式発表を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: El ministro francés de Exteriores visitará el epicentro de la epidemia de ébola en la RDC - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The French Minister of Foreign Affairs will visit the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic in the DRC - Diario de Santiago. News from Santiago de Compostela and Galicia.
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot will visit the Democratic Republic of Congo on October 2–3, 2026, touring Kinshasa and Bunia in Ituri province, the epicenter of the Ebola epidemic. The outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases with about 4,000 deaths, making it the worst in the DRC's history. In Kinshasa, Barrot will meet Foreign Minister Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner; in Bunia, he will engage with Congolese communities, local authorities, and NGOs on the ground. The visit aims to bolster France's support for Congo's health systems and advance scientific cooperation, bilaterally and with international partners. Although Bunia is the epicenter, the outbreak spans seven of 26 provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi-Sud. French officials also flag cross-border health security concerns. Barrot will discuss humanitarian law violations and announce new cooperation measures. The trip precedes the National Humanitarian Conference in Paris on Oct 6.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行震源地を訪問へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が史上最悪規模（8000例以上、死者約4000人）に達し、7州に拡大、国際支援・外交対応が行われていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: フランス外相の訪問は外交的関心の高さを示す。DRCのエボラ流行は史上最大規模で、国境を越えた公衆衛生上の懸念も指摘されている。継続的なフォローアップが必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: पीलीभीत जेल में डेंगू-मलेरिया के बाद अब चिकनपॉक्स का खौफ, 3 बंदी मेरठ रेफर; मचा हड़कंप - pilibhit jail chickenpox outbreak inmates meerut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After dengue and malaria, chickenpox scare grips Pilibhit jail; 3 inmates referred to Meerut; chaos erupts.
article.articleSummary: Three inmates in Pilibhit district jail have been confirmed with chickenpox, with two others displaying symptoms; all were referred to Meerut for treatment after initial care in jail hospital and district hospital proved insufficient. Health teams visited the jail, collecting samples from others to gauge spread and monitoring contacts. The outbreak comes as monsoon rains have aggravated infections in the district, where eight dengue cases have been reported; in Bisalpur's Rasia Khanpur area eight dengue cases and about 110 malaria cases were recorded. From April to September, 2,267 malaria positives and about 9,378 typhoid cases were logged. In Punarpur, an eight-year-old child has swine flu; in Bilasanda, a seven-year-old child has scrub typhus. Four days earlier, one prisoner’s health deteriorated, and after successive referrals he tested positive for chickenpox in Meerut. Dr. Gyan Prakash, ACMO, confirmed the cases and emphasized ongoing sampling and contact monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ピリービート刑務所でデング・マラリアに続き水痘感染拡大の恐怖、収容者3人がメーラトへ搬送され騒然
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での水痘・デング・マラリア等複数感染症の局地的発生だが、重症度や拡大リスクは限定的であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 刑務所という閉鎖環境での複数感染症（水痘・デング・マラリア・腸チフス・スクラブチフス・豚インフルエンザ）の併発事例。地域の季節性感染症流行（モンスーン期）との関連が示唆されるが、国際的な影響は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Sud-Ubangi - Deux cas d'Ebola confirmés sur fond de grève des médecins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: South Ubangi — Two confirmed Ebola cases amid a doctors' strike.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in Sud-Ubangi province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Provincial Health Division announced this at the eighth epidemiological update meeting. The outbreak, declared on 10 September 2026, remains concentrated in the Gbulu health zone, identified as the epicenter. Authorities continue the response with case detection and isolation, contact tracing, and strengthened surveillance. Separately, doctors in Sud-Ubangi persist with a strike demanding inclusion on the DPS/Sud-Ubangi declaration registry; Dr. Grâce Ngilase reiterates the request, while the Provincial Health Division says the issue falls outside its administrative remit. As Ebola response continues in Gbulu, the doctors’ strike raises concerns for the health sector in Sud-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：南ウバンギ州 — 医師ストライキの中、エボラ確定症例2件
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、医師ストライキによる対応能力低下も重なるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年9月10日に宣言された南ウバンギ州Gbulu保健区を中心としたエボラアウトブレイクの継続事例。医師ストライキにより対応体制への懸念が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna humana sobem em Andradas (MG) - 01/10/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of human scabies rise in Andradas (MG) - October 1, 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of October 1, 2026, human scabies cases rose to 16 in Andradas, Minas Gerais, up from 11, spreading across three early education centers. The first case was identified September 23 at Cemei Nara Favila Pioli, triggering closure for cleaning; it has since reopened. The city will maintain a health professional in schools for pupil inspection and epidemiological follow-up; Cerest will train staff across municipal, state, and private schools, and health surveillance will visit institutions with new suspected cases; parents are urged to seek medical evaluation for suspected cases. Separately, Lagoa Santa, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, reports 20 confirmed cases since September 18 among students at Escola Municipal Professora Mércia Margarida Lacerda Machado in Moradas da Lapinha, with a teacher also treated; classes were suspended. Scabies causes intense nocturnal itch; transmission via prolonged skin contact or contaminated textiles.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラーダス(MG)で疥癬の症例が増加 - 2026年10月1日
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で管理可能な疾患であり、学校単位の局所的流行で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトヒゼンダニによる接触感染症で致死性はなく、学校内クラスターとして地域保健当局が通常の対応（清掃・衛生教育・経過観察）で管理可能。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابة موظف لـ'أطباء بلا حدود' في الكونغو بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders employee infected with Ebola virus in Congo
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) announced on October 1, 2026 that a staff member has been infected with the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus while helping contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The individual will be evacuated safely under a strict medical protocol, in coordination with health authorities in the DRC and the Netherlands, and will be admitted to a hospital in the Netherlands designated for such cases. Government data published on Monday show confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC surpassing 8,000 for the first time since the outbreak began in Central Africa, with the latest Public Health Institute report recording about 8,067 infections and 3,901 deaths. The incident highlights ongoing transmission risk amid a large, sustained outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで国境なき医師団の職員がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,000例・死者約3,900人を超える大規模な継続流行となっており、国境なき医師団職員がオランダへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大・重症度ともに高い。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は医療対応であり、発生国としてはDRCのみを対象国として採用。中央アフリカ地域は国家単位でないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Epidemiológica realiza ação de prevenção e combate a doenças na zona rural de Silveirânia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Surveillance Conducts Disease Prevention and Control Actions in the Rural Area of Silveirânia
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, in Silveirânia, Brazil, the Municipal Health Secretariat's Epidemiological Surveillance conducted an active-search and outreach campaign in the rural zone to prevent Chagas disease, Dengue, and Schistosomiasis. Teams delivered guidance and conducted active case-finding to boost rural population access to information and care, identify risk situations, and educate residents on measures to prevent infection and transmission. The effort aimed to bring health services closer to communities, strengthening ongoing guidance and follow-up by Epidemiological Surveillance. On-site presence enables direct communication, encourages adoption of daily preventive practices, and underscores prevention as a primary strategy against transmissible diseases, dependent on collaboration between public health services and the community. No case or death data are reported; health education and risk identification were highlighted to raise awareness in Silveirânia's rural areas.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学サーベイランスがシルベイラニア農村部で疾病予防・対策活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の報告であり、症例・死亡データの報告はなく、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州シルベイラニアの農村部における、シャーガス病・デング熱・住血吸虫症の予防啓発活動の定例報告であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Itajaí apresenta Método Wolbachia a comerciantes contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itajaí Introduces the Wolbachia Method to Merchants to Fight Dengue
article.articleSummary: Itajaí, Brazil, is rolling out the Wolbachia method for dengue control, with dengue-control teams engaging local merchants to explain the approach and address deployment questions. Teams visit shops and other commercial establishments to describe how the Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes work and to clarify the rollout process. The Wolbachia bacteria reduce the capacity of the mosquitoes to transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses. The public outreach component seeks to broaden access to information about the strategy, which will be implemented in areas of Itajaí. This initiative emphasizes communication and stakeholder engagement in local vector-control efforts to curb arboviral transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイ市、デング対策でウォルバキア法を商店主に紹介
triage.triage_reason: これはデング媒介蚊対策（ウォルバキア法）の普及啓発活動に関する広報記事であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態を示す内容ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング・ジカ・チクングニア予防のためのワクチン・蚊対策技術の普及活動に関する内容で、感染拡大や症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt na lange reis aangekomen in Nederland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient arrives in the Netherlands after a long journey
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus infection has led to the admission of a patient at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in the Netherlands after arriving at Schiphol Airport on Thursday. The patient, who worked as a health-care worker for Doctors Without Borders in the Democratic Republic of Congo, became ill there and was transported to the Netherlands under medical supervision. Due to privacy, no additional personal information is released. Upon arrival at LUMC, the patient is placed in strict isolation in facilities dedicated to severe infectious diseases. Hospital officials say the intake does not pose risks to other patients or visitors. This is an imported case of Ebola virus disease, with the treatment occurring in Leiden and infection control strictly managed at the hospital. No further clinical details or laboratory confirmation are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 長旅の末、エボラ患者がオランダに到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染した医療従事者がエボラ患者としてオランダに空輸・入院した事例であり、IHR基準で複数該当（重篤性・異常性・越境移動）するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はオランダでの輸入エボラ症例の受け入れを主題としているが、実際の感染発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCにおける現地の流行状況・感染源の詳細は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Miles huyen de un campamento afectado por el ébola en el Congo; crece temor a contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands flee from an Ebola-affected camp in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; fear of contagion grows.
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled an Ebola-affected camp in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as security forces entered the Kigonze camp in Ituri province, triggering fears of wider contagion. The camp, once hosting about 19,000 displaced people, is now abandoned after clashes linked to weapon searches. About 1,000 residents had been in contact with Ebola, but only roughly 20% have been located to date, according to Congolese health officials and UN sources. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warned that efforts to stop transmission have been hampered by displacement and security operations. Reuters reported more than 30 deaths in the camp in just over a month, many from Ebola. Compounding containment, a transit center used to isolate, test, and treat suspected Ebola cases was burned, hindering response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染したキャンプから数千人が避難、感染拡大への懸念が増大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者約1000人のうち約80%が追跡不能となり、治療施設が焼失するなど封じ込めが困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 接触者約1000人中約80%が所在不明となっており、治療・隔離施設の焼失も報告されているため、感染拡大リスクが高い。続報でのWHO/UNの対応状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders employee working on Ebola response tests positive for virus
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member working on Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for Ebola and is being evacuated to a hospital in the Netherlands for treatment, authorities said on 2026-10-01. The DRC outbreak, tied to the Bundibugjo virus, has reached 8,224 cases and 3,982 deaths, per a daily Congolese government update. The first case was identified May 15, and this outbreak is the largest in Congo’s history and is likely to become the worst on record, surpassing West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic which killed more than 11,000. Response efforts are hindered by resource shortages after Western aid cuts, ongoing conflict complicating movement of health workers, and mistrust in communities toward doctors and nurses on the ground.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応に従事していた国境なき医師団の職員がウイルス検査で陽性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは史上最大規模（8,224症例、3,982死亡）に達し、MSF職員の国際搬送という形で国際的拡大の実例も確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にオランダ・アンゴラが含まれるが、記事主題はDRCでの発生であり、オランダは患者搬送先、アンゴラは本文に言及なしのため除外。史上最大規模のエボラ流行として西アフリカ2014-16流行の規模を超える見込みとされている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Flávio Bolsonaro, os hospitais federais e a pandemia de Covid no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flávio Bolsonaro, the federal hospitals, and the COVID-19 pandemic in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 hit Rio de Janeiro amid political turbulence around six federal hospitals (Andaraí, Bonsucesso, Cardoso Fontes, Ipanema, Lagoa, Servidores). Allegations link senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to influence over hospital staffing and contracts from 2019–2022; Health Minister Alexandre Padilha later called him the “powerful boss” of these facilities. Rio state recorded over 2.8 million confirmed COVID-19 cases and 77,166 deaths, with 38,8 thousand in the capital. A 235-page Ministry of Health diagnosis (Feb 2023) found 72% of hospital resources (~R$50.3 million/month) spent on maintenance contracts, while 30% of clinical/ICU beds were closed during the surge. By Dec 2020, about 3,500 contracts were terminated; MP 1,022 extended only 1,400 for 60 days. A 2023 audit noted 735 inoperative beds and stalled works; a Bonsucesso fire killed four COVID-19 patients. A militia intrusion and routine management failures marked the period.

triage.headline_ja: フラビオ・ボルソナーロ氏、連邦病院、そしてリオデジャネイロの新型コロナウイルスパンデミック
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2019-2023年のCOVID-19パンデミック期における政治的・行政的スキャンダル（病院運営・汚職疑惑）を扱った回顧的な調査報道であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の現在進行中の脅威を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去(2019-2023年)のCOVID-19パンデミック対応における政治的不正疑惑を扱った調査報道であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクの探知シグナルではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Herpes-zóster já soma mais de 33 mil atendimentos no Brasil em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shingles already has more than 33,000 visits in Brazil in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Shingles (herpes zoster) in Brazil imposes significant health-system burden. Brazilian Ministry of Health data show 2025 nationwide 49,720 outpatient visits and 3,060 hospitalizations related to the disease. In the first half of 2026, visits totaled 33,141 with 1,559 hospitalizations, indicating ongoing substantial service demand. The illness arises from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, typically in individuals who previously had chickenpox. Symptoms include intense pain, burning, tingling, and localized skin blisters, with some complications potentially persisting after lesion resolution. Vaccination is highlighted as a primary preventive measure, and prompt medical care is advised for symptom evaluation and appropriate treatment. The report provides national data but does not specify laboratory confirmation details or imported/exported cases, underscoring continued monitoring of shingles in Brazil during 2025–2026.

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹、2026年ブラジルで既に33,000件以上の受診件数
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹は水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの再活性化による既知の非流行性疾患であり、国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクもなく、通常の医療統計報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 帯状疱疹は再活性化による疾患であり新興感染症ではないため、ブラジルを対象国として記載する意義は薄く、通常の疫学統計報告として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: sete crianças morrem por dia e letalidade nos mais novos atinge 61%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: seven children die each day, and the case fatality rate among the youngest reaches 61%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) continues to cause heavy toll. Seven children die daily; case fatality rate among children under five reaches 61%, higher than the overall 48% CFR for the virus. Since May 15, at least 2,071 pediatric cases and 961 child deaths, nearly one in two infections among this group. The outbreak expanded by about a quarter in just over three weeks, from 6,604 confirmed cases to 8,116 by end-September. Official counts now stand at 8,224 infections and 3,982 deaths. Save the Children warns this is the second deadliest Ebola outbreak in global history. Outside treatment centers, at least 180 children have lost both parents or primary caregivers. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and South Ubangi. No vaccine or specifically approved treatment is available at present.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/コンゴ民主共和国：1日7人の子どもが死亡、最年少層の致死率は61%に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中であり、致死率の高さ・感染拡大・医療体制への負荷など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しない状況。感染地域はイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、南ウバンギの7州63保健地区に及ぶ大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo liga plástico a bactérias em tartarugas no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study links plastic to bacteria in turtles in Rio.
article.articleSummary: Five green sea turtles (Chelonia mydas) from Itaipu Beach, Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, were studied to compare their microbiota with bacteria in environmental plastics. The turtles’ microbiota was more similar to plastic-associated bacteria than to those on algae or in seawater. Bacteria genera found both on plastic and in turtles include Vibrio, Pseudomonas, Bacillus, Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, Chryseobacterium, and Clostridium—groups that include species capable of causing disease in animals and humans. The study did not link these bacteria to disease in the turtles nor confirm pathogenicity at the species level. Plastic waste may be a source of microbes with pathogenic relevance, and green turtles might act as dispersers of marine bacteria, moving microbes across habitats during migration. Five turtles were sampled for Aruanã; work led by Filipe Berbeti, under Henrique Fragoso dos Santos at UFF’s Laboratory of Environmental Microbiology and Microbiotechnology, with participation from UFRJ. Published in Environmental Pollution in August 2026. Agência Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: リオのウミガメにおけるプラスチックと細菌の関連を示す研究
triage.triage_reason: ウミガメの微生物叢に関する学術研究であり、ヒトまたは動物における実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は環境微生物学の学術研究であり、ヒトまたは動物の疾病発生事例ではない。病原性は種レベルで確認されておらず、感染症イベントとしての実質的な内容を含まない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : un membre du personnel de MSF testé positif et évacué médicalement aux Pays-Bas | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: an MSF staff member tested positive and medically evacuated to the Netherlands | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, MSF confirms a staff member involved in the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is being medically evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment at a designated hospital. The evacuation follows a rigorous medical protocol and is coordinated with DRC and Dutch health authorities; no further details will be released to protect the staffer’s privacy. MSF describes the ongoing outbreak as the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded in the DRC, with over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths since May, though the true toll may be higher due to surveillance gaps. Health workers are among the most exposed; MSF has trained personnel and implemented high protection levels, but exposure risk cannot be wholly eliminated. MSF continues response in Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with Congolese authorities and affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース｜DRCでのエボラ出血熱：MSFスタッフ1名が陽性となりオランダへ医療搬送｜mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)の過去最大規模の流行(8,000例超、死者約4,000人)が継続中であり、国際医療搬送事例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: オランダへの医療搬送は人道的対応であり、同国での感染拡大を意味しない。記事の主題はDRCにおける大規模エボラ流行であり、オランダは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ibiá amplia monitoramento do Aedes aegypti com instalação de ovitrampas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibiá expands Aedes aegypti monitoring with installation of ovitraps.
article.articleSummary: Ibiá expands monitoring of the Aedes aegypti mosquito by installing ovitraps to identify areas with higher vector presence and strengthen dengue prevention. The ovitraps detect the dengue and arboviruses vector across different neighborhoods, enabling authorities to monitor distribution within the municipality and target interventions more strategically. This surveillance approach supports municipal efforts to reduce mosquito proliferation and safeguard public health, by guiding where inspections, larval source reduction, and preventive education should be concentrated. The initiative enhances vector monitoring and assists the teams responsible for control activities. The report cites the City Hall of Ibiá and is sourced from Jornal Panorama.

triage.headline_ja: イビアがオビトラップ設置によりネッタイシマカのモニタリングを拡大
triage.triage_reason: 通常のベクターサーベイランス・予防活動の報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の発生事例ではなく、ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州イビア市における蚊媒介対策（オビトラップ設置）の日常的活動報告。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo revela conexão entre bactérias em plásticos e tartarugas no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study reveals a connection between bacteria on plastics and turtles in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil—Five green sea turtles (Chelonia mydas) collected at Itaipu Beach, Niterói, displayed a microbiota more similar to microorganisms on plastic debris than to those in their diet or surrounding seawater. Researchers from the Federal Fluminense University (UFF) in collaboration with UFRJ and the Aruanã turtle-conservation project analyzed microbial communities on the turtles, plastics, seawater, and algae in Guanabara Bay. DNA analysis identified bacterial genera present in both plastics and turtle microbiota, including Vibrio, Pseudomonas, Bacillus, Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, Chryseobacterium and Clostridium. While many of these groups include pathogenic species, the study did not establish a causal link to turtle disease; the findings highlight exposure risk and suggest turtles could act as vectors, dispersing marine bacteria across migratory routes. The work emphasizes the broader health implications of plastic pollution for marine ecosystems in Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでプラスチックに付着する細菌とウミガメの関連性を明らかにした研究
triage.triage_reason: 海洋生物のマイクロバイオームに関する学術研究であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響や感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はウミガメとプラスチック廃棄物上の細菌叢の関連性に関する環境・生態学研究であり、ヒト感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のイベントではないため、対象国リストに該当してもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы может стать самой смертоносной в истории ДРК - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak could become the deadliest in the history of the DRC
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 3,982, with the outbreak affecting seven of the country’s 26 provinces. The crisis began in mid-May 2026 in Ituri province. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a public health emergency of international concern, signaling potential global significance and warning it could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. Official counts may underestimate reality due to diagnostic challenges, inaccessibility of some areas, and ongoing armed conflict that hampers surveillance and care. The African CDC reports more than 50 health workers have died since the outbreak started. The episode is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC; the first human case was recorded in 1976. Epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko notes that Ebola can mutate, underscoring ongoing risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が史上最悪になる可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、DRC史上最悪となる可能性があるエボラ流行で、死者3,982人・7州に拡大しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み、紛争地域での対応困難・医療従事者50名以上死亡など深刻な状況。続報でのPHEIC詳細や国際対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt donderdagavond met ambulancevliegtuig aangekomen op Schiphol
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient arrived at Schiphol Thursday evening by air ambulance.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient, a Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) worker infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport by air ambulance and was transported to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) for isolation and treatment. The patient’s identity was not disclosed. Schiphol's dedicated medical team and the HART-team prepared the patient for transfer to LUMC under strict precautions. The arrival occurred on Thursday evening at Schiphol. LUMC has isolation facilities to manage highly contagious infections. The patient will be treated and isolated at LUMC in Leiden in the coming days. The article does not provide details on symptoms or laboratory confirmation. This represents an imported Ebola case into the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が木曜夜、救急医療機の空路搬送機でスキポール空港に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち『公衆衛生への深刻な影響』と『異常性』の2項目が該当し、コンゴ民主共和国で感染したエボラ患者の国際輸送例としてフルリスク評価の対象とすべきである。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国で感染したMSF職員であり、オランダ（対象国外）に空輸・隔離治療された輸入症例。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源国であるDRCでのアウトブレイク状況（規模・死亡者数等）については記事に記載がなく、背景情報として不明点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: Espírito Santo tem alta de metapneumovírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: Espírito Santo reports rise in human metapneumovirus.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo in Brazil’s Southeast shows an uptick in severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) linked to human metapneumovirus, per Fiocruz InfoGripe Week 38 (Sept 20–26); however, the state is not at alert level or displaying sustained growth. Nationally, Rio de Janeiro and Sergipe have the highest risk, driven by metapneumovirus and rhinovirus in children ≤4 years. Across Brazil, only metapneumovirus and SARS-CoV-2 show an overall upward trend, with COVID-19 remaining low and small increases observed in Acre and São Paulo. In the last four weeks, lab-positive test prevalence was rhinovirus 52.4%, RSV 18.1%, Influenza B 6.7%, SARS-CoV-2 4.0%, and Influenza A 3.2%. Brazil has reported 157,908 SARI cases in 2026. Public health guidance emphasizes monitoring severe respiratory symptoms—high fever, fatigue, and difficulty breathing—especially in children and the elderly, and seeking medical care when needed.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe:エスピリトサント州でヒトメタニューモウイルスの増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症のサーベイランス報告であり、警戒レベルには達しておらず、持続的な増加も認められないため、特段のシグナルとはみなされない。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の定例呼吸器疾患サーベイランス（InfoGripe）報告。警戒レベルに達していないため通常監視範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Katanga : à Pweto, les cas de choléra en baisse, 590 patients guéris sur 622 enregistrés depuis août
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Katanga: In Pweto, cholera cases are down, 590 patients cured out of 622 recorded since August.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Pweto territory, Haut-Katanga, Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared on August 26. Total cases reached 622, with 590 recoveries and 26 deaths; 14 active cases remain at the Cholera Treatment Center. The incidence curve is downward, after periods with about 50 patients at the CTC. Improvements follow strengthened treatment and government-supplied medical inputs, alongside intensified support from provincial authorities and health partners. Pweto is a lake district over 400 km from Lubumbashi. Health authorities urge continued adherence to hygiene measures to prevent a resurgence of cholera.

triage.headline_ja: オー・カタンガ州：プウェトでコレラ症例が減少、8月以降の記録622例中590例が回復
triage.triage_reason: DRCハウト・カタンガ州プウェトで継続中のコレラ流行（8月26日発生）に関する経過報告で、症例は減少傾向にあるが死亡者（26名）も出ており水系感染のリスクが残るため、新規シグナルというより既存アウトブレイクの推移を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のコレラアウトブレイク（8月26日宣言）の経過フォローアップであり、症例数は減少傾向、政府・保健パートナーの支援で改善中。新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、再燃リスクに備え継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia capacita equipes sobre febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia trains teams on spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (Febre Maculosa) training for Hortolândia's municipal health network occurred in September, with updated diagnostic and treatment protocols and a presentation from the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit. Epidemiological Surveillance notes transmission by ticks in green areas near streams, with ticks found on animals such as capybaras and horses; symptoms include high fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, malaise, and red macules on wrists and ankles that can spread to palms and soles. Progression can be rapid and may be fatal, necessitating medical evaluation and avoidance of self-medication. In September, SAMU conducted trainings in Paulínia on airway obstruction by a foreign body and CPR, with 15 Civil Guard instructors to disseminate the protocols. At Hospital Mario Covas, onboarding, patient-safety goals, pharmaceutical requests, and a culture of surveillance were among September activities, plus mental health guidance, dog-therapy visits, and home-oxygen therapy training via PADO, in partnership with Unasp Hortolândia.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディアが紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）について医療チームに研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、自治体保健ネットワーク向けの診断・治療プロトコルに関する定例研修の記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は紅斑熱（febre maculosa）に関する医療従事者向け研修内容の紹介であり、具体的な患者数や流行状況の報告はない。ブラジルでは本疾患は既知の風土病であり、通常の予防啓発活動の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: LUMC in Leiden vangt patiënt op met ebolabesmetting
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LUMC in Leiden takes in a patient with Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infection: Leiden's LUMC is preparing to receive a patient who became ill while serving as an aid worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient was flown to the Netherlands on a special flight and is being treated in strict isolation at LUMC. The hospital's department for severe infectious diseases is equipped with dedicated isolation rooms and all necessary protective equipment, and staff follow strict isolation protocols to prevent transmission. LUMC maintains specialized isolation facilities and conducts regular drills to stay prepared for the arrival of patients with potentially serious diseases. Visitation is considered safe, with no additional precautions required for visitors; they may continue to visit as usual.

triage.headline_ja: ライデンのLUMC、エボラ感染患者を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラウイルスに感染した援助従事者がオランダに搬送され、特別な隔離体制で治療を受けている。エボラという重篤な疾患の国境を越えた移動を伴う事例であり、IHR基準の複数該当が想定されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで援助活動中にエボラに感染したとされ、同国内でのエボラ発生状況の裏付けとなる情報。オランダ（対象国外）は除外し、感染源国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。DRC国内の発生状況・規模については記事内に詳細情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças do El Niño reforçam a atenção à prevenção da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño Changes Reinforce the Focus on Dengue Prevention
article.articleSummary: El Niño 2026–2027 is forecast to reach very strong intensity (>90% likelihood) between spring and early summer, raising Brazil’s temperatures and expanding Aedes aegypti breeding as dengue season begins in October 2026. Dengue risk is higher in the South, Southeast, and North, with São Paulo and Minas Gerais likely to see an earlier season. Qdenga vaccination is available for 4–60-year-olds (two doses, 3 months apart); contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, severe allergy to the vaccine or components, and severe immunodeficiency or chemotherapy. Prior dengue infection does not guarantee protection against all four serotypes. Rapid tests for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya aid prompt diagnosis and public health response. Avoid NSAIDs and acetylsalicylic acid to reduce hemorrhage risk; use hydration and acetaminophen as needed, with medical follow-up for alarm signs. Protective repellents (icaridine preferred; DEET from age 2; IR3535 from 6 months) and eliminating standing water remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの変化がデング熱予防への注意を強化
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョに伴うデング熱流行拡大の予測記事であり、予防啓発が主目的で現時点での異常な大規模発生報告ではないが、季節性拡大のリスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はエルニーニョ現象によるデング熱流行季節の早期化・拡大予測と予防策（ワクチン、虫除け、迅速検査等）の啓発記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patiënt veilig aangekomen op LUMC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient safely arrived at LUMC.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient from the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in Leiden on 1 October 2026. The patient is a Dutch aid worker who had been in Congo helping Ebola patients and contracted the virus. The infected individual flew from Beni Airport to Schiphol, arriving around 19:40, then was transported by ambulance to LUMC. The patient will be treated in isolation in a department prepared for severe infectious diseases. Precautions are taken immediately for suspected cases, with isolation rooms, ample protective equipment, and strict protocols; LUMC staff regularly drills for such scenarios. In Congo, the outbreak has reported over 8,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths, with the virus spreading rapidly in recent weeks across Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者、LUMC（ライデン大学医療センター）に無事到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,000例・死亡約4,000人という大規模かつ急速に拡大するエボラ流行があり、国際的な患者搬送も発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準複数該当でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はオランダへの患者搬送を主題としているが、感染症イベントの発生源・主たる流行地はコンゴ民主共和国（中央アフリカ）であり、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率約50%の大規模流行であり、国際的拡大・ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ONU denuncia la quema de centro contra ébola en un campamento con 19.000 personas en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN condemns the burning of an Ebola treatment center in a camp housing 19,000 people in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: UN condemns the burning of an Ebola treatment center inside Kigonze camp, housing about 19,000 displaced people in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after gunfire amid military/radical clashes. The blaze destroys a key entry point for Ebola care, complicating response as roughly 1,000 direct contacts of Ebola patients were in the camp, with only 20% traced due to mass displacement. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths as of 29 September, with 2,212 recoveries and 851 patients hospitalized or isolated. Affected areas span 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. The outbreak is the second deadliest in history; security deteriorations include killings of health workers in Lubero and attacks in Rhoe camp in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、DRCで19,000人が避難する難民キャンプ内のエボラ治療センター放火を非難
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）がDRC東部で8,224例・3,982死亡と史上2番目に深刻な流行となっており、治安悪化による接触者追跡の困難化と人道アクセスの制限が国際的拡大リスクを高めている。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（武力衝突・医療従事者殺害）により接触者追跡率が20%にとどまり、感染拡大のリスクが高い。既存の大規模流行であり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: पहले डेंगू की मार, फिर करें हॉस्पिटल में बेड का इंतजार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue hits first, then you wait for a bed in the hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of October 1, 2026, Prayagraj (Allahabad) reports 83 dengue cases—up from 67 on September 30, with 35 on September 18 and 49 on September 24. Belly Hospital’s dengue ward has 20 beds (8 for general dengue; the rest for NH-positive patients), and new patients often wait as beds fill; officials say other wards could be reserved if needed. Cases span Salori, Govindpur, Teliyarganj, Rasulabad, Rajapur, and Chhota Baghada, including students in rented rooms and hostels where water-filled coolers, planters, and containers breed mosquitoes. Seven zonal rapid-response teams inspect homes, destroy larvae, and spray anti-larva measures; 10,000 homes surveyed with 32 larval positives. Fogging is underway in affected areas. Post-monsoon humidity and residual water sustain Aedes breeding into October, necessitating surveillance, anti-larva efforts, and public participation. Historical note: Oct–Nov 2022 saw 708 and 549 cases, respectively.

triage.headline_ja: まずデング熱の猛威、その後は病院のベッド待ち
triage.triage_reason: プラヤグラージ（アラハバード）での季節性デング熱症例増加と病床逼迫が報告されているが、インド北部で例年見られる雨季後の流行パターンの範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な公衆衛生上の異常性は確認できないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はウッタル・プラデーシュ州プラヤグラージ（アラハバード）における季節性デング熱の増加と病床不足を報じる地方紙の記事。2022年の同時期と比較して症例数は依然低く、地元当局による蚊媒介対策（幼虫駆除・燻蒸）が実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。国際的拡大や異常事態の兆候はなく、インドにおける通常の季節性デング熱流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Drones são utilizados no mapeamento de possíveis focos do Aedes aegypti em Limeira do Oeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drones are used in mapping possible Aedes aegypti foci in Limeira do Oeste.
article.articleSummary: Drone-assisted mapping of Aedes aegypti foci is being implemented in Limeira do Oeste, Triângulo Mineiro, Brazil. Techdengue uses drones with georeferenced imagery and data analysis to identify potential breeding sites in hard-to-reach areas, guiding inspection and elimination efforts to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The approach complements fieldwork by targeting locations not easily accessed during conventional visits, strengthening vector surveillance and response. The municipality’s Health Secretariat supports integrating technology with public health actions; residents are encouraged to prevent water accumulation in containers such as tanks, yards, tires, and other receptacles that can serve as breeding sites. This initiative demonstrates how technology augments traditional vector control, prioritizing areas with access challenges and using geospatial data to direct control measures.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ・ド・オエステでドローンを使用したネッタイシマカ発生源のマッピング
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介ベクター対策の技術導入に関する一般的な記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の報告がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの一地域における予防的なベクターサーベイランス技術（ドローン活用）の紹介であり、具体的な感染症発生や患者数の報告はない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事内容が通常の予防活動報告であるため該当国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hulpverlener met ebola aangekomen in ziekenhuis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aid worker with Ebola arrived at hospital.
article.articleSummary: On 1 October 2026, a Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) worker infected with Ebola arrived at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in the Netherlands after being repatriated by private aircraft from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient’s identity was not disclosed. The infection occurred during a broadcast in the DRC. The patient is hospitalized in strict isolation at LUMC, with the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) confirming isolation and noting that neither patients nor visitors are at risk. LUMC officials say they are prepared for intake, screening and care of Ebola patients. Visiting the hospital is allowed. MSF states that the arrival of an Ebola patient does not pose a danger to people in the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に感染した援助従事者が病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり、DRCでの感染が国際的な患者搬送（オランダへの空輸）という形で既に国境を越えて波及している。IHR基準の複数該当が見込まれる。
triage.notes: 記事はオランダに搬送された患者について報じているが、感染はDRC国内で発生したものであり、DRCにおけるエボラ発生状況の続報確認が必要。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pilibhit News: रसियाखानपुर में डेंगू संभावित लक्षण वाले 14 मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pilibhit News: 14 patients with suspected dengue found in Rasia Khanpur.
article.articleSummary: 14 patients with suspected dengue or malaria symptoms were identified in Rasia Khanpur village, Pilibhit district, during the ninth day of a district health department camp targeting dengue and malaria prevention. The camp screened locals for dengue and malaria and reinforced mosquito-control, sanitation, and removal of standing water to curb transmission. Health workers urged residents with fever to seek prompt testing and treatment at the nearest health center. The ongoing initiative involves repeated camps and source-reduction activities to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and protect the community in Rasia Khanpur and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: ピリービート・ニュース:ラシヤーカーンプルでデング熱疑いの症状を持つ患者14人が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 地域の健康キャンプによる日常的なデング・マラリア予防活動の一環であり、疑い症例14人という規模も小さく、重症度や異常性を示す情報もないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は地方の予防キャンプ活動を報じるローカルニュースであり、デング・マラリアの流行拡大や重症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo chega a 40 casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 40 measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state reach 40 in 2026, with three new cases this week. Of the total, 30 have no vaccination history or incomplete schedules; the latest cases include a 21-year-old man and a 1-year-old girl with one dose registered, and an 18-year-old man with no vaccination record. Geographically, 36 are in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André, clustering in densely populated, migratory-flow areas. New cases link to transmission chains identified since June, with surveillance indicating a downward transmission trend. The measles-mumps-rubella (triple vaccine) is available at all primary health units across São Paulo’s 645 municipalities. First-dose coverage rose from 86.56% to 93.24% (April–July); second-dose rose from 72.72% to 78.37%. About 60% of cases are under 2 years; emphasis on zero-dose vaccination in certain cities. Adults should verify and update vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹症例が40件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国内流行は継続しているが、サーベイランスでは減少傾向が示され、ワクチン接種率も改善しており、重篤例や国際拡大の兆候は報告されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 未接種者や接種歴不完全者が多数を占めるが、ワクチン接種率上昇と伝播減少傾向が確認されており、地域当局による対応が進行中。続報での推移確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt aangekomen bij ziekenhuis en in strikte isolatie opgenomen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient arrives at hospital and is admitted to strict isolation.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient, a healthcare worker who had been stationed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, arrived at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) and was admitted to strict isolation. The transport to the hospital was escorted by the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee. Privacy rules prevent disclosure of the patient’s identity. LUMC reports it has specialized isolation facilities for severe infectious diseases, and the admission poses no impact on other patients or visitors, who need not take additional precautions. The event highlights ongoing vigilance for Ebola among returning healthcare workers; no broader outbreak or community transmission is indicated in the report. No details on symptoms, onset date, or expected length of stay were provided.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で活動していた医療従事者がエボラ疑いでオランダの病院に厳重隔離入院した事例であり、重篤性・異常性・国境を越えた移動という複数のIHR基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断する。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra novos casos de sarampo e total chega a 40
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports new measles cases, and the total reaches 40.
article.articleSummary: As of October 1, 2026, São Paulo State Health Department reports 40 measles cases in 2026, with 36 in the capital city of São Paulo and the remainder in neighboring municipalities: two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one each in Guarulhos and Santo André. Three of the new cases are residents of the capital — two men aged 18 and 21, and a one-year-old infant. Transmission chains have been identified and monitored since June. About 90% of infections are in the capital, and 30 of the 40 cases involve people without vaccination or with incomplete vaccination. The state emphasizes vaccination with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) triple vaccine, provided free by Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) and available at Basic Health Units across all 645 municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹の新規症例、累計40人に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国内感染連鎖が継続しており、未接種者が多いためさらなる拡大の可能性があるが、現時点では重症度や国際的拡大の情報がなく、フルRRA相当の深刻性は確認できない。
triage.notes: 6月から続く国内の感染連鎖で、未接種者・不完全接種者が症例の75%を占める。州保健当局がワクチン接種を強化対応中。重症度（入院・死亡）の情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Seafood exports reach Rs 73,890 crore, Centre steps up disease surveillance - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: India's seafood exports surged to Rs 73,890.46 crore in 2025-26, up from Rs 30,213 crore in 2013-14, underscoring the role of aquatic animal health in maintaining market access. At a National Surveillance Programme for Aquatic Animal Diseases (NSPAAD) review chaired by Fisheries Secretary Abhilaksh Likhi, the Centre highlighted steps to institutionalize NSPAAD under PMMSY and boost state participation, stakeholder coordination, and disease-reporting adoption. Representatives from MPEDA and the Export Inspection Council pressed for closer integration with surveillance to meet international sanitary requirements and access new markets. Since its inception in 2013 and nationwide expansion in 2022, NSPAAD has strengthened early-warning and response systems and facilitated the first-time detection and confirmation of 15 emerging and exotic aquatic animal diseases in India, enhancing credibility in global aquatic health reporting and supporting export readiness.

triage.headline_ja: 水産物輸出額が738億9,046万ルピーに到達、中央政府が疾病サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 水産物輸出促進と水生動物疾病サーベイランス体制の制度的強化に関する行政報告であり、具体的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態やヒトへの健康影響は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は水産物輸出増加と水生動物疾病監視プログラム（NSPAAD）の制度強化に関する経済・行政ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Healthy practices first line of defence against communicable diseases: Pathak
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, India — Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak launched a special communicable disease control campaign at Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences, urging coordinated efforts across health, other departments, and the public to prevent and control communicable diseases. The initiative runs Oct 1–31, with a door-to-door 'Dastak' campaign Oct 12–31. Health teams will visit households to spread awareness, identify health risks, and provide information on prevention and early detection. Emphasizing cleanliness, safe drinking water, prevention of water stagnation, and mosquito breeding control, the campaign includes sanitation drives and fogging vehicle deployments. Pathak noted past Japanese encephalitis in eastern Uttar Pradesh and said coordinated interventions since 2017 have largely brought it under control. He urged daily hygiene and prompt medical attention. Senior officials attended.

triage.headline_ja: 健康的な習慣が感染症対策の第一線:パタック副首相
triage.triage_reason: 過去の日本脳炎流行への言及と予防啓発キャンペーンの発表であり、新規の症例急増や異常な公衆衛生事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の日本脳炎対策の成功事例を背景にした一般的な感染症予防キャンペーンの発表であり、現在進行中の発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Drone é utilizado no combate a possíveis criadouros do Aedes aegypti em Planura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A drone is used in the fight against possible Aedes aegypti breeding sites in Planura.
article.articleSummary: Drone-assisted health surveillance in Planura, Triângulo Mineiro, Brazil, targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The Planura Municipality Health Department uses drone overflights to map areas likely to harbor water-containing containers, pools, or materials that can collect water, including closed properties and hard-to-inspect sites. The resulting imagery guides the Endemic Disease Control Agents in prioritizing interventions and conducting active searches, resident guidance, and cleanup or treatment of premises. Drones complement but do not replace field visits. The effort aims to strengthen health surveillance and make vector control more targeted to curb transmission of dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. Community participation is emphasized: prevent standing water, keep water tanks covered, remove water-holding containers, maintain clean yards, and assist during agent visits. The initiative focuses on priority areas identified by surveillance teams to reduce mosquito breeding and disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: プラヌーラでネッタイシマカの発生源対策にドローンを活用
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ベクター対策活動の報道であり、具体的な症例報告や流行拡大の兆候がないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、ブラジル・プラヌーラ市におけるドローンを用いた蚊の発生源監視・予防活動の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo chega a 40 casos em SP; 90% estão na capital - Hora de S. Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles reaches 40 cases in SP; 90% are in the capital - Hora de São Paulo
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state reaches 40 confirmed cases by Oct 1, 2026, with 36 in the capital (90% of total). CVE-SP reports two cases in São Bernardo do Campo, one in Guarulhos, and one in Santo André. Among new cases are two men aged 18 and 21 and a 1-year-old infant, all residents of the capital, linked to transmission chains identified since June. Transmission appears downward, with Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo monitoring end of chains. Vaccination concerns: 30 of 40 cases involve unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated individuals. MMR vaccine is provided free by SUS at UBS across 645 municipalities. Recommendations: 12-month first dose, 15-month second dose; ages 15 months–29 years require two doses; 30–59 years at least one; healthcare workers two doses. A dose zero may be given to infants 6–11 months after exposure in SP, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo, but does not replace routine doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹40例に到達、90%は州都に集中 - Hora de São Paulo
triage.triage_reason: ヒト-ヒト感染チェーンが継続し未接種者が多いためWPRO基準（流行しやすさ・曝露継続）に該当するが、症例数は少なく重症例報告もなく、地域保健当局により管理されているためフルRRAには至らない。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州保健当局（CVE-SP）が感染チェーンを監視中で、伝播は減少傾向。未接種者が30/40例を占めるため、ワクチン接種率向上が今後の鍵。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases: सप्टेंबर ठरला डेंग्यूचा 'हॉटस्पॉट'! संशयितांचा आकडा १५०० पार, आरोग्य यंत्रणा सतर्क
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases: September has turned into dengue's 'hotspot'! Suspected cases cross 1,500, health system on alert.
article.articleSummary: September 2026 data from Pimpri-Chinchwad city, Maharashtra, show a dengue surge. In the first nine months (January–September), dengue cases total 122, with 70 confirmed in September alone. The NVBDCP monthly report records 1,503 suspected dengue cases in September, up from 957 in August, indicating a sharp monthly rise (August: 37 lab-confirmed dengue cases; September: ~70). No dengue deaths were reported over January–September. Malaria diagnoses in January–September total 28. Fever surveillance across the period involved 357,803 tests; in September, 43,676 tests were conducted with 8 infections detected (disease not specified in that line). Authorities emphasize preventive measures: avoid standing water, regularly clean water containers, and seek prompt medical evaluation for fever. No imported/exported case information provided.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例：9月はデング熱の「ホットスポット」に！疑い例が1500件を突破、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハーラーシュトラ州で季節性のデング熱症例が増加しているが、死亡報告はなく、例年の季節的流行の範囲内とみられるため、フルRRAには至らないが経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、地域の季節性デング熱流行。マラリアも低水準で併記されているが主要な懸念材料ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose em cães exige atenção em Sorocaba | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canine Leishmaniasis Demands Attention in Sorocaba | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Canine leishmaniasis in Sorocaba, Brazil, is being monitored by the municipal Zoonoses. In 2024 the city recorded 14 canine cases; 2025 saw 32; by 2026, 12 cases had been reported to date. Transmission occurs via the bite of an infected female sand fly (mosquito-palha) that can transfer Leishmania after feeding on an infected animal. Sand flies seek shaded areas with accumulated organic matter, so home cleaning is a preventive measure. Zoonoses follows confirmed cases, conducts examinations, and collects samples for diagnosis; suspected street animals may be notified and tested. Symptoms include appetite loss, weight loss, apathy, fever, eye changes, skin lesions, overgrown nails, and lymph node enlargement; some dogs are asymptomatic, and signs can appear months or years after infection. Prevention emphasizes environmental hygiene, veterinary follow-up, and repellents or products advised by a veterinarian to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバで犬のリーシュマニア症に注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 動物（犬）のリーシュマニア症に関する地域的な獣医学的報告であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は犬のリーシュマニア症に関する動物衛生当局の監視報告であり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tumori: nel mondo 1 caso su 8 è legato a infezioni | HealthDesk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cancers: worldwide one in eight cases is linked to infections | HealthDesk
article.articleSummary: Worldwide in 2024, about 2.3 million cancer cases—roughly 12% of the global total—were attributable to infections, many preventable. An IARC study in Lancet Oncology evaluated cancers linked to twelve oncogenic agents; the largest burdens come from Helicobacter pylori, causing about 760,000 gastric cancers, and human papillomavirus (HPV), responsible for about 750,000 cancers (notably cervical cancer and tumors of the anus, penis, and head-and-neck). Hepatitis B virus accounts for ~360,000 cases, Epstein-Barr virus ~260,000, and hepatitis C virus ~160,000. Together, these five agents constitute the vast majority of infection-related cancers. Prevention emphasizes HPV and HBV vaccination, testing and treatment for H. pylori and hepatitis viruses, and HPV-related cancer screening, yet uptake remains limited in many low- and middle-income countries. Geographically, over 75% occur in LMICs; East Asia accounts for 42% of these cancers, driven by H. pylori and HBV, while Sub-Saharan Africa bears high HPV and HHV-8-related cancers, compounded by HIV.

triage.headline_ja: がん：世界の症例の8件に1件が感染症に関連
triage.triage_reason: 感染症と発がんリスクに関する世界的な疫学研究の紹介記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はIARC/Lancet Oncologyによる世界全体の感染症関連がん負担に関する統計研究の報道であり、特定の国・地域でのアウトブレイクや急性感染症イベントではない。発生地域にChina(Shanghai)が付与されているが、記事中で中国固有の事象として特筆されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas tem 32 bairros com maior risco para dengue; confira a relação e faça a sua parte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas has 32 neighborhoods at the highest risk of dengue; check the list and do your part.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campinas, Brazil: 4,053 cases reported from January 1 to September 28, 2026, with no deaths. The 40th Arboviroses Alert lists 32 neighborhoods at highest transmission risk across the Leste, Noroeste, Norte, Sudoeste, Sul, and Suleste regions, including Vila Itapura, Jardim Garcia, Bonfim, Jardim Puccamp, and Parque Jambeiro. Vector is Aedes aegypti; no imported or exported cases noted. From January 1 to September 23, 2026, health teams conducted 1,270,445 home visits to eliminate breeding sites and performed fogging at 53,382 locations. Public health guidance urges community participation: remove standing water inside and around homes, change water in plant pots every two days, clean plant saucers weekly, seal water tanks, and close unused toilets. Approximately 80% of breeding sites occur inside residences.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスでデング熱の高リスク地区32か所、リストを確認し対策を
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナスにおけるデング熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、死亡例なし、ブラジルでは地方病的に流行する疾患であり異常性は低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地方病的に流行する疾患であり、本記事は地域保健当局による定例の媒介動物対策・啓発活動の報告。死亡例なし、輸入・輸出症例もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Município mineiro investiga 16 casos suspeitos de sarna em escolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais municipality investigates 16 suspected cases of scabies in schools.
article.articleSummary: Sixteen suspected scabies cases are under investigation in three units in Andradas, southern Minas Gerais, Brazil. The investigation is led by the Municipal Health and Education Secretariats, with Vigilance in Health, Sanitary Surveillance, and Epidemiological Surveillance coordinating prevention. The update followed a Sept 30 meeting; the first case was identified Sept 23 in a daycare. The facility closed 72 hours for cleaning; classes were suspended Sept 28 and resumed Sept 29. Since identification, educational materials have been distributed to public and private schools via messaging apps, outlining institutional precautions and family actions. Health teams visited the first site; parents are advised to seek medical evaluation for symptomatic children. Planned measures include health-professional presence in schools for inspection, staff training across Andradas by Cerest, and visits to facilities with suspected cases, with monitoring. Intense itching, especially at night, is a symptom; transmission is via skin-to-skin contact and sharing contaminated items.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の自治体、学校での疥癬疑い16例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で管理可能な皮膚疾患であり、地域の保健当局が既に対応・制御しているため、国際的拡大リスクや重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染するが重症度は低く、既に地元自治体（保健・教育局）が隔離・消毒・教育啓発を実施済み。外部支援の必要性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: EUA confirmam 5ª morte por sarampo em 2026; queda na vacinação causou pior surto em 35 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. confirms fifth measles death in 2026; decline in vaccination caused the worst outbreak in 35 years.
article.articleSummary: Measles deaths rise in the United States. By Oct 1, 2026, the US confirms its fifth measles death in 2026, a Lancaster County, Pennsylvania resident who was unvaccinated. Lancaster County’s large Amish community is noted for low vaccination rates. Since January, more than 3,650 measles cases have been confirmed nationwide, with Pennsylvania accounting for over 900; the national total is the highest since measles elimination in 2000 and the worst outbreak in about 35 years. Five Pennsylvania deaths have occurred since August, including two infants, an 18-year-old, a 40-year-old woman, and the latest Lancaster resident. Measles symptoms include fever, respiratory issues, and rash; pneumonia and encephalitis are possible complications. In Brazil, Sao Paulo State reports 40 measles cases in 2026, with three new cases in the capital this week; 30 patients are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Cases are linked to transmission chains identified since June, with signs of reduced transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で2026年の麻疹による5人目の死亡を確認；ワクチン接種率の低下が35年ぶりの最悪の流行を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 米国で35年ぶりの最大規模の麻疹流行があり死亡者も複数発生しているため、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）が2つ以上該当し、ブラジルでも関連する麻疹症例が報告されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国（ペンシルベニア州）の麻疹流行だが、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル・サンパウロ州の麻疹症例（40例、未ワクチン接種者多数）が言及されているため、verified_locationsにBrazilを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : quatre morts après avoir mangé de la viande de singe, Ebola et crises sécuritaires secouent l'Afrique - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Four Dead After Eating Monkey Meat, Ebola and Security Crises Shake Africa - Cameroun24.net News Updates
article.articleSummary: Four people died in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after eating monkey meat in Munsanga; symptoms appeared within 24 hours and others were hospitalized and watched closely as investigators seek the animal source and handling details. Separately, MSF says a staff member involved in the Ebola response in DRC tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a medical evacuation to the Netherlands planned under strict protocol; identity not disclosed. The DRC Ebola outbreak remains active in Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé, with government figures of 8,116 cases and 3,924 deaths across seven provinces; Uganda had earlier declared the outbreak over on 28 July, later confirmed by WHO on 25 August. In Sudan, a drone strike on a dormitory at El Obeid University killed five civilians and injured 47, attributed to the RSF. Ethiopia–Eritrea tensions include Ethiopia expelling 10 Eritrean diplomats and closing its embassy in Asmara, while attention also centers on the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam on the Blue Nile and related Ethiopian projects blocked by Egyptian opposition.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:サルの肉を食べた後4人死亡、エボラと治安危機がアフリカを揺るがす

triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクを主題としており、MSFスタッフの感染・国際医療避難（オランダへ）が報告されている。サルの肉摂取後の死亡事例は原因病原体不明で、エボラとの直接関連は記事上明示されていない。スーダン・エリトリア・エチオピア・UAE・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dr Nishant wins award for TB research poster presentation - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) research award: Dr Nishant won second prize for best TB poster at a one-day conference organized by Sri Guru Ram Das University of Health Sciences and Research in Amritsar. A resident of Ward No. 3, Nurpur, he serves in the Department of Biochemistry at Dr Radhakrishnan Government Medical College, Hamirpur. His presentation covered host–pathogen interactions, genetics, and molecular mechanisms of TB, underscoring the potential of molecular research to improve TB diagnosis and treatment. The award was presented by Dr Sahiba Kukreja, Head of Biochemistry at the organizing university. The conference drew researchers from multiple states and medical institutions. Dr Nishant has international recognition for TB work in 2024 and advocates expanding regional research data to unlock insights from India’s genetic and geographic diversity to advance TB science.

triage.notes: 記事は結核の発生状況やアウトブレイクに関するものではなく、学術会議でのポスター発表受賞に関する人物紹介記事であるため、感染症シグナルとしての対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue mantém queda, mas São Carlos soma 432 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue remains in decline, but São Carlos records 432 cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains the predominant arboviral disease in São Carlos, Brazil, with 432 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 as of the 1 October epidemiological bulletin. This represents a 98% reduction from 2025, when 19,828 cases were reported. Overall arbovirus notifications fell 87% to 3,669 this year, compared with 27,390 in the same period last year. The bulletin counts confirmed, pending results, and discarded cases together. No dengue deaths have been reported in 2026. Among other arboviruses, there are no confirmed chikungunya, zika, or yellow fever cases; however, 222 chikungunya, 200 zika, and 33 yellow fever cases were discarded after investigation. Although the drop is substantial, prevention remains essential, stressing Aedes aegypti control and eliminating standing water to avert new cases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱は減少傾向続くも、サンカルロスで432例に
