article.articleHeadline: QC logs alarming dengue cases spike
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Quezon City, Philippines, reports a sharp surge with 5,589 infections and 24 related deaths from January 1 to September 24, 2026, per a municipal surveillance report by the Quezon City Epidemiology and Surveillance Division. The case fatality rate is 0.43%. Although the tally is 35% below the 8,600 cases recorded in the same period in 2025, weekly infection rates have risen in recent morbidity weeks, signaling an ongoing outbreak phase. The data indicate rising transmission despite an overall year-to-date decline compared to last year, prompting heightened vigilance and public health measures at the city level. This underscores escalating weekly infection rates despite an overall year-to-date decline.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン市、デング熱症例が警戒すべき急増を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はフィリピンの風土病であり本記事も自治体の定例サーベイランス報告だが、直近週での感染率上昇が指摘されており動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で流行性疾患であり、2025年同期比では症例数は35%減少しているが、直近週の感染率上昇が指摘されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Escola municipal suspende aulas após surto de sarna; 20 casos foram registrados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal school suspends classes after scabies outbreak; 20 cases were reported.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 20 confirmed cases at a municipal school. Classes were suspended on Oct 1–2 to enable cleaning and sanitization and to curb transmission; one additional case outside the school was also confirmed. The first alert appeared on Sept 18 when a student developed symptoms; since then, students and staff have been sidelined for suspected or diagnosed scabies. The Education Secretariat says transmission is difficult to interrupt, with some families continuing to send children to school after diagnosis, contributing to spread. Health authorities began on-site evaluation and care for students on Sept 29, with doctors and nurses at the school upon parental authorization. Measures aim to protect students and staff and prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 市立学校、疥癬の集団発生により休校措置（20件の症例が報告される）
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤な疾患ではなく、学校単位での限定的な発生であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚疾患であり、学校内でのローカルな集団発生に留まる。地域保健当局により対応可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Badaun News: अब इस्लामनगर इलाके में फैला बुखार, जगत पीपरी में डेंगू के पांच मरीज निकले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Badaun News: Fever has spread in the Islamnagar area; five dengue patients detected in Jagatpipri.
article.articleSummary: Fever outbreaks in Badaun District, Uttar Pradesh, with dengue detections in Islamnagar block. In Jagat Pipri village, 270 residents were tested at a health camp; five suspected dengue cases were identified by rapid testing, with ELISA samples sent to the district hospital for confirmation. District Malaria Officer Amit Tiwari led anti-larval spraying and fogging, and conducted house-to-house larval surveys; schoolchildren were educated on mosquito-borne disease prevention. In Mudhiya Satasi village of Wazirganj block, six dengue cases were detected by rapid testing, with ELISA samples sent for confirmation. A second-day camp screened over 50 fever patients, but no additional dengue or malaria cases were found. No malaria cases were detected in Jagat Pipri. Ongoing surveillance, vector control, and community awareness are in place to curb spread as of 1 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Badaunニュース:イスラムナガル地区で発熱が拡大、ジャガットピプリでデング熱患者5名確認
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の一地区における限定的なデング熱疑い症例の集積で、地元当局による監視・対策が実施中だが、重症度や拡大の兆候は明確でなく情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱疑い症例は迅速検査のみで確定診断（ELISA）待ち。地元保健当局が媒介蚊対策・サーベイランスを実施中であり、地域的流行の可能性はあるが重症度・拡大規模は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Actor Manuel Masalva sufre amputación de los dedos de sus pies; así fue la tragedia que vivió tras quedar en coma por una bacteria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actor Manuel Masalva suffers amputation of his toes; this is how the tragedy he endured unfolded after falling into a coma due to a bacterial infection.
article.articleSummary: Mexican actor Manuel Masalva survived a severe bacterial infection acquired during travel in the Philippines and Dubai that triggered an induced coma. After awakening, doctors found his feet severely damaged, with necrosis and gangrene leading to toe amputation. He spent 105 days hospitalized, undergoing multiple surgeries as the infection affected his bloodstream and other organs. He returned to Mexico in mid-2025 and now walks with prosthetic feet, continuing long rehabilitation. His recovery spans physical, mental, and emotional dimensions, and he reflects on faith and meaning after a near-death experience, acknowledging lasting changes in how he moves and lives.

triage.headline_ja: 俳優マヌエル・マサルバ氏、足指切断を経験――細菌感染による昏睡から生還した悲劇の全貌
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の既往症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや流行の兆候は見られない。個別事例のため疫学的シグナルとしての価値は低い。
triage.notes: 単一の個人（メキシコ人俳優）が旅行中にフィリピン・ドバイで細菌感染症に罹患したという個人エピソードであり、病原体や集団発生の情報はない。公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Herpes-zóster: ES soma 620 casos de varicela e surtos locais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Herpes zoster: Espírito Santo totals 620 varicella cases and local outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Varicella-zoster virus causes both chickenpox (varicella) and shingles (herpes zoster). In Espírito Santo, Brazil, epidemiological surveillance reports 620 confirmed varicella cases with an incidence of 16.19 per 100,000 population (3,833,712 residents, IBGE 2022). The 23 September 2026 Lacen-ES bulletin notes heterogeneous, location-specific activity rather than a single statewide outbreak. From Jan 4 to Sep 5, 2026, 390 molecular tests for varicella-zoster virus were performed; 117 were positive (30%). Age groups 12–18 and 19–30 years showed the highest detection; sex distribution was 52.14% male, 47.86% female. Vaccination against herpes zoster is not yet provided by SUS; private-sector prices range roughly from R$850 to R$975 per dose. A Senate bill (PL 4.426/2025) would include the shingles vaccine in the SUS calendar, but it remains pending. The article distinguishes varicella infection from shingles reactivation.

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹：エスピリトサント州で水痘620例及び局地的流行が確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・エスピリトサント州における水痘（水疱瘡）の定例サーベイランス報告であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 水痘は既にSUS定期接種に含まれる既知の感染症であり、本記事は地域保健局の定例疫学速報（Lacen-ES bulletin）に基づく通常のサーベイランス情報。帯状疱疹ワクチンのSUS導入に関する法案（PL 4.426/2025）は政策議論であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Patient being evaluated for suspected case of Ebola, Montreal hospital says
article.articleSummary: Patient being evaluated for suspected Ebola at Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM), with ambulances rerouted to transfer the individual to a dedicated isolation room in the emergency department as standard protocols are followed; CHUM has not released further details. The situation comes amid Canada’s Ebola-related travel ban, extended to Nov. 27, preventing entry to Uganda, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Foreign nationals not from those three countries who have entered the DRC within the last 21 days are not allowed to board or transit through Canada, while travelers from the other two listed countries must quarantine for 21 days. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains out of control, with confirmed cases exceeding 8,000. This is a developing, breaking-news story.

triage.headline_ja: モントリオールの病院、エボラ出血熱疑い患者を評価中と発表
triage.triage_reason: カナダ・モントリオールでエボラ疑い患者が報告され、背景にDRCで感染者8,000人超・制御不能とされる大規模流行があるため、IHR基準複数該当とみなされフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はモントリオールでの疑い症例（カナダ、対象国外のため除外）だが、背景情報としてDRCにおける大規模エボラ流行（確定例8,000人超、制御不能）が具体的に言及されており、DRCを対象国として計上した。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。疑い症例の確定有無は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola toll likely higher than reported as insecurity hampers response: MSF
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is ongoing since May; as of 1 October 2026, more than 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally and the largest and deadliest in the DRC. MSF warns that the true toll may be higher due to surveillance gaps and case detection challenges. Security conditions deteriorating in eastern DRC are hampering the response, with violence affecting operations and a key transit center for suspected patients destroyed by fire at the Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri province. One MSF worker involved in the response tested positive for Bundibugyo virus and was evacuated to the Netherlands under strict protocols, underscoring healthcare workers' high risk. The UN notes escalating violence further disrupts containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ死者数、治安悪化による対応阻害で報告より多い可能性：国境なき医師団（MSF）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,000例・4,000人死亡という過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、治安悪化が対応を妨げ、医療従事者の国際移送（オランダへの退避）も発生しているため、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: オランダは感染した医療従事者の退避先であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。治安悪化により症例把握が困難で、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Manuel Masalva revela que perdió los dedos de los pies tras grave infección: "Vi mis pies casi negros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Manuel Masalva reveals he lost his toes after a severe infection: "I saw my feet almost black."
article.articleSummary: Manuel Masalva, the actor known for Narcos: Mexico, survived a severe bacterial infection that severely impaired his circulation, leading to necrosis and the amputation of his toes. He spent more than 100 days in an induced coma, lost about 28 kilograms, and is undergoing a prolonged rehabilitation to regain mobility. He now uses prosthetics to walk. The infection spread to several organs and the bloodstream, prompting a critical health crisis during an international trip. The report notes conflicting accounts of where the bacterium was contracted: Mezcalent says during a trip to Dubai, while Infobae states he was hospitalized in Dubai after contracting the bacterium in the Philippines. Masalva has publicly shared his recovery journey and resilience, receiving support from colleagues.

triage.headline_ja: マヌエル・マサルバ、重度の感染症で足の指を失ったことを明かす「足がほぼ黒くなっていた」
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の感染症症例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や集団発生を示す情報がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 個人の健康問題に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生イベントではない。感染経路もドバイかフィリピンか不明確で、集団感染の兆候はない。UAEは対象国リストに含まれず、フィリピンも記事の主題として確定的でないため、いずれもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Why an animal disease in ||Kharas should worry every Namibian, not just farmers
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in ||Kharas region, Namibia, triggers movement and export restrictions, with ripple effects beyond farms to processors, workers and the broader economy. Local councillor William Minnie warns that Namibia's livestock sector underpins foreign exchange earnings and rural livelihoods, and that Meatco's revenue fell 40.4% to N$1.11 billion in 2025 due to reduced cattle processing. The outbreak threatens access to markets in the European Union, Norway, China and the SADC bloc, which hinges on maintaining a disease-free status. The situation also risks jeopardizing Africa's AfCFTA ambitions unless systems prove products safe for cross-border trade. Minnie frames FMD as a test of Namibia's ability to protect productive capacity while growing the economy, highlighting that a single regional outbreak can destabilize jobs, exports, and economic growth.

triage.headline_ja: ||Kharas地域の家畜疾病が、なぜすべてのナミビア人にとって懸念事項なのか（農家だけでなく）
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はヒトへの感染リスクがほぼない動物疾病であり、発生地であるナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、ヒト公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては見送り。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜の口蹄疫であり、ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは記載なし。発生地はナミビアであり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国・ノルウェー等は輸出先市場として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: A Manuel Masalva le amputaron los dedos de los pies tras la infección que lo dejó en coma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Manuel Masalva had his toes amputated after an infection that left him comatose.
article.articleSummary: Manuel Masalva, a 45-year-old actor, survived a severe bacterial infection first detected in late March 2025 while vacationing in the Philippines, with a layover in Dubai. The infection triggered bacteremia that spread to organs and impaired circulation, leading to necrosis and gangrene in both feet. After more than 100 days in a medically induced coma, he awoke to the reality that amputation of the toes was necessary to save his life. He ultimately underwent amputation of the toes of both feet and embarked on a prolonged rehabilitation. In July 2026, Masalva returned to Mexico to begin long rehabilitation, having lost 28 kg; he spent months in a wheelchair and faced gait changes, later standing again after about a year of recovery. He received widespread public and financial support, including treatment abroad, and has shared messages of resilience and faith.

triage.headline_ja: マヌエル・マサルバ氏、昏睡状態に陥った感染症により足の指を切断
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人に関する単発の細菌感染症エピソードであり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性、社会的関心（公衆衛生上の）は認められない。
triage.notes: 単一個人の既往症例（芸能ニュース）であり、感染症の病原体や公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報は不明。フィリピン・ドバイは一時滞在地として言及されているのみで、発生地域としての特定は不可。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba o que é Creutzfeldt-Jakob, doença rara que influenciador Lito Sousa enfrentava | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out what Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease is, the rare disease that influencer Lito Sousa was facing | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) caused death of Brazilian influencer Lito Sousa, 59, on October 1, 2026. CJD is a rare, degenerative transmissible spongiform encephalopathy with no cure. Early symptoms include dementia, memory loss and tremors, followed by rapid neurological decline and multi-focal signs; Sousa’s vision and mobility deteriorated quickly after diagnosis in late August. The disease is linked to prions, proteinaceous infectious particles — smaller than viruses and highly resistant. CJD occurs in three forms: sporadic (about 85%), hereditary (5–15%), and iatrogenic (<1%). Approximately 90% die within one year of onset. Sousa, a pilot and aviation influencer from Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, wrote a book and ran the “Aviões e Música” channel, which continued online with help from peers. He leaves wife Mila Seidl and their 7-year-old son Malone.

triage.headline_ja: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病とは何か、インフルエンサーのリト・ソウザ氏が闘っていた希少疾患について知る | ラジオ・イタチアイア
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発例（著名人の死亡）報道であり、CJDは非伝染性のプリオン病で公衆衛生上の集団発生リスクや国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: CJDは孤発性が大半を占める非感染性疾患であり、本記事は著名人の死亡に関する単発の訃報記事。公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要。

article.articleHeadline: 足跡曝光 南市境外登革熱 個案連跑兩市場 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Footprints Revealed: Imported Dengue Fever in Nanshi; Case Visited Two Markets
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Tainan City reports one imported dengue fever case: a Taiwanese woman in her 50s from Nanshi district who traveled to Ha Long Bay, Vietnam, September 19–24. After returning, she visited Shui Xian Gong Market and Guiren Market to sell clothes. She developed fever on September 27 and tested PCR-positive for dengue virus serotype 1, the city’s 8th imported dengue case this year. During the viremic period she frequented crowded markets, raising local transmission risk if Aedes mosquitoes are present. The Tainan Dengue Prevention Center conducted emergency fogging around the patient’s residence and activity sites, eliminated potential breeding sources, and performed vector-density surveys, with planned indoor-outdoor chemical interventions to reduce vector density and community transmission risk. As of 1 October 2026, authorities continue measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 足跡公開：南市境外感染デング熱、患者は市場2カ所を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 台湾台南市における単発の輸入デング熱症例であり、通常の公衆衛生対応（消毒・媒介蚊調査）が実施されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムは患者の渡航先として言及されているのみでベトナム国内での感染流行を示す記述はないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。今年8例目の輸入症例であり、地域当局により標準的な防疫措置（燻煙・発生源除去・媒介蚊密度調査）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 彰爆3年來首例本土登革熱群聚 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua: First Local Dengue Fever Cluster in Three Years
article.articleSummary: Changhua County reports its first local dengue fever cluster since 2023, with one newly diagnosed locally acquired case after two hospital visits. The patient, a man in his 60s from Changhua City, developed fever, diarrhea and malaise in late September; dengue virus serotype 1 was detected. Residence is only 110 meters from this year’s first local case, leading to a community cluster designation. The patient is hospitalized and contacts are asymptomatic. Sequencing will be performed to clarify linkage between the two cases. Taiwan CDC has mobilized an epidemic-prevention task force; by Sept 29, 34 personnel conducted vector-source checks, chemical-control supervision, efficacy assessments, and risk-point rechecks, finding 544 standing-water containers and 70 positive, with 21 inspection records issued. Separately, Tainan City reports its 8th imported dengue case: a woman in her 50s who traveled to Ha Long Bay, Vietnam in mid-September. By Sept 30, Taiwan totals 178 dengue cases (12 locally—Kaohsiung City 10, Changhua County 2; 166 imported—Vietnam 43, Indonesia 29, Philippines 20, etc.), below 2025’s 188.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化：3年ぶりの地元感染デング熱クラスター発生
triage.triage_reason: 発生地域は台湾（彰化県・高雄市・台南市）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事象ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 台湾彰化県での地元感染デング熱クラスター（1例）に関する地域ニュース。台湾CDCにより通常の媒介蚊対策・疫学調査が実施されており、特段の異常事態ではない。輸入症例の渡航歴として挙げられたベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは当該国での発生事象を示すものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz aponta alta de casos de Covid e Rio Branco aparece entre capitais em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz reports a rise in COVID-19 cases, and Rio Branco is among capitals on alert.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin indicates a rise in COVID-19–related severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases nationwide, with Acre reporting higher SRAG activity but still low overall incidence. The update covers Week 38 (Sept 20–26). Rio Branco, the capital of Acre, is among three capitals with SRAG activity at alert, risk, or high risk, showing growth in SRAG in the past six weeks up to SE 38; Porto Alegre (Rio Grande do Sul) and Rio de Janeiro (Rio de Janeiro) are the other two. In 2026, Brazil has notified 157,908 SRAG cases, of which 85,087 (53.9%) tested positive for some respiratory virus, 56,799 (36%) were negative, and about 7,090 (4.5%) awaited results. Among positives, 40.4% were respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), 32.1% rhinovirus, 16.4% influenza A, 5.5% influenza B, and 3.8% SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruzが新型コロナ症例の増加を報告、リオブランコが警戒対象の州都に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例の増加が報告されているが、全体的な発生率は依然低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な影響は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: Fiocruzの定期的なサーベイランス報告（InfoGripe）であり、季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、RSV、インフルエンザ等）の通常の動向モニタリングに該当。特定の異常事態や危機的状況は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Miles huyen de un campamento afectado por el ébola y crece la alarma por una propagación fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands flee an Ebola-affected camp as alarm grows over an out-of-control spread.
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled the Kigonze camp in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after security forces entered to search for weapons, triggering clashes and displacement. The camp, housing about 19,000 displaced, is now abandoned; around 1,000 residents had Ebola exposure, but only about 200 have been located. A transit center for isolation and testing was burned. The country is amid its 17th Ebola outbreak—the deadliest yet—with more than 8,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths, centered in Ituri with spillovers to North Kivu (Butembo). Violence against health workers and distrust of the government complicate response. No licensed vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; clinical trials are ongoing in Ituri. The WHO warns persistent challenges in case detection and care, and the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa toll.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影響を受けたキャンプから数千人が避難、制御不能な感染拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（8000例超、死者4000人近く）の第17次エボラ流行が進行中であり、治安悪化により接触者追跡が崩壊し感染拡大・国際的波及のリスクが高いため。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文での言及がないため除外。北キブ・イトゥリは国内の行政区分であり、国単位でDRCとして集約。

article.articleHeadline: பருவ கால நோய்கள் பரவும் இடங்களில் மருத்துவ முகாம்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical camps in areas where seasonal diseases spread.
article.articleSummary: Mobile medical camps will be deployed in areas with rising seasonal disease transmission, notably dengue and influenza, following the monsoon. Each camp team includes a doctor, a nurse, a medical assistant, and a laboratory technician, with medicines and equipment carried in vehicles for on-site treatment. Post-monsoon conditions are associated with increased influenza-like fever, respiratory infections, dengue, chikungunya, typhoid, Elik fever, bacterial infections, skin ulcers, and diarrhea. Blood tests will determine the disease identity, and patients requiring advanced care will be referred to government hospitals with available facilities. Separate teams have been formed to curb mosquito breeding and larval production. Additional measures include chlorinating drinking water and ensuring food quality, with the health department supervising sanitation and related efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性疾患が広がる地域で医療キャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン後の季節性疾患（デング熱、インフルエンザ等）に対する通常の行政対応（医療キャンプ設置）を報じる内容であり、異常事態や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 毎年のモンスーン後に見られる季節性感染症の増加に対する地方自治体の定例的な公衆衛生対応であり、新規性・異常性は認められない。地域はタミル・ナードゥ州チェンナイに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Após surto de sarna, escola municipal em Lagoa Santa suspende aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a scabies outbreak, the municipal school in Lagoa Santa suspends classes.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak at the Municipal School Mércia Margarida Lacerda Machado in Lagoa Santa leads to suspension of classes on Oct 1-2, 2026, after 21 cases among students and one teacher. The municipality will implement preventive and control measures during the closure, including thorough cleaning and disinfection of school premises, pest-control extermination, and sanitization of the water tank. The Municipal Health Department advises families not to send students with scabies symptoms to school and to seek evaluation at the nearest health unit, which is prepared to identify and treat the disease if needed.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の発生により、ラゴアサンタの市立学校が休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤な疾患ではなく、局所的な学校内発生で既に対策が取られており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）は寄生虫による皮膚感染症で、重症度は低く、学校という限定環境での発生。市当局が既に消毒・対策を実施しており、国際的関心事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: O que é Creutzfeldt-Jakob, doença rara que matou Lito Sousa cerca de 41 dias após diagnóstico - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, the rare disease that killed Lito Sousa about 41 days after diagnosis - Visor News
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) is a rare, fatal neurodegenerative condition caused by prions, part of transmissible spongiform encephalopathies. The case of Lito Sousa, a 59-year-old aviation specialist, ended about 41 days after diagnosis. CJD can progress rapidly, with memory loss, cognitive decline, movement disorders, coordination problems, speech and swallowing difficulties, vision issues, and advancing dementia. There is no cure or treatment to halt progression; care centers on symptom control and comfort. Sousa, who had a prior prostate cancer, reported left-arm numbness in August, leading to brain inflammation and the CJD diagnosis. The disease is extremely rare worldwide (~1–2 cases per million per year). Transmission is not from casual contact; most cases are sporadic, with genetic forms and rare iatrogenic exposure. A variant (vDCJ) is linked to bovine spongiform encephalopathy.

triage.headline_ja: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病とは？診断から約41日後にリト・ソウザ氏を死に至らしめた稀な病気
triage.triage_reason: 単一の孤発性CJD症例に関する一般解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 孤発性CJDは感染症ではなくプリオン病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念もない。個人の訃報に関する一般向け解説記事。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Bunia: More than 2,000 students sensitized on prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) awareness drive in Bunia with over 2,000 students from Fabia School Complex, spanning kindergarten to secondary, conducted by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) on October 1, 2026. The program covers main transmission modes and preventive behaviors, featuring interactive exchanges and a practical handwashing demonstration to reinforce proper practices. Information, Education and Communication (IEC) materials were provided to sustain school-based awareness. Ms. Fura Fifi, head of Fabia School Complex, stated the initiative meets a genuine need and should be regularly repeated in schools to strengthen community preparedness against Ebola. The report emphasizes school-driven prevention within Bunia and broader public health readiness; no case counts, laboratory confirmation, or outbreak details were reported.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ：2,000人以上の生徒が予防について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する記事だが、症例数・検査確認・アウトブレイクの詳細は報告されておらず、学校での予防啓発活動のみを伝える内容。DRCはエボラ流行歴がある地域のため、関連情報の継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例や発生確認情報を含まず、ブニアにおける学校ベースのエボラ予防啓発活動の報告のみ。DRCは過去にエボラ流行歴があるため、関連の続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: Older people encouraged to raise awareness on Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Oct 1, 2026, in Butembo, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, older people were urged to lead Ebola prevention efforts for the International Day of Older Persons. Norbert Muhindo, coordinator of the Association of Young People in Solidarity with Older Persons (AJSTA), said older residents should educate youth on protecting themselves from Ebola and avoid conflicts with health workers. He noted older people are aware of Ebola’s existence and are already adopting preventive measures, including regular handwashing, with infection risk perceived as accidental. The event, held at AJSTA’s office, featured talks on rights and empowerment, and the year’s theme: 'Let us demand that our voices and rights be heard and upheld in accordance with the Constitution of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.' The report emphasizes community awareness rather than a defined outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:高齢者にエボラ予防啓発を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事は国際高齢者デーに合わせたエボラ予防啓発活動を伝える内容であり、新規症例や確定アウトブレイクの報告ではない。社会的関心やIHR/WPRO基準に該当する具体的な公衆衛生上の懸念は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事自体が『明確なアウトブレイクではなくコミュニティ啓発活動』であると明記しており、具体的な感染確認・症例報告は含まれていない。DRC北キブ州ブテンボでの啓発イベントに関する内容のため、発生国としての確証がなく verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Droplet Digital PCR Speeds Pathogen Detection in Febrile Leukopenia
article.articleSummary: Febrile leukopenia in hematologic cancer patients in Hangzhou, China: a retrospective cohort from The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang Chinese Medical University (Mar 2024–Mar 2025) shows droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) detects pathogens faster and more often than blood culture and standard fungal antigen tests. Among 172 inpatients and 253 samples, 47 patients had antimicrobial therapy guided by ddPCR versus 206 with standard care. ddPCR surpassed blood culture, β-D-glucan, and galactomannan in pathogen detection rate. By enabling direct pathogen DNA amplification, ddPCR does not require organism viability or antigen expression, counting target molecules via Poisson statistics across tens of thousands of droplets; it tolerates inhibitors and detects low concentrations in leukopenia. Diagnostic performance against adjudicated bloodstream infection yielded AUC 0.796 (95% CI 0.703–0.889). ddPCR outperformed CRP (p=0.011) and interferon-based testing (p=0.001); procalcitonin difference not statistically significant.

triage.headline_ja: ドロップレットデジタルPCRが発熱性白血球減少症患者における病原体検出を迅速化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断技術（ddPCR）の性能評価に関する研究報告であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にCoccidioidomycosisが付与されているが、記事内容は発熱性白血球減少症患者における病原体検出技術（ddPCR）の臨床研究であり、アウトブレイク情報ではない。Bluedotの疾患タグ付けが不適切な可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 中国多地猪瘟蔓延 养殖户：猪打疫苗后仍发病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classical swine fever spreading across multiple regions in China; pig farmers say vaccinated pigs still fall ill.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreaks are being reported across multiple Chinese provinces, including Guangxi, Hunan, and Jiangxi, with signals of activity in Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Chongqing. Farmers describe rapid pig mortality, large-scale depopulation, and infected pigs being sold at very low prices as some vaccination campaigns fail to prevent illness; sows reportedly abort or deliver dead fetuses after vaccination, and nursing piglets also fall ill. In Hunan, 80–90% of large farms have been affected and depopulated; in Guangxi, nearby farms began clearing stock, including deaths of dozens of pigs in a single facility. In Jiangxi, sick pigs fetch about 1–2 yuan per jin, while healthy pigs previously sold for 5–6 yuan per jin. Some carcasses are moved to cold storage or processing plants for sausage production. August live-pig prices fell to about 10.82 yuan/kg (down ~21%), with self-breeding losses cited around 150–210 yuan per head. Official reports have not acknowledged these outbreaks; only a September Chongqing case of O-type swine fever is mentioned, raising questions about verification.

triage.headline_ja: 中国多地で豚熱（豚コレラ）蔓延、養豚農家「ワクチン接種後も発病」
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、広域にわたる発生・ワクチン不全・当局未確認という異常性があり、食料安全保障・経済・社会的関心の観点から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本疾患は人獣共通感染症ではないが、養豚業への大規模な経済的影響と食料供給リスク、当局による公式発表の欠如という情報の非対称性があり、公衆衛生ではなく畜産・経済・バイオセキュリティの観点からWATCH対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: 中國多地豬瘟蔓延 養殖戶：豬打疫苗後仍發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classical swine fever spreads across many parts of China; farmers say pigs still fall ill after vaccination.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are spreading across China, with confirmed concerns in Guangxi, Hunan and Jiangxi and rising risk across East, South and Southwest provinces including Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan and Chongqing. Farm accounts describe two ASF waves this year in Guangxi’s Rongxian, with sows vaccinated by a state-owned Zhongmu vaccine gestating into abortions and stillbirths; weaned pigs also fall ill. In Hunan, large farms report infections despite vaccination, with farmers dismissing uniform vaccine efficacy as a ‘commercial secret.’ Jiangxi’s Gao’an area reports extensive culling as sick pigs die within days; distressed farmers sell healthy pigs at low prices (about 5–6 RMB per jin; sick pigs ~1–2 RMB per jin), while some carcasses are sent to cold storage or meat-processing facilities for sausages made from diseased or culled pigs. Transport and vehicle hygiene, plus autumn weather, may facilitate spread. Official MOA reports are sparse, noting only a September Chongqing swine O-type foot-and-mouth disease outbreak; reliability is questioned.

triage.headline_ja: 中国各地で豚コレラ（アフリカ豚熱）が拡大、養豚農家はワクチン接種後も発病すると証言
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱・口蹄疫は動物疾病でヒトへの直接感染性はないが、中国広域での拡大と食品安全（病死豚肉の流通）への懸念があり、公式報告の不透明さも指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ASF・口蹄疫はいずれもヒト感染症ではなく人獣共通感染症でもないため公衆衛生リスクは限定的だが、病死豚肉が食品加工に流用されている可能性が指摘されており食品安全上の懸念がある。公式統計の信頼性が低い点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: China reports two additional H9N2 avian influenza cases
article.articleSummary: Two additional human infections with avian influenza A(H9N2) were reported in China for 18–24 September 2026. Both cases concern 1‑year‑old girls: one from Henan Province with symptom onset 30 August 2026 and direct exposure to poultry; the other from Guangdong Province with symptom onset 7 September 2026 and potential exposure related to a live poultry market visit. Neither case received antiviral treatment nor required hospitalization, and both have fully recovered. Since 2015, 183 human H9N2 infections have been documented, including two deaths (both with underlying conditions). Of these, 180 cases occurred in China, with two in Cambodia and one in Viet Nam. Most human infections are linked to exposure to infected poultry or contaminated environments, and the majority of cases have been mild.

triage.notes: 記事はカンボジアとベトナムにも言及しているが、これは2015年以降の累計症例数の内訳（歴史的データ）であり、今回報告された新規感染はいずれも中国国内（河南省・広東省）の事例であるため、verified_locationsには中国のみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Montreal hospital isolates patient exhibiting Ebola symptoms
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-symptom case has been isolated at Montreal's Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM). The female patient arrived late Thursday afternoon exhibiting Ebola-like signs. CHUM spokesperson Irène Marcheterre said isolation protocols and full safety measures were immediately enacted, and there are currently no concerns about public exposure. The case remains suspected rather than confirmed, with no laboratory confirmation reported in the article. Marcheterre could not confirm the patient's travel history. The suspected case comes amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where thousands have died in recent months. No details on infection source or whether it is an imported/exported case were provided.

article.articleHeadline: Un potentiel cas d'Ebola est évalué au Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A potential Ebola case is being evaluated at the University of Montreal Hospital Center.
article.articleSummary: One person in Montreal is being evaluated for Ebola at the Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM). CHUM's media relations confirmed via email that standard isolation protocols are in place, including diverting ambulances to transfer the patient securely from the ambulance to an isolation room in the emergency department. The report notes an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda since May, with the World Health Organization declaring a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Quebec's government site updated Sept 21 states that no Ebola cases have been reported in Quebec or anywhere in Canada, and the probability of introduction by a contagious traveler is considered low. Ebola symptoms can appear 2–21 days after exposure, initially fever, chills, headache, weakness, fatigue, sore throat, or cough.

article.articleHeadline: Google wants to spread mosquitos to fight deadly diseases. Here's why.
article.articleSummary: Google’s Debug program seeks EPA permits to release large numbers of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes across California and Florida to curb dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever by leveraging Wolbachia bacteria. In sterile-insect technique (SIT), lab-reared male mosquitoes are released; since wild females lack Wolbachia, mating with Wolbachia-carrying males creates cytoplasmic incompatibility, producing nonviable eggs and suppressing the population. Trials in Singapore (May 2026) reported a 70% decrease in dengue cases within months, and a 2020 Brazilian study also showed reduced dengue transmission. Yet suppression is costly and requires ongoing releases, and not permanently establishes Wolbachia in the environment. Yale researchers highlight an alternative: population replacement, releasing Wolbachia-infected males and females so offspring inherit the microbe, potentially providing disease protection like a vaccine once a threshold is reached, reducing reliance on continuous releases. Aedes aegypti, typically tropical, is expanding with climate warming, even found in the UK; regulatory and logistical hurdles remain for US rollout.

article.articleHeadline: Phường Cầu Giấy chủ động phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết và bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cầu Giấy Ward Takes Proactive Measures to Prevent and Control Dengue Fever and Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 1 October, the Ward Health Station of Cau Giay Ward in Hanoi, Vietnam, organized a conference to implement dengue fever prevention and a proactive infectious-disease control model for the locality. Nguyen Thi Thu Ha, Vice Chairwoman of the ward People’s Committee and head of the ward's Disease Prevention Steering Committee, said the health station has actively advised and coordinated with neighborhood groups, departments, agencies, and schools to enhance surveillance, detect cases, mitigate risks, and educate residents. As of 30 September 2026 in Cau Giay, 31 dengue cases, 49 hand-foot-and-mouth disease, 5 measles, 14 influenza, and 21 COVID-19 have been recorded. Bui Van Hao, Director of Hanoi's Center for Disease Control and Prevention, underscored the role of frontline teams in surveillance and early risk detection. Community teams were equipped with handheld flashlights to assist inspections and surveillance, reinforcing local disease prevention at the street level.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Thailand: Symptoms and Warning Signs That Need Urgent Care
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, dengue remains a year-round risk in Thailand, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that bite during the day; peaks during the rainy season. Dengue typically begins with sudden high fever, headache, eye pain, muscle and joint aches, nausea, vomiting, rash, or swollen glands, with illness lasting 2–7 days in the febrile phase. As fever falls, a short critical phase can occur within 24–48 hours, during which condition may worsen. Seek urgent medical care for warning signs: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding (nose/gums, vomit, black stools, heavy menses, blood in urine), rapid breathing, dizziness, confusion, drowsiness, or very little urine. Do not assume recovery with a lower fever. For fever or pain, use acetaminophen (paracetamol) as directed; avoid aspirin/ibuprofen due to bleeding risk. Dengue testing varies by illness day: molecular or NS1 early; antibody tests later; a negative early result does not rule out dengue; follow clinician guidance.

triage.headline_ja: タイのデング熱:緊急受診が必要な症状と警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: タイでは季節性・年間を通じたデング熱は既知の風土病であり、本記事は症状啓発の一般情報であって新規性・異常性や急激な拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は患者向けの症状・警告サインの啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数・流行状況の報告はない。デング熱はタイで既知の季節性疾患であるため新規シグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik di September, Dinkes Medan Perkuat Kesiapsiagaan Puskesmas dan Rumah Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise in September, Medan Health Office strengthens preparedness of community health centers and hospitals
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rose in Medan City, Indonesia, with 15 Influenza A and 3 Influenza B reported from January through September 2026, and September activity increasing. Acting Head of the Medan City Health Office, Dr. Surya Syahputra Pulungan, M.Kes, attributes rapid spread to the highly contagious Influenza A virus and stresses heightened preparedness. Following an order from Mayor Rico Tri Putra Bayu Waas, Dinkes Medan issued a preparedness letter to all Puskesmas (community health centers) and hospitals to strengthen response and surveillance. Focus on high-risk groups—the elderly, those with comorbidities, and travelers. Community measures include PHBS, handwashing, coughing/sneezing etiquette, and masking for those with symptoms. Citizens are urged to seek early evaluation at Puskesmas for fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, malaise, or myalgia; screening protocols include fever >38°C with cough and symptoms ≤10 days, plus similar hospital screening for inpatients.

triage.headline_ja: 9月にインフルエンザA型の症例増加、メダン保健局が保健所・病院の備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、1月〜9月で計18例と規模も小さく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当せず、行政の通常対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A型・B型）の通常の増加であり、地方保健当局による予防的な注意喚起レベルの対応。症例数も少なく重症度の記載もない。対象国リストに含まれるIndonesiaだが、イベント自体が国際的懸念に該当しないためverified_locationsは空とする判断も検討したが、国内発生のため記載せず（通常季節性のため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: आसान शिकार की लत से तराई में बदल रही बाघों की डाइट; PTR में मंडराया 'कान्हा' जैसा बड़ा खतरा - pilibhit tiger reserve tigers diet change stray cattle canine distemper threat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tigers' diet changing in the Terai due to a habit of easy prey; a Kanha-like major threat looming over Pilibhit Tiger Reserve (PTR) — stray cattle, canine distemper threat.
article.articleSummary: Tigers in Pilibhit Tiger Reserve (PTR) in India’s Terai region are shifting from their natural prey to easy targets such as stray cattle along farm and forest edges. This change, driven by livestock abandonment and transport into forests, reduces hunting effort but risks eroding hunting skills and increasing human-wildlife contact. A crucial spillover threat arises from canine-origin diseases transmitted by stray dogs and jackals, notably Canine Distemper Virus (CDV) attacking the nervous system, plus Rabies and Canine Parvovirus (CPV) causing dehydration and death in cubs. Kanha Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh reported in May 2026 a CDV outbreak killing eight tigers, including a tigress and cubs. PTR surveillance has captured a tiger preying on cattle on safari routes. If these dietary shifts persist, future tiger generations may be imperiled and human-tiger conflict could rise; officials urge responsible livestock management and wildlife protection.

triage.headline_ja: 容易な獲物への依存でテライ地方のトラの食性が変化；ピリビート・タイガー・リザーブ（PTR）にカンハ保護区のような大きな脅威が迫る―野良牛・イヌジステンパーの脅威
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（トラ）における犬由来感染症（ジステンパー、狂犬病等）の生態学的リスクに関する記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は野生動物保護区内のトラの生態・食性変化と動物間感染症（CDV、狂犬病、CPV）のリスクに関するものであり、ヒトの感染症イベントではないため対象国リストへの計上対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Қытай ғалымдары кене арқылы жұғып, белгісіз ауру тудыратын жаңа вирусты анықтады
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese scientists identify a new virus transmitted by ticks that causes an unknown disease.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV) is a newly identified tick-borne pathogen (Nairoviridae) linked to an unknown febrile illness in endemic areas of China. Beijing researchers analyzed 3,163 tick-bite patients and found ALTNV infection in 10.4% of cases; among DBV (Dabi virus)-negative patients, ALTNV accounted for 15.1% of illnesses. ALTNV's key symptoms include fatigue (84%), gastrointestinal disturbances (80%), thrombocytopenia (38%), and elevated transaminases (36%); all monoinfected patients recovered. Co-infection with DBV occurred in 38 individuals, who showed 61% respiratory symptoms, 84% renal impairment, and an 18.4% mortality rate. Surveillance of 47,428 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces detected ALTNV RNA in 1.3% of ticks, most frequently in Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks (about 1.8%). The study, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, highlights a potentially emerging tick-borne threat in China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者ら、マダニが媒介し原因不明の疾患を引き起こす新種ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 新規ダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)がNEJMで報告され、単独感染は軽症だが既知ウイルス(DBV)との共感染で致死率18.4%と報告された。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、現時点では学術的発見の段階であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はNEJM掲載の学術研究報道であり、新規病原体(ALTNV)のヒトへの影響範囲・伝播性・公衆衛生対応の緊急性については情報が限定的。単独感染例は全員回復しているが、既知のDabie bandavirus(DBV)との共感染で重症化・死亡例が確認されており、今後の疫学調査結果を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, Broccolo: "Ripresa attesa, il virus ormai è endemico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, Broccolo: "Expected recovery, the virus is now endemic."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is now endemic, with SARS-CoV-2 potentially causing one or two waves per year, not following strict influenza-like seasonality, according to Francesco Broccolo, clinical microbiologist at the University of Salento. Among the circulating variants are NB181 and XFG, both descended from the JN-1 lineage. Spike-protein mutations may help these strains evade antibodies and trigger new infections in previously exposed people, but there is no evidence of increased clinical severity; they spread more easily rather than being more dangerous. Rising case numbers are driven by school and workplace return, more time indoors, and waning immunity over months. In China, late July–early August positivity rose above 20% without imposing major hospital strain. Protection should focus on the vulnerable: test symptomatic individuals, limit contact with the vulnerable, ensure good ventilation, and sustain genomic surveillance and laboratory diagnostics beyond emergencies as an early warning system.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ、ブロッコロ氏「流行の再燃が予想される、ウイルスはもはや風土病化している」
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は専門家により流行病（endemic）化したとの見解が示されており、重症度増加の証拠もなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアの専門家によるCOVID-19流行状況の解説記事であり、イタリアおよび中国の感染状況に言及しているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれるのは中国のみ。ただし中国に関する言及は7-8月の陽性率上昇の一例として挙げられているのみで、記事の主題はイタリアにおける専門家見解であるため、中国も発生地域の主題とは言えず、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders Worker Contracts Ebola in Congo, Evacuated to Netherlands
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with confirmed infections and deaths since it began. A Doctors Without Borders (MSF) worker contracted Ebola while helping fight the DRC's largest-ever outbreak and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment. The outbreak remains difficult to contain despite an expanding response and ongoing control efforts. The report emphasizes the scale of the outbreak in the DRC and the ongoing international response, including medical evacuation of an infected worker for care.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団スタッフがコンゴでエボラに感染、オランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際医療従事者が感染し国境を越えて搬送されるなど、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: オランダは感染者の搬送先であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行は『過去最大規模』と記載されており、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case at Montreal hospital turns out to be a false alarm
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-01, a suspected Ebola case at Montreal's Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM) was declared a false alarm. A female patient arrived late Thursday afternoon with symptoms compatible with Ebola; CHUM immediately activated isolation protocols and safety measures. Just before 8 p.m., CHUM spokesperson Ellen Caracas said the patient tested negative for Ebola and emergency protocols were lifted, with no risk to the public. The incident occurred amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where thousands have died in recent months. CHUM spokesperson Irène Marcheterre could not confirm whether the patient had recently traveled from the DRC region. No further details on travel history were provided.

triage.headline_ja: モントリオールの病院でエボラ疑い例、偽陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: モントリオールでの疑い例は検査の結果陰性であり偽陽性と確定したため、公衆衛生上の実際の脅威は発生していない。DRCでの流行は既知のものであり新規性がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナダ・モントリオールでの疑い例が偽陽性だったという事象であり、カナダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCでの流行自体は言及されているが本記事の主題ではなく、新規情報も含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 지오영, ﻿가축전염병 대비 동물의약품 공급망 점검
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GeoYoung inspects the veterinary medicines supply chain in preparation for livestock infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: GeoYoung to bolster storage and delivery of veterinary medicines as South Korea enters the 'Special Livestock Disease Countermeasures Period' through February next year. Korea currently faces nationwide outbreaks of foot-and-mouth disease, African swine fever, lumpy skin disease, and bovine tuberculosis, alongside avian influenza and reports of new SAT1 strain foot-and-mouth disease in neighboring China and Mongolia, prompting heightened biosecurity. GeoYoung will pre-emptively inspect cold-chain facilities, inventory, and emergency delivery systems to ensure rapid response if outbreaks occur. Chair Cho Seon-hye stated that the effectiveness of livestock disease control hinges on prompt on-site supply capabilities and pledged seamless distribution so medicines reach where needed without gaps. The initiative emphasizes supply-chain resilience to support veterinary authorities during the extended outbreak-preparedness window.

triage.headline_ja: ジオヨン、家畜伝染病に備え動物医薬品供給網を点検
triage.triage_reason: 韓国で口蹄疫・豚熱・ランピースキン病・結核・鳥インフルエンザが同時多発的に発生し、中国・モンゴルでも新型SAT1株口蹄疫が報告されるなど国際的拡大と貿易制限リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は韓国の民間医薬品供給企業による家畜伝染病対応の体制整備であり、人への感染（Human Infection with Avian Influenza）は明示されていない。中国・モンゴルでの新型SAT1株口蹄疫報告は言及のみで詳細情報は不明。モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。韓国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 지오영, 겨울철 가축전염병 대비 동물의약품 공급망 점검 - 매일일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GEOYOUNG conducts inspection of the veterinary medicines supply chain in preparation for winter livestock infectious diseases - Maeil Ilbo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, GEOYOUNG announced strengthened storage and distribution of animal medicines during the Livestock Infectious Disease Special Quarantine Period (Oct–Feb) to fortify winter control. Incheon and Deokpyeong centers will audit cold-chain facilities, stock status, and emergency delivery to enable rapid response to outbreaks. Fall–winter peaks raise risks of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), Classical Swine Fever (CSF), Lumpy Skin Disease, and Bovine Tuberculosis, with rising avian influenza threats from wild birds and SAT1 FMD reports in China and Mongolia. GEOYOUNG handles 373 veterinary medicines; 9.3 million units were processed January–September. Deokpyeong Center (4,620 m2) maintains 2–8°C refrigeration and ≤-20°C ultra-cold storage. Vaccines require strict temperature control; many are refrigerated or freeze-dried; liquid vaccines must be mixed before use. Major vaccines include FMD, CSF, PRRS, bovine mastitis; companion vaccines include DHPPi, canine coronavirus, Kennel Cough, canine influenza, Rabies, FeLV. Chairman Jang Hye emphasizes timely field supply.

triage.headline_ja: ジオヨン、冬季家畜伝染病に備え動物医薬品供給網を点検 - 毎日日報
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、韓国の動物医薬品卸企業による冬季防疫に向けた供給網点検という企業広報的内容であり、公衆衛生上の具体的シグナルは確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国企業GEOYOUNGの冬季家畜伝染病特別防疫期間に向けた動物薬品供給体制の点検に関する内容。中国・モンゴルでのSAT1型口蹄疫報告は文脈情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders Worker Contracts Ebola in Congo, Evacuated to Netherlands | Today News
article.articleSummary: MSF worker contracted Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) during the Democratic Republic of Congo’s largest-ever outbreak and is being evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment under strict protocols, with Congolese and Dutch authorities coordinating. Separately, a Montreal hospital isolated a patient with Ebola-like symptoms while investigation proceeds; no public risk identified. Since the outbreak began in May, Congo has 8,224 confirmed infections and 3,982 deaths. About 254 health workers have been infected and 50 have died. On Sept. 29, 53 new cases and 28 deaths were reported, including 22 community deaths. The response remains challenging: roughly 80% of new infections occur among people not on contact lists; Africa CDC estimates responders reach only about 23% of expected contacts, with more than 30,000 identified contacts under monitoring. Authorities say the outbreak cannot yet be confidently deemed under control.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団スタッフ、コンゴでエボラに感染しオランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（スーダン型/ブンディブギョ型）流行が継続中で致死率が高く、医療従事者感染や国際搬送事例も発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: モントリオールおよびオランダでの事例は搬送・疑い例であり、発生国はDRCのみ。接触者追跡率が低く、感染拡大継続中のため国際支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen zonder Grenzen-medewerker besmet met ebola tijdens recorduitbraak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF worker infected with Ebola during a record outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Médecins Sans Frontières reports one confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease case in an MSF worker aiding Congo’s response to the world’s largest recorded Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is evacuated to the Netherlands for specialized care under strict protocols. Since the outbreak began in May, the DRC has recorded about 8,224 infections and 3,982 deaths. On 29 September, authorities reported 53 new cases and 28 deaths, 22 of them community-acquired. Around 254 health workers have been infected, 50 have died. Persistent gaps in contact tracing show nearly 80% of new infections occur among unregistered contacts; Congo reported 79% of registered contacts followed up on 29 September, while Africa CDC estimates responders reach only about 23%. Separately, a Montreal hospital isolated a patient with Ebola-compatible symptoms, with no identified public risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの記録的なエボラ流行の中、国境なき医師団のスタッフがエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が継続しており、感染者の国際移送（オランダへの退避）や接触者追跡の大幅な不足など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: モントリオールでの疑い例やオランダへの患者移送は確認例ではなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでの流行規模（8,224例・3,982死亡）と医療従事者感染（254名）、接触者追跡率の低さ（約23%）が深刻度を示している。

article.articleHeadline: 国庆假期健康防护指南：科学佩戴口罩，警惕蚊媒和肠道传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Day Holiday Health Protection Guide: Proper Mask-Wearing, Be Vigilant Against Mosquito-Borne and Enteric Infectious Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, COVID-19 remains at low transmission and influenza at moderate-to-low levels during the National Day holiday in China. With increased travel, mask-wearing in transit hubs and indoor venues is advised to reduce respiratory infection risk. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever persist in southern provinces, with scattered and localized clusters; residents should eliminate standing water, overturn containers, clean outdoor debris, and install screens or nets to curb mosquitoes and protect outdoor exposure. Holiday gatherings raise risks of norovirus and enteric infections such as hand-foot-and-mouth disease; emphasize food and water hygiene, wash hands before meals, and keep raw and cooked foods separate. For outbound travel, monitor destination infectious disease risks and report overseas travel history when seeking medical care upon return. With inter-regional movement, influenza risk rises; early influenza vaccination is recommended, ahead of the flu season that begins after October.

triage.headline_ja: 国慶節連休健康防護ガイド：正しいマスク着用、蚊媒介感染症と腸管感染症に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 国慶節における一般的な健康注意喚起記事であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザは低~中程度、デング熱・チクングニア熱も散発的局地的クラスターと記載され、新規異常事象や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ノロウイルス、手足口病、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）に言及するが、いずれも既知の季節性・地域的流行の範囲内で、休暇期間の一般的な予防啓発記事に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Exotic Pet Trade Poses Rising Zoonotic Disease Risks in India
article.articleSummary: India's exotic pet trade elevates zoonotic spillover risk as close contact with imported wild animals creates repeated opportunities for pathogens to jump to humans. In Mumbai, avian and exotic wildlife veterinarian Dr. Rina Dev treats imported animals and warns psittacosis (avian chlamydiosis) is a common risk for bird handlers. Traders can carry salmonellosis from reptiles and tuberculosis from primates, with tuberculosis increasingly detected among primates. Nonhuman primates can transmit Ebola and HIV to people, underscoring cross-species danger. Global analyses show traded mammals are 1.5 times more likely to share pathogens with humans than nontraded species, with roughly one additional shared pathogen per decade of trade. A 2026 Humane World for Animals report notes 75% of emerging infectious diseases are zoonotic and estimates about 850,000 unknown viruses in birds and mammals that could infect people. Risks rise in pet cafes, petting zoos, and public events; first responders often lack PPE, and illegal trafficking bypasses quarantine. A One Health approach is urged, but investment remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: エキゾチックペット取引がインドでの人獣共通感染症リスクを高めている
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、エキゾチックペット取引に伴う人獣共通感染症リスクに関する一般的な啓発・解説記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症流行事例ではなく、野生動物・エキゾチックペット取引全般に伴う人獣共通感染症（オウム病、結核、エボラ、HIVなど）のリスクについての一般論的な特集記事。具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Balaghat Children Deaths
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, has recorded at least 44 tribal child deaths in recent months due to malaria, measles, malnutrition and related illnesses. Rahul Gandhi, Leader of the Opposition, spent about an hour with Baiga families, including those who lost children, criticizing what he framed as a total government failure. He visited Mate government primary school and the Jagla area, examining mid-day meals and pressing for urgent action on healthcare, education and employment. Gandhi urged resolution of land rights, MGNREGA and the Forest Rights Act, and pledged that his party would assist affected communities if elected. The visit spotlights tribal grievances of neglect as malaria and other illnesses continue to affect children in Balaghat.

triage.headline_ja: バラガート郡の子供死亡事件
triage.triage_reason: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州の部族地域で麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調による子供44人の死亡が報告され、政治的関心も高まっているため。
triage.notes: 本記事は政治的視察（野党指導者の訪問）を中心に報じているが、麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調による子供の死亡という公衆衛生上の懸念が背景にあり、感染症（麻疹）の流行しやすさや医療体制の脆弱性が示唆される。続報でのアウトブレイク詳細確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Brodowski (SP) investiga surto de problema de pele incomum - 01/10/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brodowski (SP) investigates outbreak of an unusual skin condition - October 1, 2026.
article.articleSummary: 127 people in Brodowski, São Paulo, sought public health care from Sept 25 to Oct 1 for itching and red skin patches; about 60% are children. Vila Nossa Senhora das Graças neighborhood accounts for most cases. Health teams monitor all patients; no worsening or new symptoms reported. Skin scrapings were sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz; results are expected by Oct 2, but the state reference lab requested epidemiological surveillance reports, potentially delaying diagnosis. Early diagnoses included scabies, but officials say human scabies is unlikely now; measles has been ruled out due to absence of fever. A recent pest-control spraying occurred in a nearby sewage-treatment lagoon, where mosquito larvae were found; warm weather is cited as contributing to vector proliferation. As a precaution, 13 municipal schools were closed for cleaning; classes resume on Monday, Oct 5 (with the class council) and Tuesday, Oct 6. The intersectoral situation room remains active, and case-investigation forms have been prepared; authorities will act on lab results with safety as priority.

triage.headline_ja: ブロドウスキー（サンパウロ州）、原因不明の皮膚症状アウトブレイクを調査（2026年10月1日）
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の集団皮膚症状（127人、うち60%が子ども）で学校閉鎖措置がとられ、麻疹・疥癬は否定的、蚊媒介性の可能性が検討中であり、WPRO基準（異常性・曝露継続）に該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確定（皮膚擦過検体の検査結果待ち）。蚊幼虫が付近の下水処理ラグーンで発見されており、ベクター媒介性皮膚疾患の可能性が示唆されているが、確定診断前であり続報を要する。
